But when Shabbos arrives — and the sacred vitality of the light of the good point in each person of Israel begins to shine and flash — then he understands and sees from afar that everything is worthwhile — for the sake of one single good point — to give nachas to his Father in Heaven. And: "leis re'useh tav d'is'avid" — and in the end G-d, blessed be He, will complete what is His own with each person of Israel — until all of them will truly rise to the scale of merit — and will merit the fullness of their ultimate purpose — until the honor of Heaven is magnified through them. And therefore one should rejoice greatly in His acts, blessed be He — in the aspect of: "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" — and so on — as mentioned above. And this is what the Sages concluded there: "v'achshav shenevra — yefashpesh b'ma'asav" — that is, he should examine and separate his deeds — so that good and evil should not be mixed together — until the excellence of the good is not recognizable because of the abundance of the evil. Rather — he should separate and distinguish the evil alone — and the good points that are found in him should also be alone. And he should revive himself and rejoice in them greatly. And then — the small good within him will outweigh all the evil — until he merits complete repentance. And the evil within him will fall and be nullified entirely — and the good within him will grow and bloom like a palm tree and a cedar — "od yinuvun b'seivah — deshanim v'ra'ananim yihyu." And there is another version: "v'amri lei — yemashmesh b'ma'asav" — that is, before he does something — he should feel it carefully to see whether it is good or evil — and he should assess in his mind the greatness of the Creator, blessed be He, and the great harm of a transgression, heaven have mercy. And likewise the opposite — the great excellence of the commandment — until every single good point is very precious — beyond all measure. And then he will certainly always walk in the good path. And this [Psalms 92:6]: "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem — me'od amku machshevosecha" — that is, likewise in the aforementioned matter — there is such great depth — that it is impossible to explain at all the depth of the matter within this. And as understood somewhat also in Likutay Halachos. And around this revolves and goes the entire subsequent matter of the psalm — and it explains how the success of the wicked is only for the moment — a brief instant — and in the end they are spent and lost. And the success of the righteous is eternal — and they produce fruit and their stump replenishes — like the palm tree and the cedar — and so on. And this is in general. And from this one can understand also in particular: that the essential matter is to strengthen oneself in complete faith — in His abundant lovingkindness and goodness and the greatness of His compassion, blessed be He — and to feel deeply sorry for having rebelled against His honor, blessed be He — even for some blemish however small — for who can assess the harm of even a minor transgression, heaven have mercy. And likewise the opposite — to strengthen oneself and greatly rejoice one's soul in every single good point. And then one will certainly merit complete repentance — and the evil within him will fall and be nullified entirely — and the good within him will grow and bloom like a palm tree and a cedar — "od yinuvun b'seivah — deshanim v'ra'ananim yihyu."

And this is what is explained in the writings regarding [Psalms 92]: "M'zmor Sh'ir l'Yom haSh'abas" — initial letters — למש"ה — and so on — for then Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him, together with other Tzadikim with him — are engaged in elevating the souls of the living and the dead — who fell to the depths of the husks, heaven have mercy — as mentioned above. For this was the service of Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him, in his lifetime — and also now — to search out and find the good within each person of Israel — and to judge each person favorably. And the essential fullness of this matter is done through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And this [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Yisrael" — and it is explained in Zohar Vayakhel, folio 195: "begin d'havu Erev Rav beinaihu — itzterich Moshe l'achnasha lon — v'leyachda lon mibeinhaihu" — see there at length. And this is likewise in the aspect of the aforementioned. For at first they were mixed with the Erev Rav — (which is the aspect of the good being mixed together with much evil — and this caused them the sin of the golden calf). And therefore afterward — Moshe separated them from the Erev Rav — and gathered them together — that is, he gathered and collected together all the good points of the holiness of Israel within them. And then they were commanded regarding the work of the Mishkan — for from these good points the Mishkan was built — as also understood within in this teaching — and as likewise explained in Likutay Halachos. And they were also commanded regarding the warning of Shabbos — for the work of the Mishkan does not override Shabbos — for on the contrary — all the essential power to gather and clarify the good points that are in Israel — and to build the Mishkan through this — all of it flows from the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And see in Likutay Halachos, Halachos Techum Shabbas — where this matter of the holiness of Shabbos is explained according to this teaching in wondrous things.

segments.he: ומחמת שלפעמים יש שהסט"א מתגברת לינק מן הרחמנות עד שעי"ז נפגם הדעת ועי"ז בא ח"ו תאוות ניאוף ואז א"א להתפלל בבחי' רחמים ותחנונים רק צריכין בעל כח גדול שיתפלל תפלה בבחי' דין ואז הסט"א שעיקר יניקתה הוא מבחי' דינים ומוחין דקטנות רוצה לבלוע התפלה הזאת שהוא מבחי' דין.
segments.en: And see within: it is explained regarding the matter of: in every generation there is a shepherd — and he is the aspect of Moshe — who is the faithful shepherd. And this shepherd builds a Mishkan. And know: the children of the house of the teacher receive the breath of their mouth — in which there is no sin — from this Mishkan — and so on — see there. And this is the aspect of the passage [Numbers 7:1]: "vayehi b'yom kalos Moshe l'hakim es haMishkan" — and so on — concluding: "u'v'vo Moshe el Ohel Mo'ed l'daber ito — vayishma es haKol midaber eilav — mibein shney haKeruvim — vayedaber eilav" — and so on. And it is known and brought in the Introduction of the Zohar, folio 1: for the Keruvim are the root of the aspect of the children of the house of the teacher — for this is the aspect of "keruvim k'ravya [cherubs — like children]" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. For Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him, is the aspect of: entirely good — as it is written [Exodus 2:2]: "ki tov hu" — and he had a quality like this — that all the good points in Israel yearned to be encompassed within him. For this is the aspect of: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" — as mentioned above. And therefore he was able to clarify every good point that is in each person of Israel — and to elevate him through this to the scale of merit — until each person — according to his good point — contributed to the Mishkan. And from this were made all the matters of the Mishkan. And [Numbers 7:1]: "vayavi'u es haMishkan el Moshe" — and [Exodus 40:18]: "vayakem Moshe es haMishkan" — for only he was able to erect it — for he was the true public prayer leader [shali'ach tzibbur] — who was encompassed within him all the good points of all the congregation — as mentioned above. And from the aspect of this Mishkan — which is entirely good — from there the children receive the breath of their mouth that has no sin — that is, it is likewise entirely good — with no mixture of evil at all — since they have no sin yet. Which is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Shabbos 119]: the breath of the mouth that has no sin is not comparable to the breath of the mouth that has sin.

segments.he: אך מחמת שהתפלה הזאת יצאתה מבעל כח גדול ע"כ היא עומדת בבית הבליעה של הסט"א עד שמוכרחת ליתן הקאות ולהחזיר כל הקדושות שבלעה אף גם מוכרחת להוציא ולהקיא עצמות חיותה ממש.
segments.en: And behold — it is known what Rashi of blessed memory explained — and our Sages of blessed memory likewise taught — regarding what Lot said: "pen tidbakeni hara'ah" — when I was among the people of Sodom — I appeared righteous — and when I come next to a righteous person — I appear as wicked. And likewise the woman of Tzarfas said to Eliyahu — and so on. It follows that accordingly — on the contrary — when the Tzadik is entirely good — the good points that are in one's fellow — and are mixed together with much evil — might be even more nullified relative to the goodness of the Tzadik — (who is entirely pure and clear) — until they are not seen or recognizable at all — as mentioned above. But in truth — it is only Lot and the woman of Tzarfas who were concerned about this — perhaps it will be so. And perhaps there is sometimes some aspect in this manner as well. Therefore — the essential tikkun is through a Tzadik of this kind — who is the aspect of Moshe our teacher — who was exceedingly humble above all people — and so on. And who was able to conceal and hide the good within him so greatly — until no accusation at all was aroused through him, heaven forfend, against the good of his fellow — which does not yet have complete fullness. But on the contrary — the light of the good point within each person of Israel shines and illuminates even more — even if it does not yet have fullness. And because of this itself — all the good points yearn and anticipate to be encompassed within him — as mentioned above. And something like this is brought in the holy books — and is also understood from his teachings of blessed memory in many places. And perhaps this is the aspect of the small Aleph of Vayikra. And something like this is explained in Zohar Vayechi, folio 234b: "tu — Aleph ze'ira — me'atar ze'ira havah — ze'ira d'ihu rav b'ischabrutei l'eila" — and so on. And this is something like what we explained above — that specifically through the recognition of some part of the immensity of His greatness, blessed be He, — until one knows that all the great service of the greatest of the great is absolutely nothing and literally null before the immensity of His greatness, blessed be He — but because of the greatness of His compassion and lovingkindness — He wishes to receive nachas and pleasures from lowly human beings specifically. And then one knows likewise that on the contrary — His compassion, blessed be He, is so abundant — that every good point of the most lowly among Israel — its excellence is great and awesome beyond all measure — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזהו בחי' גרים שמתגיירין וכו' ומזה היה בחי' יציאת מצרים וקריעת י"ס כמובן בפנים. וכבר מבואר במ"א שענין מס"נ על קדושת השם הוא ג"כ בבחי' התפלה שבבחי' דין הנ"ל ושזה היה ג"כ ענין מכירת יוסף למצרים ועמד שם דייקא בנסיון גדול. ואח"כ כתיב ויישם בארון במצרים ואח"כ היה קריעת י"ס בזכות ארונו של יוסף וכו'. וע"כ קדושת שבת הוא ג"כ מהדברים שמסרו ישראל נפשם עליהם כשארז"ל ומבואר בכוונות ועל מנוחתם יקדישו את שמך שצריך לכוון לקבל על עצמו מסירות נפש. כי עי"ז מכניעין הסט"א ביותר עד שזוכין עי"ז להשלים את התפלה בשלימות גדול ע"י קדושת שבת כנ"ל. וזה בעצמו ג"כ ענין זכור ושמור הנאמר בשבת. כי זכור בחי' דכורא שהוא בחי' מדת הרחמים כידוע היינו בחי' התפלה שהוא בבחי' רחמים ותחנונים. וע"כ כתיב בו כי ששת ימים עשה ה' וכו'. והבריאה היתה ע"י בחי' חסד ורחמים בחי' עולם חסד יבנה וכשארז"ל שיתף מדת הרחמים וכו'. ושמור הוא כנגד בחי' נוקבא בחי' דין כידוע היינו שלימות התפלה ע"י התפלה שבבחי' דין הנ"ל וע"כ כתיב שם וזכרת כי עבד היית בארץ מצרים וכו'. כי יציאת מצרים היה ג"כ ע"י בחי' זאת הנ"ל.
segments.en:
And behold — all the clarifications that are made through the weekday pursuits of the six days of deed — are in the aspect of the work of the Mishkan. And all is done through the power of the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And from there — from the aspect of this Mishkan — the children receive [their portion] — for this is the aspect of the fact that one begins with the child by learning from [Leviticus 1:1]: "Vayikra el Moshe" — as explained within. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: one teacher should not teach more than twenty-five children — twenty-five — specifically — corresponding to the twenty-five letters that are in the verse Vayikra — (from the word vayedaber to the end of the verse — that is, the word leimor) — and it is explained in the holy Zohar that these twenty-five letters correspond to the twenty-five letters in the verse Shema Yisrael. And therefore it is explained in the Zohar that the twenty-five children mentioned above are likewise corresponding to the twenty-five letters in Shema Yisrael. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Nedarim 37 — and brought in Shulchan Aruch, Yoreh De'ah, Siman 245, paragraph 14]: one does not teach children on Shabbos something new that they have not yet learned — because of the burden of Shabbos [tirchah d'Shabbas]. But what they have already read once — they review for them on Shabbos. And this is as mentioned above. For Shabbos is the aspect of the ultimate purpose of heaven and earth — as it is written [Genesis 2:2]: "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" — and so on — which is likewise the aspect of the completion of the work of the Mishkan — in the aspect of [Exodus 35:2]: "sheshes yamim ta'aseh melachah — u'vayom hashevi'i" — and so on — for the image of the Mishkan is like the image of the act of Bereishis [creation]. And our Sages of blessed memory taught: on the day the Mishkan was erected — the entire world was erected with it — and so on. And then immediately — the children come and receive from the aspect of the erecting of the aforementioned Mishkan. For this is the aspect of what they read in the Torah on Shabbos — for then all of them are in the aspect of children of the house of the teacher — for the breath of their mouth that has no sin — for each one receives an extra soul — a new higher-soul — and is like a small child who was born — and he is forgiven all his sins through the guarding of Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And then all of them receive the sacred havalim of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the breath of the mouth that has no sin — as mentioned above many times. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: Shabbosim were given only for Torah study — for then is the essential fullness of the study — since the breath is the breath of the mouth that has no sin. But nonetheless — since the essential breath of the mouth that has no sin that they receive from the aspect of the Mishkan — is with actual children — whose breath of the mouth has literally no sin at all in its plain sense — since they have no sin yet — therefore one should not teach new things with them on Shabbos because of the burden of Shabbos.

And it would thereby blemish, heaven forfend, the holiness of Shabbos — from which is all the power and the root of the matter of the erecting of the Mishkan — as mentioned above. Only — what they have already read once — one reviews for them on Shabbos. For what they have already read in the weekday — this was from the aspect of the erecting of the Mishkan of the previous Shabbos. Therefore — this will not blemish, heaven forfend, the holiness of this Shabbos. And therefore likewise — the matter of the prayer leader [chazan] who sees where the children are reading — as explained within — is stated likewise regarding Shabbos. For from there is the root of the learning of the children — as mentioned above. And this is what they concluded: but he should not read — for the entire matter of what he is a chazan and a shali'ach tzibbur — and all the good points of Israel are encompassed within him — and he comes and prays with them — and so on — all of this is because — from the immensity of his humility — it never occurs to him at all — the immensity of the excellence of the holiness of the good within him — but on the contrary — he is exceedingly humble above all people — and so on — as mentioned above. For if he were to begin to make use of the great power of the good within him — then perhaps on the contrary — the good points in the rest of Israel would become even more hidden and nullified — in the manner of: "bast eilai l'hazkir es avoni" — as mentioned above. But because he is exceedingly humble — because of the immensity of his attainment — until it seems to him that the good within his fellow is even more praiseworthy — since his mind is not yet complete — and nonetheless there is such good within him — and therefore he is the shali'ach tzibbur and prays only through the connection to the congregation — and arouses and illuminates the merit of their good point even more each time — until the aspect of a Mishkan is built from this — and from there the children receive — as mentioned above. And this is likewise only because of the aforementioned — for had he made use of the power of the good within him — then the learning of the children would not have had such importance. For even though it has no sin — but nonetheless their mind is not yet complete — since they are still small — and what will all the good within them amount to compared to the service and the learning of the aspect of Moshe himself — who certainly has no sin — and has completely and wondrously complete Da'as at the utmost level? But since — on the contrary — the more one attains the fullness of Da'as — the more one comes through this very thing to even greater humility — until the good within him is not considered at all in his own eyes — and he seeks only a free gift — and gathers and arouses the good within all of Israel — and clarifies it from within the evil and the dross literally, heaven have mercy — and builds from this the Mishkan. And from there specifically the children receive — for then certainly there is great importance to their learning — since they have no sin. And even though their mind is not yet complete — on the contrary — through this he considers the good within them even more praiseworthy — since they are still small — and their mind is not yet complete — and nonetheless there is such good within them. And therefore — the essential completion of the erecting of the Mishkan — which was on the eighth day of the consecration — was on the first day of the week — which is Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. For all of it was through the power of the previous holy Shabbos. And since every true Tzadik in the generation is the aspect of a shepherd — and builds the aspect of a Mishkan — and from there the children receive — and so on — and it has already been explained that the essential matter is done through the holiness of Shabbos. And on Shabbos — all of Israel are in the aspect of children of the house of the teacher — as mentioned above. And therefore it is especially propitious to be with true Tzadikim on the holy Shabbos. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe" — that it is a commandment to gather congregations on every Shabbos — and to expound words of Torah to them — and this is as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזהו שמבואר בזוה"ק שענין שבת הוא תיקון על מכירת יוסף למצרים שהיה ג"כ בבחי' זו כנ"ל. וע"כ כשחללו שבת ויצאו ללקוט ביום השביעי מיד ויבא עמלק כמו שארז"ל כי עיקר הכנעת עמלק הוא ע"י התפלה שהוא בבחי' דין הנ"ל שמקבלת כח מקדושת שבת לעמוד בבית הבליעה של הסט"א ולהכניע אותה. כי עיקר הכנעת הסט"א הוא ע"י קדושת שבת כי כדין יתפרדו כל פועלי און וכמבואר בזוה"ק. וע"י התפלה הנ"ל נעשין גרים ונתגדל כבודו ית'. וזה בחי' כבוד שבת.
segments.en: Note — end of Siman 282: (From the words "And see within: it is explained regarding the matter" — and so on — this was written only as general discussion [pilpula b'alma] — for I have no business with such fine and spiritual matters.) — Tushlab"a [thus far Part One of Yikara DiShabsa].

segments.he: והכבוד הוא שורש הנפשות שזה בעצמו ג"כ בחי' קדושת שבת שהוא שורש נפשות ישראל בחי' שבת וינפש וכשארז"ל.
segments.en:
✦ Translator's Summary — Simanim 178–282
 
 Siman 178 — Verbal confession / joy of Shabbos / Tikkun 21 / unity of voice and speech: Tikkun 21 (folio 57) cited (Aramaic): "leis pikuda d'aseh v'lo ta'aseh d'lo ishtech b'Shabbas" = therefore Shabbos equivalent to entire Torah. Must rejoice very greatly. Nature of sins = draws anxiety = "edaig mecha'tati." When entering joy of Shabbos = Shabbos = complete stature = totality of all commandments → blemishes of sins come to confuse joy. In particular: Shabbos = sacred speech (Zohar Bereishis 32); blemish of sin in the soul = aspect of speech (within). Even though Shabbos holiness covers over everything ("kol hame'aneg es haShabbas mochalin lo / afilu aved avodah zarah mochalin lo") → through this: one remembers all one's blemishes → can make verbal confession in fullness → speech rectified and built → yichud Kud'sha B'rich Hu u'Shechinteih = secret of holiness of Shabbos (Tikunim and Zohar). Psalm 92: "tov lehodos" = Sages: from language of viduy devarim = through which speech rectified = Malchus = merit to hear voices from above; "v'lezamre lishimcha elyon"; "lehagid baboker chasdecha" = Ze'ir Anpin d'Atzilus (kavannos); "v'emunascha baleilos" = Malchus d'Atzilus → yichud Kud'sha B'rich Hu u'Shechinteih = unity of voice and speech (kol v'dibur); touches on the secret of hearing the sound of musical instruments; "alay asor v'alay navel alay higgayon b'chinor"; "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" = aspect of joy; "b'feroa'ch resha'im / ki hinneh oyevecha yovadu / vatarem kir'em karni" = in general; and also in particular: blemishes of sins come to confuse joy = all work of the adversary; but on the contrary: specifically through this is the essential subjugation and nullification of them = through this one remembers them and makes verbal confession over them explicitly → everything rectified in fullness. Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = source of supernal and very wondrous joy = Zohar Vayikra 133 cited (Aramaic): "sos asis b'Hashem b'Atik Yomin is'mar d'ha hu chedvasa d'chola"; "hirkavticha" = full ascent of Malchus = destroys buildings of Sitra Achra (built through one's blemishes) and builds sacred speech = ascent of sacred Malchus; "nachalas Yaakov = Ze'ir Anpin" = voice = "kol kol Yaakov" = voice unified with speech; "ki pi Hashem diber" = yichud Kud'sha B'rich Hu u'Shechinteih = speech unified with G-d = cross-references to Siman 78 and Siman 94.

 Siman 179 — Shabbos = peace / charity on Erev Shabbos / fasting on Erev Shabbos / delight of Shabbos superior to a thousand fasts / extra soul = will / tachyas hamaysim: Shabbos = peace (Sages) → must give charity for Shabbos = "marbeh tzedakah marbeh shalom." SA OC 249: way of people of deed = fast on every Erev Shabbos; also: everyone must not establish a new meal on Erev Shabbos = aspect of a fast → through fasting: strife nullified and peace made. In truth: delight of Shabbos itself more propitious than a fast and more than this (elsewhere). Midrash Tanchuma Bereishis: "kevod Shabbas adif me'elef tani'yos." Virtue of fasting = nullify one's will before G-d's will (within). Shabbos even more propitious = extra soul of Shabbos = "nefesh" is an expression of will (within) = then each person of Israel merits good and holy wills (many times). "V'taher libbenu l'ovdecha be'emes / v'hanchilenu b'ahavah u'v'ratzon Shabbas Kodshecha." Sages: guardian and delighter of Shabbos = decrees and G-d fulfills = all desires of his heart = essential perfection of peace = nothing done to him against his will. Joy of Shabbos = when there is peace → joy and gladness. Shabbos = aspect of tachyas hamaysim = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu." Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = after the resurrection = Daniel 12:13. Essential vitality of holiness of all weekdays comes from Shabbos = "zachor es yom haShabbas / zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas." Shammai ate all his days in honor of Shabbos = so all the vitality he received through eating would be only from Shabbos. Through Shabbos: stature of joy is built = new sacred vitality and joy drawn upon entire creation = "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" (Psalm 92). Sages on Psalms 139:16: "yamim yotzaru v'lo echad bahem" = this is the Shabbos day = vitality of all of them.

segments.he: וע"י התגלות הכבוד עי"ז בא התפשטות הנבואה שזה בחי' הרוה"ק שזוכה כ"א לקבל בשבת כמבואר בזוה"ק. וזה בחי' אין הנבואה שורה אלא על חכם גיבור ועשיר כי כל אלו הם בבחי' כבוד כמבפ"נ ולענינינו אפשר לומר שזה בחי' עליית המלכות בבחי' נה"י חג"ת חב"ד כמבואר בכוונות שבת. כי המלכות הוא בחי' כבוד בחי' מלך הכבוד. ובחי' הכבוד של עשירות הוא בחי' נה"י כי העשירות הוא בחי' רגלין בחי' ואת היקום אשר ברגליהם. והגבורה הוא בחי' חג"ת בחי' ידין בחי' ובידך כח וגבורה וכתיב לך זרוע עם גבורה תעוז ידך וכו'. והחכמה הוא חב"ד וזה בחי' ויבא יעקב שלם ודרז"ל שלם בגופו ובממונו ובתורתו היינו בחי' חכם גבור ועשיר הנ"ל ויחן את פני העיר ודרז"ל ששמר את השבת והתגלות הכבוד הנ"ל הוא בחי' זריחת השמש ועי"ז בא רפואה כ"ש וזרחה לכם יראי שמי שמש צדקה ומרפא כמבפ"נ. וע"כ דרז"ל פסוק זה לענין שומרי שבת. וזה ג"כ בחי' שבת הוא מלזעוק ורפואה קרובה לבא. וזריחת השמש הנ"ל בא ע"י סליחת העון שבא ע"י ריבוי התפלות וכו'. וזה בחי' משארז"ל על השומר שבת שמוחלין לו על כל עוונותיו.
segments.en: Siman 188 — Shabbos = returning of lost objects / the one thousand lights / Moshe restores the crowns / the Tzadik as shofar: Shabbos = returning of lost objects (Ari z"l writings): they restore to Moshe our teacher the one thousand lights that were taken from him; Moshe restores the crowns taken from Israel. Also plain: "keivan she'shavas vav avdah nefesh" = there is a loss for each person; on Shabbos: one's lost object returned = extra soul. "Zachor es yom haShabbas" = opposite of forgetting = opposite of loss. Since one does not return a lost object until one inquires whether he is a deceiver and a liar: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = also aspect of returning the lost object = "im tashiv miShabbas" roshei teivos emes (writings). Therefore essential time to come to the Tzadik = reclaim one's lost object. Must receive the face of one's teacher on Shabbos (Zohar). Aspect of the tekiyos blown on Erev Shabbos = "b'yom hahu yitaka b'shofar gadol u'va'u ha'ovdim" (Isaiah 27:13) = returning of the lost objects.

segments.he: ועיקר שלימות התפלה הוא ע"י שניתוסף שכן מישראל וזה בחי' מעלת קדושת הקיבוץ של ישראל כי ג' אבנים בונות ששה בתים ד' אבנים בונות כ"ד בתים וכו' כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' ויקהל משה את כל עדת ב"י ואז הזהירם על מלאכת המשכן שהוא בחי' כי ביתי בית תפלה ונבנה דייקא ממה שנתקבץ מנדבת לב של כל ישראל ואז הזהירם ג"כ על ענין שבת. כי כלל ענין הקיבוץ הק' של כלל ישראל והשכנים שניתוספין עליהם שזה בחי' הגרים שנעשין ע"י התפלה בבחי' דין הנ"ל הכל נמשך רק מכח קדושת שבת וזה ואל יאמר בן הנכר הנלוה על ה' (היינו בבחי' תוספות השכנים הנ"ל) הבדל יבדילני ה' מעל עמו. היינו שא"א לו להכלל בכלל הקיבוץ של ישראל בכדי שעי"ז יתוספו ריבוי של בתי התפלה ביותר. ואל יאמר הסריס הן אני עץ יבש כי זה עיקר מצוות פריה ורביה בכדי שיתרבו ביותר נפשות ישראל שעי"ז נתרבין בתי התפלה ביותר וכמבואר בליקוטי הלכות. אבל הסריס שאין לו בנים יוכל לומר שהוא עץ יבש ח"ו. כי כה אמר ה' לסריסים אשר ישמרו את שבתותי וכו' ונתתי להם בביתי ובחומותי (דייקא היינו בחי' הבתים הק' הנ"ל) יד ושם טוב מבנים ובנות כו' כי מאחר שכל התיקון נמשך ע"י קדושת שבת נמצא מאחר שהם זהירים בזה ביותר ממילא יש להם חלק גדול ביותר בענין הבתים הנ"ל ובני הנכר הנלוים על ה' וכו' כל שומר שבת מחללו וכו' והביאותים אל הר קדשי ושימחתים בבית תפלתי עולותיהם וזבחיהם לרצון וכו' היינו בחי' שלימות התפלה הנ"ל עד שהוא במקום קרבן ומכפרת עוונות כמובא בפנים על פסוק זה בעצמו. וזה כי ביתי בית תפלה יקרא לכל העמים נאום ה' מקבץ נדחי ישראל עוד אקבץ עליו לנקבציו כי ע"י ריבוי בתי התפלה נתכנסין ונתקבצין כל נדחי ישראל (שהם בבחי' תשתפכנה אבני קודש בראש כל חוצות) ג"כ אל הבתים הנ"ל וכן ג"כ הגרים כנ"ל. וזה בחי' משארז"ל ויקהל משה וכו' שמצוה להקהיל קהלות בכל שבת ולדרוש בד"ת קהלות דייקא כי אז מאיר קדושת הקהלה והקיבוץ של ישראל ביותר כנ"ל.
segments.en: Siman 225 — Shabbos = ru'ach chayyim in kanfey re'iyah / extra soul and sacred mochin / trust / charity / speech / Psalm 92: Shabbos = ru'ach chayyim in wings of the lungs (explained above) = essential sustaining of the intellect = neshamah. Therefore on Shabbos: extra soul and sacred mochin. Through this: trust = "luvu alai va'ani porei'a." Through this: charity = fullness of charity of Shabbos; delight of Shabbos itself = aspect of charity (many times). Through this: comes to the level of a person = aspect of speech = "v'daber davar" stated regarding Shabbos (Zohar many times). Until: merits to make words from sound of chirping and hear words from sound of the harp (within). "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas tov lehodos laHashem" = through sacred words opened then; "lehagid baboker chasdecha" = "lehagid" = milah d'chochmata = fullness of intellect and mochin = lovingkindnesses; "v'emunascha baleilos" = strengthening trust even in darkness; "alay asor / alay higgayon b'chinor" = merits to make words from sound of the harp.

segments.he: וע"י התפשטות הנבואה הנ"ל עי"ז נתברר המדמה ונתתקן האמונה אמתיית דקדושה ונתבטל אמונות כוזביות. ויש עשרה מדריגות בנבואה והם כנגד עשרת הדברות וכו' ועי"ז זוכין להאמין בחידוש העולם שהכל ברא ה' בעשרה מאמרות וכו' וזה בחי' קדושת שבת שכל עיקר יסודו על אמונת חידוש העולם שברא ה' את הכל בעשרה מאמרות ושבת בשבת. ושלימות האמונה הזאת זכו ישראל במעמד הר סיני שאז זכו כל ישראל לנבואת פנים בפנים שזה בחי' הא דהששי שכל העולם הי' תלוי עד ששה בסיון שקבלו ישראל את התורה כמבפ"נ. וזה היה בשבת קודש כיהכל מודים שבשבת ניתנה תורה. וע"כ צריך האדם להקביל פני רבו בשבת כי אעפ"י שבשבת נמשך על כ"א רוח נבואה רוה"ק אבל אעפי"כ בוודאי יש בזה מדריגות רבות.
segments.en:
Siman 234 — Shabbos = world of thought = mochin d'gadlus / songs of Creator's greatness at entry of Shabbos / Havdalah = righteous vs. wicked: Shabbos = world of thought = mochin d'gadlus. At entry of Shabbos: recite psalms of the Creator's greatness (= righteous One of the world) → purity of thought. Psalm 92: "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem me'od amku machshevosecha" = then elaborates at length: stories of success of wicked = only temporary = for their destruction forever; stories of success of righteous = true and eternal — forever. Havdalah: "haMavdil bein Kodesh l'chol / bein or l'choshech / bein Yisrael la'amim" = Israel as a collective are righteous against all the nations = "v'amech kulam tzadikim" (Isaiah 60:21). "Bein yom hashevi'i l'sheshes yemey haMa'aseh" = as mentioned above.

 Siman 250 — Complete Da'as and complete faith on Shabbos / all suffering nullified / Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = light of Providence / tlas guvnin d'eina: On Shabbos: complete Da'as and complete faith = everything conducted only through Providence of G-d → all kinds of suffering and afflictions nullified = "b'yom hani'ach lecha mei'atzevecha u'merogzecha." Also: saved from subjugation of kingdoms = sorrow of exile. Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = day that is entirely Shabbos = then nature entirely nullified = only Providence alone. Also now: through Shabbos holiness one merits to draw light of Providence from the aspect of the final end → Israel elevated above nature → end and conclusion comes to all those who oppress us. "Lo charevah Yerushalayim ela al she'chilellu bah es haShabbas / ilmalai shamru Yisrael Shabbas rishonah lo hayah shum umah v'lashon sholetin bahem / ilmalai shamru shtay Shabbasos miyad nigalin." Midrash Rabbah Beshalach: even through merit of one Shabbos one is redeemed. If all Israel had merited to guard Shabbos in fullness → light of Providence would have flowed in fullness → certain eternal redemption. "Es Shabsosai tishmoru" mostly in plural = through plain guarding of Shabbos one merits to draw light of future Shabbos (= day that is entirely Shabbos). Perhaps this itself = the two Shabbosim. Shabbos = "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" = light of Providence.

segments.he: ועיקר הרוה"ק רוח נבואה ממש הוא אצל הרב המנהיג האמת שהוא בחי' איש אשר רוח בו. והוא בוודאי זוכה בשבת לקבל רוח חדשה רוח נבואה ממש ועי"ז נתברר המדמה ביותר אצל המקורבין אליו וזוכין לקבל פניו בשבת קודש ועי"ז זוכין לקבל הארת קדושת שבת ביותר עד שנשלם גם אצלם האמונה בשלימות ונתבטלין כל מיני אמונות כוזביות שהם בחי' זוהמת הנחש כי בשבת נדחה ונתבטל בחי' זוהמת הנחש כידוע וכמובא במאמר מרכבות פרעה וכו'. וע"כ ארז"ל אפי' עע"ז כדור אנוש מוחלין לו. וע"כ ארז"ל המתפלל בע"ש ואומר ויכלו כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשב"ר. כי עיקר חידוש העולם היה ע"י אמונה כ"ש וכל מעשיהו באמונה וכמבפ"נ ועיקר שלימות האמונה הנ"ל נמשכת ע"י שלימות התפלה הנ"ל שנשלמת ע"י קדושת שבת.
segments.en: Siman 276 — The essential satiety is on Shabbos / three Shabbos meals are to draw bounty on all six days / great Tzadikim feed on spiritual bounty / support Torah scholars / Isaiah 58: Essential satiety on Shabbos = fullness of light of the eyes = "pos'im bo pesi'ah ketanah." Essential satiety = through sight of the eyes (Sages). Three Shabbos meals: "begin d'yisbrechu minei kol shita yomin" (Zohar). Resolution of Zohar's question re no manna on Shabbos: on the contrary = this is the essential blessing = such satiety that no need at all for physical eating and drinking. Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = no eating and drinking. Commandment of eating Shabbos meals = only to draw bounty on weekdays. Manna did not descend on Shabbos; on sixth day = bread for two days for the Shabbos meals. "Chol mekhin l'Shabbas v'ein Shabbas mekhin l'chol." "Vayevarech vayekadesh": blessed = manna on sixth day; sanctified = no manna = to indicate immensity of holiness of Shabbos = aspect of World to Come (no eating for its own sake = only to draw blessing on six days). Great Tzadikim: through whom the entire world is sustained yet they themselves lack sustenance = from the aforementioned reason: their food and sustenance is only from spiritual bounty. Zohar Beshalach 61 (Aramaic) cited: "mezonah ila'ah yatir mikola hu mezonah d'chavrayya — inon d'mishtadlin b'orayta — d'achlei mezonah d'rucha v'nishmata — v'lo achlei mezonah d'gufa klal — v'hiynoo me'atar ila'ah yakira al kola v'itkari chochmah / v'achlei mezonah d'rucha v'nishmata me'atar rachika ila'ah yakira mikola / zakai chulkah d'gufa d'yachil l'is'zanah b'mezonah d'nafsha." They eat only for benefit of the world = to draw bounty and blessing to the entire world → must strongly support Torah scholars and provide for all their needs amply and honorably. "Ain Shabbas mekhin l'chol ela chol tzarich sheychin l'Shabbas." "Kol hamosif mosifin lo." Prohibition of labor on Shabbos: since Shabbos itself has no need for this = laboring on Shabbos for the sake of weekday livelihood = greatly blemishes and desecrates the honor of Shabbos. Sages on Isaiah 56:2: "u'ven adam yachazik bah" = regarding supporters of Torah scholars; juxtaposed: "shomer Shabbas mecha'lelo" = they are in one aspect. Isaiah 58 mapped: "az tis'anag = da se'udasa d'Atika Kadisha"; "hirkavticha = da se'udasa d'Chakla Tupichin Kadishin"; "nachalas Yaakov = da se'udasa d'Ze'ir Anpin." See and look from afar: greatness of awesomeness and wondrous spirituality of holiness of Shabbos meals — how such spiritual matters are clothed in the secret of the plain commandment of eating and drinking — all for benefit of the world = "begin d'yisbrechu minei kol shita yomin."

segments.he: וע"כ המתפלל בע"ש ואומר ויכלו שבזה מגלה ומעיד על אמונת חידוש העולם שעי"ז עצמו היה חידוש העולם כנ"ל ע"כ כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשה בראשית וע"כ המלאכים מניחים ידיהם על ראשו ואומרים וסר עוונך וחטאתך תכופר כי ע"י כל הנ"ל בא ג"כ סליחת עוונות כנ"ל.
segments.en: Siman 277 — Peace and nullification of all enemies / Eretz Yisrael healed / Zohar Vayikra 12 / small steps of Shabbos = tikkun for desecration / the infant who begins to walk: Shabbos = peace = nullification of all enemies and strife = "oyevai yashuvun yevoshu raga" (Psalms 92:10; within). Shabbos = virtue to silence the enemy and the avenger (Siman 57 cross-ref.). Karnayim, teaching Zayin: secret of month of Iyar from secret of Shabbos; "dan yadinenu / a'yovai yashuvun yevoshu raga" = roshei teivos = Iyar. Through Shabbos: earth receives power for all influences and all healings = "eretz nasna yevulah" (Psalms 67:7). Zohar Vayikra 12 (Aramaic): "eimasai is'rabias ar'ah kadisha v'is'atras b'atrah — havi omer b'yom haShabbas — k'din is'chavras kalah b'malka — l'afaka deshayin u'virchan l'alma." "Shabbas hi miliz'ok v'refu'ah kerovah lavo." All judgments sweetened on Shabbos = no grip in sacred dispute = complete Da'as = dispute of Tzadikim only for good = "b'kamim alai mere'im / Tzadik katamar yifrach" (within). Shabbos eating = precious = entirely divinity = entirely holy = great commandment to eat abundantly at Shabbos meals = tikkun for desecration of Shabbos. Desecration of Shabbos = "chalal" = departure; one whose first wife died = steps become shorter; Shabbos = first wife = "Keneses Yisrael yihyeh ben zugcha" → desecration of Shabbos = shorter steps. Honor of Shabbos = small steps; large strides forbidden on Shabbos. Explanation: during weekdays: Sitra Achra draws from legs of commandments = "ragleha yordos maves"; on Shabbos: legs ascend from husks = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" (Ari z"l writings) → commandment begins to walk before G-d. At first = small steps and fine narrow path. Like the parable of the infant beginning to walk = father makes from child's small footsteps a well-trodden path = father makes from every deed of his small child a great thing. Likewise G-d, blessed be He, when commandment begins to walk before Him or when person makes some new path toward G-d = even though at first a fine narrow path = because of immensity of His delight → makes from its small footsteps a well-trodden path. All done through eating of Shabbos = through eating: legs receive strength → from small steps: well-trodden path is made → tikkun for desecration of Shabbos (= shortened steps) → from short steps broad steps are made → from them a well-trodden path is made (all explained within).

segments.he: וע"י אמונת חידוש העולם נמשך קדושת א"י ששם מאיר השגחתו ית' תמיד וכו' כמובא בפנים. וע"כ ארז"ל אם משמרין אתם את השבת תכנסו לארץ ישראל וכו'. וקדושת שבת בעצמה הוא בחי' קדושת א"י כנ"ל כ"פ. וע"כ ארז"ל מזונותיו של אדם קצובין לו מר"ה לבד מהוצאות שבתות וכו' שאם מוסיף מוסיפין לו וכו'. כי ההוצאה של שבת הוא בהשגחה פרטיית תמיד בבחי' א"י כנ"ל. וע"י שלימות האמונה יהיה גם חידוש העולם שלעתיד ואז יהי' כל העולם בבחי' א"י כי אז יתנהג כל העולם ע"י השגחה בלבד שהוא בחי' נפלאות שלא כדרך הטבע. ואז יתער שיר חדש שהוא בחי' השיר שיתער לעתיד שהוא בחי' שיר וניגון של השגחה שהוא בחי' נפלאות. ושיר הזה הוא בחי' שיר פשוט כפול משולש ומרובע וכו' והוא בחי' הקול הנ"ל המשקה את הגן וכו' שעי"ז יכולין להוכיח את ישראל ולהוסיף ע"י התוכחה ריח טוב בנשמתם כנ"ל. וע"כ שבת קודש הוא מעין עוה"ב כי הוא מבחי' חידוש העולם שלעתיד. וע"כ מאיר בו השגחה ונפלאות. כי שבת הוא בחי' תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין שהוא בחי' ראי' והשגחה בחי' עיני ה' אל' בה תמיד. והוא בחי' ביטול ההנהגה של דרך הטבע של מערכת השמים שזה בחי' ויכלו השמים והארץ וכל צבאם ויכלו ממש. ואז נתעורר שיר חדש שהוא מבחי' השיר שלעתיד שהוא שיר של השגחה ונפלאות והוא בחי' שיר פשוט כפול משולש מרובע שהוא יוד אותיות של שם הויה וכו' כמבפ"נ.
segments.en:
Siman 282 — On Shabbos judged favorably / the good point in every person of Israel / joy of Shabbos = zemiros v'nigunnim / Psalm 92 fully expounded / Vayakhel = gathering of good points = Mishkan / Moshe = shali'ach tzibbur = encompasses all good points / children of the house of the teacher = 25 children = 25 letters = Shema Yisrael / end of Part One: On Shabbos: everyone judged favorably = all judgments suppressed (Zohar); good point in every person of Israel shines = even in one completely wicked, heaven forfend. Zohar Chadash Bereishis: no wicked person of Israel without good deeds that bring him to World to Come; when? On day of Shabbos. Midrash Shir haShirim: "shechorah ani b'yemay hachol v'na'avah ani b'Shabbas." Through being judged favorably → truly rises to scale of merit → merits repentance. Shabbos = teshuvah (many times). Sages: "kol hashomer Shabbas v'chol haggid mochalin lo al kol avonasav" = truly rises from scale of guilt to scale of merit. Zohar Shemos 256 (Aramaic): "in one chamber there are those appointed to gladden the world... when the soul is added on Erev Shabbos... they pass over Israel removing from them all sadness and all weariness and all bitterness of soul and all the irritations of the world." Then: all sadness and melancholy repelled → from all the good points flashing and shining: made melodies and tunes (zemiros v'nigunnim) → can pray and sing and praise G-d. Psalm 92 fully expounded through "good points" / "judged favorably" lens: "tov lehodos laHashem v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" = "elyon davka" = G-d is supremely exalted ("ant hu ila'ah al kol ila'in / v'leis machshavah tefisah bei klal") = how G-d constricts His simple will to receive delight from service of Israel even from the greatest; but: "u'vemakom she'atah motzeh gedultaso sham atah motzeh anavtanuso" = wishes specifically for service of the lowly person = "v'avit tehilah megoshah afar" (Isaiah 57:15); even the most lowly must rejoice greatly = caused delight to the Most High G-d through even a small good point; "a small amount of light repels a large amount of darkness"; through one's good point + G-d's compassion + merit of guarding Shabbos = can return with complete repentance; sins can become merits (Sages). "Lehagid baboker chasdecha" = when one merits to feel some illumination and flash = must thank and declare G-d's lovingkindnesses; "v'emunascha baleilos" = even in time of intensification of darkness (plural nights): firm and strong in faith + increase words of faith for oneself and for one's fellow. "Alay asor v'alay navel alay higgayon b'chinor" = melodies and tunes made through this; "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha b'ma'asey yadecha aranen" = when person contemplates his deeds and it seems his sins outweigh his merits = thinks: for what purpose was I created? But when Shabbos arrives = sacred vitality of light of good point begins to shine → understands: everything worthwhile for the sake of one single good point to give nachas to Father in Heaven = "leis re'useh tav d'is'avid"; in the end G-d will complete what is His own with each person of Israel. Sages: "v'achshav shenevra yefashpesh b'ma'asav" = examine and separate deeds so good and evil not mixed together; let good points alone = revive oneself and rejoice greatly in them; then small good will outweigh all evil → complete repentance; evil falls and nullified; good grows and blooms "k'tamar v'erez / od yinuvun b'seivah deshanim v'ra'ananim." Also: "v'amri lei yemashmesh b'ma'asav" = before doing something: carefully feel whether good or evil; assess immensity of Creator's greatness and the harm of transgression and the excellence of commandment → every single good point precious beyond all measure → will always walk in the good path. "Mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem me'od amku machshevosecha" = great depth in this matter; impossible to explain fully. Entire subsequent Psalm 92 revolves around this: success of wicked = only for a moment; success of righteous = eternal; in general and in particular = essential = strengthen in complete faith in G-d's abundant lovingkindness and compassion + feel deeply sorry for any blemish + strengthen and greatly rejoice in every single good point → complete repentance → evil nullified → good grows like palm tree and cedar → "od yinuvun b'seivah deshanim v'ra'ananim yihyu." "Mizmor Shir = l'Moshe" = Moshe together with other Tzadikim engaged in elevating the souls of the living and the dead. "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Yisrael" = Zohar Vayakhel 195 (Aramaic): "begin d'havu Erev Rav beinaihu itzterich Moshe l'achnasha lon v'leyachda lon mibeinhaihu." Before: Israel mixed with Erev Rav = good mixed with much evil = caused sin of golden calf. Afterward: Moshe separated them and gathered together all the good points of holiness of Israel → commanded regarding work of Mishkan = from these good points the Mishkan was built (within; Likutay Halachos) → also commanded regarding warning of Shabbos: work of Mishkan does not override Shabbos = all essential power to gather and clarify good points = to build Mishkan = all flows from holiness of Shabbos. Cross-ref. Likutay Halachos Halachos Techum Shabbas. In every generation: shepherd = aspect of Moshe = faithful shepherd → builds Mishkan → children receive from this Mishkan "haval pihem she'ein bo chet." Passage "vayehi b'yom kalos Moshe l'hakim es haMishkan / u'v'vo Moshe el Ohel Mo'ed / vayishma es haKol midaber eilav / mibein shney haKeruvim vayedaber eilav" (Numbers 7:1). Zohar Introduction folio 1: Keruvim = root of children of the house of the teacher = "keruvim k'ravya" (Sages). Moshe = "ki tov hu" = entirely good → all good points in Israel yearned to be encompassed within him = "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael." Therefore: could clarify every good point in each person of Israel = elevate to scale of merit = each person contributed to Mishkan from his good point. "Vayavi'u es haMishkan el Moshe / vayakem Moshe es haMishkan" = only he could erect it = true shali'ach tzibbur = all good points of all the congregation encompassed within him. From this Mishkan: children receive "haval pihem she'ein bo chet" = entirely good with no mixture of evil. Rashi and Sages on Lot: "pen tidbakeni hara'ah" = when I was among people of Sodom I appeared righteous; when I come next to a righteous person I appear as wicked. And the woman of Tzarfas to Eliyahu. But: the essential tikkun = through a Tzadik who is the aspect of Moshe = exceedingly humble above all people → conceals and hides the good within him so greatly → no accusation against the good of his fellow → on the contrary: light of good point in each person of Israel shines and illuminates even more → all the good points yearn to be encompassed within him. Small Aleph of Vayikra. Zohar Vayechi 234b (Aramaic): "tu Aleph ze'ira me'atar ze'ira havah ze'ira d'ihu rav b'ischabrutei l'eila." Through recognition of some part of the immensity of His greatness → all great service of greatest is nothing before His greatness → but through His great compassion and lovingkindness: receives nachas from lowly human beings → every good point of most lowly among Israel = its excellence is great and awesome beyond all measure. All clarifications of weekday pursuits = aspect of work of Mishkan → all through power of holiness of Shabbos → from aspect of this Mishkan: children receive → aspect of beginning learning with the child from "Vayikra el Moshe" (within). Therefore Sages: one teacher should not teach more than 25 children = 25 = corresponding to 25 letters in verse Vayikra (from "vayedaber" to "leimor"; Zohar: these 25 letters correspond to 25 letters of "Shema Yisrael"; therefore: 25 children also corresponding to 25 letters of "Shema Yisrael"). Sages (Nedarim 37; SA YD 245:14): do not teach children on Shabbos something new that they have not yet learned = because of "tirchah d'Shabbas" [burden of Shabbos]; but what they have already read once: review for them on Shabbos. Explanation: Shabbos = ultimate purpose of heaven and earth = "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" = also aspect of completion of work of Mishkan = "sheshes yamim ta'aseh melachah u'vayom hashevi'i"; "tziura d'Mishkana k'tziura d'uvda d'Bereishis"; Sages: "b'yom she'hukam haMishkan hukam kol ha'olam imo"; then immediately: children come and receive from aspect of erecting of Mishkan = aspect of reading Torah on Shabbos = then all of them in aspect of children of house of teacher = breath of their mouth = "haval peh she'ein bo chet" = each one receives extra soul = new higher-soul = like small child born = forgiven all sins through guarding of Shabbos (Sages). Therefore: "lo nitnit shabbatos ela l'talmud Torah" = then: essential fullness of learning since breath is "haval peh she'ein bo chet." But: essential "haval peh she'ein bo chet" = with actual children literally = therefore: do not teach new things on Shabbos = "tirchah d'Shabbas" would blemish holiness of Shabbos (from which = all power and root of erecting Mishkan). But what they have already read once: review on Shabbos = what they read in weekday = from aspect of erecting of Mishkan of previous Shabbos = will not blemish this Shabbos. Also: the chazan who sees where the children are reading (within) = stated likewise regarding Shabbos = from there is the root of the learning of the children. "But he should not read himself" = because entire matter of being chazan and shali'ach tzibbur = all the good points of Israel encompassed within him = he prays with them = all this because: from immensity of his humility = it never occurs to him at all the immensity of the excellence of the holiness of the good within him = exceedingly humble above all people. If he were to begin to make use of his good → then perhaps other good points would be even more hidden and nullified = "bast eilai l'hazkir es avoni." But because of his immensity of attainment = it seems to him that the good within his fellow is even more praiseworthy (since his mind is not yet complete and yet there is such good within him) → he is shali'ach tzibbur and prays only through connection to the congregation → arouses and illuminates the merit of their good point more each time → Mishkan is built → children receive. Completion of erecting Mishkan = on the eighth day of the consecration = was on the first day of the week = on Shabbos (Sages) = all through power of previous holy Shabbos. On Shabbos: all Israel in aspect of children of house of the teacher (many times). Therefore: especially propitious to be with true Tzadikim on holy Shabbos. Therefore Sages expounded "Vayakhel Moshe" = commandment to gather congregations on every Shabbos and expound Torah to them. (Note at end: from the words "And see within" onward — written only as general discussion — "I have no business with such fine and spiritual matters." — Tushlab"a [end of Part One of Yikara DiShabsa].)

 This completes Part One of Yikara DiShabsa. Part Two (Chelek Beis) begins in the next installment.

segments.he: וזה בחי' מזמור שיר ליום השבת ליום שכולו שבת וכו' בחי' השיר שיתער לעתיד. וזה טוב להודות לה' ולזמר לשמך עליון. כי השיר הזה הוא עליון על כל השירים כי הוא שיר של השגחה ונפלאות שזה בחי' אספרה כל נפלאותך אשמחה ואעלצה בך אזמרה שמך עליון כי ההנהגה של השגחה הוא בבחי' עליון על כל הארץ וכו' כי הוא למעלה מבחי' ההנהגה המלובשת בדרך הטבע. וזה להגיד בבוקר חסדך ואמונתך בלילות. כי התקבצות החסידים שעל ידם יהי' חידוש העולם שלעתיד הכל הוא ע"י שלימות האמונה שבא ע"י בירור המדמה שהוא בחי' לילה כמבואר כ"ז בפנים. וזה עלי עשור כי השיר הזה הוא כלול מעשרה מיני נגינה שהוא בחי' שיר פשוט כפול וכו' שהם עשרה אותיות כנ"ל ורז"ל דרשו עלי עשור עלי לקיים עשרת הדברות ועלי נבל עלי לנבל עצמו עליהם בשעת השמד ר"ל. היינו כי שלימות האמונה ובירור המדמה הנ"ל בא ע"י נבואה שהוא בחי' עשרת הדברות כנ"ל, והתפשטות הנבואה בא ע"י התגלות הכבוד שבא ע"י גרים שנעשין ע"י התפלה בבחי' דין שזה בחי' המס"נ שיש לישראל על דברי תורה וכנ"ל. וזהו כי שמחתני ה' בפעלך וכו' כי השיר הזה הוא שורש כל השמחות דקדושה וכמבואר במ"א ובליקוטי הלכות. וזה מה גדלו מעשך ה' מאד עמקו מחשבותך וכו' בפרוח רשעים כמו עשב וכו' היינו שהסט"א מגבהת עצמה לבלוע התפלות שהן בבחי' דין אבל באמת הוא להשמדם עדי עד. כי ע"י הכח של קדושת שבת אז התפלות הנ"ל ממצין בבית הבליעה של הסט"א עד שמוכרחין דייקא ע"י התפלות הנ"ל שהן בבחי' דין ליתן הקאות ולהחזיר כל הקדושות שבלעו אף גם עצמות חיותם ממש. ואז ממילא הם כלים ונאבדים לגמרי. וזה כי הנה אויביך יאבדו ותרם כראם קרני וכו' (ואפשר שזה ג"כ סוד השלהובא דאשא שיורד בכל ע"ש על ראשי הקליפות שרוצים לעלות ולינק מהקדושה והשלהובא הנ"ל הוא מבחי' גבורות כידוע שזה בחי' התפלה שהוא בבחי' דין ומשפט שהוא בחי' אש כ"ש כי באש ה' נשפט וכמבואר במ"א) בקמים עלי מרעים תשמענה אזני צדיק כתמר יפרח וכו'. כי אדרבא ע"י שהסט"א מתגברת לבלוע את הכל עי"ז דייקא נתרומם קרן הקדושה ביתר שאת ויתר עוז. כי עי"ז נעשין גרים ונתוספין שכנים על הקיבוץ הק' ועי"ז נתרבין הבתים הק' בית שזה בחי' שתולים בבית ה' וכו' וזה ג"כ בחי' מקולות מים רבים אדירים משברי ים אדיר במרום ה' וכו' לביתך נאוה קדש וכו'.
segments.en: נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל ויכל אלוקים ביום השביעי מה היה העולם חסר מנוחה בא שבת בא מנוחה כלתה ונגמרה המלאכה כי עיקר חידוש מעש"ב הוא ע"י אמונה ושלימות האמונה הוא ע"י נבואה ונבואה נקראת מנוחה כמבפ"נ וע"כ כשבא שבת בא מנוחה שהוא בחי' נבואה ואז נשלמה האמונה ע"כ אז כלתה ונגמרה המלאכה ומחמת שע"י נבואה נתברר המדמה שהוא בחי' שינה ע"כ גם השינה של שבת יקרה וקדושה מאד כמובא.
segments.en: Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

segments.he: ומחמת שכל הנ"ל כלול בקדושת ראש השנה כמבפ"נ ע"כ ארז"ל י"ט של ר"ה שחל להיות בשבת וכנ"ל כמה פעמים כי כשחל ר"ה בשבת אז טוב מאד כי אז נגמרין כל התיקונים ביתר שאת ע"י קדושת שבת וזה בחי' התקיעות שהיו תוקעין בכל ע"ש תקיעה הוא בחי' התגלות הכבוד כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' כבוד שבת כנ"ל. תרועה הוא בחי' נבואה בחי' השראת השכינה כמבפ"נ שזה בחי' קדושת שבת כנ"ל וכמבואר בזוה"ק ובתיקונים ועיין זוהר ויקרא ד' קעט. דבגין כך לא זזת שכינה מישראל בכל שבתות וכו'. שברים זה בחי' תיקון האמונה הק' וביטול אמונות כוזביות שזה נמשך בשלימות ע"י קדושת שבת וע"כ ארז"ל אפי' עע"ז וכו' מוחלין לו כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Yikara DiShabsa — Part Two Simanim 1 and 2

 Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Part Two — Chelek Beis · Simanim 1 · 2 (with embedded Siman 4)

segments.he: ומחמת שע"י קדושת שבת זוכין למוחין ודעת והדעת כלול מתלת מוחין שהם בחי' מחיצות פרוסות בפני תאוות ניאוף שזה בחי' מחנה ישראל כמה הוה תלת פרסי' כי זה עיקר קדושת מחנה ישראל בחי' והיה מחניך קדוש כמבפ"נ וע"כ נאמר אצל שבת לדעת כי אני ה' מקדשכם. וע"כ תחום שבת דאורייתא הוא תלת פרסי כידוע היינו כנגד בחי' תלת פרסי הנ"ל.
segments.en: נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת רגלך וכו' אז תתענג על ה' היינו שתזכה לשלימות הדעת והמוחין ששם עיקר הענג כנ"ל כ"פ וזשדרז"ל הוא גוזר והקב"ה מקיים שזה בחי' שלימות התפלה בבחי' דין שהוא כמו בגזירה שגוזר כך עפ"י הדין. וזה והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ זה בחי' ביטול והכנעת הסט"א. וזשדרז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות ועי"ז נעשין גרים שכל זה בכלל והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ. ועי"ז נתגלה כבודו ית' שהוא בחי' שורש נפשות ישראל שמשם באה התפשטות הנבואה. וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך. כי יעקב אבינו הוא שורש נפשות ישראל בחי' הכבוד הנ"ל כמבואר בליקו"א סי' קפא. גם הנבואה הוא בחי' נחלת יעקב שזה בחי' וסלחת וכו' ונחלתנו כמו שפירש"י שם. וזה כי פי ה' דבר דבר ה' זו נבואה כמבפ"נ.
segments.en:
✦ חלק ב · PART TWO ✦

 Siman 1 — סימן א (Part Two)
 Tik'u Memshalah — Shabbos = the ultimate purpose — rule over angels — the Throne — three rectified desires — three journeys of the feet — prophecy — prayer as devar Hashem — the three labors that ruin prayer — Isaiah 58

segments.he: וע"י התפשטות הנבואה עי"ז נתתקן האמונה ונעשה שותף להקב"ה במעש"ב. וזה ג"כ בחי' אז תתענג על ה' הוא גוזר והקב"ה מקיים מאחר שהוא שותף עמו כביכול. וזה בחי' שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה והתענג על ה' ויתן לך משאלות לבך וכשדרז"ל נותנין לו כל משאלות לבו. וזה והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ זהבחי' ביטול אמונות כוזביות שהם בחי' זוהמת הנחש. וע"כ כשעמדו ישראל על הר סיני ופסקה זוהמתן אז נעשו חירות משיעבוד מלכיות כשדרז"ל. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך כפשוטו ממש היינו שיזכה לנחלת א"י כי עיקר ירושת א"י הוא ע"י כח מעשיו הגיד לעמו וכו' היינו ע"י אמונה שלימה בחידוש העולם. וזה כי פי ה' דבר בחי' נבואה כי ע"י התפשטות הנבואה שהוא דבר ה' זו נבואה זוכין להאמין בחידוש העולם שהכל נהיה בדברו כ"ש בדבר ה' שמים נעשו וכו'. ועי"ז זוכין לירושת א"י שהוא בחי' אל הארץ אשר דבר להם. וכן לך נחה את העם אל אשר דברתי לך.
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of the ultimate purpose — for it is the ultimate purpose of the act of heaven and earth. And the ultimate purpose is that Israel should have dominion over angels — and so on — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the angels that accompany the person on Erev Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the world of the Throne — for this is the aspect of: "b'yom hashevi'i nistalah v'yashav al kissay kevodo" — as is well-known. And it is the aspect of the root of all the souls — in the aspect of [Exodus 31:17]: "v'vayom hashevi'i shavas vayinafash" — as mentioned above many times. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the building of Jerusalem — as it is written [Jeremiah 17:24–25]: "v'hayah im shamo'a tishme'u eilai" — and so on — "v'ladesh es yom haShabbas" — and so on — "u'va'u v'sha'arey ha'ir hazos melachim v'sarim — v'yashevah ha'ir hazos l'olam." And our Sages of blessed memory taught: Jerusalem was destroyed only because they desecrated the Shabbos. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of awe that depends upon the heart — for Shabbos is the aspect of the heart — as explained in the Tikunim. And it is the aspect of awe — the aspect of yirey Shabbas — as mentioned above many times. And also — through the holiness of Shabbos — the three desires [ta'avos] are rectified — which are the desire for money [ta'avas mamon] — the desire for eating [ta'avas achilah] — and the desire for sexual union [ta'avas mishgal].

segments.he: וע"י אמונה יהיה חידוש העולם לעתיד ואז יתנהג כל העולם בבחי' השגחה ונפלאות. וזה ג"כ בחי' אז תתענג על ה' שהוא בחי' עוה"ב שהוא עין לא ראתה.
segments.en: For our Sages of blessed memory taught: "birkas Hashem hi sa'ashir" — this is Shabbos — and so on. And this is what it concludes: "v'lo yosif etzev imah [and He adds no sorrow with it]" [Proverbs 10:22]. For the desire for money is the aspect of sorrow [atzvus] — the aspect of: "marbeh nechasim marbeh de'agah [he who increases possessions increases worry]" — for the more wealth he has — the more he lacks. And as explained elsewhere. But the wealth that is drawn through the holiness of Shabbos is in the aspect of: "v'lo yosif etzev imah" — for this is the aspect of the rectification of the desire for money. And also — the essential satiety is on Shabbos — as explained above within — (in Likutay Moharan, Siman 276) — for this is the aspect of the rectification of the desire for eating. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:25]: "icheluhu hayom" — stated regarding Shabbos — and as explained elsewhere regarding the great excellence of the holiness of the eating of Shabbos. And also — then is the essential rectification of the desire for sexual union — for this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:16]: "v'shamru Vnay Yisrael es haShabbas" — the initial letters of which spell ביאה [bi'ah] — as brought. And this is the aspect of the holiness of the sacred union on Shabbos — for then the warmth [chamimus] is rectified — so that it should be in great holiness — in the aspect of the sacred fire [eish d'Kodesh] — and not in the aspect of the weekday fire [eish d'chol] — which is the aspect of [Exodus 35:3]: "lo seva'aru eish" — and so on — stated regarding Shabbos.

segments.he: וזה ג"כ בחי' הוא גוזר והקב"ה מקיים מאחר שיתנהג הכל רק בהשגחה ונפלאות. וזה שדרז"ל בזוה"ק אז תתענג על ה' דא עתיקא קדישא שהוא בחי' פלא עליון ששם שורש כל הנפלאות בחי' בעתיקא תליא מלתא וזה והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין היינו בחי' עליית המלכות דקדושה שהוא בבחי' עקב ענוה יראת ה' כידוע והכנעת המלכות דסט"א שהם מבחי' עקב דסט"א עקב עשו כנ"ל.
segments.en:
And as brought in the Tikunim. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 4:39]: "v'yada'ta hayom v'hashevosa el l'vavecha" — of drawing the Da'as to the heart — for this is the aspect of "zachor" and "shamor" — stated regarding Shabbos — which correspond to the mind [mocha] and the heart [libba] — as explained in the Tikunim. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:13]: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — stated regarding Shabbos — that is, the aspect of the aforementioned drawing down of Da'as. And the Da'as encompasses three mental faculties [mochin] — which are the aspect of the three Festivals [shalosh regalim] — as explained within.

And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: if you guard the Shabbos — I shall give you the Festivals — and so on. And our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who fulfill the Festivals — it is as if they fulfilled the Shabbosim. And likewise — Shabbos is the first of the holy convocations — as mentioned above. And since all the aforementioned attributes — and likewise the awe mentioned above — are the aspect of "shem [Name]" — as explained within — therefore — regarding the reward of one who guards the Shabbos it is stated [Isaiah 56:5]: "shem olam etein lo" — and so on.

segments.he: וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך היינו בחי' הקול קול יעקב שהוא בחי' הקול המשקה את הגן ששם גדילים כל הריחות והיראות. וזה והאכלתיך דייקא. כי עי"ז נתתקן האכילה שתהא בבחי' מזונא דנשמתא בחי' ריח שזה בחי' יעקב בחי' ראה ריח בני כריח שדה וכו' ודרז"ל שנכנס עמו הגן עדן היינו בחי' ריח של הגן השקה ע"י בחי' הקול כנ"ל. וזה כי פי ה' דבר היינו כי עי"ז נתתקן בחי' התוכחה שתהא בבחי' התוכחה של משה בחי' אלה הדברים אשר דבר משה וכמו שפירש"י דברי קהלת כל מקום שנאמר דברי אינו אלא דברי תוכחות וכו'. וע"י תוכחה כזו מוסיפין ריח טוב בהנשמות שזה בחי' כי פי ה' דבר כשארז"ל שכל דבור ודיבור שיצא מפי הקב"ה נתמלא כל העולם בושם וכו' (שבת דף פח).
segments.en: And through the rectification of awe — the flowing of prophecy is drawn — as brought within. And this is the aspect of the holy spirit [Ru'ach haKodesh] that flows upon Israel on Shabbos — as explained in the holy Zohar. And therefore when they asked Hillel the Elder — who had forgotten and not brought a knife from Erev Shabbos — whether this is permitted — (that is, for the sake of the slaughter of the Paschal lamb) — he said to them: I have heard this law but forgot it. Rather — leave it to Israel — if they are not prophets — they are the children of prophets. The next day — and so on [Tractate Pesachim 66] — that is, for through the aspect of the spirit of prophecy that shines upon Israel on Shabbos — through this they knew how to conduct themselves in this matter. And through the flowing of prophecy — prayer is redeemed and released — and so on. And then the entire medical establishment falls — for then there is no need for medicines — for then prayer is in the aspect of the word of Hashem [devar Hashem] — which is the root of everything — and from there healing is drawn — in the aspect of [Psalms 107:20]: "yishlach devaro v'yirpa'em" — and so on — as explained within. And therefore one should not engage in any medical activity on Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "tov lehodos laHashem" — stated in the psalm for the Shabbos day — for then prayer is completed. And this [Psalms 92:2]: "v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — for the complete prayer — which is in the aspect of the word of Hashem — is exalted above everything — for it is the root of all of them. And this is the aspect of: "Shabbas hu miliz'ok — v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" — for through the holiness of Shabbos — healing is drawn in the aspect of: "yishlach devaro v'yirpa'em" — for Shabbos is the aspect of the word of Hashem — which is the aspect of: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos — as brought in Zohar Bereishis, folio 32 — and as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: סימן יב-איה מקום כבודו
segments.en: And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who pray on Erev Shabbos and say Vayechulu — it is as if one became a partner with the Holy One, blessed be He, in the act of creation — and so on. And immediately juxtaposed to this — they stated: from where [do we know] that speech is like deed? As it is stated [Psalms 33:6]: "b'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu." For through the fact that one says Vayechulu — and reveals and testifies to the holiness of Shabbos — through this prayer is completed — until it is in the aspect of the word of Hashem. And through this — it is as if one became a partner with the Holy One, blessed be He, in the act of creation — for it is stated regarding this: "b'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu" — and so on — as explained within. And also — on Shabbos — the three labors that ruin the service of prayer are nullified. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 20:9]: "sheshes yamim ta'avod" — (for then there is a grip [achizah] for the aspect of servitude) — "u'vayom hashevi'i" — and so on — for then all kinds of servitude are nullified — and one merits the sacred service — in the aspect of [Exodus 23:25]: "va'avadetem es Hashem Elokeichem" — which is the aspect of the service of prayer — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:6]: "u'vnay haneychar hanilavim al Hashem" — and so on — "lihyos lo la'avadim — kol shomer Shabbas mecha'lelo" — and so on — "v'simachtim b'veys tefilasi" — that is, the aspect of the fullness of prayer — which is the aspect of the word of Hashem literally — which is the aspect of: "beys tefilasi [My house of prayer]" — specifically — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. For Shabbos is the aspect of the complete rectification of faith — and all the aspects of idolatry are nullified — which is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: even if one worshipped idolatry — and so on — he is forgiven. And as mentioned above many times. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the complete guarding of the covenant [shmirat habris] — as mentioned above many times. And this is the aspect of: "bris olam" — stated regarding Shabbos. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:4]: "kol shomer Shabbas mecha'lelo — u'machzikim b'vrisi" — and so on. And also — Shabbos is the opposite of the aspect of contempt for people [bizzayon anashim] — in the aspect of: "al tehi vaz l'chol adam [do not hold any person in contempt]" — for "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — as brought. For through Shabbos — one merits honor — which is the opposite of disgrace and shame. And this is the aspect of: "me'angeha l'olam kavod yinchalu [those who delight in it shall forever inherit honor]." And then on Shabbos — the holiness of Israel shines and illuminates — even of the most lowly among them — as mentioned above. It follows that on Shabbos all the aforementioned aspects are rectified — which are alluded to in the passage [Exodus 15:26]: "v'hayashar b'einav ta'aseh — v'ha'azanta l'mitzvosav" — and so on — as explained within. And therefore this passage was stated at Marah — where they were commanded regarding Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

segments.he: שבת הוא תכלית מעשה שמים וארץ. והוא עיקר קיום ושלימות של כל הבריאה כולה וכל מה שברא הקב"ה לא ברא אלא לכבודו. ועיקר התגלות כבודו ית' הוא ע"י קדושת שבת בבחי' וביום השביעי נתעלה וישב על כסא כבודו. וזה בחי' כבוד שבת וזה בחי' מענגיה לעולם כבוד ינחלו בחי' כי מכבדי אכבד.
segments.en:
And also — Shabbos is the aspect of: a day of souls and not a day of bodies — and the soul is not nourished except from scent [rei'ach] — for this is the aspect of: "tavlin echad yesh lanu — v'Shabbas shemah — v'rei'cho noded [we have one spice — and Shabbos is its name — and its scent spreads]." And the essential prayer comes from the soul — in the aspect of [Psalms 150:6]: "kol haNeshamah tehallel Yah" — and therefore then is the essential fullness of prayer. And then — all the growth of the field [si'ach hasadeh] — (which grow through rain — and rain is the initials of "mar'eh — ta'am — rei'ach [appearance — taste — scent]" — for they are divided into one another in appearance — taste — and scent — and the essential one is scent — and so on — as explained within) — return their power into the prayer. And this is the aspect of the flashing of Mashiach — as explained within. And this is the aspect of [Jeremiah 17:24–25]: "v'hayah im shamo'a" — and so on — "u'va'u b'sha'arey ha'ir hazos melachim v'sarim yoshvim al kissay David" — and so on. And our Sages of blessed memory taught [Midrash Rabbah Beshalach 25]: had Israel guarded a single Shabbos — the son of David would have come.

And this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 11:14]: "v'nasati metar artzechem b'ito" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: on Shabbos nights — and so on — for then is the essential fullness of the rain through which all the growth of the field mentioned above grows. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: the double bread [lechem mishneh] — which is distinguished in its taste and its scent and its appearance — the aspect of: "mar'eh — ta'am — rei'ach" — mentioned above. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of bearing grace [nesi'as chen] — as explained within. And this is the aspect of [Genesis 6:8]: "v'Noach matza chen." Noach is the aspect of bearing grace — as explained within. And this is the aspect of: "v'Noach matza chen" — Noach is the aspect of Shabbos — as explained in the Tikunim, Tikkun Shiv'in. And through this — one can recognize those who are famous [mefursamim] — who become so through arrogance — for their arrogance falls before him — and so on — as explained within. And this is the expression of Shabbos — as it is written [Leviticus 26:6]: "v'hishbati ga'on azim [and I shall cause the pride of the arrogant to cease]." And through this — one can connect oneself with all the truly famous ones of the generation — who are the aspect of the totality [kelaliut] of the souls of Israel. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" — stated regarding the warning of Shabbos. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the place of the world [mekomo shel olam]. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "al yetzei ish mimekomo" — stated regarding Shabbos — as explained below within in Siman 83. And therefore all judgments are suppressed and do not stir at all then. And then each person is judged favorably according to his place. And this is the aspect of the New Year [Rosh haShana] that falls on Shabbos. And it is brought in the holy books that it alludes to goodness for Israel when Rosh haShana falls on Shabbos — see there the reason. And according to the aforementioned — this is understood by itself — for the fact that the Almighty established for us Rosh haShana on Rosh Chodesh is likewise a great lovingkindness — as explained within. And all the more so — when it also falls on Shabbos — when then all judgments are suppressed — and all are judged favorably — as mentioned above — certainly it is very good. And therefore we conclude the acceptance of Shabbos with the verse [Psalms 93:5]: "l'vayscha na'avah Kodesh Hashem l'orech yamim" — which alludes to the fact that the Almighty is the place of the world — and makes Rosh haShana — which is a long day — because it was established on Rosh Chodesh — and this is because of the immensity of His lovingkindness, blessed be He — Who fulfills for us: "hevei dan es kol adam l'chaf zechus [judge every person favorably]" — as explained within. And since all the aforementioned aspects are encompassed in the shofar — as explained within — therefore they would blow on every Erev Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

segments.he: ובשבת קודש נמשך הארת הדעת הק' על כ"א בבחי' לדעת כי אני ה' מקדשכם. וכן לדעת כי אני ה' אלקיכם ע"כ צריכין להתקשר מאד אליו ית' ולקבל על עצמו בקבלה גמורה שלא יעשה לעולם רק מה שיש בזה כבוד להשי"ת. ואפי' אם נופל ח"ו לספיקות ויש שנפילתו גדולה מאד ר"ל שנופל לספיקות והרהורים גמורים ומהרהר אחר השי"ת אעפי"כ אם יחזיק עצמו בקדושת שבת אז בוודאי סוף כל סוף יעלה מנפילתו ויוכל להיות שהנפילה והירידה תהי' תכלית עלייתו.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — that is, one should rectify the awe — which is the aspect of the leg — as explained below within in Siman 4. And also — the rectification of the three desires — which are money — eating — and sexual union — are likewise the aspect of the leg. Money — as it is written [Numbers 16:33]: "v'es hayekum asher b'ragleihem" — and so on. Eating — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: "dok b'chakei v'tishkach b'nagrei [look well in the stirrup-leathers and you will find in the bags]." Sexual union — as it is written [Ruth 3:7]: "v'rachatz raglav" — and as also explained in the writings. And also — the aforementioned dominion is the aspect of [Psalms 8:7]: "timshilehu b'ma'asey yadecha — kol shatah tachas raglav." And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" — that one should refrain from doing one's pursuits on Shabbos. For Shabbos is the aspect of the word of Hashem — which is the root of everything — and from it all the influences flow to everything. And [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg — v'liKdosh Hashem mechubbad." For since it is the root of everything — and all receive and borrow from it — therefore certainly one must delight it and honor it — so that it should not be in the aspect of: "loveh rasha v'lo yeshalem [the wicked borrows and does not repay]" — heaven forfend.

segments.he: וזה בחי' אשרי אנוש יעשה זאת ובן אדם יחזיק בה שומר שבת מחללו וכו' ודרז"ל אפי' עע"ז כדור אנוש מוחלין לו כי בוודאי ע"י קדושת שבת יזכה לתשובה שלימה עד שיתתקן הכל. כי מי שנופל לספיקות והרהורים הנ"ל שהם בחי' מקומות המטונפים שעליהם נאמר וכבודי לאחר לא אתן אעפי"כ גם שם יש חיות מהבורא ית' רק ששם חיותו וכבודו ית' סתום ונעלם בתכלית העלמה כי הם מקבלין חיות מבחי' מאמר סתום דבראשית שהוא בחי' איה מקום כבודו.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — that is, not to blemish through the three labors that ruin the service of prayer — which are idolatry [avodah zarah] — and sexual immorality [gilui arayos] — and bloodshed [shfichas damim] — as explained within. And all of these are the aspect of: "derech [way/path]" — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded [Midrash Rabbah Vayeitzei]: "v'shamrani b'derech hazeh" — from idolatry — and from sexual immorality — and from bloodshed — and so on — there is no "derech" except idolatry — there is no "derech" except sexual immorality — and so on. And since one must be careful not to blemish through the three aforementioned labors — even in a very fine and subtle manner — as understood within. For presumably one who has merited to rectify the three desires — which are money — eating — and sexual union — and merited the fullness of awe — is certainly completely far from any blemish of idolatry — sexual immorality — and bloodshed — in its plain sense — heaven forbid. Rather — the intent is that one must be careful of some fine error and a very small and subtle blemish that comes from the aspect of the three aforementioned labors in a very fine manner. Therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded here likewise: "mei'asos derachecha" — not to take large strides — which is a subtle blemish of Shabbos. And therefore for a matter of a commandment — it is a commandment to run — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. For the large stride on Shabbos for a discretionary matter is a very fine subtle blemish in the aspect of the three aforementioned labors. For regarding bloodshed — it is stated [Proverbs 1:16]: "ragleihem la'ra yarutzu — yimaharu lishpoch dam" — and regarding sexual immorality — it is stated [Proverbs 6:18]: "raglayim memar'haros laruts l'ra'ah" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded regarding the sotah. And it is stated [Proverbs 19:2]: "v'atz b'raglayim chote" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: this is one who engages in sexual congress and repeats it — and so on — which is the aspect of the subtle blemish of the covenant. Regarding idolatry — Menashe said to Rav Ashi: had you been there — you would have taken hold — and so on — and run after it [Tractate Sanhedrin 102]. And it is stated [Hosea 12:2]: "Efraim ro'eh ru'ach — v'roded kadim" — and so on — and Rashi explained: he associates with idolatry — and so on.

segments.he: כי אי' וכו' הוא בחי' הכבוד העליון של המאמר העליון מכל העשרה מאמרות שהוא מאמר סתום דבראשית וע"כ כשנופל למקומות הנ"ל ומתבונן על עומק נפילתו וצועק ומבקש ומחפש ושואל גם ממקומות הנ"ל אחר כבודו ית' בבחי' איה מקום כבודו עי"ז הוא מדבק עצמו אל בחי' הכבוד העליון הנ"ל שהוא בחי' איה כנ"ל ועי"ז הוא מחי' את נפילתו ועולה משם בתכלית העליה עד שזוכה עי"ז להתגלות כבודו ית'.
segments.en:
And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar" — and our Sages of blessed memory taught: one should not request one's needs on Shabbos — for then awe is in its fullness — and through this all lacks are filled — in the aspect of [Psalms 34:10]: "ki ein machsor lirey'av [for there is no lack for those who fear Him]" — the initials of which spell: מלאך [malach] — which is the aspect of the angel who grants the flowing of prophecy — through which prayer is fully redeemed — as explained within. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: he decrees and the Holy One, blessed be He, fulfills — for one merits the fullness of prayer — which is the aspect of the word of Hashem — which is the root of everything. And therefore they give him all the desires of his heart — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — for one merits that one should have dominion over angels — which are the aspect of: "bamosey aretz." And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits — that is, one merits that one should be in the aspect of the place of the world — and the world is not His place — as explained within. And therefore the image of Yaakov our Patriarch, peace be upon him, is engraved upon the Throne of Honor — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. For the Throne of Honor is in this aspect — as explained within. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — that is, one merits all this through the fullness of prayer — which is the aspect of the word of Hashem — in the aspect of [Isaiah 51:16]: "v'asim devarai b'ficha [and I shall place My words in your mouth]." And the fullness of prayer comes through the flowing of prophecy — for this is the aspect of: "devar Hashem — this is prophecy" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Shabbos 138]. And the flowing of prophecy comes through the fullness of awe — in the aspect of [Isaiah 66:2]: "u'midbaryecha pachad libbi" — and likewise it is written [Jeremiah 10:7]: "hayirei es devar Hashem" — and as mentioned above many times. And the fullness of awe depends on the rectification of the three desires — which are money — eating — and sexual union — whose root in holiness is from the aspect of the word of Hashem. Eating — as it is written [Deuteronomy 8:3]: "ki lo al halechem levado yichyeh ha'adam — ki al kol motza pi Hashem" — and so on — and it is stated [Ezekiel 41:22]: "vayedaber eilai — zeh hashulchan" — and so on. Money — which is the aspect of: "birkas Hashem hi sa'ashir" — and this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 15:6]: "vayevarech eschem ka'asher diber lachem." The sacred union — this is the aspect of [Genesis 24:51]: "meiHashem yatza hadavar" — and it is stated there [Genesis 24:51]: "v'tehi ishah l'ven adonecha ka'asher diber Hashem [and she shall be a wife to your master's son as Hashem has spoken]." And this is what was stated regarding Miriam and Aharon — when they spoke about Moshe for having separated from his wife — [Numbers 12:2]: "harak ach b'Moshe diber Hashem — halo gam banu diber" — and the Almighty answered them: [Numbers 12:8]: "lo chen avdi Moshe" — and so on — "peh el peh adaber bo" — and I told him to separate from his wife. That is — for he merited the word of Hashem at such a supreme level — until he was commanded to separate entirely — for he merited the supernal union [zivuga ila'ah] — as explained in the holy Zohar. And the rectification of the three aforementioned desires is through Da'as. And the essential revelation of Da'as is likewise through the aspect of: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for this is the aspect of [Proverbs 2:6]: "mipihu da'as v'sevunah [from His mouth come knowledge and understanding]."

segments.he: וזה בחי' קרבן עולה שמכפר על הרהור הלב וכו' וזה בחי' תשובה כי זה עיקר התשובה כמובא בפנים.
segments.en:
Siman 2 — סימן ב (Part Two)
 Yemey Chanukah — Shabbos = foretaste of the World to Come — four who must give thanks — the blood flows in order — lechem mishneh — speech of charity / teshuvah / wealth / malchus — the Holy Language and the joy of Shabbos extended to the six weekdays — revelation of simple unity
