And then — the luminaries of light are removed and subdued, heaven forfend — and the luminaries of fire intensify. For this is the aspect of the burning of the Holy Temple — as explained within. And this is what is written [Jeremiah 17:27]: "v'im lo tishme'u eilai" — and so on — "v'ladesh es yom haShabbas — v'hitzasi eish b'she'areha" — and so on. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: Jerusalem was destroyed only because they desecrated the Shabbos. And likewise: fire is common only in a place where there is a desecration of Shabbos, heaven forfend.

segments.he: אעפי"כ גם הטוב שבו יקבל תיקון ע"י קדושת שבת וזשדרז"ל מה תמרה זו נאוה במראיה וכל פירותיה מתוקים כך הצדיקים היינו בחי' מה יפית ומה נעמת הנ"ל. מה תמרה יש לה תאוה כך הצדיקים ומה תאוותם הקב"ה וכו'. היינו כי משפע נועם העליון נתעוררין שלהובין דרחימותא כנ"ל וזה כארז בלבנון ישגא ודרש בזוהר ויקרא ד' טז בלבנון ודאי דא עדן עילאה דעליה כתיב עין לא ראתה וכו' (עיין מקדש מלך שם) כי גם הנועם מקבל ונשפע עוד מלמעלה יותר היינו מבחי' עדן עילאה הנ"ל וזה שתולים בבית ה' ודרז"ל על שעתיד הקב"ה לקבץ הגליות מחו"ל לא"י.
segments.en:
And through mourning over the destruction of Jerusalem and the Holy Temple — through this the luminaries of fire are subdued — and the luminaries of light shine — which are the aspect of Shabbos.

And this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:3]: "lo siva'aru eish b'chol moshevoseichem" — the initial letters of which spell: "misabel [one who mourns]." And this [Exodus 35:3]: "b'yom haShabbas" — and so on — as explained within. And this [Exodus 31:16]: "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "l'dortam" — spelled without a vav — from the language of dwelling [dirah]. For through the holiness of the guarding of Shabbos — one is saved from fires — and the dwellings of Israel are sustained. And also — through this one merits the building of the Holy Temple — where is the essential dwelling of the root of the holiness of Israel — the aspect of [Exodus 15:17]: "machon l'shivtecha pa'alta Hashem" — and as explained within. And this is likewise [Exodus 31:16]: "l'dorosam" — in its plain sense — for all the generations are drawn from the Tzadik — who is the aspect of the head of the house — the aspect of Shabbos — as explained within. And therefore the essential time of the holiness of the sacred union is on Shabbos — for then one merits to draw holy souls for one's children — as explained in the holy Zohar. And this is because from there all the sacred generations are drawn — which are in the aspect of [Genesis 6:9]: "eileh toldos Noach" — the aspect of: "korei hadorosmeiro'sh" — for this is the aspect of the head of the house — which is the aspect of Shabbos. And therefore the letters of "rosh" [Reish-Aleph-Shin] immediately precede the letters of "Shabbas" [Shin-Beis-Sav] — as brought — for they are one aspect — as mentioned above.

segments.he: היינו שיעלו מבחי' מוחין של חו"ל לבחי' מוחין של א"י.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 56:3]: "v'al yomar ben haneychar" — and so on — "havdel yavdileni Hashem mei'al amo" — since he is not from the generations of Israel that are drawn from the aforementioned head of the house. And [Isaiah 56:3]: "v'al yomar hasaris — hen ani etz yavesh" — since he does not beget children — and has no portion in drawing the generations. For [Isaiah 56:4–5]: "ki choh amar Hashem la'sarisim — asher yishmeru es Shabsosai" — and so on — "v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai — davka" — (for the essential sustaining of the holy houses and the holy walls of Israel — and the sustaining of the Holy Temple — flows from the holiness of Shabbos — for this is the aspect of: "l'dortam" — as written) — "yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos — shem olam etein lo" — and so on — for Shabbos is the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. And therefore he will merit an eternal name. He will have a great portion in the sustaining of the sacred generations and the sacred houses — for this is the aspect of: "l'dortam" — and likewise in the drawing of the generations of all of Israel — which flow from the holiness of Shabbos — for this is the aspect of: "l'dorosam" — in its plain sense — as mentioned above. And therefore this verse was expounded in the holy Zohar regarding the union of Shabbos — for this is the aspect of the holiness of the union of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 56:6–7]: "u'vnay haneychar" — and so on — "kol shomer Shabbas mecha'lelo" — and so on — [Isaiah 56:7]: "v'havi'osim el har kodshi v'simachtim b'veys tefilasi" — and so on — "ki veisi beys tefilah yikarei l'chol ha'amim — ne'um Hashem mekabbetz nidchey Yisrael — od akabbetz alav l'nikibatzav." For the ways of G-d, blessed be He, are very wondrous — so much so that all manner of descents can be transformed into great ascents. And our Sages of blessed memory already taught: Israel went into exile only so that converts should be added to them. It follows that the fact that the sacred houses of Israel were destroyed — and they became exiles and wanderers — in the aspect of [Lamentations 4:1]: "tishtefachna avnei Kodesh b'rosh kol chutzos" — and this came about through the desecration of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And therefore — through the guarding of Shabbos — not only are the dispersed of Israel gathered — who are the aspect of the aforementioned sacred stones — so they are gathered from outside into the sacred houses. But on the contrary — through this — converts are added to them — who come from the nations — who are in truth from the aspect of the head of every outside street. But nonetheless — even within them there is some sacred vitality from the aspect of the sacred sparks [nitzotzos Kedushah] that fell within them. And specifically through the exile of Israel — the sacred sparks were clarified — and from them converts will be made — and they will also be gathered into the houses of holiness — whose root is all the Holy Temple — which is the aspect of the house of the head of the house. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:7]: "ki veisi beys tefilah yikarei l'chol ha'amim" — and so on — "mekabbetz nidchey Yisrael — od akabbetz alav l'nikibatzav" — these are the converts.

segments.he: וזה להגיד כי ישר ה' צורי וכו' כי המוחין של חו"ל שהם בבחי' מחלוקת הם בבחי' חלק לבם שמעקמין את הלב עד שבאים להרהר גם אחר השי"ת כביכול. אבל ע"י מוחין של א"י זוכין לידע ולהגיד כי צדיק וישר ה' ולא עולתה בו. ומחמת שהטוב שבנגה שזה בחי' הטוב שבחובלים עולה ונתתקן ע"י קדושת שבת ע"כ נעשין עי"ז גרים כידוע שהגרים הם מבחי' הטוב שבנגה. וזה בחי' שנים מקרא ואחד תרגום. כי גם התרגום בחי' נגה נכלל בקדושה. וזה ובני הנכר הנלוים על ה' וכו' כל שומר שבת וכו' והביאותים אל הר קדשי וכו' נאום ה' מקבץ נדחי ישראל עוד אקבץ עליו לנקבציו אלו הגרים היינו כנ"ל וע"כ ארז"ל שע"י הסעודות של שבת ניצולין מחבלי משיח. כי חבלי משיח יהי' ג"כ מחמת שיבאו החובלים לקבל תיקון ומחמת זה יתעורר קטגוריא בין הת"ח כמו שפירש"י שם וכל זה מחמת החובלים שהן בבחי' מחלוקת אבל ע"י קדושת שבת ניצולין מזה כנ"ל.
segments.en: And this [Psalms 92]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" — initial letters — למשה — for Moshe is the essential head of the house — in the aspect of [Numbers 12:7]: "b'chol beysi ne'eman hu" — and this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: [Genesis 1:1]: "Bereishis bara" — for the sake of Moshe — and so on. And he engages at the entry of Shabbos in elevating the souls of the living and the dead who fell to the depths of the husks. For this is the aspect of: "tishtefachna avnei Kodesh b'rosh kol chutzos." And this [Psalms 92:2]: "tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — for then is the essential revelation of the Name of Hashem — the aspect of Shabbos — the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. And also — for Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above. Which is likewise the aspect of: "tov lehodos laHashem" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: from the language of repentance and verbal confession. And through this — His Name, blessed be He, is completed — as it were — as explained in the aforementioned Siman 66. And this is the aspect of: "v'lezamre lishimcha elyon." And this [Psalms 92:3]: "lehagid baboker" — (for then is the time of the dominion of the luminaries of light — and they are the aspect of lovingkindnesses — in the aspect of [Psalms 42:9]: "yomam yetzaveh Hashem Chasdo") — and this [Psalms 92:3]: "chasdecha" — and [Psalms 92:3]: "v'emunascha baleilos" — for even at night — when then is the time of the dominion of the luminaries of fire — nonetheless — even they are subdued before the aspect of the luminaries of light through the aspect of faith. And this [Psalms 92:5]: "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha — b'ma'asey yadecha aranen." For the totality of the creation in the act of Bereishis is likewise the aspect of the house — for this is the aspect of the Beis of "Bereishis" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: why was the world created with a Beis? — and so on. And therefore regarding the time of the destruction — it is stated [Genesis 1:2]: "v'ha'aretz hayesah tohu vavohu v'choshech" — and so on — as if the entire world was destroyed — through the aspect of the dominion of the luminaries of fire. But on Shabbos — when the luminaries of light shine — which is the aspect of the head of the house — then the entire world is in its fullness and completeness. For this is the aspect of [Genesis 2:2]: "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i melachto asher asah." For the seventh day is the aspect of the head that shines upon the house — which is the totality of the entire creation — as mentioned above. And this [Psalms 92:6]: "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" — which is the aspect of the totality of the creation — which is the aspect of the house. And this [Psalms 92:6]: "me'od amku machshevosecha" — these are the aspect of the mental faculties — the aspect of the head of the house. And this [Psalms 92:7–9]: "ish ba'ar lo yeda" — and so on — "b'feroa'ch resha'im k'mo esev" — and so on — that is, at the time of the dominion of the luminaries of fire. But it is for their destruction forever. And in holiness — this is the aspect of the shalhava d'asha [flame of fire] that descends on Erev Shabbos — to scorch the heads of the husks and humble them — as brought in the writings. But [Psalms 92:13–14]: "Tzadik katamar yifrach" — and so on — for he produces fruit and his stump replenishes — for from him are drawn all the generations — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת וכו' אז תתענג על ה' דא עתיקא קדישא ששם שרש המוחין הק' שהם בבחי' נועם העליון הנ"ל והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין בחי' עליית המלכות דקדושה שזה בחי' התגלות כבודו ית' שבא ע"י השפע הנועם הנ"ל. וזהו שדרז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות שהם בחי' הרע שבחובלים שבא ע"י שפוגמין בבחי' מלכות דקדושה שהוא בחי' כבוד שמים כנ"ל וע"כ נקראים המלכות דסט"א עכו"ם מחבלים כרמים ונקראים ג"כ חבלי רשעים חבלי מות חבלי שאול כידוע וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך הוא בחי' הכלי שנעשה ע"י הצדקה לקבל בה שפע נועם העליון בכדי שיהיה נעשה עי"ז הולדה ויתגדל כבודו ית' שזה בחי' כל זרע יעקב כבדוהו ויעקב הוא בחי' צדקה כמבואר כ"ז בפנים. וע"כ בניו של יעקב שהם עיקר נחלתו כ"ש הנה נחלת ה' בנים נקראים נטעי נעמנים כ"ש (ישעי' יז) על כן תטעי נטעי נעמנים ופרש"י נטעת נטעים נעמנים שנים עשר בני יעקב וכו' היינו כנ"ל כי הולדה שלהם נמשך ע"י שפע נועם העליון כנ"ל. גם והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב כפשוטו היינו ירושת א"י ששם המוחין בבחי' נועם הנ"ל וזשדרז"ל שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים כי זוכה לתקן עי"ז גם המוחין של חו"ל שהם בבחי' חובלים ע"י שהרע שבהם נופל ונתבטל והטוב שבהם נכלל בקדושה הנ"ל.
segments.en:
And this [Psalms 92:14]: "shetulin b'veys Hashem" — for he is in the aspect of the mental faculties and the colors [guvanim] that shine upon the Holy Temple — which is the aspect of the mental faculties of the tefillin that are within the houses — as explained within.

 Siman 71 — סימן עא (Part Two)
 Chavalim Naflu Li b'Ne'imim — Shabbos = supernal pleasantness / No'am — the vessel made through charity — the sacred union of Shabbos = flames of love — glory and splendor — the chavalim [harmful disciplines] from outside Eretz Yisrael — the shalhava d'asha on Erev Shabbos — Korach receives his tikkun — chavalei Mashiach — Psalm 92 — Isaiah 58

segments.he: סימן עב-חיים נצחיים
segments.en: The essential mind and wisdom is in Eretz Yisrael — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: there is no wisdom like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael. And it is already explained above many times: the essential holiness of Eretz Yisrael depends upon the guarding of the holy Shabbos. For this is the aspect of [Ezekiel 20:15]: "v'gam ani nasa'ti es yadai lahem bamidbar l'vilti havi osam el ha'aretz" — and so on — "ya'an b'mishpatai mas'u" — and so on — "v'es Shabsosai chilelu" [Ezekiel 20:15]. And likewise the opposite: a full verse is explicitly stated: [Isaiah 58:13–14]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — and [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — that is, the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. And each and every person of Israel has a portion in the holiness of Shabbos — in the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" — and he commanded them regarding Shabbos.

segments.he: ע"י קדושת שבת זוכין לקבל גדולה שזה בחי' וגם האוהבים דבריה גדולה בחרו. ועיקר הגדולה הוא שפלות. וזה יהיה עיקר התחיה של לעתיד שיהיה נחיה ויקום בתחיה השפלות של כל או"א ועי"ז יהיה האדם בבחי' בלתי גבול ויהיה יכול להשיג תענוג עוה"ב הרוחני שהוא ג"כ בבחי' בלתי גבול ויחיה חיים נצחיים של עוה"ב שהם בבחי' בלתי גבול כמבפ"נ. וכמו כן לענין קדושת שבת שהוא מעין עוה"ב וע"כ ארז"ל נותנין לו נחלה בלי מצרים היינו בלי גבול ונאמר בו טועמיה חיים זכו היינו שזוכה לחיים נצחיים היינו שנחיה השפלות שעי"ז הוא בבחי' אין ואין לו שום גבול ויוכל עי"ז להשיג בחי' תענוג עוה"ב שהוא בחי' בלתי גבול כנ"ל. גם ע"י השבת זוכה כ"א כפי בחינתו לקבל התנוצצות המוחין כנ"ל כ"פ. והמוחין והדעת הן בחי' בנין ביהמ"ק כמבפ"נ וזה שנסמך שבת לבנין ביהמ"ק.
segments.en: And likewise each and every person has a portion in Eretz Yisrael. And according to one's portion in the holiness of Shabbos and Eretz Yisrael — so does one receive and draw sustenance from the mental faculties of Eretz Yisrael. And therefore the mental faculties of Eretz Yisrael are the aspect of no'am [pleasantness] — for they make one pleasant to one another in Halachah [shemena'imim zeh l'zeh b'halachah]. For this is the aspect of [Proverbs 3:17]: "derachehah darchey no'am — v'chol nesivoseha shalom [her ways are ways of pleasantness — and all her paths are peace]." For they flow from the holiness of Shabbos — when then the supernal pleasantness [no'am ha'elyon] flows — as explained in the holy Zohar.

segments.he: וכפי מה שמקבל התנוצצות המוחין כן זוכה לקבל גדולה. כי הגדולה בחי' מלכות הוא אסור וקשור ברהיטי מוחין בבחי' מלך אסור ברהטים ברהיטי מוחין.
segments.en:
And this is the aspect of [Psalms 90:17]: "Vihi no'am" — which one says at the going out of Shabbos — in order to draw the illumination of the holiness of Shabbos upon the six weekdays — as is well-known. And this is likewise the aspect of: "Shabbas Shalom" — for the supernal pleasantness is the aspect of peace — as mentioned above. And therefore — on Shabbos — one must be especially careful from all kinds of dispute — for this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:3]: "lo siva'aru eish b'chol moshevoseichem" — as is well-known. And this is the aspect of the holiness of the sacred union of Shabbos. For through the flow of the supernal pleasantness — the flames of love [shalhavim d'rachimusa] are awakened. For this is the aspect of [Song of Songs 7:7]: "mah yafis u'mah na'amt — ahavah b'ta'anugim" — which is the aspect of the delight of Shabbos [oneg Shabbas] — in which the flow of the supernal pleasantness shines. And from there come the flames of love — through which one is awakened to the holiness of the union — for the sake of sacred births. And through this the honor of G-d, blessed be He, is magnified — for this was the purpose of the entire creation. And this is the aspect of the honor of Shabbos [kevod Shabbas] — for through the holiness of Shabbos — the honor of G-d, blessed be He, is magnified — as mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg — v'liKdosh Hashem mechubbad." And this [Prayer]: "me'angeha l'olam kavod yinchalu."

And since the essential vessel for receiving the flow of the supernal pleasantness is made through charity — as explained within — therefore one must increase charity on Shabbos. And therefore the charity box [kupah shel tzedakah] is distributed on every Erev Shabbos. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — (ilu shomrey Shabbas) — shemesh Tzedakah" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "shemesh b'Shabbas — tzedakah l'aniyim [the sun on Shabbos — charity to the poor]." That is — for the sun is the aspect of peace — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: just as the sun [brings] peace to the world — as brought in Rashi, Parashas Mishpatim, on the verse [Exodus 22:2]: "im zarachah alav hashemesh" — and so on. And peace is the aspect of no'am — as mentioned above. And this is: "shemesh b'Shabbas" — that is, the peace and the love of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the flow of the supernal pleasantness — is received in its fullness through charity to the poor. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: one must give charity before the sacred union — for through charity — the vessel is made to receive the flow of the supernal pleasantness — through which the sacred birth comes — as mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 56:3]: "v'al yomar hasaris — hen ani etz yavesh" — since he does not beget children — and has no portion in the revelation of the honor of G-d, blessed be He, that comes through birth — as mentioned above. For [Isaiah 56:4–5]: "ki choh amar Hashem la'sarisim — asher yishmeru es Shabsosai" — and so on — "v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai" — (for there is the essential revelation of the honor of G-d, blessed be He — in the aspect of [Psalms 29:9]: "u'v'heichalo kullo omer kavod" — and the aspect of: "u'chevod Hashem malei es habayis") — "yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos" — for through the guarding of Shabbos — they draw the flow of the supernal pleasantness — and they have a great portion in the revelation of the honor of G-d, blessed be He, that comes through the births of all of Israel.

segments.he: וכל המוחין פרטיים הם מקבלין ממוח הכולל שהוא חכם הדור. וזה בחי' ויקהל משה את כל עדת ב"י. ואז ציום על מלאכת המשכן דאקרי נמי מקדש ועל הזהרת שבת וע"כ מצוה להקביל פני רבו בשבת כי ע"י שרבו החכם הכולל רואה אותו ומסתכל בו עי"ז מתנוצץ מוחו וזוכה לקבל קדושת שבת ביותר שזה בעצמו בחי' התנוצצות המוחין בחי' כי קדש היא שהם המוחין כידוע ועי"ז מקבל גדולה.
segments.en: And therefore — this verse was expounded in the holy Zohar regarding the union of Shabbos — for this is the secret of the union of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And this [Exodus 31:16]: "v'shamru Vnay Yisrael es haShabbas — la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam" — for through this the birth of the generations is drawn. And therefore this verse alludes to the union of Shabbos — as brought.

segments.he: וע"כ מצוה בשבת לחדש חידושין דאורייתא כי ע"י התנוצצות המוחין הנ"ל זוכין לחדש בתורה כמבפ"נ. וע"כ הכל מודים שבשבת ניתנה תורה. וזה ג"כ בחי' הבושה והיראה הגדולה הנמשך על האדם בשבת בחי' ירא בשת ירא שבת. כי שבת אותיות בשת כמובא. כי ע"י חידושי וביאורי תורה הנ"ל נמשך בושה כמבפ"נ וע"י הבושה זוכין לתשובה שהוא ג"כ בחי' שבת כנ"ל כ"פ. ותשובה הוא בחי' חיים כ"ש והשיבו וחיו בחי' חיים נצחיים של עוה"ב בחי' שבת שנאמר בו טועמיה חיים זכו ועי"ז חוזר ונחיה וקם בתחיה השפלות של משה רבינו שמלובש בכל אבר ואבר של כ"א מישראל ועי"ז זוכין לענג שבת ענג עוה"ב שהוא בלתי גבול כנ"ל. וזש"כ (ירמי' יז) והיה אם שמוע תשמעון אלי וכו' ולקדש את יום השבת וכו' ובאו בשערי העיר הזאת מלכים ושרים וכו' היינו בחי' הגדולה והמלכות שזוכין לקבל ע"י התנוצצות המוחין של שבת כנ"ל. וזה בחי' הג' שבתות המובא בזוה"ק שבת עילאה שבת דיומא שבת דלילא. שבת עילאה הוא בחי' חכמה ובינה בחי' התנוצצות המוחין או אפשר כי שבת עילאה מורה על בחי' אור עוה"ב עצמו שמתנוצץ ומאיר בשבת קודש שהוא מעין עוה"ב. שבת דיומא זה בחי' תפארת שהוא בחי' התורה כידוע היינו בחי' החידושי תורה שזוכין עי"ז. שבת דלילא הוא בחי' מלכות בחי' הגדולה והמלכות שמקבלין עי"ז כנ"ל.
segments.en:
And this [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon." The gematria of "elyon" equals the gematria of "no'am" — for then the supernal pleasantness flows — from which all the melodies [zemiros] are drawn — in the aspect of: "ne'im zemiros Yisrael [the pleasant singer of Israel]" — as explained within. And therefore certainly then it is good to sing to His Name — in the aspect of [Psalms 135:3]: "zamru lishmo ki na'im [sing to His Name — for it is pleasant]." And this [Psalms 92:4]: "alay asor v'alay navel — alay higgayon b'chinor" — which is the aspect of: "kinor na'im im navel [the pleasant harp with the lute]." And this [Psalms 92:5]: "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" — and so on — for through the flow of the supernal pleasantness — birth is made — and the honor of G-d, blessed be He, is revealed. For this entire purpose the whole of creation was made. And this [Psalms 92:8]: "b'feroa'ch resha'im k'mo esev" — and so on. And it is explained in the writings: this alludes to the fact that on Erev Shabbos — the good that is in Nogah [the intermediate realm] ascends and is encompassed in holiness. And then the impure husks also wish to ascend with it — to draw sustenance from the holiness. And then the shalhava d'asha [the flame of fire] descends upon their heads — and humbles them — and so on. For this is the aspect of: "l'hishamedam adey ad" — and so on.

That is — for through blemishing the honor of the Almighty — through this one falls into the aspect of the mental faculties of outside Eretz Yisrael [chutz la'aretz] — which are the aspect of the chavalim [harmful disciplines] — that harm one another in Halachah [shechavlin zeh es zeh b'halachah]. And behold — there is much good within them — since they at least engage in a matter of Halachah. Only — since the evil that rules even more strongly in chutz la'aretz has a grip on them — therefore they cannot equate themselves with one another — and they dispute with one another — and harm one another. And behold — the mental faculties of chutz la'aretz are seeking a tikkun for themselves. And therefore — when the holiness of Shabbos begins to flash — when then is the essential flow of the supernal pleasantness — as mentioned above — they then also come to be rectified — and fall into the aspect of the mental faculties of Eretz Yisrael — which are the aspect of no'am. For this is the aspect of: "chavalim naflu li b'ne'imim [the lines fell for me in pleasant places]" — as explained within. And this is the aspect of what the good of Nogah is encompassed in holiness at that time — and the evil in it — and also the entirely impure husks — fall downward through the aforementioned shalhava d'asha. And this [Psalms 92:10–11]: "ki hinneh oyevecha yovadu" — and so on. And this [Psalms 92:13]: "Tzadik katamar yifrach" — and it is brought that the Sofei Teivos [final letters] of Kaf-Tamar-Yifrach spell [Korach] — for also Korach receives a tikkun through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. For the chavalim were so rectified — until even Korach — in whom the evil of the chavalim had such a grip — until he disputed with Moshe our teacher himself. Nonetheless — even the good within him will receive a tikkun through the holiness of Shabbos. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: just as the palm tree is beautiful in its appearance and all its fruits are sweet — likewise the righteous — which is the aspect of: "mah yafis u'mah na'amt" — mentioned above. Just as the palm tree has a desire — likewise the righteous. And what is their desire? — The Holy One, blessed be He. And so on. That is — for from the supernal pleasantness the flames of love are awakened — as mentioned above. And this [Psalms 92:13]: "k'erez baLevanon yisgeh" — and it was expounded in Zohar Vayikra, folio 16: "b'Levanon — vadai — da Eden ila'ah — d'aleih ksiv — ein lo ra'asah" — and so on — (see Mikdash Melech there) — for even the pleasantness receives and flows even from above it — that is, from the aspect of the supernal Eden [Eden ila'ah] — mentioned above. And this [Psalms 92:14]: "shetulin b'veys Hashem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: regarding the future — when the Holy One, blessed be He, will gather the exiles from chutz la'aretz to Eretz Yisrael. That is, they will ascend from the aspect of the mental faculties of chutz la'aretz to the aspect of the mental faculties of Eretz Yisrael.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת וכו' אז תתענג על ה' שיזכה לקבל ענג עוה"ב שהוא בלתי גבול. והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ בחי' הגדולה ומלכות שזוכין לקבל ע"י קדושת שבת. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך הוא בחי' היראה והשפלות שזוכה לקבל שזה בחי' נחלת יעקב שזכה לזה שזה בחי' עקב ענוה יראת ה' והשפלות הזה הוא בחי' חיים נצחיים כנ"ל. וע"כ ארז"ל יעקב אבינו לא מת.
segments.en: And this [Psalms 92:16]: "lehagid ki yashar Hashem tzuri" — and so on — for the mental faculties of chutz la'aretz — which are in the aspect of dispute — are in the aspect of: "chalak libam [their heart is divided]" — which twist the heart — until one comes to question even the Almighty, as it were. But through the mental faculties of Eretz Yisrael — one merits to know and declare: that Hashem is righteous and upright — and there is no injustice in Him. And since the good of Nogah — which is the aspect of the good of the chavalim — ascends and is rectified through the holiness of Shabbos — therefore converts are made from this — as is well-known: the converts are from the aspect of the good of Nogah. And this is the aspect of: "shnayyim mikra v'echad Targum [twice the text and once the Targum]." For the Targum is also the aspect of Nogah — encompassed in holiness. And this [Isaiah 56:6–7]: "u'vnay haneychar" — and so on — "kol shomer Shabbas" — and so on — "v'havi'osim el har kodshi" — and so on — "ne'um Hashem mekabbetz nidchey Yisrael — od akabbetz alav l'nikibatzav" — these are the converts — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: one is saved from the birth pangs of Mashiach [chavalei Mashiach] through the Shabbos meals. For the birth pangs of Mashiach will also come because the chavalim come to receive their tikkun — and through this a dispute among the Torah scholars will be aroused — as Rashi explained there. And all of this is because of the chavalim — which are in the aspect of dispute. But through the holiness of Shabbos — one is saved from this — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזשדרז"ל על זה שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים כי ע"י בחי' חיים נצחיים שנחיה השפלות הנ"ל עד שהוא בבחי' אין ובלתי גבול זוכה לקבל ענג שבת ענג עוה"ב שהוא בלתי גבול בחי' נחלה בלי מצרים כנ"ל. גם החידושי תורה הנ"ל הם בחי' נחלת יעקב בחי' מורשה קהלת יעקב. וזה והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ. ר"ל שיזכה לגדולה ומלכות והגדולה תהיה כלולה מענוה שזה עיקר הגדולה בחי' במקום גדולתו שם אתה מוצא ענוותנותו כמבפ"נ ואז יש שלימות לשניהם וזשדרז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות היינו שאין להמלכות דסט"א שהן בחי' גאוה ועזות שום אחיזה בהגדולה והמלכות דקדושה מאחר שהיא כלולה עם ענוה ושפלות. וכן הענוה בשלימות ואינו בבחי' שפל ונבזה ועצל שעי"ז יכול להיות נכנע לפעמים לפני בעלי גאוה. וענוה כזו נקראת ענוה פסולה וחנופה כמבואר במ"א וזה נקרא ג"כ בחי' שיעבוד מלכיות דסט"א שמלכותם הוא רק ע"י עזות כשארז"ל גם כי כשהענוה אינה בשלימות הוא רק בבחי' מרה שחורה והמוח משועבד עי"ז בבחי' שיעבוד מלכיות וע"כ עיקר שלימות הענוה כשהיא כלולה עם הגדולה ומלכות דקדושה שזה בחי' שנחיה וקם בתחיה השפלות שבו בבחי' חיים נצחיים וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך הוא בחי' החידושי תורה כנ"ל.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — where is the root of the sacred mental faculties — which are in the aspect of the supernal pleasantness — mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of the sacred Malchus — which is the aspect of the revelation of the honor of G-d, blessed be He, that comes through the flow of the supernal pleasantness — mentioned above. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — which are the aspect of the evil of the chavalim — that comes through blemishing the aspect of the sacred Malchus — which is the aspect of the heavenly honor — as mentioned above. And therefore the Malchus d'Sitra Achra are called: nations who harass [me'achblin] the vineyards — and they are likewise called: the cords of the wicked [chavley resha'im] — the cords of death [chavley maves] — the cords of the netherworld [chavley Sh'ol] — as is well-known. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — this is the aspect of the vessel that is made through charity — to receive in it the flow of the supernal pleasantness — in order that through this the birth should be made — and the honor of G-d, blessed be He, should be magnified. For this is the aspect of: "kol zera Yaakov kabbeduhu" — and Yaakov is the aspect of charity — as all of this is explained within. And therefore the children of Yaakov — who are the essential heritage — as it is written [Psalms 127:3]: "hinneh nachalas Hashem banim" — are called [Isaiah 17:10]: "nit'ey ne'manim [pleasant plantings]." As it is written there: "al ken tit'i nit'ey na'amanim" — and Rashi explained: "nata'ta neti'im ne'amim — shenem asar shivtei Yaakov [you planted pleasant plantings — the twelve tribes of Yaakov]" — and so on. That is, as mentioned above — for their birth is drawn through the flow of the supernal pleasantness — as mentioned above. And also [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov" — in its plain sense — that is, the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — where the mental faculties are in the aspect of no'am — as mentioned above. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits [nachalah b'li metzarim] — for one merits to rectify through this also the mental faculties of chutz la'aretz — which are in the aspect of chavalim — through the fact that the evil in them falls and is nullified — and the good in them is encompassed in holiness — as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן עג-תהלים מסוגל לתשובה
segments.en:
Siman 72 — סימן עב (Part Two)
 Chayyim Nitzchiyim — Through Shabbos: receiving greatness — essential greatness = lowliness — the resurrection of the future world = the revival of the lowliness of Moshe in every limb — three aspects of Shabbos — Isaiah 58

Through the holiness of Shabbos — one merits to receive greatness [gedulah]. For this is the aspect of [Prayer]: "v'gam ha'ohavim devarehah gedulah baCharu [and those who love her words have chosen greatness]." And the essential greatness is lowliness [shefilus]. And this will be the essential resurrection of the future — that the lowliness of each and every person will be revived and rise in resurrection. And through this the person will be in the aspect of without limit [b'li gevul] — and will be able to attain the spiritual delight of the World to Come — which is likewise in the aspect of without limit. And he will live eternal life of the World to Come — which is in the aspect of without limit — as explained within. And likewise regarding the holiness of Shabbos — which is a foretaste of the World to Come. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits [nachalah b'li metzarim]. And it is stated regarding it: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu [those who taste it merited life]" — that is, one merits eternal life. That is — the lowliness is revived — through which one is in the aspect of nothing [ayin] — and has no limit whatsoever. And through this one can attain the spiritual delight of the World to Come — which is in the aspect of without limit — as mentioned above. And also — through Shabbos — each person merits according to his level to receive the flashing of the mental faculties — as mentioned above many times. And the mental faculties and Da'as are the aspect of the building of the Holy Temple — as explained within. And this is why Shabbos is juxtaposed to the building of the Holy Temple.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' בינה כמבואר בזוה"ק. ובינה הוא שורש בחי' תשובה כידוע וכ"ש ולבבו יבין וןשב. וע"כ שבת הוא בחי' תשובה כנ"ל כ"פ. ומחמת שאמירת מזמורי תהלים מסוגל לתשובה ע"כ מרבים במזמורי תהלים בשבת גם בסדר התפלה ורבים מישראל נוהגים לומר מזמורי תהלים הרבה בכל שבת. וע"כ אדה"ר כשנודע לו כח התשובה פתח ואמר מזמור שיר ליום השבת כי שבת הוא בחי' תשובה וכמבפ"נ בליקו"א סי' ע"ט. וע"כ אמר תיכף טוב להודות לה' ולזמר לשמך עליון היינו לומר מזמורי תהלים הרבה. וע"כ מ"ט ימי הספירה שהם כנגד מ"ט שערי תשובה כמבפ"נ נאמר בהם וספרתם לכם ממחרת השבת וכו' וקורא לפסח שבת כי יציאת מצרים שהוא בחי' תשובה הוא בחי' שבת וזה עד ממחרת השבת השביעית תספרו וכו' היינו כנ"ל. כי כל החמשים שערי תשובה כלולים בקדושת שבת. וע"כ הכל מודים כי בשבת ניתנה תורה שזה בחי' שביום החמשים אז וירד ה' על הר סיני שזה בחי' ואשובה אליכם שזה בחי' שער החמשים כמובא בפנים.
segments.en: And according to the degree one receives the flashing of the mental faculties — so does one merit to receive greatness. For greatness — the aspect of Malchus — is bound and tied to the flowing of the mental faculties — in the aspect of [Song of Songs 7:6]: "melech asur baRahasim — b'Rahasim — b'Rihitei mochin [the king is held in the tresses — in the tresses — in the flowing of the mental faculties]."

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת וכו' אז תתענג על ה' היינו שיזכה לעבור בכל המ"ט שערי תשובה עד שיגיע לשער החמשים של תשובה שהוא בחי' תשובת השי"ת בעצמו כביכול בחי' ואשובה אליכם. והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ ודרז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות כי אין הגאולה תלוי אלא בתשובה כשארז"ל. גם כי ארז"ל רצוני לעשות רצונך ומי מעכב שאור שבעיסה ושיעבוד מלכיות והנה ע"י קדושת שבת נכנע השאור שבעיסה והבטיח הכתוב שלא יהיה לו עיכוב לתשובה גם משיעבוד מלכיות. וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך הוא בחי' תשובה שניתנה רק לבני יעקב ולא לעכו"ם כמבואר בקדמונים ז"ל באריכות הובא קצת גם בליקוט חדש ערך תשובה. גם נחלת ה' בנים. וע"כ נחלת יעקב הם הי"ב שבטי יעקב שהם בחי' מ"ט שערי תשובה כמבפ"נ וזה בחי' שבטי יה עדות לישראל להודות לשם ה' בחי' תהלים גם נחלת יעקב הוא בחי' תהלים כשארז"ל (מ"ר ויצא פ' עד) שיעקב אמר כל ספר תהלים שנאמר ואתה קדוש יושב תהלות ישראל, ישראל סבא וע"כ מבואר אצל יעקב ששמר את השבת שהוא שורש בחי' תשובה כנ"ל.
segments.en: And all the individual mental faculties receive from the encompassing mind — which is the sage of the generation [chacham haDor]. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael." And then he commanded them regarding the work of the Mishkan — which is also called "Mikdash" — and regarding the warning of Shabbos. And therefore it is a commandment to receive the face of one's teacher on Shabbos — for through the fact that one's teacher — the all-encompassing sage — sees him and looks upon him — through this his mind flashes. And one merits to receive the holiness of Shabbos even more — which itself is the aspect of the flashing of the mental faculties — in the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "ki Kodesh hi" — which is the mental faculties — as is well-known. And through this one receives greatness.

segments.he: וע"כ דרז"ל שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים כי אין לך דבר שעומד בפני התשובה. גם כי ע"י אמירת תהלים נתבטלין כל המצרים והמניעות שיש לאדם על תשובה כי ע"י תהלים זוכה להגיע להאות והשער של תשובה השייך לו וגם לפתוח השער. ואפי' מי שאין לו שום התעוררות לתשובה זוכה ע"י תהלים להתעורר לעשות תשובה נמצא שהוא בחי' נחלה בלי מצרים.
segments.en:
And therefore — on Shabbos — it is a commandment to innovate Torah novellae [chidushei Torah] — for through the aforementioned flashing of the mental faculties — one merits to innovate in Torah — as explained within. And therefore all agree: on Shabbos the Torah was given. And this likewise the aspect of the shame and the great awe that is drawn upon a person on Shabbos — the aspect of: "yirey boshes — yirey Shabbas [one who fears shame — one who fears Shabbos]." For "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — as brought. For through the aforementioned Torah novellae and Torah explanations — shame is drawn — as explained within. And through shame — one merits repentance — which is likewise the aspect of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times. And repentance is the aspect of life — as it is written [Ezekiel 18:32]: "v'hashivum v'chayu" — the aspect of the eternal life of the World to Come. For Shabbos — regarding which it is stated: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" — and through this the lowliness of Moshe our teacher — which is dressed within every limb and limb of each and every person of Israel — is revived and rises in resurrection. And through this one merits the delight of Shabbos — the delight of the World to Come — which is without limit — as mentioned above. And this is what is written [Jeremiah 17:24–25]: "v'hayah im shamo'a tishme'u eilai" — and so on — "v'ladesh es yom haShabbas" — and so on — "u'va'u b'sha'arey ha'ir hazos melachim v'sarim" — and so on — that is, the aspect of the greatness and the kingship [gedulah u'malchus] that one merits to receive through the flashing of the mental faculties of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of the three Shabbosim brought in the holy Zohar: the upper Shabbos [Shabbas ila'ah] — the Shabbos of day [Shabbas d'yoma] — the Shabbos of night [Shabbas d'leila]. The upper Shabbos is the aspect of wisdom and understanding — the aspect of the flashing of the mental faculties. Or perhaps — the upper Shabbos alludes to the aspect of the light of the World to Come itself — that flashes and shines on the holy Shabbos — which is a foretaste of the World to Come. The Shabbos of day — this is the aspect of Tiferes — which is the aspect of the Torah — as is well-known — that is, the aspect of the Torah novellae that one merits through this. The Shabbos of night — this is the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of the greatness and the kingship that one receives through this — as mentioned above.

And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — that one should merit to receive the delight of the World to Come — which is without limit. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — the aspect of the greatness and kingship that one merits to receive through the holiness of Shabbos. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — this is the aspect of the awe and the lowliness that one merits to receive — for this is the aspect of the heritage of Yaakov — who merited this — for this is the aspect of [Proverbs 22:4]: "ekev anavah yiras Hashem" — and this lowliness is the aspect of eternal life — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: "Yaakov Avinu lo mes [Yaakov our Patriarch did not die]."

segments.he: סימן עז-רצועה היתה יוצאת
segments.en: And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits — for through the aspect of eternal life — that the lowliness is revived — so that one is in the aspect of nothing and without limit — one merits to receive the delight of Shabbos — the delight of the World to Come — which is without limit — in the aspect of: "nachalah b'li metzarim" — as mentioned above. And also — the aforementioned Torah novellae are the aspect of the heritage of Yaakov — in the aspect of [Deuteronomy 33:4]: "morashah kehilas Yaakov." And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — that is, one merits greatness and kingship — and this greatness will be encompassed with humility. For this is the essential greatness — in the aspect of: "b'makom gedulas — sham atah motzei anavtanuso" [where you find His greatness — there you find His humility] — as explained within. And then there is completeness to both — and this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — that is, the Malchus d'Sitra Achra — which is in the aspect of arrogance and insolence — has no grip on the greatness and kingship of holiness — since it is encompassed with humility and lowliness. And likewise — the humility should be in its fullness — and not be in the aspect of lowly and contemptible and lazy — through which one can sometimes be subjugated before people of arrogance. And such humility is called defective humility and flattery — as explained elsewhere. And this is also called the aspect of the subjugation of the Malchus d'Sitra Achra — since their kingship is only through insolence — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And also — when humility is not in its fullness — it is only in the aspect of melancholy — and the mind is subjugated through this — in the aspect of the subjugation of kingdoms. And therefore the essential fullness of humility is when it is encompassed with greatness and the sacred kingship. For this is the aspect of the revival in resurrection of the lowliness mentioned above — so that it is in the aspect of eternal life — and without limit. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — this is the aspect of the Torah novellae — as mentioned above.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' תפילין מוחין כידוע וכנ"ל כ"פ. גם בשבת זוכין ליראה בחי' ירא שבת. כי שבת הוא ג"כ בחי' מלכות והמלכות הוא מקור היראה בחי' מוראה של מלכות וע"כ נמשך אז היראה על האדם כשארז"ל מפני שאימת שבת עליו ואפי' ע"ה ירא לשקר בשבת וע"כ השומרי שבת נקראים יראי שמי כ"ש וזרחה לכם יראי שמי וכו' וכשדרז"ל וכנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en:
Siman 73 — סימן עג (Part Two)
 Tehillim Mesugal l'Teshuvah — Shabbos = Binah = root of repentance — reciting Psalms on Shabbos — Adam the first man opened with Psalm 92 — the 49 gates of repentance = 49 days of the Omer = all encompassed in Shabbos — the giving of the Torah on Shabbos — Isaiah 58 — heritage of Yaakov = Psalms

segments.he: והיראה הנ"ל הוא בחי' הרצועה שעוברת בתוך המעברתא של תפילין היינו היראה שעוברת בתוך המוחין והתפילין כי ראשית חכמה יראת ה' וכמבואר בפנים והנה גם בחול ע"י שאוכלין בקדושה וביראת שמים ממתיקין את היראה בחי' הרצועה הנ"ל בכדי שלא ישתלשל ממנה איזה צער ח"ו וכמבפ"נ. ובשבת קודש אז האכילה בוודאי בקדושה אצל כל אדם כי אכילת שבת כולו קודש. ואז ממילא היראה באה להאדם בשעת אכילה בבחי' לעת האוכל גשי הלום וכו' כמבפ"נ ועי"ז זוכין להנצל מכל צער (כי אכילת שבת הוא בחי' המתקת הדינים כמובא) ולא עוד אלא שזוכין שנעשה מהפה קומת אדם היינו שנתתקן הדיבור שזה בחי' ודבר דבר הנאמר בשבת. כי הפה נשלם באור גדול בשעת אכילת שבת וכמבפ"נ לעיל בליקו"א סי' נז. עד שזוכה לעליה יותר גדולה לבחי' שכינה מדברת מתוך גרונו שזה בחי' הרוה"ק שנמשך על כ"א כפי בחינתו בשבת קודש כמבואר בזוה"ק (ממילא מובן כי יש בזה ענינים דקים ורוחניים מאד שא"א לבארם).
segments.en:
Shabbos is the aspect of Binah — as explained in the holy Zohar. And Binah is the root of the aspect of repentance — as is well-known. And as it is written [Isaiah 6:10]: "u'levano yovin — v'shav [and his heart understands — and he returns]." And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times. And since the reciting of Psalms [amirah d'mizmorey Tehillim] is propitious for repentance — therefore one increases the reciting of Psalms on Shabbos. And also in the order of prayer — and many among Israel are accustomed to reciting many Psalms on every Shabbos. And therefore Adam the first man — when the power of repentance became known to him — opened and said: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" [Psalms 92] — for Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — and as explained within in Likutay Moharan, Siman 79. And therefore he immediately said: "tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — that is, to recite many Psalms. And therefore the forty-nine days of the Omer counting — which correspond to the forty-nine gates of repentance — as explained within — it is stated regarding them [Leviticus 23:15]: "u'sfartem lachem mimacharat haShabbas" — and so on. And it calls Passover: "Shabbas" — for the exodus from Egypt — which is the aspect of repentance — is the aspect of Shabbos. And this [Leviticus 23:16]: "ad mimacharat haShabbas hashevi'is tisperu" — and so on — as mentioned above. For all the fifty gates of repentance are encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos. And therefore all agree: on Shabbos the Torah was given. For this is the aspect of: on the fiftieth day — then [Exodus 19:20]: "vayyered Hashem al Har Sinai" — for this is the aspect of [Zechariah 1:3]: "v'ashuva aleichem [and I shall return to you]" — which is the aspect of the fiftieth gate — as brought within.

And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — that is, one should merit to pass through all forty-nine gates of repentance — until one arrives at the fiftieth gate of repentance — which is the aspect of the repentance of the Almighty Himself — as it were — the aspect of: "v'ashuva aleichem." And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms. For redemption depends only upon repentance — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And also — for our Sages of blessed memory taught: "retzioni la'asos retzoncha — ela she'or she'ba'isah — v'shibbud malchiyos me'akev [My desire is to do Your desire — but the leaven in the dough — and the subjugation of the kingdoms — delays me]." And behold — through the holiness of Shabbos — the leaven in the dough is subdued. And the verse promises: there will be no obstruction to repentance — even from the subjugation of kingdoms. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — this is the aspect of repentance — which was given only to the children of Yaakov — and not to the nations — as explained at length by the early authorities — and a portion is also brought in the Likut Chadash, the entry of repentance. And also: [Psalms 127:3]: "nachalas Hashem banim." And therefore the heritage of Yaakov — these are the twelve tribes of Yaakov — which are the aspect of the forty-nine gates of repentance — as explained within. And this [Psalms 122:4]: "shivtei Yah — eidus l'Yisrael — lehodos l'Shem Hashem" — the aspect of Psalms. And also — the heritage of Yaakov is the aspect of Psalms — as our Sages of blessed memory taught [Midrash Rabbah Vayeitzei]: that Yaakov said the entire Book of Psalms — as it is stated [Psalms 22:4]: "v'Atah Kadosh yoshev tehilos Yisrael" — this refers to Yaakov — who is "Yisrael Sava [the elder Israel]." And therefore it is explained regarding Yaakov: that he guarded the Shabbos — which is the root of the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת רגלך וכו' וקראת לשבת ענג (בחי' הסעודות של שבת) וכו' אז תתענג על ה' דא עתיקא קדישא שהוא שרש המוחין העליונים ונפלאים מאד. גם משם שורש המתקת כל הדינים וזשארז"ל שנותנין לו כל משאלות לבו כי ניצול עי"ז מכל צער.
segments.en: And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits. For nothing stands before repentance. And also — for through the reciting of Psalms — all the obstacles and obstructions that a person has in relation to repentance are nullified. For through Psalms — one merits to arrive at the letter and the gate of repentance that pertains to one — and also to open the gate. And even one who has no awakening at all toward repentance — merits through Psalms to be awakened to do repentance. It follows that it is in the aspect of: an inheritance without limits.

segments.he: וזה והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין בחי' עליית המלכות שהוא היראה כנ"ל. וע"כ דרז"ל על זה שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות שהם בחי' היראות הנפולות בחי' מוראה של מלכות. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא בחי' אדם היושב על הכסא כידוע ויעקב אבינו הוא מרכבה להאדם הנ"ל וע"כ צורתו חקוקה בכה"כ כמבואר בזוה"ק וזה והאכלתיך דייקא כי זוכה לזה ע"י האכילה דקדושה של קדושת שבת. שעי"ז נעשה הפה בבחי' קומת אדם ואח"כ נתעלה עוד יותר עד שנעשה בבחי' אדם היושב אל הכסא. וזשדרז"ל שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים כי האדם הנ"ל הוא בבחי' נחלה בלי מצרים כמבואר בכתבים.
segments.en:
✦ Translator's Summary — Part Two, Simanim 67, 71, 72, 73
 
 Siman 67 — Bereishis l'Einey Chol Yisrael — Luminaries of light / luminaries of fire / the Tzadik = head of the house / the Samech-Mem = the poor one outside / Shabbos = tefillin = head of the house / Moshe = faithful in all My house: Zohar Bereishis folio 21: on Shabbos: luminaries of light dominate; luminaries of fire are subdued until going out of Shabbos. Sages: destruction of Holy Temple occurred at going out of Shabbos = destruction came through luminaries of fire = their dominion begins at going out of Shabbos. Shabbos = sacred mochin = "ki Kodesh hi." Shabbos = "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein." Shabbos = Name of G-d = root of four elements. "Shabbas" = Shin Beis: Shin = three Patriarchs = root of fire/water/wind; Beis = Malchus = root of element of earth. Shabbos = Tzadik Yesod Olam = simple foundation = splendor and grace and so on of the world = "v'Noach matza chen"; Noach = Shabbos = nayyicha d'ilayin v'tata'in (well-known) = the aforementioned Tzadik (within). "Tiferes atah l'yom haMenuchah." Oneg Shabbas = roshei teivos = Eden/Nahar/Gan = simple foundation = "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan" (Zohar; within). Through being truly encompassed in holiness of Shabbos → eyes opened = "re'u ki Hashem nasan lachem es haShabbas" → each person merits to see himself = how he holds onto all the attributes that are drawn from the four elements. Therefore: commandment to receive face of teacher on Shabbos = "v'hayu einecha ro'os es morecha" (Isaiah 30:20) = looking upon face of Tzadik → through this also: merits to see and look upon himself = how he holds onto all the attributes (within; Siman 66 cross-ref.). Therefore Shabbos = teshuvah (many times) = through this: certainly awakened to complete repentance. Also = aspect of what the Tzadik himself does teshuvah on behalf of all of Israel (Siman 66 cross-ref.). Everywhere building of Holy Temple is mentioned = Shabbos is mentioned = Holy Temple = aspect of eyes; Shabbos = aspect of guvanim of eyes that shine upon the Holy Temple (within). Through Shabbos (= rosh bayis): we are called bnei habayis = rosh kol chutzos is subdued. Tractate Shabbos opened with "keitzad ha'oni omeid b'chutz" = the Samech-Mem = rosh kol chutzos. Through holiness of Shabbos: he stands outside and the master of the house is inside. Samech-Mem = aspect of "ha'oni" = his gematria equals his name (with heh); or: when the Aleph is absent from his name = essential of his vitality = then he is in aspect of a poor one. "Leis aniya m'chalba" (Sages) = also alludes to him (well-known). Sages: dogs howl. Shabbos = aspect of tefillin (many times) = rosh bayis = mochin of the tefillin together with the battim (within). Through desecration of Shabbos: Name of G-d diminished and concealed → luminaries of light removed and subdued, heaven forfend → luminaries of fire intensify = aspect of burning of Holy Temple (within). Jeremiah 17:27. "Lo charevah Yerushalayim ela al she'chilellu bah es haShabbas." "Ein haDelikah metzuya ela b'makom she'yesh bo chillul Shabbas." Through mourning over destruction of Jerusalem and Holy Temple → luminaries of fire subdued + luminaries of light shine = aspect of Shabbos. "Lo siva'aru eish b'chol moshevoseichem" = roshei teivos = "misabel" + "b'yom haShabbas" (within). "La'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam" = Sages: "l'dortam ksiv" (without vav) = from language of dirah = through guarding Shabbos: saved from fires + dwellings of Israel sustained + building of Holy Temple = "machon l'shivtecha pa'alta Hashem" (Exodus 15:17; within). "L'dorosam" plain sense = all the generations are drawn from the Tzadik (= rosh bayis = Shabbos) (within). Therefore: essential time of sacred union on Shabbos = draws holy souls for one's children (Zohar) = all sacred generations are drawn from there = "eileh toldos Noach" = "korei hadorosmeiro'sh" = rosh bayis = Shabbos. Therefore letters of "rosh" immediately precede letters of "Shabbas" (as brought) = they are one aspect. Isaiah 56:3: "ben haneychar" = not from generations of Israel drawn from the rosh bayis. Isaiah 56:3: "hasaris" = does not beget children = no portion in drawing the generations. Isaiah 56:4–5: "la'sarisim asher yishmeru es Shabsosai / v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai davka" = (sustaining of holy houses and Holy Temple flows from holiness of Shabbos = aspect of "l'dortam") + "shem olam etein lo" = Shabbos is Name of G-d = will merit eternal name = great portion in sustaining sacred generations and sacred houses (= "l'dortam") and drawing of generations of all Israel (= "l'dorosam"). Zohar: this verse expounded regarding union of Shabbos. Isaiah 56:6–7 cited fully + "ne'um Hashem mekabbetz nidchey Yisrael od akabbetz alav l'nikibatzav." Ways of G-d are very wondrous = all manner of descents can be transformed into great ascents. "Lo galu Yisrael ela k'dei she'yitosfu aleihem gerim." Therefore: through guarding Shabbos = not only gathered the dispersed of Israel (= sacred stones from outside into sacred houses) but on the contrary = converts are added to them (= from the nations = from the aspect of rosh kol chutzos → but even within them: sacred sparks that fell) = specifically through exile of Israel: sacred sparks clarified → from them converts will be made → gathered into houses of holiness (root = Holy Temple = house of rosh bayis) = "ki veisi beys tefilah yikarei l'chol ha'amim / mekabbetz nidchey Yisrael od akabbetz alav l'nikibatzav" = these are the converts. "Mizmor Shir = l'Moshe" = Moshe = essential rosh bayis = "b'chol beysi ne'eman hu" (Numbers 12:7) + "Bereishis bara b'shvil Moshe." Moshe engages at entry of Shabbos in elevating the souls of living and dead = "tishtefachna avnei Kodesh b'rosh kol chutzos." "Tov lehodos v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" = essential revelation of Name of G-d = Shabbos = Name of G-d; also Shabbos = teshuvah = "tov lehodos" = Sages: from language of teshuvah and viduy devarim → His Name completed (Siman 66). "Lehagid baboker" = time of dominion of luminaries of light = aspect of lovingkindnesses = "yomam yetzaveh Hashem Chasdo" (Psalms 42:9). "V'emunascha baleilos" = even at night (= time of dominion of luminaries of fire) → they are subdued before luminaries of light through the aspect of faith. "Ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha b'ma'asey yadecha aranen" = totality of creation in act of Bereishis = aspect of the house = Beis of "Bereishis" (Sages: why was world created with a Beis?). Regarding time of destruction: "v'ha'aretz hayesah tohu vavohu v'choshech" = as if entire world destroyed through dominion of luminaries of fire. But on Shabbos = luminaries of light shine = rosh bayis = entire world in its fullness = "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i melachto asher asah" = seventh day = rosh that shines upon the house = totality of entire creation. "Mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" = totality of creation = aspect of the house. "Me'od amku machshevosecha" = the mochin = aspect of rosh bayis. "Ish ba'ar lo yeda / b'feroa'ch resha'im" = at time of dominion of luminaries of fire → for their destruction forever; in holiness = aspect of shalhava d'asha on Erev Shabbos = scorches the heads of the husks (writings). "Tzadik katamar yifrach" = produces fruit and stump replenishes = all generations drawn from him. "Shetulin b'veys Hashem" = in the aspect of the mochin and guvanim that shine upon the Holy Temple = mochin of the tefillin that are within the battim (within).

segments.he: וזה כי פי ה' דבר היינו שזוכה לבחי' שכינה מדברת מתוך גרונו שזה בחי' כי פי ה' דבר וצריכין עוד לבאר בענין זה ואין כאן מקומו עיין זוהר פנחס רכ"ח ע"א בענין אדם היושב על הכסא הנ"ל. ועיין ג"כ בזוהר ויקרא טז ע"א בענין יעקב וכו'. ועיין גם במקדש מלך שם.
segments.en:
Siman 71 — Chavalim Naflu Li b'Ne'imim — Shabbos = supernal pleasantness / vessel made through charity / sacred union of Shabbos = flames of love / glory and splendor / chavalim from chutz la'aretz / shalhava d'asha on Erev Shabbos / Korach receives his tikkun / chavalei Mashiach / Psalm 92 / Isaiah 58: Essential mind and wisdom = in Eretz Yisrael (Sages: "ein chochmah k'chochmas Eretz Yisrael"). Essential holiness of Eretz Yisrael depends upon guarding holy Shabbos (many times). Ezekiel 20:15 cited. Isaiah 58:13–14 cited. Each and every person of Israel has a portion in holiness of Shabbos = "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" commanded regarding Shabbos. Each person has portion in Eretz Yisrael. According to one's portion in Shabbos and Eretz Yisrael: receives and draws sustenance from the mochin of Eretz Yisrael. Mochin of Eretz Yisrael = aspect of no'am = "shemena'imim zeh l'zeh b'halachah" = "derachehah darchey no'am v'chol nesivoseha shalom" (Proverbs 3:17). Flow from holiness of Shabbos = supernal no'am flows (Zohar). "Vihi no'am" (Psalms 90:17) = said at going out of Shabbos = to draw illumination of Shabbos holiness upon six weekdays (well-known). "Shabbas Shalom" = supernal no'am = aspect of peace. On Shabbos: especially careful from all kinds of dispute = "lo siva'aru eish b'chol moshevoseichem" (well-known). Holiness of sacred union of Shabbos = through flow of supernal no'am → flames of love awakened = "mah yafis u'mah na'amt ahavah b'ta'anugim" = oneg Shabbas = supernal no'am shines in it → flames of love → awakened to sacred union for sake of sacred births. Through this: honor of G-d magnified = purpose of entire creation. Honor of Shabbos. "V'karas l'Shabbas oneg v'liKdosh Hashem mechubbad." "Me'angeha l'olam kavod yinchalu." Essential vessel for receiving flow of supernal no'am = made through charity (within) → must increase charity on Shabbos. Charity box distributed on every Erev Shabbos. "V'zarachah lachem yirey shmi (ilu shomrey Shabbas) shemesh Tzedakah" + Sages: "shemesh b'Shabbas tzedakah l'aniyim." Sun = aspect of peace (Sages; Rashi on Exodus 22:2). Peace = aspect of no'am (above). "Shemesh b'Shabbas" = peace and love of Shabbos = flow of supernal no'am = received in its fullness through charity to the poor. Sages: must give charity before the sacred union = through charity: vessel made to receive flow of supernal no'am → sacred birth. Isaiah 56:3: "hasaris" = no portion in revelation of honor of G-d that comes through birth. Isaiah 56:4–5: "la'sarisim asher yishmeru es Shabsosai / v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai" = ("u'v'heichalo kullo omer kavod / u'chevod Hashem malei es habayis") + "yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos" = through guarding Shabbos: draw flow of supernal no'am = great portion in revelation of honor of G-d through births of all Israel. Zohar: this verse expounded regarding union of Shabbos. "V'shamru Vnay Yisrael es haShabbas la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam" = through this: birth of generations is drawn → alludes to union of Shabbos (as brought). "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas tov lehodos v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — "elyon" gematria = "no'am" = then: supernal no'am flows from which all the zemiros are drawn = "ne'im zemiros Yisrael" (within). "Zamru lishmo ki na'im" (Psalms 135:3). "Alay asor v'alay navel alay higgayon b'chinor" = "kinor na'im im navel." "Ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" = through flow of supernal no'am: birth made + honor of G-d revealed = purpose of entire creation. "B'feroa'ch resha'im" = writings: on Erev Shabbos the good of Nogah ascends and is encompassed in holiness → impure husks wish to ascend with it → shalhava d'asha descends on their heads and humbles them = "l'hishamedam adey ad." Through blemishing honor of G-d → falls into aspect of mochin of chutz la'aretz = aspect of chavalim = "shechavlin zeh es zeh b'halachah." Much good within them = at least engage in Halachah. Only: evil that rules more strongly in chutz la'aretz has grip on them → cannot equate themselves → dispute and harm one another. Mochin of chutz la'aretz are seeking a tikkun for themselves. When holiness of Shabbos begins to flash (= essential flow of supernal no'am) → they also come to be rectified → fall into aspect of mochin of Eretz Yisrael = aspect of no'am = "chavalim naflu li b'ne'imim" (within). Good of Nogah encompassed in holiness; evil and impure husks fall downward through shalhava d'asha. "Ki hinneh oyevecha yovadu." "Tzadik katamar yifrach" = sofei teivos spell "Korach" = also Korach receives tikkun through holiness of Shabbos (as above). Chavalim were so rectified = even Korach (in whom evil of chavalim had such a grip = disputed with Moshe himself) → even the good within him will receive tikkun through holiness of Shabbos. Sages on "Tzadik katamar": just as the palm tree beautiful in appearance and fruits sweet = "mah yafis u'mah na'amt"; just as palm tree has a desire = righteous have a desire; their desire = G-d = from supernal no'am: flames of love awakened. "K'erez baLevanon yisgeh" = Zohar Vayikra folio 16 (Aramaic): "b'Levanon vadai da Eden ila'ah d'aleih ksiv ein lo ra'asah" (see Mikdash Melech) = the no'am itself receives and flows even from above it = from aspect of supernal Eden. "Shetulin b'veys Hashem" = Sages: regarding the future when G-d will gather the exiles from chutz la'aretz to Eretz Yisrael = they will ascend from mochin of chutz la'aretz to mochin of Eretz Yisrael. "Lehagid ki yashar Hashem tzuri" = mochin of chutz la'aretz = aspect of dispute = "chalak libam" = twist the heart = come to question G-d as it were. But through mochin of Eretz Yisrael: merits to know and declare that G-d is righteous and upright. Since good of Nogah ascends and is rectified through Shabbos → converts are made from this (well-known: converts are from aspect of good of Nogah). "Shnayyim mikra v'echad Targum" = Targum is also aspect of Nogah encompassed in holiness. Isaiah 56:6–7 + "ne'um Hashem mekabbetz nidchey Yisrael od akabbetz alav l'nikibatzav" = these are the converts. Sages: saved from chavalei Mashiach through Shabbos meals = chavalei Mashiach will come because chavalim come to receive their tikkun → will arouse dispute among Torah scholars (Rashi) = all because of the chavalim = aspect of dispute. But through holiness of Shabbos: saved from this (above). Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = root of sacred mochin = aspect of supernal no'am; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of sacred Malchus = revelation of honor of G-d through flow of supernal no'am; saved from subjugation of kingdoms = the evil of the chavalim = blemishing the sacred Malchus (= heavenly honor); therefore Malchus d'Sitra Achra called "me'achblin kramim / chavley resha'im / chavley maves / chavley Sh'ol" (well-known); "nachalas Yaakov" = vessel made through charity to receive flow of supernal no'am → sacred birth + honor of G-d magnified = "kol zera Yaakov kabbeduhu" + Yaakov = aspect of charity (within). Children of Yaakov = "nachalas Hashem banim" = called "nit'ey ne'manim" (Isaiah 17:10) = "al ken tit'i nit'ey na'amanim" + Rashi: "nata'ta neti'im ne'amim shenem asar shivtei Yaakov" = their birth drawn through flow of supernal no'am. Also: "nachalas Yaakov" plain sense = inheritance of Eretz Yisrael = mochin of Eretz Yisrael = aspect of no'am (above). Nachalah b'li metzarim = merits to rectify mochin of chutz la'aretz = evil in them falls and is nullified + good encompassed in holiness.

 Siman 72 — Chayyim Nitzchiyim — Through Shabbos: receiving greatness / essential greatness = lowliness / resurrection = revival of the lowliness of Moshe / three aspects of Shabbos / Isaiah 58: Through holiness of Shabbos: merits to receive greatness (gedulah) = "v'gam ha'ohavim devarehah gedulah baCharu" (Prayer). Essential greatness = lowliness (shefilus). This will be the essential resurrection of the future = that the lowliness of each and every person will be revived and rise in resurrection → person will be in the aspect of without limit (b'li gevul) → able to attain spiritual delight of World to Come (= without limit) → will live eternal life of World to Come (= without limit) (within). Likewise regarding holiness of Shabbos (= foretaste of World to Come) → nachalah b'li metzarim + "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" = merits eternal life = lowliness is revived → in aspect of nothing (ayin) and without limit → can attain delight of World to Come (= without limit). Also: through Shabbos: each person merits according to his level to receive flashing of mochin (many times). Mochin and Da'as = building of Holy Temple (within) → why Shabbos is juxtaposed to building of Holy Temple. According to degree one receives flashing of mochin → merits to receive greatness. Greatness = Malchus = bound and tied to the flowing of the mochin = "melech asur baRahasim b'Rihitei mochin" (Song of Songs 7:6). All individual mochin receive from the encompassing mind = chacham haDor. "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" → commanded regarding work of Mishkan (also called Mikdash) and warning of Shabbos. Therefore: commandment to receive face of teacher on Shabbos = through the fact that the all-encompassing sage sees him and looks upon him → his mind flashes → merits to receive holiness of Shabbos even more = aspect of flashing of mochin = "ki Kodesh hi" = the mochin (well-known) → receives greatness. Therefore: commandment on Shabbos to innovate Torah novellae = through flashing of mochin: merits to innovate in Torah (within). All agree: Torah was given on Shabbos. "Yirey boshes — yirey Shabbas." "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" (as brought). Through Torah novellae and Torah explanations: shame is drawn (within) → through shame: merits teshuvah (= aspect of Shabbos; many times). Teshuvah = aspect of life = "v'hashivum v'chayu" (Ezekiel 18:32) = eternal life of World to Come (= Shabbos = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu"). Through this: lowliness of Moshe our teacher (= dressed within every limb and limb of each and every person of Israel) is revived and rises in resurrection → merits oneg Shabbas = delight of World to Come = without limit. Jeremiah 17:24–25: "u'va'u b'sha'arey ha'ir hazos melachim v'sarim" = aspect of greatness and kingship received through flashing of mochin of Shabbos. Three Shabbosim of Zohar: (1) Shabbas ila'ah = aspect of wisdom and understanding = flashing of mochin; or perhaps = the light of World to Come itself that flashes and shines on Shabbos (= foretaste of World to Come); (2) Shabbas d'yoma = aspect of Tiferes = Torah = aspect of Torah novellae; (3) Shabbas d'leila = aspect of Malchus = greatness and kingship received through this. Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag" = merits to receive delight of World to Come (= without limit); "hirkavticha" = greatness and kingship received through holiness of Shabbos; "nachalas Yaakov" = aspect of awe and lowliness (shefilus) = heritage of Yaakov = "ekev anavah yiras Hashem" (Proverbs 22:4) = this lowliness = aspect of eternal life; therefore "Yaakov Avinu lo mes" (Sages). Nachalah b'li metzarim = through aspect of eternal life = lowliness revived = in the aspect of nothing and without limit → merits oneg Shabbas = delight of World to Come = without limit. Also: Torah novellae = aspect of heritage of Yaakov = "morashah kehilas Yaakov" (Deuteronomy 33:4). "Hirkavticha" = one merits greatness and kingship → greatness will be encompassed with humility = essential greatness = "b'makom gedulas sham atah motzei anavtanuso" (within) → then completeness to both. Saved from subjugation of kingdoms = Malchus d'Sitra Achra (= arrogance and insolence) has no grip on greatness and kingship of holiness (since encompassed with humility and lowliness). Also: humility must be in its fullness — not in aspect of lowly and contemptible and lazy (= defective humility and flattery; elsewhere) = also called aspect of subjugation of Malchus d'Sitra Achra (whose kingship only through insolence; Sages). When humility not in its fullness = only aspect of melancholy = mind subjugated = aspect of subjugation of kingdoms. Essential fullness of humility = when encompassed with greatness and sacred kingship = aspect of revival in resurrection of the lowliness = in the aspect of eternal life = without limit. "Nachalas Yaakov" = aspect of Torah novellae (above).

segments.he:
סימן עח-בענין הנהגות הפשוטות 
ארז"ל חד אמר לא ניתנה שבת אלא לתענוג וח"א לא ניתנה שבת אלא לד"ת ולא פליגי מ"ד לתענוג אלו ת"ח שהם יגיעים בתורה כל ימות השבוע ובשבת הם באים ומתענגים ומ"ד לת"ת אלו הפועלים שהם עמלים במלאכתם כל ימות השבוע ובשבת הם באים ומתעסקים בתורה. גם ארז"ל ששת ימים תעבוד וכו' בנוהג שבעולם מלך ב"ו אומר לעבדי' עשו עמכם יום אחד ועמי ששה ימים. אבל הקב"ה אינו כן אלא כך אמר הקב"ה לישראל בני עשו עמכם ששת ימים ועשו עמי יום אחד (פסיקתא דעשרת הדברות) ולפי המבפ"נ מובן הענין היטב כי עיקר החיים הוא התורה וכל הפורש מן התורה כפורש מן החיים ובאמת א"א להיות דבוק בהתורה תמיד בלי הפסק רגע. כי אפי' הבעל תורה ואפי' הבעל השגה וכו' בהכרח להיות בטלין מן התורה איזה זמן בשביל לעסוק בצרכי הגוף וא"כ במה מחיין עצמן בזו השעה שבטלין מן התורה שאז הוא בבחי' איש פשוט. ומכש"כ שיש אנשים פשוטים ממש ואעפי"כ הם כשרים ויראי שמים וצריכים לקבל איזה חיות מהתורה שהוא עיקר החיים ובאמת הם רחוקים מהתורה. אך דע שהחיות של כל אלו הפשוטים הוא מבחי' קיום העולם קודם מתן תורה שהיה העולם מתקיים רק בחסדו. וזה בחי' האוצר מתנת חנם. ובאמת בוודאי גם אז היתה התורה במציאות כי התורה הוא נצחיית אמנם אז היתה התורה בהעלם ובהסתר היינו שכל התורה הכלולה בעשרת הדברות היתה אז נעלמת בדרך ארץ וישוב העולם שנברא בעשרה מאמרות.
segments.en: Siman 73 — Tehillim Mesugal l'Teshuvah — Shabbos = Binah = root of repentance / reciting Psalms on Shabbos / Adam opened with Psalm 92 / 49 gates of teshuvah = 49 days of the Omer / all encompassed in Shabbos / giving of the Torah on Shabbos / Isaiah 58 / heritage of Yaakov = Psalms: Shabbos = aspect of Binah (Zohar). Binah = root of aspect of teshuvah (well-known). "U'levano yovin v'shav" (Isaiah 6:10). Shabbos = aspect of teshuvah (many times). Since reciting Psalms is propitious for teshuvah → increase reciting of Psalms on Shabbos. Also in the order of prayer. Many among Israel are accustomed to reciting many Psalms on every Shabbos. Adam the first man — when power of teshuvah became known to him — opened and said "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" = Shabbos = aspect of teshuvah (within; Likutay Moharan Siman 79 cross-ref.). Therefore he immediately said: "tov lehodos laHashem v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" = to recite many Psalms. Forty-nine days of the Omer counting = corresponding to forty-nine gates of teshuvah (within). "U'sfartem lachem mimacharat haShabbas" (Leviticus 23:15) = calls Passover "Shabbas" = yetzias Mitzrayim = aspect of teshuvah = aspect of Shabbos. "Ad mimacharat haShabbas hashevi'is tisperu" (Leviticus 23:16). All fifty gates of teshuvah encompassed in holiness of Shabbos. Therefore all agree: Torah given on Shabbos = on the fiftieth day "vayyered Hashem al Har Sinai" = aspect of "v'ashuva aleichem" = aspect of fiftieth gate (within). Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag" = merits to pass through all forty-nine gates of teshuvah until arrives at fiftieth gate (= teshuvah of the Almighty Himself = "v'ashuva aleichem"); "hirkavticha" = saved from subjugation of kingdoms = "ein haGeulah taluyah ela b'teshuvah" (Sages); also Sages: "retzioni la'asos retzoncha ela she'or she'ba'isah v'shibbud malchiyos me'akev" → through holiness of Shabbos: leaven in the dough subdued + verse promises no obstruction to teshuvah even from subjugation of kingdoms; "nachalas Yaakov" = aspect of teshuvah = given only to children of Yaakov and not to nations (early authorities; Likut Chadash entry teshuvah); also "nachalas Hashem banim." Heritage of Yaakov = twelve tribes of Yaakov = aspect of forty-nine gates of teshuvah (within). "Shivtei Yah eidus l'Yisrael lehodos l'Shem Hashem" = aspect of Psalms. Heritage of Yaakov = aspect of Psalms (Sages; Midrash Rabbah Vayeitzei): Yaakov said entire Book of Psalms = "v'Atah Kadosh yoshev tehilos Yisrael" = refers to Yaakov = "Yisrael Sava." Therefore it is explained regarding Yaakov: he guarded Shabbos = root of aspect of teshuvah (above). Sages: nachalah b'li metzarim = nothing stands before teshuvah. Also: through reciting Psalms: all obstacles and obstructions to teshuvah are nullified → through Psalms: merits to arrive at the letter and gate of teshuvah that pertains to one + to open the gate. Even one who has no awakening toward teshuvah: through Psalms: merits to be awakened to do teshuvah → aspect of nachalah b'li metzarim.

segments.he: והצדיק הגדול בעת שמוכרח לפרוש מן התורה לפי שעה קלה והוא אז בבחי' איש פשוט אז הוא מקבל חיות מבחי' האוצר מתנת חנם הזה. וזה הוא הדרך לא"י. כי עיקר כבישת א"י הוא ע"י כח מעשיו הגיד לעמו וכו' שזה בחי' העשרה מאמרות שבהם נברא העולם. ועי"ז הוא מחיה את כל הפשוטים הנ"ל וכו' וכל מה שהאדם קרוב יותר אל הקדושה ואל הצדיק הוא מקבל ממנו חיות גבוה ביותר עיי"ש עוד.
segments.en:
Simanim 77, 78, 79 continue in the next installment.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

segments.he: והנה קדושת שבת מבואר בזוה"ק שהוא כללא דכל אורייתא ונביאים וכתובים וכו' והכל מודים כי בשבת ניתנה תורה כי הם בחי' אחת כי שקולה שבת ככל התורה כולה כשארז"ל. וע"כ באמת הוא בחי' חיים בחי' טועמיה חיים זכו ועל הפורש ממנה ח"ו נאמר מחלליה מות יומת והוא ככופר בכל התורה כשארז"ל.
segments.en: Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

segments.he: וע"כ לא ניתנה שבת אלא לד"ת בבחי' אמר הקב"ה עשו עמכם ששה ימים ועשו עמי יום אחד כי בכל ימות השבוע טרודים רוב העולם בד"א ועסק ומלאכה וע"כ צריכין לעסוק בד"ת בשבת עכ"פ שאז כל המלאכות אסורין. וע"כ ארז"ל זכריהו מאחד בשבת כי קדושת שבת הוא החיות של כל ימות השבוע ע"כ צריכין לזכור עכ"פ בכל ימות השבוע שעיקר החיות דקדושה הוא שבת ועי"ז ממשיך איזה חיות דקדושה מהארת קדושת שבת על כל ימי החול ג"כ כי בימי החול שטרודים במלאכה ועסקי ד"א ורחוקים מהתורה אז צריכין לקבל חיות רק מהחסד חנם בחי' האוצר מתנת חנם הנ"ל שהוא בחי' החסד חנם שהיה מקיים העולם קודם מ"ת ע"י התורה הנעלמת שהיא מלובשת בתוך ד"א שהיא בחי' הדרך לא"י כנ"ל. ועיקר הארת זה החסד חנם שהוא שרש בחי' העשרה מאמרות בחי' כי אמרתי עולם חסד יבנה וכמובא במ"א הוא בשבת שאז הוא עיקר שלימות הבריאה כולה שנבראת בעשרה מאמרות בחי' ויכל א' ביום השביעי וכו' וכמו שארז"ל וע"כ נמתקין אז כל הדינים ונמשכין חסדים גדולים כמבואר בזוה"ק. וכל זה מחמת שמאיר אז בחי' האוצר מתנת חנם הנ"ל. וע"כ ארז"ל באמת אפי' עע"ז וכו' מוחלין לו כי הכל נתתקן ע"י האוצר מתנת חנם הנ"ל.
segments.en: Yikara DiShabsa — Part Two Simanim 77, 78, 79

segments.he: וע"כ בשבת אז עיקר זמן המסוגל ביותר להשגת סתרי תורה כמובא. כי אז מאיר בחי' החסד חנם שהיא בחי' התורה הנעלמת הנ"ל. וע"כ קדושת שבת בעצמה נקראת מתנה כשארז"ל מתנה טובה יש לי בבית גנזי ושבת שמה כי הוא בבחי' האוצר מתנת חנם הנ"ל אך מחמת שמהאוצר הזה א"א לקבל כ"א הצדיק הגדול שדבוק מאד בהתוה"ק בתכלית השלימות ואז כשהוא מוכרח לבטל קצת ואז הוא איש פשוט. ומחמת שהוא דבוק מאד בהתוה"ק וא"א לו לפרוש ממנה כלל אפי' רגע קלה ע"כ הוא זוכה לקבל חיות בעת פשיטותו מבחי' התורה הנעלמת בתוך ד"א שזה בחי' העשרה מאמרות שבהם מלובש עשרת הדברות כנ"ל. ועי"ז הוא ממשיך חיות לכל הפשוטים כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Part Two — Chelek Beis · Simanim 77 · 78 · 79

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

segments.he: וע"כ אלו הפשוטים צריכין לעסוק ביותר בתלמוד תורה בשבת עכ"פ בכדי שיהיה להם איזה שייכות והתקרבות להתוה"ק מחמת שבעת שבטלים ממלאכה וד"א מרבים בעסק התורה מזה נגלה ונראה שמה שאינם עוסקים בתורה בימי החול הוא רק מחמת טרדתם בעסקי פרנסה ודרך ארץ. ועי"ז זוכים שגם בימי החול מקבלין חיות דרך הצדיק הנ"ל מבחי' התורה הנעלמת בתוך דרך ארץ. וע"כ הת"ח וצדיקים שהם יגיעים בתורה כל ימות השבת ע"כ הם רשאים לבטל קצת בשבת מת"ת ולהמשיך קצת בענג אכילה ושתיה לכבוד שבת (וכמובא גם בשו"ע או"ח סי' רצ) ועי"ז יש להם איזה שייכות לבחי' האנשים הפשוטים הנ"ל וממשיכים להם חיות דקדושה מבחי' התורה הנעלמת בתוך ד"א ועסקי הגוף וכמבפ"נ שבשביל זה מוכרח הצדיק הגדול לירד וליפול לפעמים לתוך פשיטות ולהיות איש פשוט איזה שעה כי עי"ז הוא מחיה את כל הפשוטים וכו' וכ"א כפי קירובו אל הקדושה ואל הצדיק הנ"ל ביותר כן הוא מקבל ממנו חיות גבוה יותר וכנ"ל.
segments.en: ✦ חלק ב · PART TWO ✦

segments.he: וע"כ צריך אדם להקביל פני רבו בשבת כמבואר בזוה"ק ודבר גדול מאד לבא על שבת לצדיק אמתי כמבואר במ"א כי זוכה עי"ז לקבל ביותר בחי' הארת החיות דקדושה שממשיך הצדיק מבחי' התורה הנעלמת והאוצר מתנת חנם שמאיר ומתגלה ביותר ע"י קדושת שבת כנ"ל. וע"כ ארז"ל כי אפי' ע"ה ירא לשקר בשבת. כי אעפ"י שהוא רחוק מהתורה אעפי"כ ע"י קדושת שבת נמשך גם עליו יראה מבחי' התורה הנעלמת בתוך העשרה מאמרות וכל מאמר יש לו בחי' יראה בחי' הקם לעבדך אמרתך אשר ליראתך וכמבפ"נ. וזשדרז"ל בראשית ברא וכו' בשביל היראה שנקראת ראשית נמצא שכל העשרה מאמרות שעל ידם היתה הבריאה הוא רק בשביל יראה.
segments.en:
Siman 77 — סימן עז (Part Two)
 Retzu'ah Hayesah Yotzeis — Shabbos = tefillin = mochin — the awe of Shabbos = the strap that passes through the maavarta — eating on Shabbos in holiness sweetens the awe — from the mouth: the stature of a person [kumat Adam] — the Shechinah speaks from his throat — Zohar Pinchas 228a — Zohar Vayikra 16a — Isaiah 58

segments.he: וזה שמובא בפנים איך שצריכין להתחזק בעבודת ה' ושלא לייאש עצמו לעולם ולידע ולהאמין שגם הוא מקבל חיות דקדושה מהתורה ע"י הצדיק הנ"ל וכו' ואפי' איש פשוט ג"כ צריך שיהיה לו יראת שמים וכו' היינו כנ"ל שזה בחי' היראה שמאיר בשבת אפי' לעמי הארץ ואנשים פשוטים כנ"ל. ומחמת שזה הדרך הוא הדרך של כבישת א"י ע"כ ארז"ל אם אתם משמרין את השבת אתם נכנסים לא"י היינו כנ"ל. וזה בחי' וירא מנוחה כי טוב. מנוחה זה בחי' קדושת שבת שהוא יום מנוחה וקדושה וזה ואת הארץ כי נעמה כי עי"ז זוכין לירושת א"י וע"כ א"י בעצמה נקראת ג"כ מנוחה בחי' אם יבואון אל מנוחתי וכתיב אל המנוחה ואל הנחלה.
segments.en:
Shabbos is the aspect of tefillin — mental faculties [mochin] — as is well-known — and as mentioned above many times. And also — on Shabbos one merits awe — the aspect of: "yirey Shabbas." For Shabbos is likewise the aspect of Malchus — and Malchus is the source of awe — the aspect of the fear of the kingship [morah shel Malchus]. And therefore the awe is drawn upon a person [at that time] — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: "mipnei she'eymas Shabbas alav [because the awe of Shabbos is upon him]." And even an am ha'aretz [unlearned person] fears to lie on Shabbos. And therefore those who guard the Shabbos are called: "yirey shmi" — as it is written [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught — and as mentioned above many times.

And the aforementioned awe is the aspect of the strap [retzu'ah] that passes through the maavarta [the passage] of the tefillin — that is, the awe that passes through the mental faculties and the tefillin. For [Psalms 111:10]: "reishis chochmah yiras Hashem [the beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem]" — and as explained within. And behold — even during the weekday — through eating in holiness and in the awe of Heaven — one sweetens the aforementioned awe — the aspect of the strap — so that no sorrow, heaven forfend, should flow from it. And as explained within. And on the holy Shabbos — eating is certainly in holiness by every person — for the eating of Shabbos is entirely holy. And then — through the eating — the awe comes upon the person — in the aspect of [Ruth 2:14]: "l'eis ha'ochel gashi halum" — and so on — as explained within. And through this one merits to be saved from all sorrow — (for the eating of Shabbos is the aspect of the sweetening of the judgments [hamtakas haDinim] — as brought) — and moreover — one merits that from the mouth the stature of a person [kumat Adam] is made — that is, the mouth [peh] is rectified — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos. For the mouth is completed in great light during the eating of Shabbos — and as explained within — above in Likutay Moharan, Siman 57. Until one merits an even greater ascent — to the aspect of: "Shechinah medaberes mitoch gerono [the Shechinah speaks from within his throat]" — which is the aspect of the holy spirit [Ru'ach haKodesh] that is drawn upon each and every person according to his level on the holy Shabbos — as explained in the holy Zohar. (From this it is understood — for there are in this very refined and very spiritual matters that it is impossible to explain.)
