segments.he: וזה ונח מצא חן נח הוא בחי' שבת נייחא וכו' כמובא בזוה"ק מצא חן כי ע"י שבת ממשיכין בחי' האוצר מתנת חנם שעליו נאמר וחנותי את אשר אחון כשדרז"ל (מ"ר פרשת כי תשא מה) וע"כ שבת הוא בחי' תשובה כנ"ל כ"פ. כי עיקר תיקון התשובה הוא ע"י בחי' החסד חנם הנ"ל וע"כ צריכין להרבות צדקה לעניים על שבת וקופה של צדקה מתחלקת בערב שבת בכדי להמשיך עי"ז החסד חנם הנ"ל המאיר בשבת.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — and so on — "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg" — (the aspect of the meals of Shabbos) — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — which is the root of the supreme mental faculties — and most wondrous. And also from there is the root of the sweetening of all judgments. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: they give him all the desires of his heart — for through this he is saved from all sorrow.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת וכו' אז תתענג על ה' דא עתיקא קדישא שהוא בחי' רב חסד כמבואר בזוה"ק היינו בחי' האוצר מתנת חנם הנ"ל שנמשך מבחי' רב חסד בחי' עתיק. והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין בחי' עליית המלכות שהוא מחיה את כל המדריגות התחתונות שהן בחי' הפשוטים הנ"ל הרחוקים מהתוה"ק ובחול אז המלכות בבחי' רגליה יורדות מות ויונקים ממנה כביכול המלכיות דסט"א. אבל בשבת שמאיר החסד חנם הנ"ל שבזה מחיין גם כל הפשוטים הנ"ל ע"י התורה הנעלמת אז עולה המלכות בעליות גדולות והמלכיות דסט"א נדחין ונופלין. וע"כ דרז"ל על זה שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות היינו כנ"ל. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא בחי' התורה כידוע.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — which is the awe — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — which are the aspect of the fallen awe [yira'os nefalos] — the aspect of the fear of the kingship. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the person who sits upon the Throne [Adam hayoshev al haKissay] — as is well-known. And Yaakov our Patriarch is the Chariot [merkavah] for the aforementioned person. And therefore his form is engraved upon the Throne — as explained in the holy Zohar. And this: "v'ha'achalticha" — specifically — for one merits this through the holy eating of the holiness of Shabbos. For through this — the mouth is made into the stature of a person — and afterward one ascends even further — until one reaches the aspect of: the person who sits upon the Throne. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits [nachalah b'li metzarim] — for the aforementioned person is in the aspect of: an inheritance without limits — as explained in the writings.

segments.he: היינו כי עי"ז יכולין להחזיר ולקרב הכל אל התורה"ק גם כפשוטו ר"ל שיזכה לירושת א"י שהוא נחלת יעקב כי ע"י זה הדרך כובשין א"י וזשדרז"ל שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים. היינו כי יכולין עי"ז לקדש כל המקומות שבעולם בבחי' קדושת א"י כמבפ"נ. וזהו כי פי ה' דבר כי הכל נברא בעשרה מאמרות שבהן נעלמים עשרת הדברות ועיקר שלימות העשרה מאמרות הוא ע"י שבת כנ"ל. וכן העשרת הדברות שהם כלל התוה"ק ניתנו בשבת כנ"ל. וצריכין לבאר עוד.
segments.en:
And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — that is, one merits the aspect of: "Shechinah medaberes mitoch gerono" — for this is the aspect of: "ki pi Hashem diber." And one must yet explain further regarding this matter — and this is not its place. See Zohar Pinchas, folio 228a — regarding the matter of the person who sits upon the Throne — mentioned above. And also see in Zohar Vayikra, folio 16a — regarding the matter of Yaakov — and so on. And also see in Mikdash Melech there.

 Siman 78 — סימן עח (Part Two)
 B'Inyan Hanhagos haPeshutos — Shabbos = the totality of all the Torah — the hidden Torah within the ten utterances — the simple person receives vitality from the hidden Torah through the Tzadik — the treasury of free gift [otzar matnas chinam] — on Shabbos this free gift shines most — even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos — "Bereishis bara" — for the sake of awe — coming to the Tzadik on Shabbos — "Vihi no'am" — charity on Erev Shabbos — "v'Noach matza chen" — Shabbos = teshuvah — Isaiah 58

segments.he: סימן עט-הקול קול יעקב
segments.en: Our Sages of blessed memory taught: one said — Shabbos was given only for delight [ta'anug] — and one said — Shabbos was given only for words of Torah [divrei Torah]. And they do not dispute one another. The one who said for delight — these are the Torah scholars [Talmidei Chachamim] — who toil in Torah all the days of the week — and on Shabbos they come and take delight. And the one who said for words of Torah — these are the laborers [po'alim] — who toil in their work all the days of the week — and on Shabbos they come and engage in Torah. And also our Sages of blessed memory taught: "sheshes yamim ta'avod" — and so on. The usual way of the world: a mortal king says to his servants — do for yourselves one day and do for me six days. But the Holy One, blessed be He, is not so. Rather — this is what the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Israel: My children — do for yourselves six days — and do for Me one day. (Pesikta d'Aseres haDevuros.) And according to what is explained within — the matter is well understood. For the essential life is the Torah. And all who separate from the Torah — it is as if they separate from life. And in truth — it is impossible to be constantly cleaving to the Torah without interruption for even a moment. For even the master of Torah — and even the master of attainment — and so on — is inevitably idle from the Torah for some time — for the sake of engaging in the bodily needs. And if so — through what do they sustain themselves during this time when they are idle from the Torah — when they are in the aspect of a simple person [ish pashut]? All the more so that there are literally simple people [anashim peshutim] — and nonetheless they are fit and G-d-fearing — and they need to receive some vitality from the Torah — which is the essential life. And in truth — they are far from the Torah. But know: the vitality of all these simple people is from the aspect of the sustaining of the world before the giving of the Torah [matan Torah] — when the world was sustained only through His lovingkindness. And this is the aspect of: the treasury of free gift [otzar matnas chinam]. And in truth — certainly even then the Torah existed — for the Torah is eternal [nitzchiyis]. But then — the Torah was in concealment and hiddenness — that is, all the Torah encompassed in the Ten Commandments was then concealed within the way of the world [derech eretz] and the settling of the world [yishuv ha'olam] — which was created through the ten utterances.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' תשובה בחי' ושבת עד ה' אלקיך. ושבת אותיות בשת כמבואר בליקו"א סי' וא"ו. ובסי' נח מבואר שהוא בחי' תשובה מאהבה. ואהבה הוא בחי' התאחדות הזמן כמבפ"נ. כי שבת הוא מעין עוה"ב שהוא למעלה מהזמן. וזה בחי' וברכתו מכל הימים וקדשתו מכל הזמנים. ועי"ז זוכין לשמוע הקול דקדושה. וזה שנסמך אחר פסוק שם שם לו חוק ומשפט (שדרז"ל מזה ששבת במרה נצטוו) ויאמר אם שמוע תשמע לקול ה' אלקיך וכו'. וזה בחי' הקולות שאומרין בכניסת שבת במזמור לדוד הבו וכו'.
segments.en:
And the great Tzadik — at the time when he is compelled to separate from the Torah for a brief moment — and he is then in the aspect of a simple person — he receives vitality from the aspect of this treasury of free gift. And this is the path to Eretz Yisrael. For the essential conquest of Eretz Yisrael is through the power of His deeds [ko'ach ma'asav] — He told His people — and so on — [Psalms 111:6] — which is the aspect of the ten utterances through which the world was created. And through this he revives all the aforementioned simple people — and so on. And the closer a person is to holiness and to the Tzadik — the higher the vitality he receives from him. See there further.

And behold — the holiness of Shabbos — it is explained in the holy Zohar: it is the totality [kelala] of the entire Torah — Prophets — and Writings — and so on. And all agree: on Shabbos the Torah was given — for they are one aspect. For Shabbos is equivalent to the entire Torah — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And therefore — in truth — it is the aspect of life — the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu [those who taste it merited life]." And regarding one who abandons it, heaven forfend — it is stated [Exodus 31:14]: "mechaleleha mos yumas" — and he is like one who denies the entire Torah — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

segments.he: סימן פא-כשאדם משמח עצמו
segments.en: And therefore: Shabbos was given only for words of Torah — in the aspect of: G-d, blessed be He, said: do for yourselves six days and do for Me one day. For all the days of the week the majority of the world is occupied with worldly matters [divrei alma] — and work — and labor. And therefore they need to engage in words of Torah on Shabbos at least — when then all the labors are forbidden. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — for the holiness of Shabbos is the vitality of all the weekdays. Therefore one must at least remember throughout all the weekdays: that the essential sacred vitality is Shabbos. And through this one draws some sacred vitality from the illumination of the holiness of Shabbos upon all the weekdays as well. For during the weekdays — when one is occupied with labor and the affairs of worldly matters — and is far from the Torah — then one needs to receive vitality only from the free lovingkindness [chesed chinam] — the aspect of the treasury of free gift — mentioned above. Which is the aspect of the free lovingkindness that sustained the world before the giving of the Torah — through the concealed Torah — which is clothed within worldly matters. And this is the aspect of: the path to Eretz Yisrael — as mentioned above. And the essential illumination of this free lovingkindness — which is the root of the aspect of the ten utterances — the aspect of [Psalms 89:3]: "ki amarti olam chesed yibbaneh" — and as brought elsewhere — is on Shabbos. For then is the essential fullness of the entire creation — which was created through the ten utterances — in the aspect of [Genesis 2:2]: "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" — and so on. And as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And therefore — then — all the judgments are sweetened — and great lovingkindnesses are drawn — as explained in the holy Zohar. And all of this is because at that time the aspect of the treasury of free gift mentioned above shines. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught in truth: even if one worshipped idolatry and so on — he is forgiven. For everything is rectified through the aforementioned treasury of free gift.

segments.he: מבואר כבר לעיל כ"פ בשם ספר אור ישראל סמך לריקודין של שמחה בשבת קודש שזה ע"ד אם תשיב משבת רגליך כי אז עולין הרגלין אל הקדושה שזה בחי' ריקודין. ומבפ"נ במאמר זה שע"י ריקודין של שמחה של תורה ומצוה בזה נתעלין כל תמכי אורייתא שהם נקראים סמכי קשוט וכו'. ואפשר שזה בחי' משארז"ל (שבת קטז) מצילין תיק הספק עם הספר ומובא במגלה עמוקות אופן ס' תיק הספר ר"ת תרין ירכי קשוט. היינו שע"י השמחה של תורה ומצוה שנקראים ספר בפרט קדושת שבת ששקולה ככל התורה והמצוות כשארז"ל ונקרא ג"כ ספר דא שם ושבת שמא דקוב"ה כנ"ל כ"פ. וזה ג"כ ותיק התפילין עם התפילין כי קדושת שבת הוא בחי' תפילין כנ"ל כ"פ. וע"י קדושת שבת נתעלה גם רגלי הקדושה שהן בחי' ירכי קשוט היינו תמכי אורייתא. וזה ואעפ"י שיש בתוכן מעות. היינו אעפ"י שהם טרודים במלאכה ועסק ממון ומעות כל ימות השבוע אעפי"כ גם הם יש להם עליה ע"י קדושת שבת. גם ע"י קדושת שבת נתתקן ונתעלה הדיבור שנקרא רגל שזה בחי' ודבר דבר הנאמר בשבת גם נתעלה בממון הנקרא רגל שזה בחי' משארז"ל ברכת ה' היא תעשיר וכו' זה שבת. ועשירים שבשאר ארצות על שמכבדין את השבת כשארז"ל. וזה בחי' קדושת הזווג של שבת. כי גם האשה נקראת רגל כמבפ"נ. וע"י קדושת שבת נתעלה גם היא וזוכה עי"ז לבנים הגונים שנקראים ג"כ רגל בבחי' ברא כרעא דאבוה. גם נתתקן האמונה הק' שהיא ג"כ בחי' רגל וכן כל הדברים שנקראים רגל נתעלים ע"י קדושת שבת כמובן כפי המבפ"נ.
segments.en: And therefore on Shabbos — then — the time that is most propitious for attaining the secrets of Torah [sitrei Torah] — as brought. For then — the aspect of the free lovingkindness shines — which is the aspect of the concealed Torah — mentioned above. And therefore the holiness of Shabbos itself is called a gift [matanah] — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay — v'Shabbas shemah [a good gift I have in My treasury — and Shabbos is its name]." For it is in the aspect of the treasury of free gift — mentioned above. But since from this treasury — only the great Tzadik can receive — the one who is cleaving to the holy Torah with the utmost fullness — and then when he is compelled to set it aside somewhat — he is then a simple person. And since he is cleaving so greatly to the holy Torah — and it is impossible for him to separate from it at all even for a brief moment — therefore he merits to receive vitality in his time of simplicity from the aspect of the concealed Torah within worldly matters — which is the aspect of the ten utterances within which the Ten Commandments are clothed — as mentioned above. And through this he draws vitality to all the simple people — as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן פב-כי תצא
segments.en:
And therefore these simple people must engage even more in the study of Torah on Shabbos at least — in order to have some connection and closeness to the holy Torah. Since at the time when they are idle from labor and worldly matters — they increase their engagement in the Torah. From this it is revealed and seen: that the fact that they do not engage in Torah during the weekdays — is only because of their being occupied with the affairs of livelihood and the way of the world. And through this they merit — that also during the weekdays they receive vitality through the aforementioned Tzadik — from the aspect of the concealed Torah within the way of the world. And therefore — the Torah scholars and Tzadikim — who are toiling in Torah all the days of the week — therefore they are permitted to set aside somewhat on Shabbos from the study of Torah — and to draw somewhat upon the delight of eating and drinking for the honor of Shabbos — (and as also brought in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 290) — and through this they have some connection to the aspect of the aforementioned simple people — and they draw for them sacred vitality from the aspect of the concealed Torah within worldly matters and the bodily affairs. And as explained within: for this very reason the great Tzadik is compelled to descend and fall sometimes into simplicity — and to be a simple person for some time. For through this he revives all the simple people — and so on. And each person — according to his greater closeness to holiness and to the aforementioned Tzadik — receives a higher vitality from him — as mentioned above.

And therefore a person must receive the face of his teacher on Shabbos — as explained in the holy Zohar. And it is a very great matter to come on Shabbos to a true Tzadik — as explained elsewhere. For through this one merits even more to receive the aspect of the illumination of the sacred vitality — that the Tzadik draws from the aspect of the concealed Torah and the treasury of free gift — that shines and is revealed even more through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos. For even though he is far from the Torah — nonetheless — through the holiness of Shabbos — awe is drawn upon him as well — from the aspect of the concealed Torah within the ten utterances. And every utterance has the aspect of awe — the aspect of [Psalms 119:38]: "hakem l'avdecha imrasecha — asher l'yir'asecha" — and as explained within. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "Bereishis bara" — and so on — for the sake of awe — which is called "reishis." It follows that the entire ten utterances — through which the creation came about — are only for the sake of awe.

segments.he: מבואר כבר לעיל כ"פ כי שבת הוא בחי' מלכות והוא בחי' הדיבור שזה בחי' ודבר דבר הנאמר בשבת כמובא בזוהר בראשית ד' לב. והדיבור הוא בחי' חוה בחי' שלא כסדר בחי' תשרק. גם שבת הוא בחי' עולם המחשבה. ומחשבה הוא בחי' חשוב מה בחי' חכמה כח מה ומה גימטריא אדם. שזה בחי' כסדר כמבפ"נ.
segments.en: And this is what is brought within: how one must strengthen oneself in the service of G-d — and never despair — and to know and believe: that he too receives some sacred vitality from the Torah through the aforementioned Tzadik — and so on. And even a simple person must likewise have the awe of Heaven — and so on — as mentioned above. For this is the aspect of the awe that shines on Shabbos even for the amei ha'aretz [unlearned people] and simple people — as mentioned above. And since this path is the path of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael — therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: if you guard the Shabbos — you shall enter Eretz Yisrael — as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of [Genesis 49:15]: "vayar menuchah ki tov" — "menuchah" — this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — which is a day of rest and holiness. And this [Genesis 49:15]: "v'es ha'aretz ki na'amah" — for through this one merits the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. And therefore Eretz Yisrael itself is likewise called "menuchah" — in the aspect of [Psalms 95:11]: "im yavo'un el menuchasi" — and it is written [Deuteronomy 12:9]: "el haMenuchah v'el hanachalah."

segments.he: ועיקר השלימות שתהא בחי' חוה בחי' מלכות מקושרת לאדם בחי' מה היינו להקב"ה ואזי יש לה שלימות. וזה בחי' זכור ושמור של שבת. וכן שבת דלילא ושבת דיומא שהם בחי' קוב"ה ושכינתיה כמבואר בתיקונים וע"כ עיקר שלימות כל הבריאה הוא ע"י שבת. כי כלל הבריאה הוא בחי' שלא כסדר בחי' תשרק שזה סוד בתשרי נברא העולם. וכן מה שבאו האותיות בסדר תשרק לברוא בהם את העולם כמבואר בזוה"ק ובתיקונים ועיין בזה גם בליקוטי הלכות. ובחול יש כביכול איזה אחיזה להסט"א בבחי' מלכות שלא כסדר כי אז ימי עשיה ומלאכה ויכול האדם להפריד ח"ו את בחי' המלכות מהקב"ה וליקח אותה לעצמו שזה בחי' כחי ועצם ידי עשה לי וכו'. אבל בשבת אז עולה המלכות לשרשה ואז עיקר שלימות יחוד קוב"ה ושכינתי'. ואזי נתבטל בחי' ההנהגה של שלא כסדר נגד בחי' כסדר ואז הולך לו להאדם כסדר. וזה בחי' שבת בחי' משבית מלחמות וכו' כי שלא כסדר זה בחי' מלחמה כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' ביום הניח ה' לך מעצבך ומרגזך וכו' וכל דינין אתכפין ולא מתערין כלל.
segments.en: And this [Genesis 6:8]: "v'Noach matza chen" — Noach is the aspect of Shabbos — rest [nayyicha] — and so on — as brought in the holy Zohar. "matza chen" — for through Shabbos one draws the aspect of the treasury of free gift — regarding which it is stated [Exodus 33:19]: "v'chanosi es asher achon [and I shall grant grace to whom I grant grace]" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught [Midrash Rabbah Parashas Ki Sisa]. And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times. For the essential tikkun of repentance is through the aspect of the aforementioned free lovingkindness. And therefore one must increase charity to the poor on Shabbos — and the charity box is distributed on Erev Shabbos — in order to draw through this the free lovingkindness mentioned above — that shines on Shabbos.

segments.he: וזשארז"ל נותנין לו כל משאלות לבו שהולך לו להאדם כרצונו כסדר בשלימות. וע"כ ארז"ל שאסור לבקש על צרכיו בשבת קודש כדי שלא יהא נזכר בצערו. היינו שלא יהיה נזכר אז כלל שום בחי' שלא כסדר וזהו שמתפללין וברצונך הניח לנו שלא תהא צרה ודאגה וכו' ביום מנוחתינו.
segments.en:
And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — which is the aspect of "rav chesed" — as explained in the holy Zohar — that is, the aspect of the treasury of free gift — mentioned above — which flows from the aspect of "rav chesed" — the aspect of Atik. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — which revives all the lower levels — which are the aspect of the aforementioned simple people — who are far from the holy Torah. And during the weekday — Malchus is in the aspect of: "ragleha yordos maves [her legs go down to death]" — and the Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra draw sustenance from her — as it were. But on Shabbos — when the aforementioned free lovingkindness shines — through which all the simple people are revived through the concealed Torah — then Malchus ascends to very great heights — and the Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra are pushed away and fall. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — as mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the Torah — as is well-known. That is — through this one can return and draw everyone close to the holy Torah. And also in its plain sense — that is, one merits the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — which is the heritage of Yaakov — for through this path one conquers Eretz Yisrael. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits [nachalah b'li metzarim]. That is — through this one can sanctify all the places in the world with the holiness of Eretz Yisrael — as explained within. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for everything was created through the ten utterances — within which the Ten Commandments are concealed. And the essential fullness of the ten utterances is through Shabbos — as mentioned above. And likewise — the Ten Commandments — which are the totality of the holy Torah — were given on Shabbos — as mentioned above. And one must yet explain further.

 Siman 79 — סימן עט (Part Two)
 haKol Kol Yaakov — Shabbos = repentance = "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha" — "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" — Likutay Moharan Siman 6 — Siman 58 of LM = teshuvah from love — love = unification of time — Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = above time — "u'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim" — through this: merits to hear the sacred voice — juxtaposed after "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" — "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" — the voices in "Mizmor l'David havu" said at entry of Shabbos

segments.he: וזה בחי' מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' וכו' להגיד בבוקר חסדך. היינו כשהולך לו כסדר בבחי' חסדים. ואמונתך בלילות היינו אפי' בבחי' הנהגה של שלא כסדר שהוא בחי' חוה בחי' לילה כ"ש ולילה ללילה יחוה ובפשוטו ג"כ ההנהגה של שלא כסדר הוא בחי' חשכת לילה. ואעפי"כ ע"י קדושת שבת זוכין להתחזק באמונה ולהאמין כי בוודאי הכל לטובה שזה בחי' כסדר. וזה כי שמחתני ה' בפעלך וכו' כי כל הבריאה הוא מבחי' שלא כסדר. אבל כשבא שבת ונכללת בבחי' כסדר אזי נמשך בחי' שמחה ששמחים על מה שנברא הכל. וזה מה גדלו מעשיך ה' בחי' עשיה הוא בחי' מלכות שלא כסדר. מאד עמקו מחשבותיך. מחשבה הוא בחי' חכמה בחי' סדר. ואח"כ מבאר שאפי' ההנהגה של בחי' צדיק ורע לו רשע וטוב לו שזה נראה בוודאי לבחי' שלא כסדר. אבל באמת גם זה נכון וישר. כי הצלחת הרשעים הוא רק לפי שעה ולהשמדם עדי עד. אבל צדיק כתמר יפרח וכו'. וזה להגיד כי ישר ה' בחי' כסדר.
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — in the aspect of [Deuteronomy 30:2]: "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha [and you shall return unto Hashem your G-d]." And "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 6. And in Siman 58 [of Likutay Moharan] — it is explained that it is the aspect of repentance from love [teshuvah mei'ahavah]. And love [ahavah] is the aspect of the unification of time [ichud haZman] — as explained within. For Shabbos is the foretaste of the World to Come [me'ein Olam haBa] — which is above time. And this is the aspect of [Prayer]: "u'verachto mikol hayamim — v'kidashto mikol hazmanim [and You blessed it above all days — and sanctified it above all times]." And through this — one merits to hear the sacred voice. And this is what is juxtaposed after the verse [Exodus 15:25]: "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" — (which our Sages of blessed memory taught: from this — that Shabbos was commanded at Marah) — [Exodus 15:26]: "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" — and so on. And this is the aspect of the voices in [Psalms 29]: "Mizmor l'David — havu" — and so on — which are said at the entry of Shabbos.

segments.he: גם שבת הוא בחי' תשובה כנ"ל כ"פ. כי עיקר דרך התשובה (המבפ"נ שנמשך מבחי' שם ס"ג ושם קס"א) מאיר בשבת קודש שזהו בחי' וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך וכמבואר בליקו"א סי' ואו. כי ע"י קדושת שבת נתגלה ומאיר אור של חיות אלקות שיש אפי' בהפחות שבישראל. שזה בחי' ויקהל משה את כל ישראל.
segments.en:
✦ Translator's Summary — Part Two, Simanim 77, 78, 79
 
 Siman 77 — Retzu'ah Hayesah Yotzeis — Shabbos = tefillin = mochin / awe of Shabbos = the strap / eating in holiness on Shabbos sweetens the awe / from the mouth: kumat Adam / Shechinah speaks from his throat / Zohar Pinchas 228a / Zohar Vayikra 16a / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = tefillin = mochin (well-known; many times). On Shabbos: merits awe = "yirey Shabbas." Shabbos = Malchus = source of awe = morah shel Malchus. Drawn upon a person: "mipnei she'eymas Shabbas alav" (Sages). Even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos. Therefore those who guard Shabbos called "yirey shmi" = "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi" (Malachi 3:20; Sages; many times). Aforementioned awe = aspect of the strap (retzu'ah) that passes through the maavarta of the tefillin = the awe that passes through the mochin and the tefillin = "reishis chochmah yiras Hashem" (Psalms 111:10; within). Even during the weekday: through eating in holiness and in awe of Heaven → sweetens the aforementioned awe = aspect of the strap → so that no sorrow should flow from it (within). On holy Shabbos: eating is certainly in holiness by every person = eating of Shabbos is entirely holy → through the eating: awe comes upon the person = "l'eis ha'ochel gashi halum" (Ruth 2:14; within) → through this: merits to be saved from all sorrow (eating of Shabbos = sweetening of the judgments [hamtakas haDinim]; as brought) → moreover: merits that from the mouth the stature of a person [kumat Adam] is made = the mouth [peh] is rectified = "v'daber davar" (Isaiah 58:13; stated regarding Shabbos); the mouth is completed in great light during the eating of Shabbos (within; Likutay Moharan Siman 57 cross-ref.) → merits even greater ascent = aspect of "Shechinah medaberes mitoch gerono" = Ru'ach haKodesh drawn upon each and every person according to his level on holy Shabbos (Zohar). (Very refined and very spiritual matters impossible to explain.) Isaiah 58: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha / v'karas l'Shabbas oneg (= aspect of Shabbos meals) / az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = root of supreme and most wondrous mochin + root of sweetening of all judgments + "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" (Sages) = saved from all sorrow; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus (= the awe); saved from subjugation of kingdoms = aspect of fallen awe (yira'os nefalos) = morah shel Malchus; "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = Adam hayoshev al haKissay (well-known); Yaakov our Patriarch is the Chariot [merkavah] for the aforementioned Adam; his form is engraved upon the Throne (Zohar); "v'ha'achalticha davka" = merits this through holy eating of holiness of Shabbos → mouth made into kumat Adam → then ascends further until reaches Adam hayoshev al haKissay; nachalah b'li metzarim = the aforementioned Adam is in the aspect of nachalah b'li metzarim (writings). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = merits the aspect of "Shechinah medaberes mitoch gerono" = aspect of "ki pi Hashem diber." One must yet explain further — not its place here. Cross-references: Zohar Pinchas folio 228a (regarding Adam hayoshev al haKissay); Zohar Vayikra folio 16a (regarding Yaakov); Mikdash Melech there.

segments.he: שמשה היה מייחד ומקשר עצמו עם כל ישראל ואפי' עם הפחות שבהם שזה בחי' כולו סג יחדיו כמבפ"נ.
segments.en:
Siman 78 — B'Inyan Hanhagos haPeshutos — Shabbos = totality of all the Torah / hidden Torah within the ten utterances / the simple person receives vitality from the hidden Torah through the Tzadik / treasury of free gift / on Shabbos this free gift shines most / even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos / "Bereishis bara" for the sake of awe / coming to the Tzadik on Shabbos / "Vihi no'am" / charity on Erev Shabbos / "v'Noach matza chen" / Shabbos = teshuvah / Isaiah 58: Sages: "chad amar lo nitnesah Shabbas ela l'ta'anug / v'chad amar lo nitnesah Shabbas ela l'divrei Torah / v'lo pfligi": the one who said for delight = Torah scholars (Talmidei Chachamim) who toil in Torah all the days of the week → on Shabbos: come and take delight; the one who said for words of Torah = laborers (po'alim) who toil in their work all the days of the week → on Shabbos: come and engage in Torah. Also Sages: "sheshes yamim ta'avod" = a mortal king says to his servants: do for yourselves one day and do for me six days; but G-d, blessed be He, is not so → G-d, blessed be He, said to Israel: My children — do for yourselves six days and do for Me one day (Pesikta d'Aseres haDevuros). According to what is explained within: the matter is well understood. Essential life = the Torah. All who separate from the Torah = as if separate from life. But: impossible to be constantly cleaving to the Torah without interruption → even the master of Torah and the master of attainment → inevitably idle from Torah for some time for the sake of bodily needs → when idle from Torah: in the aspect of ish pashut [simple person]. And also: literally simple people (anashim peshutim) who are nonetheless fit and G-d-fearing → need to receive some vitality from the Torah (= essential life) → in truth they are far from the Torah. But know: vitality of all these simple people = from the aspect of the sustaining of the world before the giving of the Torah (matan Torah) = when the world was sustained only through His lovingkindness = aspect of "otzar matnas chinam" [treasury of free gift]. In truth: the Torah certainly existed then too (= Torah is eternal [nitzchiyis]). But then: the Torah was in concealment and hiddenness = all the Torah encompassed in the Ten Commandments was then concealed within the way of the world (derech eretz) and the settling of the world (yishuv ha'olam) = which was created through the ten utterances. The great Tzadik — when compelled to separate from the Torah for a brief moment (= in the aspect of ish pashut) → receives vitality from the aspect of this otzar matnas chinam. This is the path to Eretz Yisrael = essential conquest of Eretz Yisrael = through "ko'ach ma'asav higid l'amo" (Psalms 111:6) = aspect of ten utterances through which world was created → through this: revives all the aforementioned simple people. The closer a person is to holiness and to the Tzadik → the higher the vitality he receives from him. Holiness of Shabbos = Zohar: "kelala d'chol orayta Neviim u'Chsuvim." All agree: Torah was given on Shabbos = they are one aspect. "Shabbas equivalant to entire Torah" (Sages). Shabbos = aspect of life = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu." "Mechaleleha mos yumas" = like one who denies the entire Torah (Sages). Therefore: "lo nitnesah Shabbas ela l'divrei Torah" = G-d said: do for yourselves six days and do for Me one day = all the days of the week: majority of the world is occupied with worldly matters and work → need to engage in Torah on Shabbos at least (when all labors are forbidden). Therefore: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" = holiness of Shabbos = the vitality of all the weekdays → must remember throughout all the weekdays: that the essential sacred vitality is Shabbos → through this: draws some sacred vitality from the illumination of holiness of Shabbos upon all the weekdays. During weekdays: occupied with labor and worldly matters and far from Torah → receives vitality only from chesed chinam = otzar matnas chinam (above) = free lovingkindness that sustained the world before matan Torah through the concealed Torah clothed within worldly matters = path to Eretz Yisrael. Essential illumination of this chesed chinam = root of aspect of ten utterances = "ki amarti olam chesed yibbaneh" (Psalms 89:3; elsewhere) = on Shabbos = then: essential fullness of entire creation created through ten utterances = "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" (Sages) → then: all judgments sweetened + great lovingkindnesses drawn (Zohar) = aspect of otzar matnas chinam shines. Therefore: "afilu aved avodah zarah mochalin lo" (Sages) = everything rectified through otzar matnas chinam. Therefore on Shabbos: most propitious time for attaining sitrei Torah (as brought) = chesed chinam shines = concealed Torah shines. Holiness of Shabbos called a "matanah" = "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay v'Shabbas shemah" (Sages) = aspect of otzar matnas chinam. From this treasury: only the great Tzadik can receive = the one cleaving to the holy Torah with utmost fullness → when compelled to set it aside somewhat: then ish pashut → since cleaving so greatly to Torah and impossible for him to separate from it even for a brief moment → merits to receive vitality in his time of simplicity from aspect of concealed Torah within worldly matters = aspect of ten utterances within which Ten Commandments are clothed (above) → through this: draws vitality to all the simple people. Therefore: these simple people must engage even more in Torah on Shabbos at least → in order to have some connection and closeness to the holy Torah; since at the time when they are idle from labor and worldly matters they increase engagement in Torah → from this it is revealed: that the fact that they do not engage in Torah during the weekdays is only because of their being occupied with livelihood and derech eretz → through this: merit that also during weekdays they receive vitality through the aforementioned Tzadik from the aspect of concealed Torah within derech eretz. Therefore: Torah scholars and Tzadikim who toil in Torah all the days of the week → permitted to set aside somewhat on Shabbos from Torah study + to draw somewhat upon delight of eating and drinking for honor of Shabbos (SA OC Siman 290) → through this: have some connection to the aspect of the aforementioned simple people → draw for them sacred vitality from the aspect of concealed Torah within worldly matters and bodily affairs (within): for this very reason: the great Tzadik is compelled to descend and fall sometimes into simplicity and to be ish pashut for some time → through this: revives all the simple people; each person according to greater closeness to holiness and to the Tzadik: receives higher vitality from him (above). Therefore: commandment to receive face of one's teacher on Shabbos (Zohar). Very great matter to come on Shabbos to a true Tzadik (elsewhere) = through this: merits even more to receive aspect of illumination of sacred vitality that the Tzadik draws from aspect of concealed Torah and otzar matnas chinam that shines and is revealed even more through holiness of Shabbos. Therefore: "afilu am ha'aretz yirey lishaker b'Shabbas" (Sages) = even though far from Torah → through holiness of Shabbos: awe is drawn upon him too from aspect of concealed Torah within the ten utterances; every utterance has the aspect of awe = "hakem l'avdecha imrasecha asher l'yir'asecha" (Psalms 119:38; within). Therefore: Sages expounded "Bereishis bara" = for the sake of awe = which is called "reishis" = entire ten utterances (through which the creation came about) = only for the sake of awe. Also (within): must strengthen oneself in service of G-d + never despair + know and believe that he too receives sacred vitality from Torah through the aforementioned Tzadik; even simple person must have awe of Heaven = awe that shines on Shabbos even for amei ha'aretz and simple people. Since this path = path of conquest of Eretz Yisrael → "im mishmartem es haShabbas nichansu l'Eretz Yisrael" (Sages). "Vayar menuchah ki tov" (Genesis 49:15) = "menuchah" = holiness of Shabbos = day of rest and holiness; "v'es ha'aretz ki na'amah" = through this: merits inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. Therefore Eretz Yisrael itself also called "menuchah" = "im yavo'un el menuchasi" (Psalms 95:11) + "el haMenuchah v'el hanachalah" (Deuteronomy 12:9). "V'Noach matza chen" (Genesis 6:8) = Noach = Shabbos = nayyicha (Zohar). "Matza chen" = through Shabbos: draws otzar matnas chinam = "v'chanosi es asher achon" (Exodus 33:19; Sages; Midrash Rabbah Ki Sisa). Therefore Shabbos = teshuvah (many times) = essential tikkun of teshuvah through aspect of chesed chinam. Must increase charity to poor on Shabbos. Charity box distributed on Erev Shabbos = to draw chesed chinam that shines on Shabbos. Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = "rav chesed" (Zohar) = otzar matnas chinam = flows from "rav chesed" = aspect of Atik; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus = revives all the lower levels = simple people far from holy Torah; during weekday: Malchus in aspect of "ragleha yordos maves" and Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra draw sustenance from her; on Shabbos: chesed chinam shines → all simple people revived through concealed Torah → Malchus ascends to very great heights → Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra pushed away and fall → therefore: "nitstol mi'shibbud malchuyos"; "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = aspect of Torah (well-known) = through this: can return and draw everyone close to holy Torah; also plain sense = inheritance of Eretz Yisrael = heritage of Yaakov = through this path: conquers Eretz Yisrael; nachalah b'li metzarim = through this: can sanctify all the places in the world with holiness of Eretz Yisrael (within). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = everything created through ten utterances within which Ten Commandments are concealed = essential fullness of ten utterances through Shabbos = Ten Commandments (= totality of holy Torah) were given on Shabbos. One must yet explain further.

 Siman 79 — haKol Kol Yaakov — Shabbos = teshuvah = "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha" / "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" / LM Siman 6 / Siman 58 of LM = teshuvah from love / love = unification of time / Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = above time / "u'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim" / through this: merits to hear the sacred voice / juxtaposed after "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" / "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" / the voices in "Mizmor l'David havu" said at entry of Shabbos: Shabbos = aspect of teshuvah = "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha" (Deuteronomy 30:2). "Shabbas" has same letters as "boshes" = Likutay Moharan Siman 6. And in Siman 58 of LM: it is the aspect of teshuvah mei'ahavah [repentance from love]. Ahavah = aspect of ichud haZman [unification of time] (within). For Shabbos = me'ein Olam haBa = which is above time. "U'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim" (Prayer). Through this: merits to hear the sacred voice. Therefore: juxtaposed after "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" (Exodus 15:25; Sages: from this — that Shabbos was commanded at Marah): "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" (Exodus 15:26). Aspect of the voices in "Mizmor l'David havu" (Psalms 29) said at entry of Shabbos.

segments.he: וע"כ ציום אז על שבת וזה בחי' הארת השם ס"ג הק' שהוא בעולם הבריאה בחי' בינה בחי' שבת. גם אז מאיר השם קס"א שהוא בחי' אם אסק שמים שם אתה.

segments.he: והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחים קדישין היינו עליית המלכות שהוא בחי' שלא כסדר להכלל בבחי' כסדר. וע"כ דרז"ל על זה שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות היינו שלא יהיה יניקה ואחיזה להמלכות דסט"א בבחי' המלכות דקדושה שהוא בחי' שלא כסדר (וע"כ נקרא החורבן והגלות בשם צלמות ולא סדרים כשדרז"ל (סוטה דף מט) על שם שיניקתן מבחי' שלא כסדר כנ"ל) והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שזה בחי' השם מ"ה בחי' אדם הנ" ל וע"כ דרז"ל שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים כי נתבטלין כל המצרים שהם מבחי' שלא כסדר לגבי בחי' כסדר כנ"ל. וזה כי פי ה' דבר שנתייחד הדיבור שהוא בחי' מלכות פה בחי' שלא כסדר עם שם הוי"ה שהוא בחי' כסדר. וזה ג"כ בחי' אם תשיב משבת בחי' התשובה של שבת כנ"ל. אז תתענג על ה' היינו שתזכה לעלות בעליות גדולות דקדושה שזה בחי' אם אסק שמים בחי' שם קס"א שהוא שם אהיה במילוי יודין. ושם אהיה מאיר בשבת כמבואר בברית מנוחה דרך דלת.

segments.he: והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין בחי' עליית המלכות אל המוחין שזה בחי' השם ס"ג בחי' כולו סג יחדיו היינו החיות אלקות שנמצא אפי' בהפחות שבישראל שעי"ז יכולין לייחד ולקשר עמו ג"כ ולקרבו אל הקדושה ולהשיבו בתשובה שזה בחי' חירק דסג בחי' ובחירק לאנחתא לה לתתא לאמלכא לה על תתאין לקיים ומלכותו בכל משלה כמבפ"נ. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא בחי' הבריח התיכון המבריח מן הקצה אל הקצה כי הוא מחבר שני הבחינות הנ"ל יחדיו וכוללם ביחד. כי אלו השני בחינות בחי' אסק וסג הנ"ל הם בעצמם ג"כ בחי' כסדר ושלא כסדר הנ"ל שזה בחי' אחור וקדם צרתני כי אלו שעולי' בעליות גדולות הם בחי' קדם בחי' פנים בחי' כסדר. וע"כ דרז"ל באמת אז תתענג על ה' שנותנין לו כל משאלות לבו שזה בחי' כסדר. ואל הפחותים שבישראל שצריכין להחיות אותם ולקרבם ע"י בחי' חירק דסג בחי' ומלכותו בכל משלה הנ"ל. הם בבחי' אחור בחי' שלא כסדר. כי הם נסוגים אחור מקדושתם ויש בהם אחיזה להסט"א מאד. שזה בחי' משדרז"ל והרכבתיך וכו' שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות כנ"ל. ונחלת יעקב שהוא מחבר שני הבחינות הנ"ל יחד. היינו שמיחד ומקשר בחי' שלא כסדר עם בחי' כסדר בחי' אחור וקדם צרתני ותשת עלי כפיך אל תקרי כפיך אלא כפך היינו יוד גמטריא כף כמבפ"נ.
