נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

✦ חלק ב · PART TWO ✦

segments.he: היינו שהבחינה שלא כסדר בחי' אחור נכלל בבחי' קדם בחי' כסדר אזי נעשה מזה בחי' כף. היינו שנעשה מזה בחי' כלי וצמצום לקבל האור של בחי' כסדר בחי' קדם ולא יזיק לו ריבוי האור ח"ו. שזה בחי' ושכותי כפי עליך וכו' וראית את אחורי וכו' וכמובן בפנים. ועיין עוד במה שמבואר לעיל על מאמר קרא את יהושע סי' ואו בלקו"א.
segments.en:
Siman 81 — סימן פא (Part Two)
 Keshe'Adam Mesamei'ach Atzmo — Dancing on Shabbos — the case of the book and the tefillin — the supporters of the Torah = the thighs of truth — the legs ascend through Shabbos — speech / money / wife / faith — everything called "leg" is elevated through Shabbos

segments.he: סימן פג-ע"י תיקון הברית
segments.en: It is already explained above many times — in the name of the book Or Yisrael — that there is a basis for dancing [rikudim] for joy on the holy Shabbos. For this is in accordance with: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — for then the legs [raglaim] ascend to holiness — which is the aspect of dancing. And it is explained within — in this teaching — that through dancing with the joy of Torah and commandments [simchas Torah u'mitzvah] — through this all the supporters of the Torah [tomchei orayta] are elevated — who are called: "samchei Kishut" — and so on. And perhaps this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Shabbos 116]: one saves the case of the sacred text [tik haSefer] together with the book [Sefer]. And it is brought in Megillas Amukos, Ofan 60: the case of the book [tik haSefer] is the initial letters of: "terin yarchei Kishut [the two thighs of truth]." That is — through the joy of Torah and commandments — which are called "Sefer" — in particular the holiness of Shabbos — which is equivalent to the entire Torah and commandments — as our Sages of blessed memory taught — and is likewise called "Sefer" — for it is the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He — and Shabbos is the Name of G-d — as mentioned above many times. And this likewise: the case of the tefillin together with the tefillin — for the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of tefillin — as mentioned above many times. And through the holiness of Shabbos — the legs of holiness are also elevated — which are the aspect of: "yarchei Kishut" — that is, the supporters of the Torah [tomchei orayta]. And this: "even though there are coins within it" — that is, even though they are occupied with labor and the business of money and coins [ma'os] all the days of the week — nonetheless — they too have an elevation through the holiness of Shabbos. And also — through the holiness of Shabbos — the speech [dibbur] is rectified and elevated — which is called "regel" — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos. And also — money [mamon] is elevated — which is called "regel" — for this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir" — and so on — "zeh Shabbas" — and those who are wealthy in other lands — because they honor the Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is the aspect of the holiness of the sacred union of Shabbos — for the wife [ishah] is likewise called "regel" — as explained within. And through the holiness of Shabbos — she too is elevated. And through this one merits worthy children — who are likewise called "regel" — in the aspect of [Aramaic]: "bera kara d'avuha [the son is the foot of the father]." And also — the sacred faith is rectified — which is likewise the aspect of "regel." And likewise — all the things that are called "regel" are elevated through the holiness of Shabbos — as understood according to what is explained within.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' תיקון הברית בחי' ברית עולם וכו' וכנ"ל כ"פ ועי"ז נתתקן התפלה שזה בחי' טוב להודות לה' וכו' ואז התחלת צמיחת קרן משיח בבחי' אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות מיד נגאלו. והנעלם של שבת עולה כמנין אליהו משיח בן דוד כנ"ל בסי' ל"ב (עיין מ"ר בשלח פ' כה) וכללות משיח באבות היינו שהדיבור שבו מתפלל כלול מאש ומים רוח שזה בחי' שבת שין בת. שין הם האבות בת הוא בחי' התפלה וכמבואר גם בפנים. ואז נעשה בן חורין בחי' החרות של שבת שאסור במלאכה כמבפ"נ. וקדושת שבת זה בחי' תכלית הידיעה. בחי' תכלית הידיעה אשר לא נדע ותכלית הזה הוא עיקר המקום היינו בחי' מקומו של עולם שזה בחי' אל יצא איש ממקומו ביום השביעי כמבפ"נ. ואז פושט גוף המצורע ולובש גוף קדוש מגן עדן שזה בחי' בגדי שבת כמבפ"נ.ואז נתרומם מזלו וזוכה לעושר וכו'. וזה בחי' ברכת ה' היא תעשיר וכו' שדרז"ל על שבת. ואז נתחזק יצרו הטוב כנ"ל כ"פ בשם הזוה"ק ונתבטל העצבות בחי' ביום הניח ה' לך מעצבך ונתבטל גם הליצנות בחי' שחוק הכסיל כי אז נתגדל הדעת ונכנע הכסילות וזוכין לבחי' לב חכם לימינו כמבואר בתיקונים. ועי"ז נתבטלין כל אהבות ויראות רעות. וזוכין לאהבות ויראות קדושות שזה בחי' האהבה ויראה שזוכין בשבת כנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en:
Siman 82 — סימן פב (Part Two)
 Ki Seitzei — Shabbos = Malchus = speech [Chavah = disorder] — Shabbos = world of thought = Chochmah [Adam = order] — the essential perfection = Chavah/Malchus joined to G-d — zachor/shamor — the Sitra Achra's grip on Malchus during the weekday — on Shabbos: Malchus ascends to its root — no "disorder" — Shabbos = teshuvah — Shem Samech-Gimmel — Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph — Psalm 92 — Isaiah 58

It is already explained above many times: Shabbos is the aspect of Malchus — and it is the aspect of speech [dibbur] — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos — as brought in Zohar Bereishis, folio 32. And speech is the aspect of Chavah [Eve] — the aspect of disorder [shelo k'seder] — the aspect of: "Tashra"k" [the reversed alphabet]. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the world of thought [olam hamachshavah]. And thought is the aspect of: "chashuv mah" — the aspect of wisdom [Chochmah] — "koach mah" — and the gematria of "mah" is Adam. And this is the aspect of order [k'seder] — as explained within.

segments.he: גם עי"ז מעבירין החשך המכסה על העינים ואז העינים רואין נפלאות בחי' גל עיני ואביטה נפלאות מתורתך שזה בחי' קדושת שבת תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין ואז עיקר הזמן להשגת התורה ולחדש נפלאות. ועי"ז נתעלין כל הבקשות ומעוררין הגאולה ונתבטל שאור וחמץ שבלב האדם המסית את האדם שיהרהר אחר ת"ח שבדור וכו'. כי שבת הוא בחי' ביטול שאור וחמץ בחי' תשביתו שאור ואז זוכין לבחי' אמונת חכמים בשלימות כנ"ל כ"פ. ואז יכול הלב להתלהב בלימוד התורה בשלהובין דרחימותא שנתעוררין בשבת כמבואר בתיקונים. וזה בחי' רשפיה רשפי אש שלהבת יה מים רבים לא יכלו לכבות את האהבה וכו' שנאמר לענין שבת כמבואר בכתבים. ואז נמשך בושה על כ"א מישראל. כי שבת אותיות בשת כמובא. והבושה הוא בחי' שפיכות דמים. והשכינה מכסה בכנפיה על דמם של ישראל באהבה הזאת ועי"ז נתכסין כל הפשעים בבחי' על כל פשעים תכסה אהבה וזהו שארז"ל כל המשמר את השבת מוחלין לו על כל עוונותיו.
segments.en: And the essential perfection is that the aspect of Chavah — the aspect of Malchus — should be joined to the aspect of mah — that is, to the Holy One, blessed be He. And then she has completeness. And this is the aspect of: "zachor" and "shamor" of Shabbos. And likewise: "Shabbas d'leila" and "Shabbas d'yoma" — which are the aspects of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah — as explained in the Tikunim. And therefore the essential perfection of the entire creation is through Shabbos. For the totality of the creation is the aspect of disorder — the aspect of "Tashra"k" — which is the secret of: "b'Tishrei nivra ha'olam [in Tishri the world was created]." And likewise — the fact that the letters came in the order of "Tashra"k" to create the world — as explained in the holy Zohar and in the Tikunim — and also see in Likutay Halachos. And during the weekday — the Sitra Achra has, as it were, some grip on the aspect of Malchus in the mode of disorder — for then are the days of deed and labor — and a person can, heaven forfend, separate the aspect of Malchus from the Holy One, blessed be He, and take it for himself. For this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 8:17]: "kochi v'otzem yadi asah li" — and so on. But on Shabbos — Malchus ascends to its root. And then is the essential perfection of the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah. And then the aspect of the conduct of disorder is nullified relative to the aspect of order. And then — for the person — everything goes in an orderly manner [k'seder]. And this is the aspect of Shabbos — the aspect of: "meishiv milchamos" [quieting the wars] — and so on. For disorder is the aspect of war — as explained within. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 14:3]: "b'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha u'meirogzecha" — and so on — and all the judgments are subdued and do not awaken at all.

segments.he: סימן פז-דע שכוונות אלול
segments.en: And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: they give him all the desires of his heart — for everything goes for the person as he wishes — in an orderly and complete manner. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: it is forbidden to ask for one's needs on the holy Shabbos — so that he should not be reminded of his sorrow. That is — so that at that time he should not be reminded at all of any aspect of disorder. And this is what one prays: "u'virtzoncha hani'ach lanu — shelo sehey tzarah v'yagon" — and so on — "b'yom menuchaseinu."

segments.he: בשבת מאיר ביותר הדרך הק' של כוונות אלול שזה בחי' וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך הנאמר בשבת וכמבואר לעיל על מאמר קרא את יהושע סי' ואו בליקו"א ועל מאמר כי תצא סי' פ"ב בליקות"נ. וזה הדרך הוא בחי' תיקון הברית ומסוגל למצוא זווגו של אדם ושיהיה לה רצון אליו וכו' כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' קדושת שבת בעצמו בחי' כנ"י יהי' בן זוגך. ועל זה מתפללין רצה נא במנוחתינו וכו' והנחילנו באהבה וברצון שבת קדשך וע"כ עיקר זמן הזווג דקדושה בשבת.
segments.en:
And this is the aspect of [Psalms 92]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on — [Psalms 92:3]: "lehagid baboker chasdecha" — that is, when things go in an orderly manner — in the aspect of lovingkindnesses [chasadim]. And [Psalms 92:3]: "v'emunascha baleilos" — that is, even in the aspect of the conduct of disorder — which is the aspect of Chavah — the aspect of night. As it is written [Psalms 19:3]: "v'lailah l'lailah yechaveh" — and in its plain sense too: the conduct of disorder is the aspect of the darkness of night. And nonetheless — through the holiness of Shabbos — one merits to strengthen oneself in faith — and to believe: that certainly everything is for the good — which is the aspect of order. And this [Psalms 92:5]: "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" — and so on — for the entire creation is from the aspect of disorder. But when Shabbos comes — and it is encompassed in the aspect of order — then the aspect of joy is drawn — and one rejoices over the fact that everything was created. And this [Psalms 92:6]: "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" — the aspect of deed [asiyah] — which is the aspect of Malchus — disorder. [Psalms 92:6]: "me'od amku machshevosecha" — thought is the aspect of wisdom — the aspect of order. And afterward he explains: that even the conduct of the aspect of a righteous person who suffers — a wicked person who prospers [tzaddik v'ra lo — rasha v'tov lo] — which certainly appears to be the aspect of disorder — but in truth this too is correct and upright. For the success of the wicked is only for a brief time — and for their destruction forever. But [Psalms 92:13]: "Tzadik katamar yifrach" — and so on. And this [Psalms 92:16]: "lehagid ki yashar Hashem" — the aspect of order.

And also — Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times. For the essential path of repentance — (explained within — which flows from the aspect of the Name Samech-Gimmel [63] and the Name Kuf-Samech-Aleph [161]) — shines on the holy Shabbos. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — and as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 6. For through the holiness of Shabbos — the light of the divine vitality is revealed and shines — that exists even within the least of Israel. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol Yisrael."

segments.he: סימן פח-שלא לאכול פרי שלא נתבשלה
segments.en: For Moshe was unifying and connecting himself with all of Israel — even with the least of them — which is the aspect of: "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" — as explained within.

segments.he: עיקר זמן האבידות הוא בחול שזה בחי' כיון ששבת וי אבדה נפש. וכשמגיע קדושת שבת אז הרבה אבידות נמצאין ושבין ועולין למנוחתם שזה בחי' עליית הניצוצות הק' שעולין ע"י קדושת שבת. וזה בחי' התקיעות שהיו תוקעין בע"ש בחי' והיה ביום ההוא יתקע בשופר גדול ובאו האובדים וכו'. וזה שמובא (בשו"ע או"ח סי' שו) שמותר להכריז על האבידה בשבת.
segments.en: And therefore he commanded them then regarding Shabbos. And this is the aspect of the illumination of the sacred Name Samech-Gimmel — which is in the world of Beriah — the aspect of Binah — the aspect of Shabbos. And also — then the Name Kuf-Samech-Aleph shines — which is the aspect of [Psalms 139:8]: "im esak shamayim sham Atah [if I ascend to heaven — there You are]."

segments.he: סי' פט-הדעת משדך כל השידוכים שבת הוא בחי' דעת כנ"ל כ"פ. וקדושת שבת בעצמו הוא בחי' חתן וכלה כמבואר בתיקונים וכמו שאומרין באי כלה. ואז נגמר השידוך שבין ישראל לאביהם שבשמים כי הכל מודים שבשבת ניתנה תורה.
segments.en:
For then is the essential ascent of the worlds — upward and upward — which is the aspect of: "im esak shamayim" — and so on.

And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — where is the root of the supreme mental faculties — the aspect of thought and wisdom — the root of the aspect of order. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: they give him all the desires of his heart — that is, everything goes for him in an orderly manner — as mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — that is, the ascent of Malchus — which is the aspect of disorder — to be encompassed within the aspect of order. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — that is, so that the Malchus d'Sitra Achra should have no sustenance and grip on the sacred Malchus — which is the aspect of disorder. (And therefore the destruction and the exile are called by the name: "tzalmavet v'lo sederim [death-shadow and no order]" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Sotah 49] — for their sustenance is from the aspect of disorder — as mentioned above.) And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the Name Mah — the aforementioned Adam. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits — for all the limitations — which are from the aspect of disorder — are nullified relative to the aspect of order — as mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for the speech [dibbur] — which is the aspect of Malchus — the mouth — the aspect of disorder — is unified with the Name Havayah — which is the aspect of order. And this likewise the aspect of: "im tashiv miShabbas" — the aspect of the repentance of Shabbos — as mentioned above. [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — that is, one merits to ascend to great sacred ascents — which is the aspect of: "im esak shamayim" — the aspect of the Name Kuf-Samech-Aleph — which is the Name Ehyeh spelled out with Yudim. And the Name Ehyeh shines on Shabbos — as explained in Bris Menuchah, the path of Dales. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus to the mental faculties — which is the aspect of the Name Samech-Gimmel — the aspect of: "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" — that is, the divine vitality that is found even in the least of Israel. Through which one can also unify and connect with him — and draw him close to holiness — and bring him back in repentance. For this is the aspect of the chirik of Samech-Gimmel — the aspect of: "u'v'chirik l'anchata lah l'tata — l'amlecha lah al tata'in — l'kayem u'malchusei b'chol mashlah [and through the chirik to lower it below — to make it reign over those below — to fulfill: and His kingship rules over all]" — as explained within. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the middle bolt [bri'ach hatichon] that passes from one end to the other — for it joins both the aforementioned aspects together — and encompasses them as one. For these two aspects — the aspect of "esak" and "Samech-Gimmel" — mentioned above — are themselves likewise the aspects of order and disorder — mentioned above. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 139:5]: "achor va'kedem tzartani [You formed me from behind and before]." For those who ascend to great heights — they are the aspect of "kedem" — the aspect of face [panim] — the aspect of order. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded in truth: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — they give him all the desires of his heart — which is the aspect of order. And toward the least of Israel — whom one must revive and draw close — through the aspect of the chirik of Samech-Gimmel — the aspect of: "u'malchusei b'chol mashlah" — mentioned above — they are in the aspect of "achor" — the aspect of disorder. For they have turned backward from their holiness — and the Sitra Achra has a very strong grip on them. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "v'hirkavticha" — and so on — one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — as mentioned above. And "nachalas Yaakov" — which joins both the aforementioned aspects together. That is — he unifies and connects the aspect of disorder with the aspect of order — the aspect of [Psalms 139:5]: "achor va'kedem tzartani — v'tashet alai kapecha" — do not read "kapecha" [Your hand] but rather "kafecha" [Your palm] — for Yud equals the gematria of "kaf" — as explained within. That is — the aspect of disorder — the aspect of "achor" — is encompassed within the aspect of "kedem" — the aspect of order. And then from this is made the aspect of "kaf" — that is, from this is made the aspect of a vessel [kli] and a constriction — to receive the light of the aspect of order — the aspect of "kedem" — so that the abundance of light should not damage him, heaven forfend. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 33:22–23]: "v'sachosi chapi alecha" — and so on — "v'ra'ita es achorai" — and so on — and as understood within. And also see what is explained above — on the teaching "Kra es Yehoshua" — in Siman 6 of Likutay Moharan.

segments.he: וע"כ ע"י קדושת שבת בפרט כשזוכין לשמוע חידושי תורה בשבת עי"ז זוכה למצוא זווגו ולשדך שידוכים טובים והגונים. וזה בחי' משארז"ל (שבת קנו ובשו"ע או"ח סי' שו) מותר לשדך התינוקות ליארס בשבת.
segments.en:
Siman 83 — סימן פג (Part Two)
 Al Yedei Tikkun haBris — Shabbos = tikkun of the covenant = bris olam — prayer is rectified — the first sprouting of the horn of Mashiach — the hidden of Shabbos = Eliyahu / Mashiach ben David — Mashiach is encompassed in the Patriarchs — the speech of prayer = fire + water + wind = Shabbos: Shin-Beis — the man of freedom — tachlis haDe'ah — al yetzei ish mimekomo — garments of Shabbos — exaltation of one's mazal — the yetzer tov is strengthened — sadness nullified — mockery nullified — sacred love and awe — darkness covering the eyes is removed — redemption awakened — leaven and chametz of the heart nullified — emunas Chachamim — flames of love — boshes — the Shechinah covers with her wings — forgiveness of all sins

segments.he: סימן צא-וידבר אלוקים וכו'
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of the rectification of the covenant [tikkun habris] — the aspect of: "bris olam" — and so on — as mentioned above many times. And through this — prayer is rectified. For this is the aspect of: "tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on. And then — the first sprouting of the horn of Mashiach [tzemichas keren Mashiach] — in the aspect of: "ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu [had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would have been redeemed immediately]." And the hidden [nig'lam] of Shabbos is numerically equal to Eliyahu — Mashiach ben David — as mentioned above in Siman 32. (See Midrash Rabbah Beshalach, Parashah 25.) And Mashiach in totality is encompassed in the Patriarchs [Avos] — that is, the speech [dibbur] with which one prays encompasses fire and water and wind — for this is the aspect of Shabbos: "Shin-Beis" — Shin represents the Patriarchs — Beis is the aspect of prayer. And as also explained within. And then one becomes a free man [ben chorin] — the aspect of the freedom of Shabbos — which is forbidden in labor — as explained within. And the holiness of Shabbos — this is the aspect of the ultimate of knowledge [tachlis haDe'ah]. For the aspect of: the ultimate of knowledge — is: that we do not know. And this ultimate is the essential place — that is, the aspect of: the place of the world [mekomo shel Olam]. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "al yetzei ish mimekomo b'yom hashevi'i" — as explained within. And then one sheds the garment of the leper [guf haMetzora] — and dresses in a holy body from the Garden of Eden — for this is the aspect of the Shabbos garments [bigdei Shabbas] — as explained within. And then one's mazal is elevated — and one merits wealth — and so on. And this is the aspect of [Proverbs 10:22]: "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir" — and so on — which our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding Shabbos. And then the good inclination [yetzer tov] is strengthened — as mentioned above many times in the name of the holy Zohar. And sadness is nullified — in the aspect of [Isaiah 14:3]: "b'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha [on the day Hashem gives you rest from your sorrow]." And mockery is also nullified — the aspect of: the laughter of the fool [sechok haKesil]. For then Da'as is magnified — and foolishness [kesilut] is subdued. And one merits the aspect of: "lev chacham limino [the heart of the wise man to his right]" — as explained in the Tikunim. And through this all the fallen loves and awe are nullified. And one merits sacred loves and awe — for this is the aspect of the love and awe that one merits on Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: ע"י קדושת שבת זוכין לתשובה שלימה ולכפרת עוון.
segments.en:
And also — through this — the darkness that covers the eyes is removed. And then the eyes see wonders — the aspect of [Psalms 119:18]: "gal einai v'abitah nifla'os miTorasecha" — for this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" — and then is the essential time for attaining Torah and innovating wonders. And through this — all the prayers and requests are elevated — and the redemption is awakened. And the leaven and chametz [se'or v'chametz] in a person's heart — which entice a person to have thoughts against the Torah scholars of the generation — and so on — are nullified. For Shabbos is the aspect of the nullification of the leaven and the chametz — the aspect of [Exodus 12:15]: "tashbisu se'or" — and then one merits to the faith in the Sages [emunas Chachamim] in fullness — as mentioned above many times. And then the heart can be set ablaze in the study of Torah — with the flames of love [shalhavim d'rachimusa] that are awakened on Shabbos — as explained in the Tikunim. And this is the aspect of [Song of Songs 8:6]: "reshafeha reshpei eish shalheves Yah — mayim rabbim lo yuchlu l'chabes es ha'ahavah" — and so on — which is stated regarding the matter of Shabbos — as explained in the writings. And then shame [boshes] is drawn upon each and every person of Israel — for "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — as brought. And shame is the aspect of the shedding of blood [shefichas damim]. And the Shechinah covers with her wings over the blood of Israel — through this love. And through this — all the sins are covered — in the aspect of [Proverbs 10:12]: "v'al kol pesha'im techaseh ahavah [and over all sins — love covers]." And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who guard the Shabbos — he is forgiven for all his sins.

 Siman 87 — סימן פז (Part Two)
 Da sheKavannos Elul — On Shabbos: the holy path of the kavannos of Elul shines even more — "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — tikkun habris — finding one's match — "v'karas l'Shabbas" — "retzei b'menuchaseinu"

segments.he: ונמתקין הדינים ונתבטלין לגמרי ונעשה יחוד קב"ה ושכינתיה. כי שבת קודש הוא בחי' תשובה כנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en: On Shabbos — the holy path of the kavannos [sacred meditations] of Elul shines even more. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — stated regarding Shabbos. And as explained above regarding the teaching "Kra es Yehoshua" — in Siman 6 of Likutay Moharan. And regarding the teaching "Ki Seitzei" — in Siman 82 of this pamphlet [Likutay Tinyana]. And this path is the aspect of the rectification of the covenant [tikkun habris] — and is propitious for finding one's match [zivug] — and that she should have a will toward him — and so on — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos itself — the aspect of: "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha [the Congregation of Israel shall be your partner]." And regarding this one prays: "retzei na b'menuchaseinu" — and so on — and [Prayer]: "v'hanchileynu b'ahavah u'v'ratzon Shabbas Kodshecha [and grant us as an inheritance — with love and with will — Your holy Shabbos]." And therefore the essential time of the sacred union is on Shabbos.

segments.he: וארז"ל המשמר את השבת מוחלין לו על כל עוונותיו.
segments.en:
Siman 88 — סימן פח (Part Two)
 Shelo Le'echol Pri shelo Nisbashel — The time of lost objects is during the weekday — at the entry of Shabbos: many lost things are found and return to their resting place — the ascent of the sacred sparks — the shofar blowings on Erev Shabbos — announcing a lost object on Shabbos is permitted

The essential time of lost objects [aveidos] is during the weekday — for this is the aspect of: "keivan sheShabbas — vav — avdah nefesh [since Shabbos ended — woe — the soul is lost]." And when the holiness of Shabbos arrives — then many lost things are found — and they return and ascend to their resting place. For this is the aspect of the ascent of the sacred sparks [nitzotzos haKodesh] that ascend through the holiness of Shabbos. And this is the aspect of the shofar blowings that they would blow on Erev Shabbos — the aspect of [Isaiah 27:13]: "v'hayah b'yom hahu yitaka b'shofar gadol — u'va'u ha'ovdim" — and so on. And this is what is brought [Shulchan Aruch Orach Chayyim Siman 306]: it is permitted to announce a lost object on Shabbos.

segments.he: ומבואר בזוה"ק כי אז דינין אתכפיין ולא מתערין כלל.
segments.en:
Siman 91 — סימן צא (Part Two)
 Vayedabber Elokim — Through Shabbos: complete repentance and atonement — the judgments are sweetened — the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah — Shabbos = teshuvah (many times) — "ilu shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos" — "Vayakhel Moshe" — gathering of students to the teacher — the Torah scholars increase in eating and the laborers in Torah — Isaiah 58

segments.he: ואז עיקר שלימות יחוד קב"ה ושכינתי' שזה בחי' ובחרו באשר חפצתי דא זווגא דמטרוניתא. כי שבת הוא בחי' חכמה עילאה וחכמה תתאה שזה סוד שתי שבתות כנ"ל כ"פ. וע"כ אז עיקר זמן קיבוץ התלמידים להרב.
segments.en: Through the holiness of Shabbos — one merits complete repentance and the atonement of sin.

segments.he: שזה בחי' ויקהל משה ודרז"ל שצריכין לעשות קהילות בכל שבת ולדרוש להם בד"ת. וחכמת הרב הוא בחי' חכמה עילאה ומה שהתלמידים מקבלין ממנו הוא בחי' חכמה תתאה. ובימי החול אז הוא בבחי' רגליה יורדות מות ואז יש יניקה להסט"א מבחי' החכמה תתאה כביכול. אבל בשבת אז עולין הרגלין בבחי' אם תשיב משבת רגלך. ואז יכולין לקשר כל החכמות שבעולם להשי"ת. ולהתורה שהוא בחי' חכמה עילאה. ועי"ז מקשרין גם השכל של ההמון עם ממקום שהם להשי"ת ולהתוה"ק. ועי"ז באים לידי תשובה שלימה. וזה בחי' מה שהת"ח מותרים להמשיך קצת יותר בתענוגי הגוף ג"כ לכבוד שבת ולמעט קצת בלימודים והפועלים וכו' צריכין להרבות בשבת בעסק התורה. כי ע"י שהת"ח והצדיקים מרבים קצת בענג שבת בתענוגי הגוף. ובאמת גם תענוגי הגוף שלהם מלובש בהם חכמה נפלאה וקדושה גדולה. ועי"ז מקשרין את השכל של ההמון עם אל התוה"ק. וע"כ הם עוסקין בתורה הרבה בשבת קודש עכ"פ וכבר מבואר לעיל מענין זה כ"פ.
segments.en:
And the judgments are sweetened and nullified entirely — and the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah is made. For the holy Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times.

And our Sages of blessed memory taught: one who guards the Shabbos — he is forgiven all his sins.

segments.he: סימן קד
segments.en: And it is explained in the holy Zohar: for then the judgments are subdued — and do not awaken at all.

segments.he: מבואר בפנים שצריכין ליזהר לזמר זמירות שבת ובמוצאי שבת וכו'.
segments.en: And then is the essential fullness of the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:4]: "u'vacharti ba'asher chafatzti — da zivuga d'Matronita [and I have chosen what I desire — this is the union of the Matronita]." For Shabbos is the aspect of the supernal wisdom [chochmah ila'ah] and the lower wisdom [chochmah tata'ah] — which is the secret of the two Shabbosim — as mentioned above many times. And therefore then is the essential time of the gathering of students to the teacher.

segments.he: סיפורי מעשיות
segments.en:
For this is the aspect of: "Vayakhel Moshe" — and our Sages of blessed memory taught: they need to make congregations on every Shabbos and expound words of Torah to them. And the wisdom of the teacher is the aspect of the supernal wisdom. And what the students receive from him is the aspect of the lower wisdom. And during the weekday — then it is in the aspect of [Proverbs 5:5]: "ragleha yordos maves" — and then the Sitra Achra has sustenance from the aspect of the lower wisdom — as it were. But on Shabbos — then the legs ascend — in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha." And then one can bind all the wisdoms of the world to the Almighty — and to the Torah — which is the aspect of the supernal wisdom. And through this — the intellect of the multitude [seichel haHamon] is also bound — from wherever they are — to the Almighty and to the holy Torah. And through this they come to complete repentance. And this is the aspect of what the Torah scholars are permitted to draw somewhat more upon the delights of the body also for the honor of Shabbos — and to diminish somewhat in their studies. And the laborers — and so on — need to increase on Shabbos in the engagement with the Torah. For through the fact that the Torah scholars and the Tzadikim increase somewhat in the delight of Shabbos — in bodily pleasures. And in truth — even their bodily pleasures have wondrous wisdom and great holiness clothed within them. And through this — the intellect of the multitude is bound to the holy Torah. And therefore they engage in Torah much on the holy Shabbos at least. And this is already explained above regarding this matter — many times.

 ✦ Translator's Summary — Part Two, Simanim 81, 82, 83, 87, 88, 91
 
 Siman 81 — Keshe'Adam Mesamei'ach Atzmo — Dancing on Shabbos / supporters of the Torah = thighs of truth / everything called "leg" is elevated through Shabbos: Explained above many times in name of book Or Yisrael: basis for dancing (rikudim) for joy on holy Shabbos = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = then the legs (raglaim) ascend to holiness = aspect of dancing. Within (in this teaching): through dancing with the joy of Torah and commandments (simchas Torah u'mitzvah) → all the "tomchei orayta" (supporters of the Torah) are elevated = called "samchei Kishut." Perhaps this is the aspect of: Sages (Tractate Shabbos 116): one saves "tik haSefer" (case of sacred text) together with the Sefer (book). Megillas Amukos Ofan 60: "tik haSefer" = roshei teivos = "terin yarchei Kishut" [the two thighs of truth] = through joy of Torah and commandments (called "Sefer") — in particular holiness of Shabbos (= equivalent to entire Torah and commandments; Sages; also called "Sefer" = it is the Name of G-d = "Shabbas shema d'KBH"; many times). Also: "the case of the tefillin together with the tefillin" = holiness of Shabbos = aspect of tefillin (many times). Through holiness of Shabbos: legs of holiness also elevated = "yarchei Kishut" = tomchei orayta. "Even though there are coins within it" = even though occupied with labor and business of money (ma'os) all the days of the week → they too have elevation through holiness of Shabbos. Through holiness of Shabbos: speech (dibbur) is rectified and elevated = called "regel" = "v'daber davar" (Isaiah 58:13; stated regarding Shabbos). Also: money (mamon) elevated = called "regel" = "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir / zeh Shabbas" (Sages) + wealthy in other lands because they honor Shabbos (Sages). Holiness of sacred union of Shabbos = wife (ishah) also called "regel" (within) → elevated through Shabbos → through this: merits worthy children = also called "regel" = "bera kara d'avuha" (Aramaic). Sacred faith also rectified = also aspect of "regel." All the things called "regel" are elevated through holiness of Shabbos (as understood according to within).

segments.he: מעשה א-מענין אבידת הבת מלך ומציאתה
segments.en: Siman 82 — Ki Seitzei — Shabbos = Malchus = speech (Chavah = disorder) / Shabbos = world of thought = Chochmah (Adam = order) / essential perfection = Chavah/Malchus joined to G-d / the Sitra Achra's grip on Malchus during weekday / on Shabbos Malchus ascends / no disorder / Shabbos = teshuvah / Shem Samech-Gimmel / Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph / Psalm 92 / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = Malchus = aspect of speech (dibbur) = "v'daber davar" (stated regarding Shabbos; Zohar Bereishis folio 32). Speech = aspect of Chavah = aspect of disorder (shelo k'seder) = aspect of "Tashra"k" [reversed alphabet]. Also: Shabbos = world of thought (olam hamachshavah) = thought = aspect of "chashuv mah" = Chochmah = "koach mah" = gematria of "mah" = Adam = aspect of order (k'seder) (within). Essential perfection = Chavah/Malchus should be joined to the aspect of "mah" (= G-d, blessed be He) → then she has completeness. Aspect of "zachor" and "shamor" of Shabbos. Also: "Shabbas d'leila" and "Shabbas d'yoma" = aspects of G-d and His Shechinah (Tikunim). Therefore: essential perfection of entire creation is through Shabbos. Totality of the creation = aspect of disorder = aspect of "Tashra"k" = secret of "b'Tishrei nivra ha'olam." Letters came in order of "Tashra"k" to create the world (Zohar; Tikunim; also see Likutay Halachos). During weekday: Sitra Achra has, as it were, some grip on Malchus in mode of disorder = days of deed and labor → a person can separate the aspect of Malchus from G-d and take it for himself = "kochi v'otzem yadi asah li" (Deuteronomy 8:17). But on Shabbos: Malchus ascends to its root → essential perfection of the union of G-d and His Shechinah → aspect of disorder is nullified relative to aspect of order → for the person: everything goes in orderly manner. Shabbos = aspect of "meishev milchamos" = disorder is the aspect of war (within). "B'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha u'meirogzecha" (Isaiah 14:3) + all judgments subdued and do not awaken at all. Sages: "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" = everything goes for the person as he wishes = orderly and complete. Therefore: forbidden to ask for one's needs on holy Shabbos so that he should not be reminded of his sorrow = should not be reminded at all of any aspect of disorder. Prays: "u'virtzoncha hani'ach lanu shelo sehey tzarah v'yagon / b'yom menuchaseinu." Psalm 92: "lehagid baboker chasdecha" = when things go in orderly manner = aspect of chasadim; "v'emunascha baleilos" = even in conduct of disorder = aspect of Chavah = aspect of night = "v'lailah l'lailah yechaveh" (Psalms 19:3); plain sense: conduct of disorder = aspect of darkness of night; nonetheless: through holiness of Shabbos: strengthened in faith = believe that certainly everything is for the good = aspect of order; "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" = entire creation from aspect of disorder; but when Shabbos comes and it is encompassed in aspect of order → then: joy is drawn = one rejoices over the fact that everything was created; "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" = aspect of asiyah (deed) = Malchus = disorder; "me'od amku machshevosecha" = thought = Chochmah = aspect of order; even "tzaddik v'ra lo rasha v'tov lo" = appears to be disorder but in truth is correct and upright = success of wicked only for a brief time = for their destruction; "Tzadik katamar yifrach"; "lehagid ki yashar Hashem" = aspect of order. Shabbos = teshuvah (many times). Essential path of teshuvah (within; flows from Shem Samech-Gimmel [63] and Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph [161]) shines on holy Shabbos = "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" (Isaiah 58:13; Likutay Moharan Siman 6 cross-ref.). Through holiness of Shabbos: light of divine vitality revealed = that exists even within the least of Israel = "Vayakhel Moshe es kol Yisrael." Moshe was unifying and connecting himself with all of Israel including the least of them = "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" (within). Therefore he commanded them then regarding Shabbos = aspect of illumination of sacred Shem Samech-Gimmel = which is in Beriah = aspect of Binah = aspect of Shabbos. Also: Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph shines = "im esak shamayim sham Atah" (Psalms 139:8) = then: essential ascent of the worlds upward and upward. Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = root of supreme mochin = thought and Chochmah = root of aspect of order + "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" = everything goes for him in orderly manner; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus (= disorder) to be encompassed within aspect of order; saved from subjugation of kingdoms = so that Malchus d'Sitra Achra should have no sustenance and grip on sacred Malchus = (therefore destruction and exile called "tzalmavet v'lo sederim" [Tractate Sotah 49] = sustained from aspect of disorder); "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = aspect of Shem Mah = Adam (above); nachalah b'li metzarim = all limitations (from aspect of disorder) nullified relative to aspect of order; "ki pi Hashem diber" = speech (Malchus = mouth = disorder) unified with the Name Havayah (= aspect of order) = also aspect of teshuvah of Shabbos. "Az tis'anag" = merits to ascend to great sacred ascents = "im esak shamayim" = Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph = Shem Ehyeh spelled out with Yudim; Shem Ehyeh shines on Shabbos (Bris Menuchah, path of Dales). "Hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus to the mochin = Shem Samech-Gimmel = "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" = divine vitality that exists even in the least of Israel → through which: can unify and connect with him + draw him close to holiness + bring him back in teshuvah = aspect of chirik of Samech-Gimmel = "u'v'chirik l'anchata lah l'tata l'amlecha lah al tata'in l'kayem u'malchusei b'chol mashlah" (within). "Nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = aspect of bri'ach hatichon = passes from one end to the other = joins both aforementioned aspects together. These two aspects (esak and Samech-Gimmel) = themselves also aspects of order and disorder = "achor va'kedem tzartani" (Psalms 139:5) = those who ascend to great heights = aspect of "kedem" = face = order. Sages: "az tis'anag" = nosnim lo kol mishalos libo = aspect of order. Toward the least of Israel = whom must revive and draw close = chirik of Samech-Gimmel = "u'malchusei b'chol mashlah" = aspect of "achor" = disorder = turned backward from their holiness = Sitra Achra has very strong grip = "hirkavticha / nitstol mi'shibbud malchuyos." "Nachalas Yaakov" = joins both aspects together = unifies and connects disorder with order = "achor va'kedem tzartani v'tashet alai kapecha" = don't read "kapecha" [Your hand] but "kafecha" [Your palm] = Yud = gematria of "kaf" (within) = disorder (= "achor") is encompassed within order (= "kedem") → makes the aspect of "kaf" = vessel and constriction → receives the light of order without the abundance of light damaging him = "v'sachosi chapi alecha / v'ra'ita es achorai" (Exodus 33:22–23; within). Also see: "Kra es Yehoshua" = LM Siman 6 cross-ref.

segments.he: מבואר בהקדמת הסיפומ"ע איך שהיה המשמעות מדברי רבינו ז"ל אשר המאמר פתח ר"ש סי' סמך בליקו"א הוא ביאור ופירוש על ענין המעשה הזאת. וכבר מבורר בקונטרס הזה איך שכל ענין המאמר של פתח ר"ש הנ"ל כלול בענין קדושת שבת קודש עיי"ש. וידוע שקדושת שבת הוא בחי' הבת מלך שזה סוד שין בת. ומבואר בזוה"ק ובכתהאריז"ל מסוד הששה ימים שהם כנגד הואו קצצות בחי' הששה בנים.
segments.en: Siman 83 — Al Yedei Tikkun haBris — Shabbos = tikkun habris = bris olam / prayer rectified / first sprouting of horn of Mashiach / hidden of Shabbos = Eliyahu / Mashiach ben David / Mashiach encompassed in Avos / speech of prayer = fire + water + wind = Shin-Beis / ben chorin / tachlis haDe'ah / al yetzei ish mimekomo / garments of Shabbos / mazal elevated / yetzer tov strengthened / sadness nullified / mockery nullified / sacred love and awe / darkness covering the eyes is removed / redemption awakened / leaven and chametz of the heart nullified / emunas Chachamim / flames of love / boshes / Shechinah covers with her wings / forgiveness of all sins: Shabbos = tikkun habris = "bris olam" (many times). Through this: prayer is rectified = "tov lehodos laHashem." Then: first sprouting of horn of Mashiach = "ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu." Hidden (nig'lam) of Shabbos = numerically equal to Eliyahu Mashiach ben David (Siman 32 cross-ref.; Midrash Rabbah Beshalach Parashah 25). Mashiach in totality is encompassed in the Avos = speech with which one prays encompasses fire + water + wind = aspect of Shabbos: "Shin-Beis" = Shin represents the Avos; Beis = aspect of prayer (also explained within). Then: becomes "ben chorin" = freedom of Shabbos = forbidden in labor (within). Holiness of Shabbos = aspect of "tachlis haDe'ah" = "tachlis haDe'ah asher lo neda" [the ultimate of knowledge is that we do not know]. This ultimate is the essential place = "mekomo shel Olam" = "al yetzei ish mimekomo b'yom hashevi'i" (Exodus 16:29; within). Then: sheds garment of the leper (guf haMetzora) + dresses in holy body from Garden of Eden = garments of Shabbos (bigdei Shabbas) (within). Then: mazal is elevated + merits wealth = "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir" (Proverbs 10:22; Sages: regarding Shabbos). Then: yetzer tov strengthened (many times in name of Zohar). Sadness nullified = "b'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha" (Isaiah 14:3). Mockery nullified = "sechok haKesil" = then Da'as is magnified + kesilut subdued + "lev chacham limino" (Tikunim). Through this: all fallen loves and awe nullified → merits sacred loves and awe = the love and awe one merits on Shabbos (many times). Also: darkness covering the eyes is removed → eyes see wonders = "gal einai v'abitah nifla'os miTorasecha" (Psalms 119:18) = holiness of Shabbos = "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" = essential time for attaining Torah and innovating wonders. Through this: all prayers and requests elevated + redemption awakened. Leaven and chametz (se'or v'chametz) in person's heart — which entice a person to have thoughts against the Torah scholars of the generation — nullified = Shabbos = aspect of nullification of leaven and chametz = "tashbisu se'or" (Exodus 12:15) → then: merits emunas Chachamim in fullness (many times). Then: heart can be set ablaze in study of Torah = flames of love (shalhavim d'rachimusa) awakened on Shabbos (Tikunim). "Reshafeha reshpei eish shalheves Yah mayim rabbim lo yuchlu l'chabes es ha'ahavah" (Song of Songs 8:6) = stated regarding Shabbos (writings). Then: shame (boshes) drawn upon each and every person of Israel = "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" (as brought). Shame = aspect of shefichas damim [shedding of blood]. Shechinah covers with her wings over the blood of Israel through this love → all sins are covered = "v'al kol pesha'im techaseh ahavah" (Proverbs 10:12). Therefore: "kol hamishmor es haShabbas mochlin lo al kol avonosav" (Sages).

segments.he: ושבת הוא בחי' הבת מלך ונקראת טוב כ"ש מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב וכו' וכמבואר בזוה"ק פ' נח ד' סמך וניתנה לטובים שהם ישראל בבחי' כנס"י יהי' בן זוגך. ובעוה"ר נתעלם קצת מקדושת שבת בבחי' שכח ה' בציון מועד ושבת. וכ"ש (הושע ב') והשבתי כל משושה חגה חדשה ושבתה. עד שכמה פעמים גזרו העכו"ם על ישראל לחלל שבת ח"ו. וישראל מסרו נפשם על זה. וכן בכל דור ודור נמצאים צדיקים וכשרים שיש להם מס"נ ממש על ענין קדושת שבת וכן כלל ישראל ג"כ כ"א מהם נכסף ומשתוקק לקבל איזה הארה דקדושה מנעימות קדושת שבת ומתגעגעין על זה בכלות הנפש ומחפשין אחריה במטמונות עד שזוכין לפעמים לאיזה התנוצצות מקדושתה. ואז היא עצמה מודיע להם ונותנת להם עצה איך לחפש ולבקש אחריה ולמוצאה ולגלות קצת מקדושתה והעיקר ע"י כיסופין וגיעגועים והשתוקקות קודש שזה בחי' זכריהו מאחד בשבת. שצריכין לזכור בקדושת שבת בכל ימי השבוע ולהתגעגע ולכסוף ולהשתוקק אחרי קדושתה ולהכין עצמו בכל מה דאפשר ליה לקבל קדושתה. וגם צריכין למעט בענינים הגופנים בפרט בתאוות אכילה ושתיה בכל ימי החול שזה ג"כ הכנה גדולה לקבל קדושת שבת שהוא בחי' עולם הנשמות וכמובא בזוה"ק שבת הוא יומא דנשמתא ולא יומא דגופא. שזה בחי' מה שמבואר בשו"ע או"ח סי' רמט דרך אנשי מעשה להתענות בכל ערב שבת. הגם כי קדושת שבת שגבה כ"כ עד שנמשך אז קדושה גדולה גם על תענוגי הגוף כי אכילת שבת כולו קודש וכו' וכנ"ל כ"פ. וכן השינה של שבת כפי הצורך לו קדושה מאד וכמבואר בספרי קודש. אבל בחול צריכין למעט בזה בכל האפשר כי אז עיקר שליטת וממשלת הסט"א שעיקר אחיזתם בגופניות וגשמיות. וזה בחי' ההרהורי תשובה שבאין להאדם בשבת קודש כ"ז מבחי' זו הנ"ל. כי אז כ"א לפי בחינתו זוכה למצוא הבת מלכה והיא בעצמה מעוררת אותו ומחזקת אותו להשתדל לבקש ולחפש אחריה עד שיזכה למוצאה ולהמשיך ולגלות קדושתה ע"י התחבולות דקדושה הנ"ל. אך אעפי"כ לפעמים דייקא ע"י שהאדם מגיע סמוך אל הקדושה אז מתגבר עליו הבעל דבר ביותר ומפילו ח"ו כדרך שני אנשים כשנלחמים זה עם זה כשרואה האחד שזה קרוב מאד שינצח אותו חבירו. אזי מתעורר הוא ג"כ ומתחזק ומתגבר מאד להפיל את חבירו ח"ו וכמבואר במ"א עד שיש שאחר היגיעה וההשתדלות הרבה בעבודת ה' מתגבר הבע"ד אז על האדם העובד ח"ו עד שמפילו לבחי' שינה ומוחין דקטנות כ"כ עד שכל עבודתו ותורתו וכו' הכל בבחי' שינה וקטנות ואינו יכול להתעלות למעלה מחמת שאין לו חיות דקדושה כראוי בשלימות ויש שנופל כ"כ עד שהוא בבחי' שינה של שבעים שנה היינו שאינם יכולים לעורר אותו בשום פנים דקדושה מבחי' השבעים פנים לתורה כ"א ע"י סיפומ"ע של בחי' שנים קדמוניות שהם מבחי' עתיק וכמבואר במאמר פתח ר"ש הנ"ל. והן ההתעוררות ע"י השבעים פנים לתורה שהם בחי' שבעים שנה והן ההתעוררות ע"י בחי' שנים קדמוניות הכל כלול בקדושת שבת כמבואר לקמן בקונטרס זה על מאמר פתח ר"ש הנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 87 — Da sheKavannos Elul — Kavannos of Elul / tikkun habris / finding one's match / "retzei b'menuchaseinu": On Shabbos: holy path of the kavannos of Elul shines even more = "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" (Isaiah 58:13; stated regarding Shabbos). Explained above: "Kra es Yehoshua" = LM Siman 6; "Ki Seitzei" = this pamphlet Siman 82. This path = aspect of tikkun habris + propitious for finding one's match (zivug) + that she should have a will toward him (within). Aspect of holiness of Shabbos itself = "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha." Regarding this one prays: "retzei na b'menuchaseinu" + "v'hanchileynu b'ahavah u'v'ratzon Shabbas Kodshecha" (Prayer). Therefore: essential time of sacred union (zivug d'Kedushah) is on Shabbos.

 Siman 88 — Shelo Le'echol Pri shelo Nisbashel — Time of lost objects / entry of Shabbos: lost things return / ascent of sacred sparks / shofar blowings on Erev Shabbos / announcing a lost object on Shabbos: Essential time of lost objects (aveidos) = during the weekday = "keivan sheShabbas vav avdah nefesh." When holiness of Shabbos arrives → many lost things are found and return and ascend to their resting place = aspect of ascent of sacred sparks (nitzotzos haKodesh) that ascend through holiness of Shabbos. Aspect of shofar blowings on Erev Shabbos = "v'hayah b'yom hahu yitaka b'shofar gadol u'va'u ha'ovdim" (Isaiah 27:13). SA OC Siman 306: permitted to announce a lost object on Shabbos.

segments.he: וע"כ אם יהיה האדם חזק בדעתו ולא יניח להפיל א"ע ולהחליש דעתו ולייאש עצמו לגמרי ח"ו בשום אופן רק אעפי"כ ישתוקק ויכסוף ויתגעגע ויבקש ויחפש וישתדל אחר כל עניינים שבקדושה בכל מה דאפשר ליה ובכל יכלתו ויקשר עצמו לצדיקי אמת אשר הם עיקר המשתדלים בכל דור ודור בענין זה לחפש ולבקש ולדרוש אחר קדושת הבת מלך ולהוציאה ממקום גלותה והתעמלות קדושתה ולהחזירה בשלום לבית אביה ויזהר בשמירת שבת קודש ולכבדו ולענגו בכל מה דאפשר ליה שאז עיקר זמן עליית המלכות בחי' הבת מלך יזכה לבא לתכלית שלימותו בפרטיות ובכלליות וכשארז"ל אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות מיד נגאלין. ובמ"ר בשלח פ' כה מבואר שאלמלי שמרו שבת אחד כראוי מיד בן דוד בא.
segments.en: Siman 91 — Vayedabber Elokim — Complete repentance and atonement / judgments sweetened / union of G-d and His Shechinah / Shabbos = teshuvah / chochmah ila'ah / chochmah tata'ah / two Shabbosim / gathering of students to teacher / Torah scholars increase in eating and laborers in Torah / Isaiah 58: Through holiness of Shabbos: complete repentance and atonement of sin. Judgments sweetened and nullified entirely. Union of G-d and His Shechinah made. Shabbos = aspect of teshuvah (many times). Sages: "hamishmor es haShabbas mochlin lo al kol avonosav." Zohar: "dinin iskafyan v'la misaarin klal" [judgments are subdued and do not awaken at all]. Then: essential fullness of union of G-d and His Shechinah = "u'vacharti ba'asher chafatzti da zivuga d'Matronita." Shabbos = chochmah ila'ah and chochmah tata'ah = secret of the two Shabbosim (many times). Therefore: essential time of gathering of students to the teacher. "Vayakhel Moshe" + Sages: need to make congregations on every Shabbos and expound Torah to them. Wisdom of the teacher = aspect of chochmah ila'ah; what students receive from him = aspect of chochmah tata'ah. During weekday: "ragleha yordos maves" (Proverbs 5:5) → Sitra Achra has sustenance from chochmah tata'ah. On Shabbos: legs ascend = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" → can bind all wisdoms of the world to G-d and to the Torah (= chochmah ila'ah) → seichel haHamon [intellect of the multitude] also bound from wherever they are to G-d and to holy Torah → come to complete teshuvah. Torah scholars are permitted to increase in delight of Shabbos in bodily pleasures somewhat + diminish somewhat in their studies. Laborers need to increase in Torah on Shabbos. For: through Torah scholars increasing in oneg Shabbas in bodily pleasures → (in truth: even their bodily pleasures have wondrous wisdom and great holiness clothed within them) → through this: seichel haHamon is bound to holy Torah → therefore they engage in Torah much on holy Shabbos at least. Already explained above many times.

segments.he: מעשה ב-ממלך וקיסר
segments.en: Siman 104 continues in the next installment.

segments.he: המעשה הזאת לא שמענו עליה שום רמז. אך מובן ממילא שמדבר מסוד ההתקשרות והיחוד הק' בין ישראל לאביהם שבשמים. שזה בחי' יחוד קוב"ה ושכינתיה ואיך שעברו על זה סיבות ומניעות רבות.

נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

segments.he: ואעפי"כ עצת ה' היא תקום עד שנגמר היחוד הק' הנ"ל בשלימות וכל זה כלול בקדושת שבת שהוא עיקר ההתקשרות שבין ישראל לאביהם שבשמים כ"ש כי אות הוא ביני וביניכם לדורותיכם לדעת כי אני ה' מקדשכם ונאמר לעשות את השבת לדורותם ברית עולם וארז"ל כנסת ישראל יהיה בן זוגך. ועיקר הגאולה העתידה לבא במהרה בימינו שאז יוגמר היחוד הנ"ל בשלימות הכל תלוי בקדושת שבת כשארז"ל וכנ"ל כ"פ.

Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Part Two — Chelek Beis · Siman 104

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

segments.he: הגם כי אין אתנו יודע עד מה ועד היכן נוגע סוד המעשיות האלו הק' כי גבהו ושגבו ורמו ונפלאו מאד מאד למעלה מדעתינו אעפי"כ ממילא מובן כי כל עינינם אלו נוגע וכלול ממש בענין קדושת שבת כי בשבת קודש אז עיקר היחוד בין השמש והירח בשרשם וכמבואר בזוה"ק מזה במקומות הרבה (שזה בחי' מה שהשמש והריח מתקבצים שם ביחד המבפ"נ) וכן קדושת שבת הוא בחי' האילן שיש לו ענפים רבים ופירות ועלים. וכל ענף ופרי ועלה יש לו סגולה מיוחדת. שזה מסוגל לבנים וזה לפרנסה וזה לרפואה וכו' שזה בחי' והיה כעץ שתול על פלגי מים אשר פריו יתן בעתו ועלהו לא יבול וכל אשר יעשה יצליח ועץ הזה הוא בחי' שבת כמבואר בתיקון ואו דף כא. וכן דרז"ל בגמרא אשר פריו יתן בעתו על זווג משבת לשבת. ושבת קודש כלולין בו כל הסגולות יקרות וכל ההשפעות טובות בני חיי ומזוני וכל הרפואות שבעולם בחי' שבת הוא מלזעוק ורפואה קרובה לבא וכו' וכנ"ל כ"פ וזה בחי' וזרחה לכם יראי שמי (אלו שומרי שבת) שמש צדקה ומרפא בכנפיה (וצריכין לבאר עוד בזה מה שהשמש קובל לפני הירח על שמייבש זה האילן ואין כאן מקומו).
segments.en: ✦ חלק ב · PART TWO ✦

segments.he: גם בשבת קודש אז עיקר הכנעת השדים והקליפות וכמבואר בזוה"ק ואז אין להם יניקה מרגלי הקדושה שזה בחי' אם תשיב משבת רגלך וכנ"ל כ"פ בשם כתהאריז"ל. ואז מאיר ביותר הדרך הקדוש שהוא בחי' דרך צדיקים ונתבטלין כל הדרכים מקולקלים שהם בחי' דרך רשעים בחי' הדרך של האפיקורסים. כי שבת הוא יסוד האמונה דקדושה בחי' ביטול האפיקורסות.
segments.en:
Siman 104 — סימן קד (Part Two)
 Shabbos as the comprehensive context of Sippur Ma'asiyos — the Bat Melech and the holiness of Shabbos — the Ba'al Tefillah and the tikkun of all the factions — Shivos ha'Kabtzonim and the sacred life — the Shabbos as the totality of all the stories and all the teachings

segments.he: גם נתבטל הדרך של המשוגעים כי שבת הוא בחי' דיעה מיושבת כי אז מאיר הדעת בשלימות כנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en:
It is explained within that one must be careful to sing the Shabbos songs [zemiros Shabbas] — and the songs of the going out of Shabbos — and so on.

Story One — Ma'aseh 1 — Regarding the Lost Princess and her Finding

segments.he: גם ע"י שבת ניצולין משיעבוד מלכיות ועי"ז ניצולין הצדיקים מיסורי השרים והפריצים ויושבים במקומם במנוחה ואינם מטולטלים. וזה בחי' וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך הנאמר אצל קדושת שבת. גם זה האבק והפיל שמפזרים תחת רגלי הצדיקים המטולטלים בכדי שיהי' להם כח ברגליהם הכל נמשך מקדושת שבת שאז עיקר תיקון וחיזוק רגלי הקדושה כנ"ל וזה בחי' הרפואה שהיה לו להחיגר על רגליו ע"י האב הנ"ל. גם בשבת קודש אז עיקר זמן השקאת האילן הק' שאם היה אותו האילן נשקה כראוי אז לא היה נשאר מהשדים והקליפות כלום כמבפ"נ. ואפשר שזה ג"כ סוד הענין מה שהחכם צוה לפני מותו את בניו ומשפחתו שישתדלו להשקות אילנות כמבואר בהתחלת סיפור המעשה הזאת ועיקר תיקון זה נמשך בשבת שזה סוד ענג שבת שהוא ר"ת עדן נהר גן בחי' ונהר יוצא מעדן להשקות את הגן וכמבואר בזוה"ק וע"כ באמת ארז"ל אלמלי שמרו ישראל שבת אחד כראוי מיד בן דוד בא היינו כנ"ל.
segments.en: It is explained in the introduction to the Sippur Ma'asiyos [the book of stories]: how it was implied from the words of our Rebbe, of blessed memory — that the teaching "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — Siman Samech [60] in Likutay Moharan — is an explanation and interpretation of the matter of this story. And it is already clarified in this pamphlet: how the entire matter of the teaching of "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — mentioned above — is encompassed in the matter of the holiness of the holy Shabbos. See there. And it is well-known that the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of the princess [Bat Melech] — for this is the secret of: "Shin Beis." And it is explained in the holy Zohar and in the writings of the holy Ari z"l — from the secret of the six days — which correspond to the Vav [six] ends — the aspect of the six sons. And Shabbos is the aspect of the princess and she is called "tov [good]" — as it is written [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov" — and so on. And as explained in the holy Zohar, Parashas Noach, folio 60 [Samech]. And she was given to the good ones — who are Israel — in the aspect of: "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha." And in our many sins — the holiness of Shabbos became somewhat concealed — in the aspect of [Lamentations 2:6]: "shachach Hashem b'Tziyon mo'ed v'Shabbas" — and as it is written [Hosea 2:13]: "v'hishbati kol masosah — chagah — chadshah — v'Shabtah." Until — many times — the nations have decreed upon Israel to desecrate the Shabbos, heaven forfend. And Israel sacrificed their souls over this. And likewise in every generation and generation — there are Tzadikim and fit people — who have genuine self-sacrifice [mesirat nefesh] over the matter of the holiness of Shabbos. And likewise — all of Israel in general — each and every one yearns and longs to receive some illumination of holiness from the pleasantness of the holiness of Shabbos — and they long for this with the annihilation of the soul [b'chalos hanefesh] — and they search for her in the hidden places. Until they sometimes merit some flash of her holiness. And then she herself makes it known to them — and gives them counsel — how to search and seek after her — and to find her — and to reveal somewhat of her holiness. And the essential way is through holy longings and yearnings and yearning of holiness — for this is the aspect of: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — for one must remember the holiness of Shabbos throughout all the weekdays — and to long and yearn and aspire after her holiness — and to prepare oneself in every way possible to receive her holiness. And also — one must diminish in the bodily matters — in particular in the desires of eating and drinking during all the weekdays. For this likewise is a great preparation to receive the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the world of souls — as brought in the holy Zohar: Shabbos is a day of souls and not a day of bodies. For this is the aspect of what is explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 249: the way of people of good deeds is to fast on every Erev Shabbos. Even though the holiness of Shabbos is so lofty — that then a great holiness is drawn even upon the bodily pleasures — for the eating of Shabbos is entirely holy — and so on — and as mentioned above many times. And likewise — the sleep of Shabbos — as much as one needs — is very holy — as explained in the holy books. But during the weekday — one must diminish in this as much as possible. For then is the essential rule and dominion of the Sitra Achra — whose essential grip is in the corporeal and the material. And this is the aspect of the thoughts of repentance that come to a person on the holy Shabbos — all of this is from the aforementioned aspect. For then — each person according to his level — merits to find the princess — and she herself awakens him and strengthens him — to strive to seek and search after her — until he merits to find her — and to draw and reveal her holiness — through the aforementioned sacred stratagems. But nonetheless — sometimes specifically — when a person draws near to the holiness — then the adversary [ba'al davar] intensifies upon him even more — and casts him down, heaven forfend — in the manner of two people fighting one another — when one of them sees that his fellow is close to defeating him — he too is then aroused — and strengthens himself and intensifies very much — to cast down his fellow, heaven forfend. And as explained elsewhere. Until there are those — who after great effort and much striving in the service of G-d — the adversary then intensifies upon the serving person, heaven forfend — until he casts him into the aspect of sleep and the small-minded faculties [mochin d'katnus] — so much so — that all his service and his Torah and so on — are all in the aspect of sleep and smallness — and he cannot elevate himself upward — because he does not have sacred vitality as fitting in fullness. And there are those who fall so much — that they are in the aspect of the sleep of seventy years — that is, they cannot be awakened to them in any aspect of holiness — from any of the seventy faces of the Torah. Only through the story-tales of ancient years [sipur d'shanin kadmoniyos] — which are from the aspect of Atik — as explained in the teaching: "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — mentioned above. And both — the awakening through the seventy faces of the Torah — which are the aspect of seventy years — and the awakening through the aspect of ancient years — are all encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as explained below in this pamphlet — regarding the teaching "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — mentioned above.

segments.he: מעשה יא-מעשה מבן מלך ובן שפחה שנחלפו.
segments.en: And therefore — if a person will be strong in his resolve — and will not allow himself to be cast down — and to weaken his resolve — and to despair entirely, heaven forfend — in any way whatsoever. But rather — nonetheless — he will yearn and long and pine and seek and search and strive after all the matters of holiness — in every way possible to him — and with all his ability. And he will connect himself to the true Tzadikim — who are the essential ones who strive in every generation and generation regarding this matter — to seek and to ask and to expound after the holiness of the princess — and to take her out from the place of her exile and the concealment of her holiness — and to return her in peace to the house of her father. And he will be careful in the guarding of the holy Shabbos — and to honor it — and to delight in it — in every way possible to him — for then is the essential time of the ascent of the Malchus — the aspect of the princess — one will merit to reach the ultimate fullness in particular and in general. And as our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would have been redeemed immediately. And in Midrash Rabbah Beshalach, Parashah 25 — it is explained: had Israel guarded one Shabbos properly — Mashiach ben David would immediately come.

segments.he: עיקר שורש אחיזת השינויים והילופים והתמורות הוא מבחי' ששת ימי החול. שאז שולטנותא דמט"ט שהוא בחי' עבד כידוע ונאמר אצלו אל תמר בו ודרשו רז"ל אל תמירני בו. ובהשתלשלות בחי' התמורות למטה למטה משתלשל כ"כ עד שממירין בחי' בן העבד והשפחה ממש בבן המלך שזה בחי' תחת עבד כי ימלוך ושפחה כי תירש גבירתה וכו'. ועיקר שורש התגברות בחי' התמורות הוא במחשבה שלהבן העבד נדמה במחשבתו שהוא באמת בן המלך. ולא עוד אלא שנתבלבלה מחשבתו ונתהפכה כ"כ עד שמחמת חשש הלעז של העולם שהיו אומרים שהוא בן העבד ובוודאי גם הוא בעצמו היה מסופק לפעמים אולי האמת הוא כך ועי"ז דייקא התגבר לחשוב מחשבות ולגרום רעות רבות להעבד שבאמת הוא אביו ממש. ולא עוד אלא שגרם לגרש את בן המלך האמת ממדינתו לגמרי. וכן הבן המלך בעצמו הגם שבכל מקום שהיה וגם אחר שנתגרש אעפי"כ הלא הוא באמת בן המלך רק שגם עליו התגברו החילופים והתמורות במחשבתו שנדמה לו שהוא בן העבד. ולא עוד אלא שע"י שידע שהעולם אומרין עליו שהוא בן המלך ועי"ז דייקא נתגרש ממדינתו בחנם עי"ז חרה לו ביותר עד שלקח עצמו אל השתיה והשכרות והלך אחר שרירות לבו שזה עיקר התגברות התמורות רעות ח"ו וכל בחינות אלו עוברין על כל ישראל בכלליות ובפרטיות עם כ"א ואחד בכל דור ודור כמובן ממילא וכמבואר מזה הרבה בליקוטי הלכות וע"כ עיקר התיקון לזה הוא ע"י קדושת שבת.
segments.en:
Story Two — Ma'aseh 2 — The Story of the King and the Emperor

We have not heard of this story any allusion. But it is understood by itself: that it speaks of the secret of the sacred connection and unity between Israel and their Father in Heaven. Which is the aspect of the unity of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah. And how many causes and obstacles passed over this.

segments.he: שהוא בחי' עולם המחשבה ומאירין בו מוחין גדולים והוא בחי' בן כמבואר במ"א. ואז נכנע הסט"א וההיכלי התמורות בהכנעה גדולה כמבואר בזוה"ק. ואז נמשך בחי' מנוחה וקדושה וישוב הדעת לכ"א כפי בחינתו עד שאפי' הבן השפחה בעצמו מתבונן בנפשו אשר לא טוב עשה שגירש את בן המלך בחנם ומכ"ש להבן המלך האמת בוודאי מגיעין לו הרהורי תשובה וישוב הדעת ומתבונן בנפשו אדרבא א"כ שהשי"ת יכול לעשות כזאת וכו' היתכן מה שאני עושה וכי כך ראוי לי להתנהג אפי' אם הייתי באמת בן העבד ומכש"כ שהעולם אומרים עלי שאני בן המלך ויש לי נימוסי מלכות ולבסוף אני הולך אחר שרירות לבי ועושה מעשים כאלו ואז הוא מתחרט מאד על מעשיו. ואז אעפ"י שאח"כ חוזר עוד למעשיו ח"ו בבחי' שארז"ל כיון ששבת וי אבדה נפש. אעפי"כ הרשימו של המחשבות של תשובה הנ"ל עולין על לבו בכל פעם גם אח"כ ומזכירין אותו ומעוררין אותו עד שזוכה עי"ז לבא לתשובה גמורה עד שזוכה לשלימות תיקונו האמתי כמבפ"נ. גם צריך לידע כי קודם שיבא לשלימות תיקונו צריכין לעבור עליו סיבות הרבה ודברים קשים רבים מאד שזה בחי' מי שטרח בע"ש יאכל בשבת שזה הסיבות שעברו על בן המלך האמת עד שבא לשלימות תיקונו ותכליתו הטוב. ואז ראה בעיניו שכל אלו הסיבות ודברים הקשים היו סיבת הצלחתו האמתיית והנצחיית כמבואר כל זה בפנים.
segments.en: And nonetheless — the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever — until the aforementioned sacred unity is completed in fullness. And all of this is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — which is the essential bond between Israel and their Father in Heaven. As it is written [Exodus 31:13]: "ki os hu beini u'veineichem l'doroseihem lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — and it is stated [Exodus 31:16]: "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam — bris olam." And our Sages of blessed memory taught: the Congregation of Israel shall be your partner. And the essential future redemption that will come speedily in our days — when then the aforementioned unity will be completed in fullness — all depends upon the holiness of Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught — and as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: גם כל הענין המבואר בפנים שהלילה אמרה אל היום מפני מה כשאתה בא אין לי שם כי שרגא בטיהרא מאי מהני וכו' ומענין חדתותי דסיהרא שאז החיות נושאי הכסא עושין ניגון בחי' מזמור שירו לה' שיר חדש שזהו השיר ששרו פרות הבשן כשנשאו הארון אל בית שמש. ומענין הג"ע שנתגרש אדה"ר מתוכו ושבת אגין עלוהי. ושבת הוא בחי' מלך שהשלום שלו וכו' ומענין הכסא ושלחן מטה ומנורה שהם תיקונהא דשכינתא וכו' הכל כלול בקדושת שבת כמבואר בזוהר תרומה ד' קלח ובשאר מקומות. גם מבפ"נ מענין הגן הנפלא שכשרוצין ליכנס בו אזי תיכף מתחילין לירדוף את האדם הרוצה ליכנס עד שמבריחין אותו מן הגן.
segments.en: Story Three — Ma'aseh 3 — The Story of the Lame One

segments.he: והתיקון הוא ע"י שיעמוד עצמו אצל דמות האדם שעומד שם אצל הגן ולמעלה ממנו יש טאבליצע וכתוב עליה שזה האדם היה מלך שהיה שלום בימיו. וצוה הבן מלך הנ"ל להעמיד את האדם הנ"ל בתוך הגן ואזי נכנסו הכל לתוך הגן ויצאו ממנו בשלום בלי פגע.
segments.en:
Even though we know nothing — to what extent and to where the secret of these holy stories reaches — for they are very high — and very elevated — and very exalted — and most wondrous — far beyond our understanding — nonetheless — it is understood by itself: that all these matters touch and are truly encompassed in the matter of the holiness of Shabbos. For on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential union between the sun and the moon at their root — as explained in the holy Zohar regarding this in many places. (For this is the aspect of what the sun and the moon gather there together — as explained within.) And likewise — the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of the tree [ilan] that has many branches and fruits and leaves. And every branch and fruit and leaf has a special virtue. For this is propitious for children — and this for livelihood — and this for healing — and so on. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 1:3]: "v'hayah k'eitz shatul al palggei mayim — asher piryo yitein b'ito — v'alehu lo yibol — v'chol asher ya'aseh yatzliach" — and this tree is the aspect of Shabbos — as explained in Tikkun 6, folio 21. And likewise our Sages of blessed memory expounded in the Talmud [Psalms 1:3]: "asher piryo yitein b'ito" — regarding the union from Shabbos to Shabbos. And the holy Shabbos encompasses all the precious virtues — and all the good influences — sons — life — and livelihood. And all the healings in the world — in the aspect of: "Shabbas hu miliz'ok — v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" — and so on — and as mentioned above many times. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — (ilu shomrey Shabbas) — shemesh Tzedakah u'marpe" — and so on. (And one must yet explain further regarding this: what the sun complains before the moon — that when it comes — there is no name for it — for a candle at noon of what use is it? — and so on — but this is not the place.)

And also — on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential subjugation of the demons and the husks — as explained in the holy Zohar. And then they have no sustenance from the legs of holiness — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — and as mentioned above many times in the name of the writings of the holy Ari z"l. And then the holy path [derech kadosh] shines even more — which is the aspect of: the path of the righteous [derech tzaddikim]. And all the corrupted paths are nullified — which are the aspect of: the path of the wicked [derech resha'im] — the aspect of the path of the heretics [apikorsim]. For Shabbos is the foundation of the sacred faith — the aspect of the nullification of heresy.

segments.he: ומבואר אח"כ בהרזמים שזה הגן הוא בחי' הג"ע שנתגרש ממנו אדה"ר ושבת שהוא בחי' מלך שהשלום שלו הגין עליו כנ"ל.
segments.en: And also — the path of the mad ones [meshuga'im] is nullified — for Shabbos is the aspect of settled understanding [de'ah meyusheves] — for then the Da'as shines in fullness — as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: גם מבואר שם מענין הכסא שעשה המלך וכו' ולפני הכסא עומד מטה ואצל המטה עומד שלחן ועל השלחן עומדת מנורה וכו' והבן מלך הנ"ל השלים ענין תיקון הכסא והמטה והשלחן והמנורה ושינה מקומם קצת וכו' וסידר הכל בסדר הראוי וכו' ואז נתנו לו המלוכה וכו'. וזה בחי' צלותא דמעלי שבתא דהא אתייחדת כורסייא יקירא קדישא וכו' ואתתקנת למשרי עלה מלכא קדישא עילאה וכו'. וזה בחי' ביום השביעי נתעלה וישב על כסא כבודו כי שבת הוא בחי' עולם הכסא כידוע. וזה שצריך אז להיות נרו דלוק ושלחנו ערוך ומטתו מוצעת בחי' נר ושלחן ומטה הנ"ל העומדים לפני הכסא. ואז בשבת קודש עולה המלכות בשלימות ונדחין ונופלין כל בחי' הסטרין אחרנין המתגברין ע"י בחי' היכלי התמורות הנ"ל. וזה שמאריך במזמור שיר ליום השבת בענין הצלחת הרשעים שהוא רק לפי שעה ולהשמדם עדי עד אבל צדיק כתמר יפרח וכו'. וכן במזמור ה' מלך והו' מקולות מים רבים אדירים וכו' אדיר במרום ה' עדותיך נאמנו מאד וכו' כי עצת ה' לעולם תעמוד ואתה מרום לעולם ה' כי סוף כל סוף יתבטלו החילופים והתמורות ויעמוד העולם על תיקונו ומכונו בשלימות ותחזור הממשלה הראשונה לבת ירושלים ובא לציון גואל. וזשארז"ל אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות מיד נגאלין. כי עיקר התיקונים הנ"ל נמשך ע"י קדושת שבת. וזש"כ (ירמי' יז) והיה אם שמוע תשמעון אלי וכו' ולקדש את יום השבת וכו' ובאו בשערי העיר הזאת מלכים ושרים יושבים אל כסא דוד וכו' כי תחזור המלוכה והממשלה לבן המלך האמת כנ"ל.
segments.en: And also — through Shabbos — one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms. And through this — the Tzadikim are saved from the suffering of the ministers and the violent ones — and they dwell in their place in tranquility — and are not displaced. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — stated regarding the holiness of Shabbos. And also — this dust and powder that is scattered beneath the legs of the Tzadikim who are displaced — so that they should have strength in their legs — all of this flows from the holiness of Shabbos — for then is the essential tikkun and strengthening of the sacred legs — as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of the healing that the lame one had for his legs — through the aforementioned father. And also — on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential time for the watering of the holy tree. For if that tree had been watered properly — then nothing of the demons and husks would have remained — as explained within. And perhaps this is likewise the secret of the matter: what the sage commanded before his death — his sons and family — that they should strive to water trees — as explained at the beginning of the telling of this story. And the essential tikkun of this is drawn on Shabbos — for this is the secret of the delight of Shabbos [oneg Shabbas] — which is the initial letters of [Eden — Nahar — Gan]: the aspect of [Genesis 2:10]: "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan" — as explained in the holy Zohar. And therefore in truth our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded one Shabbos properly — Mashiach ben David would immediately come — as mentioned above.

segments.he: מעשה יב-מעשה מהבעל תפלה
segments.en:
Story Eleven — Ma'aseh 11 — The Story of the Prince and the Maid's Son Who Were Exchanged

The essential root of the grip of the substitutions and the exchanges and the transformations is from the aspect of the six weekdays. For then is the dominion of Metatron — who is the aspect of a servant — as is well-known. And it is stated regarding him [Exodus 23:21]: "al tamor bo" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "al temirani vo [do not exchange Me for him]." And in the chain of descent — the aspect of the transformations descends further and further — until they exchange the son of the slave and the maidservant literally for the son of the king. For this is the aspect of [Proverbs 30:21–23]: "tachas eved ki yimloch — v'shifchah ki sirash gevirtah" — and so on. And the essential root of the intensification of the aspect of the transformations is in the thought. For the son of the slave imagines in his thought that he is truly the son of the king. And moreover — his thought became so confused and so inverted — until — from the fear of the slander of the world — who said that he is the son of the slave — and certainly he himself would also sometimes be in doubt: perhaps the truth is so. And specifically through this he intensified himself — to think thoughts and to cause many evils to the slave — who in truth is his very own father. And moreover — he caused the true prince to be completely banished from his land. And likewise — the prince himself — even though everywhere he was — and even after he was banished — nonetheless — he is truly the prince. Only — upon him too — the exchanges and the transformations intensified in his thought — so that it seemed to him that he is the son of the slave. And moreover — through the fact that he knew: that the world says of him that he is the son of the king — and specifically through this he was banished from his land for nothing. Through this it angered him even more — until he took himself to drinking and intoxication — and went after the stubbornness of his heart. For this is the essential intensification of the evil transformations, heaven forfend. And all these aspects pass over all of Israel — in general and in particular — with each and every one — in every generation and generation — as is understood by itself. And as is explained extensively in Likutay Halachos. And therefore — the essential tikkun for this is through the holiness of Shabbos.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' התכלית בחי' תכלית מעשה שמים וארץ והוא מעין עוה"ב שהוא בחי' עולם התיקון. ע"כ עיקר שלימות התיקון של כל הכתות המבוארים בפנים הכל ע"י קדושת שבת קודש. כי כבר מבואר בליקוטי הלכות ובדברינו בקונטרס זמרת הארץ שלכל סברא ודיעה של כל כת וכת היה לה איזה אחיזה ושורש גם בקדושה. וע"כ קדושת שבת כולל כל התיקונים של כל הכתות הנ"ל. הכת שבחרו להם שעיקר התכלית הוא כבוד ונתתקנו אח"כ ע"י המלך הזקן בעצמו שמצאוהו יושב בשדה מוכתר בכתר מלכות זה כלול בקדושת שבת כי קדושת שבת הוא בחי' ענוה ושפלות בחי' שבו איש תחתיו הנאמר בשבת וכמבואר במ"א היפוך מהטעות של כת הנ"ל שהיו רודפין אחר הכבוד. רק אדרבא צריכין למעט בכבוד עצמו ולהרבות בכבוד המקום שזה בחי' מה שמבואר בשו"ע או"ח סי' רנ שגדולי חכמי ישראל היו טורחין בעצמן להכין שום דבר לצורך שבת כדי לכבדו ומהם ילמד כל אדם ואל יאמר לא אפגום כבודי כי זה הוא כבודו שמבכבד השבת עיי"ש. כי בוודאי הכבוד דקדושה יש לו שורש גדול בקדושה עליונה כי כל מה שברא הקב"ה לא ברא אלא לכבודו וצריכין ליזהר מאד בכבוד אביו ואמו ורבו וזקן ות"ח וכו' אבל הכל רק בשביל כבוד שמים שזה בחי' ולקדוש ה' מכובד וכבדתו וכו' הנאמר אצל שבת. וזה בחי' מענגיה לעולם כבוד ינחלו בחי' כי מכבדי אכבד וזה בחי' קדושת כתר שאומרין בשבת בחי' המלך שהיה מוכתר בכתר מלכות. וגם בשבת קודש עולין עד הכתר כידוע.
segments.en: Which is the aspect of the world of thought — and great mental faculties shine in it. And it is the aspect of son [ben] — as explained elsewhere. And then the Sitra Achra and the palaces of the transformations are subdued greatly — as explained in the holy Zohar. And then — the aspect of tranquility and holiness and settled understanding [yishuv haDa'as] is drawn upon each person according to his level. Until even the son of the maidservant himself contemplates within himself — that it was not good that he banished the prince for nothing. And all the more so — for the true prince — certainly thoughts of repentance and settled understanding come to him. And he contemplates within himself: on the contrary — if so — that the Almighty is able to do such a thing — and so on — is it possible — what I am doing? And is it fitting for me to conduct myself so — even if I were truly the son of the slave? And all the more so — since the world says of me that I am the son of the king — and I have royal customs — and in the end I am going after the stubbornness of my heart — and doing such deeds. And then he repents very much over his deeds. And then — even though afterward he returns again to his deeds, heaven forfend — in the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: "keivan sheShabbas vav — avdah nefesh" — nonetheless — the residual impression [reshimu] of the aforementioned thoughts of repentance rises in his heart every time thereafter as well — and reminds him — and arouses him. Until through this he merits to come to complete repentance — until he merits to reach the fullness of his true tikkun — as explained within. And also — one must know: that before one comes to the fullness of one's tikkun — many causes and very many difficult things must pass over one. For this is the aspect of: "mi shedarach b'Erev Shabbas yochal b'Shabbas" — for this is the causes that passed over the true prince — until he reached the fullness of his tikkun and his good ultimate purpose. And then he saw with his own eyes: that all these causes and difficult things were the cause of his true and eternal success — as all of this is explained within.

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שהתכלית הוא רציחה זה נמשך בשרשו ממה שגם בקדושה יש דין ארבע מיתות ב"ד ומצוה לקיים ובערת הרע מקרבך והתיקון לזה הוא ג"כ ע"י קדושת שבת שנקראת שבת מלכתא. שזה בחי' מה שנתתקנה הכת הנ"ל ע"י המלכה שמצאו אותה יושבת בים של דם וכו' כמבפ"נ. כי גם בקדושת שבת נמצא בחי' זו בחי' מחלליה מות יומת ונאמר כל העושה בו מלאכה יומת ואעפי"כ ארז"ל (סנהדרין לה) אין רציחה דוחה שבת היינו שאין ממיתין ארבע מיתות ב"ד בשבת. כי בשבת כל שולטני רוגזין ומארי דדינא כלהו ערקין וכו' וכל דינין אתכפיין ולא מתערין כלל. ולמדו רז"ל מכמה מקראות שפיקוח נפש דוחה שבת. ועיקר החיים ואריכות ימים נמשך מקדושת שבת בחי' טועמיה חיים זכו.
segments.en:
And also — the entire matter explained within: that the night said to the day — why — when you come — there is no name for me — for a candle at noon of what use is it? — and so on. And regarding the matter of the renewal of the moon [chidushei deSihra] — when then the living creatures bearing the Throne make a melody — in the aspect of [Psalms 96:1]: "Shiru laHashem Shir Chadash" — for this is the song that the cows of Bashan sang when they bore the Ark toward Beit Shemesh. And regarding the matter of the Garden of Eden — from which Adam the first man was expelled — and Shabbos shielded over him. And Shabbos is the aspect of: the king who is the one upon whom peace depends [Melech shehaShalum shelo] — and so on. And regarding the matter of the throne — and the table — the bed — and the menorah — which are the tikkunim of the Shechinah — and so on. All of this is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as explained in Zohar Terumah, folio 138 — and in other places. And also — as explained within — regarding the wondrous garden — that when one wishes to enter it — then immediately they begin to pursue the person who wishes to enter — until they drive him out from the garden.

And the tikkun is: that one should stand near the image of a person who stands there near the garden — and above him there is a sign [tablet] — and written upon it: that this person was a king in whose days there was peace. And the prince mentioned above commanded: to stand this aforementioned person within the garden. And then — all of them entered the garden — and went out from it in peace — without harm. And it is explained afterward in the allusions: that this garden is the aspect of the Garden of Eden — from which Adam the first man was expelled. And Shabbos — which is the aspect of the king in whose days there is peace — shielded over him — as mentioned above.
