segments.he: הכת שאמרו שראוי למלוך מי שיש לו שפע מזונות הרבה וניזון רק מזונות דקים וכו'. עיקר תיקונם הוא ג"כ ע"י קדושת שבת שאז יש שפע מזונות הרבה בחי' שפע כפולה שזה בחי' לחם משנה של שבת שהוא בחי' לחם הפנים כמבואר בזוה"ק (ויחי ד' רמו) שזה עיקר בחי' מזונות דקים. ומבואר בזוה"ק ובכהאריז"ל כי אכילת שבת הוא כולו קודש ואין שום אחיזה בו להחיצונים אלא כולו נבלע באיברים. ומבואר כבר לעיל כי אכילת שבת הוא בחי' מן. וכמבואר גם בספר הקנה שצריכין לשים הלחם בין שתי מפות זכר למן וכמבואר גם בשו"ע או"ח. ואכילת מן הוא בודאי מזון דק ורוחני מאד.
segments.en: And also — it is explained there: regarding the throne that the king made — and so on. And before the throne stands a bed — and near the bed stands a table — and upon the table stands a menorah — and so on. And the aforementioned prince completed the matter of the tikkun of the throne and the bed and the table and the menorah — and moved their place somewhat — and so on. And arranged everything in the proper order — and so on. And then they gave him the kingship — and so on. And this is the aspect of: "tzeluta d'me'alei Shabbata — deha ityachdas kursaya yikira kadisha" — and so on — "v'itaknath l'mishreh alah malka kadisha ila'ah" — and so on. And this is the aspect of: "u'vayom hashevi'i nistalah v'yashav al kisse chevodo" — for Shabbos is the aspect of the world of the Throne [olam haKissay] — as is well-known. And this is why one must then have one's lamp lit — and one's table set — and one's bed spread — in the aspect of the lamp and the table and the bed — mentioned above — that stand before the throne. And then on the holy Shabbos — the kingship ascends in fullness — and all the sides of the other side [sitrin achranin] — that intensify through the aspect of the palaces of the transformations — mentioned above — are pushed away and fall. And this is what is elaborated upon in [Psalms 92]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" — regarding the success of the wicked — which is only for a brief moment — and for their destruction forever — but [Psalms 92:13]: "Tzadik katamar yifrach" — and so on. And likewise in [Psalms 93]: "Hashem Malach" — and the sixth [Psalms 93:4]: "miKolos mayim rabbim adirim" — and so on — "adir bamarom Hashem — edosecha ne'emnu me'od" — and so on. For the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever — and You are on high forever, Hashem. For in the end — the substitutions and transformations will be nullified — and the world will stand upon its tikkun and its proper place in fullness — and the first dominion will return to the daughter of Jerusalem — and a redeemer will come to Zion. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would immediately be redeemed. For the essential aforementioned tikkunim flow through the holiness of Shabbos. And this is what is written [Jeremiah 17:24–25]: "v'hayah im shamo'a tishme'u eilai" — and so on — "v'ladesh es yom haShabbas" — and so on — "u'va'u b'sha'arey ha'ir hazos — melachim v'sarim yoshvim el kisse David" — and so on. For the kingship and the dominion will return to the true prince — as mentioned above.

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שיפת תואר ראויה למלוך מחמת שעי"ז נתרבה ישוב העולם וכו' עיקר תיקונם ע"י קדושת שבת שהוא בחי' תיקון הברית וביטול תאוה זאת בחי' אל תחמוד יפיה בלבבך וכו' בחי' שקר החן והבל היופי אשה יראת ה' היא תתהלל. שזה בחי' קדושת שבת שהוא בחי' אשה כשארז"ל כנ"י יהיה בן זוגך והוא בחי' אשה יראת ה' בחי' ירא שבת. וע"י יראה קדושה נתבטל תאוה זאת וכמבואר בליקוטי הראשון סי' סמך.
segments.en: Story Twelve — Ma'aseh 12 — The Story of the Ba'al Tefillah [the Master of Prayer]

segments.he: וע"כ עיקר זמן קדושת הזווג הוא בשבת קודש. כי אז הזווג הוא בקדושה גדולה וזוכין עי"ז להוליד בנים קדושים וצדיקים ות"ח שזה עיקר ישוב העולם באמת כי ת"ח הם בנאי עולם כשארז"ל אל תקרי בניך אלא בוניך.
segments.en:
Shabbos is the aspect of the ultimate purpose [tachlis] — the aspect of: the ultimate purpose of the act of heaven and earth. And it is the foretaste of the World to Come — which is the aspect of the world of tikkun [olam haTikkun]. And therefore — the essential fullness of the tikkun of all the factions [katvos] explained within — all through the holy Shabbos. For it is already explained in Likutay Halachos and in our words in the pamphlet Zimras ha'Aretz: that every opinion and view of every faction had some grip and root also in holiness. And therefore — the holiness of Shabbos encompasses all the tikkunim of all the aforementioned factions.

The faction that chose for themselves: that the essential ultimate purpose is honor — and they were afterward rectified through the old king himself — who was found sitting in a field — crowned with a crown of kingship. This is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — for the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of humility and lowliness [anavah v'shefilus] — the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "shevu ish tachtav" — stated regarding Shabbos — and as explained elsewhere. The opposite of the error of the aforementioned faction — who pursued honor. Rather — on the contrary — one must diminish in one's own honor — and increase in the honor of G-d. For this is the aspect of what is explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 250: that the great sages of Israel would personally toil — to prepare something for the sake of Shabbos — in order to honor it. And from them — every person shall learn. And he should not say — I will not diminish my honor. For this itself is his honor — that he honors the Shabbos. See there. For certainly — sacred honor has a great root in the supreme holiness — for everything the Holy One, blessed be He, created — He created only for His honor. And one must be very careful in the honor of one's father and mother and teacher and elder and Torah scholar — and so on. But all of it only for the sake of the honor of Heaven. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'liKdosh Hashem mechubbad v'chibadto" — and so on — stated regarding Shabbos. And this is the aspect of: "me'angeha l'olam kavod yinchalu" — the aspect of [I Samuel 2:30]: "ki mechabbedai achabbed." And this is the aspect of the sanctification of Kaser — which is said on Shabbos — in the aspect of the king who was crowned with the crown of kingship. And also — on the holy Shabbos — one ascends to the Kaser [Crown] — as is well-known.

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שעיקר התכלית הוא הדיבור וכו' עיקר תיקונם ע"י קדושת שבת. כי אז נכנעין ונופלין כל לשונות העכו"ם ונמשך בחי' קדושת הדיבור של לשה"ק שזה בחי' ודבר דבר הנאמר בשבת כמובן בליקו"א סי' יט במאמר תפלה לחבקוק ובליקות"נ סי' ב' במאמר ימי חנוכה וכמבואר להדיא בזוה"ק (בראשית ד' לב). שבת אקרי דיבור ובגין דא דיבור דחול אסור בשבת וכו'.
segments.en: The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is murder — this flows in its root from the fact that even in holiness there are the four judicial death penalties [arba misos beis din] — and it is a commandment to fulfill [Deuteronomy 13:6]: "u'vi'arta hara mikirbecha." And the tikkun for this is likewise through the holiness of Shabbos — which is called "Shabbas Malketa." For this is the aspect of what the aforementioned faction was rectified — through the queen who was found sitting in a sea of blood — and so on — as explained within. For also in the holiness of Shabbos this aspect is found — in the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "mechaleleha mos yumas" — and it is stated [Exodus 31:14–15]: "kol ha'oseh vah melachah yumas." And nonetheless — our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Sanhedrin 35]: murder does not override Shabbos — that is, they do not execute the four judicial death penalties on Shabbos. For on Shabbos: "kol shultenei rogzin u'marei d'dina kulhu arkin" — and so on — "v'chol dinin iskafyan v'la misaarin klal" — and so on. And our Sages of blessed memory learned from several verses: that the preservation of life [pikuach nefesh] overrides Shabbos. And the essential life and length of days flows from the holiness of Shabbos — in the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu."

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שעיקר התכלית הוא שמחה וכו' עיקר תיקונם ע"י קדושת שבת. שאז עיקר זמן השמחה דקדושה ונמשך שמחה וחדוה גדולה בכל העולמות כמבואר בזוה"ק וכנ"ל כ"פ איך שצריכין לקבל שבת בשמחה גדולה. וזה בחי' ישמחו במלכותך שומרי שבת וקוראי ענג וכו'. והשמחה דקדושה היא כלולה ומקושרת עם אהבה דקדושה בחי' ויעלצו בך אוהבי שמך שזה בחי' מה שנתתקנו אח"כ הכת הנ"ל ע"י שמלך עליהם האוהב נאמן של המלך שמצאוהו יושב בתוך ים של יין וכו' כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' האור האהבה והרצון דקדושה שמאיר בשבת קודש. בחי' ושבת קדשך באהבה וברצון הנחלתנו. ונקראת מנוחת אהבה ונדבה. וזה בחי' הקידוש על היין בחי' נזכירה דודיך מיין משרים אהבוך.
segments.en: The faction that said: one is fit to rule — one who has an abundance of many foods — and is sustained only on refined foods — and so on. The essential tikkun of this is likewise through the holiness of Shabbos — for then there is an abundance of many foods — the aspect of the doubled bounty — for this is the aspect of the double bread [lechem mishneh] of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the showbread [lechem haPanim] — as explained in the holy Zohar, Vayechi, folio 246 [Reish Mem Vav]. For this is the essential aspect of refined foods [mazon dak]. And it is explained in the holy Zohar and in the writings of the holy Ari z"l: for the eating of Shabbos is entirely holy — and the outer forces have no grip in it at all — rather — it is entirely absorbed into the limbs. And it is already explained above: for the eating of Shabbos is the aspect of the manna. And as is also explained in Sefer haKaneh: that one must place the bread between two covers — as a remembrance of the manna — and as also explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim. And the eating of the manna is certainly a very refined and very spiritual food.

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שעיקר התכלית הוא חכמה וכו' עיקר תיקונם ע"י קדושת שבת שאז מאיר אור החכמה דקדושה שזה סוד בחי' ושמרתם את השבת כי קדש הוא קדש הוא בחי' חכמה כידוע. ואז נופלין ונתבטלין כל החכמות חיצוניות שזה בחי' מה שמבואר בשו"ע או"ח שאסור לקרות בשבת בספרי הלימודים של חכמות חיצוניות וכנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en:
The faction that said: one of beautiful countenance [yefas to'ar] is fit to rule — since through this the settlement of the world is increased — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the tikkun of the covenant — and the nullification of this desire — in the aspect of [Proverbs 6:25]: "al tachmod yafyah bilvavecha" — and so on — the aspect of [Proverbs 31:30]: "sheiker haChein v'hevel haYofi — ishah yiras Hashem hi tishalel." For this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of: "ishah" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: the Congregation of Israel shall be your partner. And it is the aspect of: "ishah yiras Hashem" — the aspect of: "yirey Shabbas." And through sacred awe — this desire is nullified — as explained in the first Likutim, Siman 60. And therefore — the essential time of the holiness of the sacred union is on the holy Shabbos. For then — the union is in great holiness — and through this one merits to beget holy and righteous children and Torah scholars. Which is the essential settlement of the world in truth — for Torah scholars are the builders of the world — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: do not read "banecha [your children]" but rather "bonecha [your builders]."

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is speech — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos. For then — all the languages of the nations are subdued and fall — and the aspect of the sanctity of speech of the holy tongue [lashon haKodesh] is drawn. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos — as understood in Likutay Moharan, Siman 19 in the teaching "Tefilah l'Chavakuk" — and in Likutay Tinyana, Siman 2 in the teaching "Yemei Chanukah" — and as explicitly explained in the holy Zohar [Bereishis folio 32]: "Shabbas ikri dibbur — u'began da — dibbur d'chol — asur b'Shabbas" — and so on.

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שעיקר התכלית הוא להשגיח לגדל האיברים ע"י אכילה ושתיה ונתתקנו אח"כ ע"י שמלך עליהם הגבור של המלך וכו'. עיקר תיקונם ע"י קדושת שבת. כי אז האכילה בקדושה גדולה ומצוה לאכול שלש סעודות בשבת כ"ש אכלוהו היום וכו' וכשדרז"ל וע"י קדושת אכילת שבת נתדשנין האיברים והעצמות בקדושה גדולה בחי' ועצמותיך יחליץ שנסמך לענין אם תשיב משבת וכו' וכשדרז"ל. ואז זוכין לגבורה גדולה דקדושה שזה בחי' והוא כחתן יוצא מחופתו ישיש כגבור וכו' שנדרש בזוה"ק תרומה ד' קלז לענין קדושת שבת קודש.
segments.en: The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is joy — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos. For then is the essential time of sacred joy — and great joy and delight is drawn in all the worlds — as explained in the holy Zohar. And as mentioned above many times: how one must receive the Shabbos with great joy. And this is the aspect of: "yismechu b'malchusecha shomrei Shabbas v'korei oneg" — and so on. And the sacred joy is encompassed and bound with sacred love — in the aspect of [Psalms 5:12]: "v'ya'altzu v'cha ohavei Shimecha" — for this is the aspect of what the aforementioned faction was afterward rectified — through the fact that the faithful friend of the king — who was found sitting within a sea of wine — and so on — ruled over them — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the light — the love — and the will of holiness — that shines on the holy Shabbos. The aspect of: "v'Shabbas Kodshecha b'ahavah u'v'ratzon hinchaltanu" — and it is called: "menuchas ahavah v'nedavah." And this is the aspect of the Kiddush over wine — the aspect of [Song of Songs 1:4]: "nazkira dodecha miyayin — meisharim ahevucha."

segments.he: הכת שאמרו שעיקר התכלית הוא עשירות ונתתקנו אח"כ ע"י הממונה על האוצרות של המלך וכו'.
segments.en: The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is wisdom — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos — for then shines the light of the sacred wisdom [chochmah d'Kedushah]. For this is the secret of [Exodus 31:14]: "v'shamartem es haShabbas ki Kodesh hu" — "Kodesh hu" is the aspect of wisdom [Chochmah] — as is well-known. And then all the outer wisdoms fall and are nullified — for this is the aspect of what is explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim: it is forbidden to read on Shabbos from books of the study of the outer wisdoms — and as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: עיקר תיקונם ע"י קדושת שבת קודש שהוא עיקר בחי' הממונה על האוצרות. כי כל ההשפעות טובות נמשכין רק מקדושת שבת כמובן בזוה"ק. ואז נמשך בחי' עשירות דקדושה ונתבטל בחי' העצבות ויגון ואנחה של תאוות ממון שזה בחי' ברכת ה' היא תעשיר ולא יוסיף עצב עמה שדרז"ל לענין קדושת שבת וכשארז"ל ג"כ עשירים שבשאר ארצות ע"י שמכבדין את השבת.
segments.en:
The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is to look after the growth of the limbs through eating and drinking — and they were afterward rectified through the warrior of the king — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos. For then — eating is in great holiness — and it is a commandment to eat three meals on Shabbos — as it is written [Exodus 16:25]: "ichluhu hayom" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And through the sacred eating of Shabbos — the limbs and the bones are nourished [mitdashnin] with great holiness — in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:11]: "v'atzmosecha yechalitz" — which is juxtaposed to the matter of: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And then one merits great sacred might [gevurah d'Kedushah]. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 19:6]: "v'hu k'chasan yotzei meichupato — yasis k'gibbor lartzo" — and so on — which was expounded in the holy Zohar, Terumah, folio 137 — regarding the matter of the holiness of the holy Shabbos.

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is wealth — and they were afterward rectified through the one who was appointed over the treasuries of the king — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holy Shabbos — which is the essential aspect of: the one appointed over the treasuries. For all the good influences flow only from the holiness of Shabbos — as understood in the holy Zohar. And then the aspect of sacred wealth is drawn — and the sadness and grief and sighing of the desire for money is nullified. For this is the aspect of [Proverbs 10:22]: "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir — v'lo yosif etzev imah" — which our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding the holiness of Shabbos. And likewise our Sages of blessed memory taught: the wealthy in other lands — because they honor the Shabbos.

segments.he: ושבת הוא בחי' התנוצצות משיח שאז יתבטל תאוות ממון כ"ש ביום ההוא ישליך אדם את אלילי כספו ואלילי זהבו. וזה בחי' מה שבשבת אסור לטלטל את המעות כלל ואפי' שכח כיסו עליו מתיר חגורו והוא נופל וכו' וכמבואר בשו"ע או"ח סי' רסו. וגם המאכלים של שבת הם בבחי' המאכלים הק' המבפ"נ שע"י הריח הטוב של אלו המאכלים זוכין להרגיש הסרחון הגדול של תאוות ממון ואח"כ כשאכלו מהם אזי מאסו מאד בממונם והשליכו מהם את כספם וזהבם וכו' כמבפ"נ.
segments.en: And Shabbos is the aspect of the flash of the light of Mashiach — for then the desire for money will be nullified — as it is written [Isaiah 2:20]: "b'yom hahu yashlich ha'adam es elilei kaspo v'es elilei zahavo." And this is the aspect of what on Shabbos it is forbidden to handle money at all — and even if one forgot one's purse upon oneself — one unties one's belt and it falls — and so on — and as explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 266. And also — the Shabbos foods have likewise the virtue of those sacred foods explained within — through whose good fragrance one merits to feel the great stench of the desire for money. And afterward — when they ate from them — they loathed their money greatly and threw away from them their silver and their gold — and so on — as explained within. And since the Shabbos foods have this virtue as well — therefore it is impossible that for the sake of the Shabbos foods one should need to depend on creatures — and should fall in one's resolve and be ashamed through this before the wealthy person. For this is entirely the opposite of the virtue of the sanctity of the Shabbos foods — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: make your Shabbos like a weekday — and do not become dependent on creatures. For all who are dependent on creatures — their face changes color — like a raven [Krum] — and so on. That is — from shame and weakness of resolve that he has before the wealthy person who gives to him. And through this — the desire for money can take hold of him, heaven forfend — since he has such submission and shame before the wealthy person. But the Shabbos foods are the aspect of those sacred foods mentioned above — when one eats from them — one loathes money to the utmost loathing — and the wealthy people are ashamed of their money. And the poor people are also very ashamed — for until now they had been small in their own eyes — and fallen in their resolve before the wealthy people — because they have no money — and so on — as explained within. And since the Shabbos foods have this virtue as well — therefore it is impossible that because of the Shabbos foods one should become dependent on creatures — and fall in one's resolve — and be ashamed through this before the wealthy person. For this is entirely the opposite of the virtue of the sanctity of the Shabbos foods — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וע"כ סמכו רז"ל (שבת קיט) אחר ענין שע"י כבוד שבת זוכין לעשירות וכו' ושם תיכף אחר זה השאלה מפני מה תבשיל של שבת ריחו נודף תבלין אחד יש לנו ושבת שמו וריחו נודף וכו' כי עי"ז זוכין למאס בתאוות ממון ועשירות שאינו בקדושה רק זוכין לעשירות דקדושה שהוא בבחי' ביטול תאוות ממון בחי' איזהו עשיר השמח בחלקו. וע"כ ארז"ל עשה שבתך חול ואל תצטרך לבריות כי כל הנצרך לבריות פניו משתנין ככרום וכו' היינו מחמת בושה וחלישות דעתו שיש לו בפני העשיר הנותן לו. ועי"ז יוכל לאחוז בו תאוות ממון ח"ו מאחר שיש לו התבטלות ובושה כ"כ בפני העשיר. אבל המאכלים של שבת הם בחי' המאכלים הק' המבפ"נ שכשאוכלין מהם ממאסין בממון בתכלית המיאוס והעשירים מתביישים בממונם והעניים מתביישים ג"כ מאד על שעד עתה היו קטנים בעיני עצמן ונפלו בדעתם לפני העשירים מחמת שאין להם ממון וכו' כמבפ"נ. ומחמת שהמאכלים של שבת יש להן ג"כ סגולה זו. ע"כ א"א שבשביל מאכלי שבת יצטרך לבריות ויהיה נופל בדעתו ומתבייש עי"ז לפני העשיר אשר זהו ההיפוך לגמרי מסגולת קדושת המאכלים של שבת כנ"ל.
segments.en: And the essential tikkun of all the aforementioned factions was through the fit Ba'al Tefillah [Master of Prayer] — who ruled over the faction that said: the essential ultimate purpose is only to engage in prayers and songs and praises and confessions — and so on — before the Almighty — and to be lowly of spirit and humble — and so on. And likewise — all that they merited to find and to gather — the entire holy gathering of the king and his people — all was through the merit of the fit Ba'al Tefillah — and through the merit of his holy prayers — and as explained within. For all the tikkunim of all the aforementioned — are all encompassed in the fullness of the sanctity of prayer — as explained in the pamphlet Zimras ha'Aretz. And the essential fullness of the tikkun of prayer — for there is a fullness beyond fullness — also in the matter of the service of prayer itself — as is well-known — and as explained elsewhere. And therefore — the essential fullness of prayer is through the holiness of Shabbos. For then prayer is completed to the ultimate fullness. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — and so on. And our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "lehodos laHashem" — from the language of repentance and verbal confession [teshuvah v'viduy devarim] — which was likewise the matter of the Ba'al Tefillah and his people — mentioned above. And see in the holy Zohar and in the Tikunim — regarding the great fullness of the sanctity of the prayers of the holy Shabbos — and as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: ועיקר התיקון של כל הכתות הנ"ל היה ע"י הבעל תפילה הכשר שמלך על הכת שאמרו שעיקר התכלית הוא רק לעסוק בתפלות ושירות ותשבחות ווידויים וכו' לפני השי"ת ולהיות שפל ברך ועניו וכו'.
segments.en:
Story Thirteen — Ma'aseh 13 — The Story of the Seven Beggars [Shivos haKabtzonim]

Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred old age [ziknah d'Kedushah] — the aspect of length of days [arichas yamim]. For then one ascends to the sacred beard [dikna kadisha] — as explained in the writings of the holy Ari z"l. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who make Kiddush over wine on the nights of Shabbos — merit length of days. For Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred memory [zikaron d'Kedushah] of the old man who is blind — who is in the aspect of entirely above time. For this is the aspect of: "u'verachto mikol hayamim — v'kidashto mikol hazmanim." And this is the aspect of [Exodus 20:8]: "zachor es yom haShabbas" — and so on — the aspect of the aforementioned supreme memory. For on Shabbos — the illumination of the light of Ein Sof is renewed in the worlds — as explained in Siddur Kol Yaakov. And one who merits to truly connect oneself to the holiness of Shabbos in fullness — can through this merit to be encompassed and to cleave to the light of Ein Sof — as it were — in the aspect of entirely above the creation — even above — as it were — the aspect of nefesh — ru'ach — neshamah — which is the aspect of nothing [ayin] — as explained within.

segments.he: וכן כל מה שזכו למצוא ולקבץ את כל הקיבוץ הק' של המלך ואנשיו הכל היה בזכות הבע"ת הכשר ובזכות תפלותיו הק' וכמבפ"נ כי כל התיקונים של כל הנ"ל הכל נכלל בשלימות קדושת התפלה כמבואר בקונטרס זמרת הארץ. ועיקר שלמות תיקון התפלה כי יש שלימות למעלה משלימות גם בענין עבודת התפלה בעצמה כידוע וכמבואר במ"א. ע"כ עיקר שלימות התפלה הוא ע"י קדושת שבת כי אז נשלמת התפלה בתכלית השלימות שזה בחי' מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' ולזמר לשמך עליון וכו' ורז"ל דרשו להודות לה' מלשון תשובה ווידוי דברים שזה היה ג"כ הענין של הבעל תפלה ואנשיו הנ"ל. ועיין בזוה"ק ובתיקונים מגודל שלימות קדושת התפלות של שבת קודש וכנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en: And also — through the holiness of the holy Shabbos — one merits good life that has no lack in it. For Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of all the creation — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And it is stated regarding it: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" — and it is called "tov" — as explained in the holy Zohar. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the Garden of Eden [Gan Eden]. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:10–11]: "v'chagan zeru'eha tatzmiyach" — brought in the Tikunim regarding the holy Shabbos. And also — it is the aspect of the Tzadik who is the foundation of the world [Tzadik Yesod Olam] — who is the aspect of the Gardener [gannan d'gintah] — and as explained in Zohar Terumah, folio 166b. And this is the aspect of the delight of Shabbos [oneg Shabbas] — which is the initial letters of Eden — Nahar — Gan — as brought in the Tikunim. For this is the aspect of: "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan." And in this garden there grow wondrous fruits that have all the tastes and fragrances and appearances in the world. And from them — one lives good life — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the sanctity of the Shabbos foods — that have an excellent taste — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: blessed with delicacies — and so on. And they have a good fragrance — in the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: the food of Shabbos — its fragrance wafts — and so on. And also — the appearance of a person shines even more then — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: blessed with the light of a person's face. And also — the eyes of a person shine even more then — for this is the aspect of Shabbos: "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein." And this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "re'u ki Hashem nasan lachem haShabbas" — and as one can observe concretely in every person — that the Shabbos day differs in its light for the good more than all other days. For this is the aspect of: blessed with light — which our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding the very first Shabbos. And a residual impression [reshimu] of this remains for all generations. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — (ilu shomrey Shabbas) — shemesh Tzedakah" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is the aspect of what one must have on Shabbos: one's table set — which corresponds to the aspect of taste. And one's lamp lit — which corresponds to the aspect of appearance. And one's bed spread — which corresponds to the aspect of fragrance — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: regarding the bed of Elisha — that a good fragrance wafted from it — because his bed was very whole and holy. For the holiness of Shabbos is the exact opposite of the qualities that ruin taste and fragrance and appearance. For Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of the speech of the holy tongue — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — as mentioned above many times in the name of the holy Zohar. And the speech of the holy tongue is the exact opposite of vulgar language [nibbul peh], heaven have mercy. For on this account it is called the holy tongue — on account of the fact that there is in it no name at all for the reproductive organ — as brought in the name of the early authorities. And this is the aspect of the holy tongue: for everywhere that you find the boundary of sexual immorality — you find holiness. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of true judgment [mishpat emes] — in the aspect of [Ezekiel 20:19–20]: "v'es mishpatai shmoru" — and so on — "v'es Shabsosai kadshu" — and so on. And it is the aspect of truth — as mentioned above many times. And it is the aspect of the light of the eyes — as mentioned above. For this is the opposite of the acceptance of bribes and the distortion of justice in falsehood — regarding which it is stated [Exodus 23:8]: "ki hashochad ye'aver" — and so on. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the holiness of the guarding of the covenant — and the nullification of the desire for sexual immorality — as mentioned above many times. And through all of this — taste and appearance and fragrance are rectified — and they return and find the aspect of the true Tzadik — who is the aspect of the Gardener — who watches over the tikkun of the garden. And through this one merits to live good life — for this is the aspect of: "kulam yisb'u v'yis'angu mituvecha" — and so on — and likewise: "v'sova'nu mituvecha" — which is said in the prayer of the holy Shabbos.

segments.he: מעשה יג-מעשה מהז' בעטלערש
segments.en:
And also — the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the speech that has completeness in it — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — and as mentioned above many times in the name of the holy Zohar. And this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on. For the essential perfection is in these words — which are praises of the Almighty — and as explained within. And when the holiness of Shabbos arrives — then many songs and riddles and praises and melodies are awakened to the Almighty — as understood in the holy Zohar. And this is likewise the aspect of what Israel increases on Shabbos with songs and melodies and praises to the Almighty. And this is likewise the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon." And this [Psalms 92:3]: "lehagid bavoker chasdecha — v'emunascha baleilos" — and its Targum: "v'kushtach b'leilin" — for this is the aspect of the lovingkindnesses of truth — through which are the essential becoming of the time of all the days — from which come all the riddles and songs — that contain all the wisdoms. And this is "lehagid — davka" — the declaring [haggadah] is a word of wisdom [milah d'chochmata] — as explained in the holy Zohar. And the most excellent of the days is the holy Shabbos — in the aspect of: "u'verachto mikol hayamim — v'kidashto mikol hazmanim." And it is stated [Psalms 139:16]: "yamim yotzaru — v'lo echad bahem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: this is the day of Shabbos. And it itself is the aspect of the light of truth — as mentioned above many times. And great lovingkindnesses are drawn in it. And the holiness of Shabbos itself was given to Israel through the aspect of a lovingkindness of truth [chesed shel emes] — in the aspect of: "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay — v'Shabbas shemah — va'ani mevakesh l'tena lah l'Yisrael" — and so on. And it is the sacred point of all the days — as brought in the holy Zohar. And therefore — wondrous songs and praises are awakened in it — that are above the aspect of all songs. For this is the aspect of the Song of Songs — which is for the King upon whom peace depends [Melech shehaShalum shelo] — for this is the aspect of the holy Shabbos — as is well-known. And this song is certainly encompassed from all the wisdoms. For the entire creation in all the days was through wisdom — as it is written [Psalms 104:24]: "kulam b'chochmah asisa." And all the days are encompassed in the holy Shabbos — as explained in the holy Zohar. And it is their fullness. And therefore — a wondrous and very supreme wisdom shines in it. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "ki Kodesh hi" — as is well-known.

And also — the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the sanctity of the brain and the lung and the heart — as understood from what is explained in this pamphlet many times — in the name of the holy Zohar and the Tikunim. And their supreme root is the aspect of the spring — and the heart — and the bird that spreads its wings over the heart and shields it — as is well-known. (And one must yet explain further in this.)

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' הזקנה דקדושה בחי' אריכות ימים. כי אז עולין עד הדיקנא קדישא כמבואר בכתהאריז"ל. וזשארז"ל כל המקדש על היין בלילי שבתות זוכה לאריכות ימים כי שבת הוא בחי' זכרון דקדושה של הזקן העור שהוא בבחי' למעלה מהזמן לגמרי שזה בחי' וברכתו מכל הימים וקדשתו מכל הזמנים. וזה בחי' זכור את יום השבת וכו' בחי' זכרון העליון הנ"ל כי בשבת מתחדש הארת אור אין סוף בהעולמות כמבואר בסידור קול יעקב. ומי שזוכה לקשר עצמו באמת לקדושת שבת בשלימות יוכל לזכות עי"ז להכלל ולהדבק באור א"ס כביכול בבחי' למעלה מהבריאה לגמרי אפי' למעלה כביכול מבחי' נפש רוח נשמה שזה בחי' אין וכמבפ"נ.
segments.en: And also — the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of the sacred throat [tzavar d'Kedushah] — which alludes to Binah and to Tiferes — as explained in Pardes. And both are encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times. And then — the aspect of all the sacred vapors and voices are drawn and awakened in fullness. For this is the aspect of the seven voices in [Psalms 29]: "Mizmor l'David" — which are said at the entry of Shabbos — and as understood there in the kavannos. And then — the aspect of the unity between the two sacred birds — mentioned within — shines and flashes. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would immediately be redeemed.

segments.he: גם ע"י קדושת שבת קודש זוכין לחיים טובים שאין בהם שום חסרון. כי שבת הוא בחי' השלימות של כל הבריאה כשארז"ל ונאמר בו טועמיה חיים זכו ונקרא טוב כבמואר בזוה"ק. גם שבת הוא בחי' הגן עדן שזה בחי' וכגנה זרועיה תצמיח המובא בתיקונים לענין שבת קודש. גם הוא בחי' הצדיק יסוד עולם שהוא בחי' הגננא דגינתא וכמבואר בזוהר תרומה ד' קסו ע"ב. וזה בחי' ענג שבת שהוא ר"ת עדן נהר גן כמובא בתיקונים שזה בחי' ונהר יוצא מעדן להשקות את הגן. ובגן הזה גדילים פירות נפלאים שיש להם כל הטעמים והריחות והמראות שבעולם. ומהם חיים חיים טובים כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' קדושת המאכלים של שבת שיש להם טעם משובח כשארז"ל ברכו במטעמים וכו' ויש להם ריח טוב בחי' משארז"ל תבשיל של שבת ריחו נודף וכו'. גם בחי' מראה האדם מאיר אז ביותר כשארז"ל ברכו באור פניו של אדם. גם עיני האדם מאירין אז ביותר שזה בחי' שבת תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין. וזה בחי' ראו כי ה' נתן לכם השבת וכנראה בחוש לכל אדם שיום שבת משונה באורו לטוב יותר משאר הימים שזה בחי' ברכו באורה שארז"ל לענין שבת הראשון ונשאר מבחי' זאת רשימו לדורות עולם וזה בחי' וזרחה לכם יראי שמי (אלו שומרי שבת) שמש צדקה וכו' וכשדרז"ל. וזה בחי' מה שצריך להיות בשבת שולחנו ערוך הוא כנגד בחי' טעם ונרו דולק הוא כנגד בחי' מראה מטתו מוצעת הוא כנגד בחי' ריח כשארז"ל על מטתו של אלישע שהיה נודף ממנה ריח טוב מחמת שהיתה מטתו שלימה וקדושה מאד. כי קדושת שבת הוא ההיפוך ממש מהמדות שמפסידין הטעם והריח והמראה כי שבת הוא בחי' שלימות הדיבור של לשה"ק שזה בחי' ודבר דבר וכנ"ל כ"פ. והדיבור של לשה"ק הוא ההיפוך ממש מניבול פה ר"ל כי על שם זה נקרא לשה"ק על שאין בו שם דבר כלל לכלי המשגל וכמובא בשם הקדמונים ז"ל. וזה בחי' לשה"ק כי כל מקום שאתה מוצא גדר ערוה אתה מוצא קדושה. גם שבת הוא בחי' משפט אמת בחי' ואת משפטי שמרו וכו' ואת שבתותי קדשו וכו'. והוא בחי' אמת כנ"ל כ"פ. והוא בחי' מאור העינים כנ"ל שזה ההיפוך מבחי' לקיחת שוחד ומטה משפט בשקר שעל זה נאמר כי השוחד יעור וכו'. גם שבת הוא בחי' קדושת שמירת הברית וביטול תאוות ניאוף כנ"ל כ"פ. וע"י כל זה נתתקן הטעם והמראה והריח וחוזרין ומוצאין את בחי' הצדיק האמת שהוא בחי' הגנני המשגיח על תיקון הגן. וזוכין לחיות עי"ז חיים טובים שזה בחי' כולם ישבעו ויתענגו מטובך וכו' וכן שבעינו מטובך שאומרין בתפלת שבת קודש.
segments.en: And also — the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of: the few containing the many — to the ultimate fullness. Which is the aspect of the ultimate end of the category of place — entirely. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "al yetzei ish mimekomo" — stated regarding Shabbos. For Shabbos encompasses in it the entire creation — as is well-known.

segments.he: גם שבת קודש הוא בחי' הדיבור שיש בו שלימות שזה בחי' ודבר דבר וכנ"ל כ"פ בשם הזוה"ק. וזה בחי' מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' וכו'. כי עיקר השלימות הוא באלו הדיבורים שהם שבחים להשי"ת וכמבפ"נ. וכשמגיע קדושת שבת אז מתעוררין שירות וחידות ושבחים וזמירות הרבה להשי"ת כמובן בזוה"ק.
segments.en:
And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the place of the world [mekomo shel Olam] — as explained in Likutay Tinyana, Siman 83. And therefore — through the holiness of Shabbos — one can come to the holy tree — mentioned within — which is entirely above place — for this is the aspect of what is explained in the holy Zohar: regarding the ascent of the souls on the holy Shabbos — upward and upward entirely — and so on.

And also — the holiness of Shabbos encompasses all the attributes of this tree — which has three roots — which are faith — humility — and awe. And truth is the body of the tree. And all these attributes are encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: וזה ג"כ בחי' מה שישראל מרבים בשבת בזמירות ושירות ותשבחות להשי"ת. וזה ג"כ בחי' מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' ולזמר לשמך עליון. וזה להגיד בבקר חסדך ואמונתך בלילות ותרגומו וקושטך בלילין שזה בחי' החסדים של אמת שעל ידם עיקר התהוות הזמן של כל הימים שמהם כל החידות והשירות שיש בהם כל החכמות. וזה להגיד דייקא הגדה הוא מלה דחכמתא כמבואר בזוה"ק. ועיקר מבחר הימים הוא שבת קודש בחי' וברכתו מכל הימים וקדשתו מכל הזמנים. ונאמר ימים יוצרו ולו אחד בהם ודרז"ל זה יום השבת והוא בעצמו בחי' אור האמת כנ"ל כ"פ ונמשכין בו חסדים גדולים וקדושת שבת בעצמה ניתנה לישראל ע"י בחי' חסד של אמת בחי' מתנה טוב יש לי בבית גנזי ושבת שמה ואני מבקש ליתנה לישראל וכו' והוא הנקודה הק' של כל הימים כמובא בזוה"ק וע"כ מתעוררין בו שירות ותשבחות נפלאים שהם למעלה מבחי' כל השירות שזה בחי' שיר השירים אשר לשלמה למלך שהשלום שלו שזה בחי' שבת קודש כידוע. והשיר הזה בוודאי כלול מכל החכמות. כי כל הבריאה שבכל הימים היתה ע"י חכמה כ"ש כולם בחכמה עשית. וכל הימים כלולים בשבת קודש כמבואר בזוה"ק. והוא שלימות כולם וע"כ מאיר בו חכמה נפלאה ועליונה מאד שזה בחי' כי קודש הוא כידוע.
segments.en: And also — through the holiness of Shabbos — is the essential drawing of the healing for the princess — as explained within. For this is the aspect of: "Shabbas hu miliz'ok — v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" — and as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 58. For through the repentance of Shabbos — healing is drawn in the physical and the spiritual. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 21:19]: "rak shivto yitein — v'rapa yirapei" — for through the holiness of Shabbos — the Sitra Achra is subdued — from which come all the arrows that were cast at the princess.

segments.he: גם שבת קודש הוא בחי' קדושת המוח והריאה והלב כמובן ממה שמבואר בקונטרס זה כ"פ בשם הזוה"ק והתיקונים. ושרשם העליון הוא בחי' המעין והלב והצפור הפורש כנפיו על הלב ומגין עליו כידוע (וצריכין לבאר עוד בזה).
segments.en: And through the holiness of Shabbos — one can return and extract the arrows from the princess — even after they have already reached her. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: even if one worshipped idolatry like the generation of Enosh — he is forgiven. And likewise — what the angels say regarding him [Isaiah 6:7]: "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar."

segments.he: גם שבת קודש הוא בחי' שלימות הצואר דקדושה שמרמז על בינה ועל תפארת כמבואר בפרדס ושניהם כלולים בקדושת שבת כנ"ל כ"פ. ואז נמשכין ונתעוררין בשלימות כל ההבלים והקולות דקדושה שזה בחי' השבעה קולות שבמזמור לדוד שאומרין בכניסת שבת וכמובן שם בכוונות. ואז מאיר ומתנוצץ בחי' היחוד שבין שתי הציפרים הק' המבפ"נ שזה בחי' משארז"ל אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות מיד נגאלין.
segments.en:
And likewise — the essential fullness of charity is through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — shemesh Tzedakah u'marpe" — and so on. And likewise — the essential ordination of the Sages [semichas Chachamim] is through the holiness of Shabbos. For this is the aspect of what Moshe ordained [samach] Yehoshua on Shabbos — specifically. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: it was a Shabbos of investiture [Shabbas shel diyuzgi] — as mentioned above many times. For then is the essential shining of the light of wisdom in the world — in the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "ki Kodesh hi" — as is well-known. And also — in the holiness of Shabbos are encompassed all ten kinds of melody [asarah minei niggina]. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "tov lehodos" — and so on — "alay asor" — and so on — and as mentioned above many times.

And the melody is the healing of the princess — as explained within.

segments.he: גם קדושת שבת הוא בחי' מועט מחזיק את המרובה בתכלית השלימות שהוא בחי' סוף מדריגת המקום לגמרי שזה בחי' אל יצא איש ממקומו האמור בשבת.
segments.en: And it is known: that the healing of the princess is the aspect of the complete redemption — that is destined to come speedily in our days. As it is written [Isaiah 30:26]: "b'yom chavosh Hashem es shever amo — u'machtzo makosam yirpa" — and similar passages — many verses. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would immediately be redeemed. And in Midrash Rabbah Beshalach, Parashah 25 — it is explained: had Israel guarded one Shabbos properly — Mashiach ben David would immediately come — and so on. May it be so — speedily in our days.

segments.he: כי שבת כלול בו כל הבריאה כולה כידוע.
segments.en:
✦ Translator's Summary — Part Two, Siman 104
 
 Opening: One must be careful to sing the Shabbos songs and the songs of the going out of Shabbos.

segments.he: גם שבת הוא בחי' מקומו של עולם כמבואר בליקות"נ סי' פג. וע"כ ע"י קדושת שבת יכולין לבא לזה האילן הק' המבפ"נ שהוא למעלה מן המקום לגמרי שזה בחי' מה שמבואר בזוה"ק מענין עליית הנשמות בשבת קודש למעלה למעלה לגמרי וכו'.
segments.en:
Story One (Ma'aseh 1 — Lost Princess): The teaching "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" (LM Siman 60) is an explanation of this story; that entire teaching is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos (as clarified in this pamphlet). Shabbos = the aspect of the princess = secret of "Shin Beis." The six days = six sons (Zohar; writings of Ari z"l). Shabbos = the daughter / called "tov" = Psalm 92:2 / Zohar Noach folio 60. Given to the good ones = Israel = "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha." In our many sins: holiness of Shabbos became somewhat concealed = "shachach Hashem b'Tziyon mo'ed v'Shabbas" (Lamentations 2:6); "v'hishbati kol masosah chagah chadshah v'Shabtah" (Hosea 2:13). Nations decreed upon Israel to desecrate the Shabbos → Israel sacrificed their souls. In every generation: Tzadikim and fit people with genuine self-sacrifice. All of Israel yearns and longs with annihilation of the soul for the illumination of holiness of Shabbos → searches for her in the hidden places → sometimes merits some flash of her holiness → she makes herself known → gives counsel. Essential way = through holy longings and yearnings = "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas." One must also diminish in bodily matters especially in desires of eating and drinking during weekdays = great preparation to receive Shabbos (= world of souls; Zohar: "yoma d'nishmata v'lo yoma d'gufa"). SA OC Siman 249: way of people of good deeds is to fast on every Erev Shabbos. Even though: eating of Shabbos is entirely holy; sleep of Shabbos is very holy. During the weekday: must diminish as much as possible because then is essential rule and dominion of the Sitra Achra. Thoughts of repentance on the holy Shabbos = from this aspect. Each person merits to find the princess. But: when person draws near to the holiness → the adversary intensifies even more (like two fighters = when one is close to winning → the other intensifies even more). Until there are those who fall into sleep of seventy years (= cannot be awakened by any of the seventy faces of the Torah) → only through "sipur d'shanin kadmoniyos" (= from aspect of Atik; teaching of Pasach Rabbi Shimon). Both: the awakening through the seventy faces of the Torah = aspect of seventy years; and the awakening through the aspect of ancient years = all encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos (as explained below in this pamphlet regarding "Pasach Rabbi Shimon"). Therefore: if a person will be strong in his resolve + will not despair + will yearn and long and seek and strive + will connect himself to the true Tzadikim + will be careful in the guarding of the holy Shabbos + will honor it and delight in it → will merit to reach the ultimate fullness. "Ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu." Midrash Rabbah Beshalach Parashah 25: "ilmalai shamru Yisrael Shabbas echad k'raui miy'yad ben David ba."

 Story Two (Ma'aseh 2 — King and Emperor): Story speaks of the secret of the sacred connection and unity between Israel and their Father in Heaven = union of G-d and His Shechinah. Many causes and obstacles passed over this. Nonetheless: "atzas Hashem l'olam ta'amod" → sacred unity will be completed in fullness. All of this encompassed in holiness of Shabbos = essential bond between Israel and their Father in Heaven = "ki os hu beini u'veineichem" (Exodus 31:13) + "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam bris olam" (Exodus 31:16) + "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha" (Sages). Essential future redemption = when this unity will be completed in fullness = all depends upon holiness of Shabbos (Sages; many times).

segments.he: גם קדושת שבת כלול מכל המדות של זה האילן שיש לו שלשה שרשים שהם אמונה וענוה ויראה. ואמת הוא גוף האילן וכל המדות האלו כלולין בקדושת שבת כנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en: Story Three (Ma'aseh 3 — The Lame One): Everything touches and is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos. On Shabbos: essential union between sun and moon at their root (Zohar; many places). Shabbos = the tree (ilan) that has many branches and fruits and leaves = every branch and fruit and leaf has its own special virtue: for children / livelihood / healing = "v'hayah k'eitz shatul al palggei mayim" (Psalms 1:3). Zohar: Shabbos = this tree (Tikkun 6 folio 21). Talmud on Psalms 1:3: regarding the union from Shabbos to Shabbos. Shabbos encompasses all precious virtues and good influences: sons / life / livelihood / all healings = "Shabbas hu miliz'ok v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" (many times). "V'zarachah lachem yirey shmi shemesh Tzedakah u'marpe" (Malachi 3:20). On Shabbos: essential subjugation of the demons and husks (Zohar); no sustenance from legs of holiness = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" (many times; writings of Ari z"l). The holy path (derech tzaddikim) shines even more. Corrupted paths nullified = path of heretics = Shabbos = foundation of sacred faith = nullification of heresy. Path of the mad ones nullified = Shabbos = settled understanding = Da'as shines in fullness (many times). Through Shabbos: saved from subjugation of kingdoms → Tzadikim saved from suffering of ministers and violent ones. "V'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" (stated regarding Shabbos). Dust and powder scattered beneath legs of displaced Tzadikim = all flows from holiness of Shabbos = essential tikkun and strengthening of sacred legs (above). Aspect of healing of the lame one for his legs = through the aforementioned father. On Shabbos: essential time for watering of the holy tree = if the tree had been watered properly → nothing of the demons and husks would have remained (within). Perhaps: this is also the secret of the matter = what the sage commanded before his death = his sons and family to strive to water trees. Essential tikkun of this = drawn on Shabbos = oneg Shabbas = roshei teivos of Eden / Nahar / Gan = "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan" (Zohar). "Ilmalai shamru Yisrael Shabbas echad k'raui miy'yad ben David ba."

segments.he: גם ע"י קדושת שבת עיקר המשכת הרפואה להבת מלכה המבואר בפנים. שזה בחי' שבת הוא מלזעוק ורפואה קרובה לבא וכמבואר בליקו"א סי' נח. שע"י התשובה של שבת נמשך רפואה בגשמיות ורוחניות שזה בחי' רק שבתו יתן ורפא ירפא כי ע"י קדושת שבת נכנע הסט"א שממנה כל החיצים שנזרקו להבת מלכה.
segments.en: Story Eleven (Ma'aseh 11 — Prince and Maid's Son Who Were Exchanged): Root of grip of substitutions and exchanges and transformations = from aspect of six weekdays = dominion of Metatron (aspect of a servant; well-known) = "al temirani vo" (Sages on Exodus 23:21). In the chain of descent: the transformations descend further and further = "tachas eved ki yimloch v'shifchah ki tirash gevirtah" (Proverbs 30:21–23). Essential root of intensification of transformations = in the thought. All these aspects pass over all of Israel in general and in particular in every generation (as understood by itself; extensively in Likutay Halachos). Essential tikkun = through holiness of Shabbos = world of thought = great mental faculties shine = aspect of "ben" [son] (elsewhere). Then: Sitra Achra and palaces of the transformations are subdued greatly (Zohar). Tranquility and holiness and settled understanding (yishuv haDa'as) drawn upon each person → even the son of the maidservant himself contemplates = it was not good → the true prince: certainly thoughts of teshuvah and settled understanding come → the residual impression (reshimu) of the thoughts of teshuvah = rises in his heart every time thereafter → arouses him → until merits to come to complete teshuvah → until merits to reach the fullness of his true tikkun (within). Before reaching the fullness of one's tikkun: many causes and very many difficult things must pass over one = "mi shedarach b'Erev Shabbas yochal b'Shabbas." The matter of the night saying to the day / chidushei deSihra / "Shiru laHashem Shir Chadash" / cows of Bashan sang when bearing Ark toward Beit Shemesh / Garden of Eden and Shabbos shielding over Adam / Melech shehaShalum shelo / throne and table and bed and menorah = tikkunei deShechinah = all encompassed in holiness of Shabbos (Zohar Terumah folio 138; other places). The wondrous garden = enters → pursued → driven out; tikkun = the image of a person who was a king in whose days there was peace = stood within the garden = all entered and went out in peace. The garden = Garden of Eden = Shabbos = Melech shehaShalum shelo = shielded over Adam. The throne + bed + table + menorah = the prince completed the tikkun of all of these + arranged everything in proper order → then given the kingship. "Tzeluta d'me'alei Shabbata deha ityachdas kursaya yikira kadisha / v'itaknath l'mishreh alah malka kadisha ila'ah." "U'vayom hashevi'i nistalah v'yashav al kisse chevodo" = Shabbos = olam haKissay (well-known). Therefore: must have lamp lit + table set + bed spread (= lamp / table / bed = stand before the throne). On Shabbos: Malchus ascends in fullness + sitrin achranin pushed away and fall. Psalm 92 fully mapped: success of wicked only for a brief moment = for their destruction forever; "Tzadik katamar yifrach." Psalms 93 cited: "miKolos mayim rabbim adirim / adir bamarom Hashem / edosecha ne'emnu me'od." Counsel of Hashem shall stand forever: in the end substitutions and transformations will be nullified → world will stand upon its tikkun → "v'tachazer haMemshalah haRishonah l'Bat Yerushalayim" → "u'va l'Tziyyon Go'el." "Ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu." Jeremiah 17:24–25: "u'va'u b'sha'arey ha'ir hazos melachim v'sarim yoshvim el kisse David."

segments.he: וע"י קדושת שבת יכולין להחזיר ולהוציא החיצים מהבת מלכה אפי' לאחר שכבר הגיעו אליה שזה בחי' משארז"ל אפי' עע"ז כדור אנוש מוחלין לו. וכן מה שהמלאכים אומרים עליו וסר עווניך וחטאתך תכופר.
segments.en:
Story Twelve (Ma'aseh 12 — Ba'al Tefillah): Shabbos = ultimate purpose = tachlis ma'aseh shamayim va'aretz = foretaste of World to Come = olam haTikkun. Essential fullness of tikkun of all the factions = all through holy Shabbos. Every faction's opinion had some grip and root also in holiness. Shabbos encompasses all the tikkunim. Each faction mapped to holiness of Shabbos: Honor faction → Shabbos = humility and lowliness = "shevu ish tachtav" (Exodus 16:29) + "v'liKdosh Hashem mechubbad v'chibadto" (Isaiah 58:13) + SA OC Siman 250 + "me'angeha l'olam kavod yinchalu / ki mechabbedai achabbed" (I Samuel 2:30) + Keser + ascending to the Kaser on Shabbos (well-known). Murder faction → flows from arba misos beis din + "u'vi'arta hara mikirbecha"; Shabbos = Shabbas Malketa; "mechaleleha mos yumas / kol ha'oseh vah melachah yumas"; but: Sages (Sanhedrin 35): murder does not override Shabbos; "kol shultenei rogzin u'marei d'dina kulhu arkin / v'chol dinin iskafyan v'la misaarin klal"; preservation of life overrides Shabbos; essential life and length of days = from holiness of Shabbos = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu." Abundant food faction → Shabbos = doubled bounty = lechem mishneh = lechem haPanim (Zohar Vayechi folio 246) = "mazon dak" [refined foods]; eating of Shabbos entirely holy = no grip to outer forces = entirely absorbed into the limbs; eating of Shabbos = aspect of the manna; Sefer haKaneh: bread between two covers = remembrance of manna; manna = very refined and very spiritual food. Beautiful countenance faction → Shabbos = tikkun habris = nullification of this desire = "al tachmod yafyah bilvavecha" (Proverbs 6:25) + "sheiker haChein v'hevel haYofi ishah yiras Hashem hi tishalel" (Proverbs 31:30); Shabbos = "ishah" = "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha" = "ishah yiras Hashem" = "yirey Shabbas"; through sacred awe: this desire is nullified (Likutay Rishon Siman 60 cross-ref.); therefore essential time of sacred union on Shabbos = begets holy children and Torah scholars = builders of the world = "al tikrei banecha ela bonecha" (Sages). Speech faction → Shabbos = all languages of nations subdued + sanctity of speech of lashon haKodesh = "v'daber davar" (Isaiah 58:13); LM Siman 19 (Tefilah l'Chavakuk) + LT Siman 2 (Yemei Chanukah) cross-refs; Zohar Bereishis folio 32: "Shabbas ikri dibbur u'began da dibbur d'chol asur b'Shabbas." Joy faction → Shabbos = essential time of sacred joy = great joy in all worlds (Zohar; many times); "yismechu b'malchusecha shomrei Shabbas v'korei oneg"; sacred joy encompassed and bound with sacred love = "v'ya'altzu v'cha ohavei Shimecha"; faction rectified through the faithful friend of the king who was found in a sea of wine; aspect of light and love and will of holiness = "v'Shabbas Kodshecha b'ahavah u'v'ratzon hinchaltanu" = "menuchas ahavah v'nedavah" = Kiddush over wine = "nazkira dodecha miyayin meisharim ahevucha" (Song of Songs 1:4). Wisdom faction → Shabbos = light of sacred Chochmah = "v'shamartem es haShabbas ki Kodesh hu" = "Kodesh hu" = Chochmah (well-known) + outer wisdoms fall and are nullified + forbidden to read from books of outer wisdoms on Shabbos (SA OC; many times). Growth of limbs through eating faction → Shabbos = eating in great holiness = commandment of three meals = "ichluhu hayom" (Exodus 16:25; Sages); through sacred eating: limbs and bones nourished (mitdashnin) with great holiness = "v'atzmosecha yechalitz" (Isaiah 58:11; juxtaposed to "im tashiv miShabbos"; Sages); merits great sacred might = "v'hu k'chasan yotzei meichupato yasis k'gibbor" (Psalms 19:6); Zohar Terumah folio 137 regarding Shabbos. Wealth faction → Shabbos = the one appointed over the treasuries; all good influences flow from holiness of Shabbos (Zohar); sacred wealth drawn + sadness and grief of desire for money nullified = "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir v'lo yosif etzev imah" (Proverbs 10:22; Sages: regarding Shabbos); wealthy in other lands because they honor Shabbos (Sages). Shabbos = flash of light of Mashiach = desire for money will be nullified = "b'yom hahu yashlich ha'adam es elilei kaspo v'es elilei zahavo" (Isaiah 2:20). On Shabbos: forbidden to handle money at all = SA OC Siman 266. Shabbos foods have the virtue of those sacred foods = through their good fragrance: feel the great stench of the desire for money → then: loathed their money and threw away their silver and gold (within). Sages: "asei Shabbatecha chol v'al titzarech libri'yos" = one who is dependent on creatures: face changes color = from shame before the wealthy person who gives to him → could let desire for money take hold of him. But Shabbos foods: when one eats from them → loathes money to utmost loathing → wealthy people are ashamed of their money → poor people are also very ashamed (within). Therefore: impossible that because of Shabbos foods one should become dependent on creatures. Essential tikkun of all factions = through the fit Ba'al Tefillah = the one who ruled over the faction that said the essential ultimate purpose = only to engage in prayers and songs and praises and confessions before G-d + to be lowly of spirit and humble. All that they merited to find and gather = through the merit of the Ba'al Tefillah and through his holy prayers (within). All tikkunim of all aforementioned = all encompassed in fullness of sanctity of prayer (Zimras ha'Aretz pamphlet cross-ref.). Essential fullness of tikkun of prayer (= there is a fullness beyond fullness in prayer itself; well-known; elsewhere). Therefore: essential fullness of prayer = through holiness of Shabbos = "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas tov lehodos laHashem v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" + Sages: "lehodos laHashem" = from language of teshuvah and viduy devarim = matter of the Ba'al Tefillah and his people. See Zohar and Tikunim regarding the great fullness of the sanctity of the Shabbos prayers (many times).

 Story Thirteen (Ma'aseh 13 — Shivos haKabtzonim / Seven Beggars): Shabbos = sacred old age (ziknah d'Kedushah) = arichas yamim = ascends to dikna kadisha (writings of Ari z"l). Sages: "kol hamekadesh al haYayin b'leilei Shabbasos zokheh l'arichas yamim." Shabbos = sacred memory (zikaron d'Kedushah) = the old man who is blind = aspect of entirely above time = "u'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim." "Zachor es yom haShabbas" = aspect of the supreme memory. On Shabbos: illumination of light of Ein Sof is renewed in the worlds (Siddur Kol Yaakov). Merits to connect oneself to the holiness of Shabbos → merits to be encompassed and to cleave to the light of Ein Sof → in the aspect of above nefesh / ru'ach / neshamah = aspect of nothing [ayin] (within). Through holiness of Shabbos: merits good life that has no lack = Shabbos = fullness of all the creation (Sages); "ta'ameha chayyim zachu"; called "tov" (Zohar). Shabbos = aspect of Gan Eden = "v'chagan zeru'eha tatzmiyach" (Tikunim: regarding Shabbos); also = Tzadik Yesod Olam = gannan d'gintah (Zohar Terumah folio 166b). Oneg Shabbas = roshei teivos of Eden/Nahar/Gan (Tikunim) = "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan." In this garden: wondrous fruits with all tastes and fragrances and appearances → one lives good life (within). Sanctity of Shabbos foods: excellent taste (Sages: "berchu b'mit'amim"); good fragrance (Sages: "tavshil shel Shabbas rei'cho noded"). Appearance of person shines more (Sages: "berchu b'me'or panav shel adam"). Eyes shine more = "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" = "re'u ki Hashem nasan lachem haShabbas." Observable concretely in every person: the Shabbos day differs in its light for the good more than all other days = "berchu b'orah" (Sages: regarding the very first Shabbos) = residual impression (reshimu) remains for all generations. "V'zarachah lachem yirey shmi shemesh Tzedakah" (Malachi 3:20; Sages). Must have: table set (= taste) + lamp lit (= appearance) + bed spread (= fragrance; Sages: regarding bed of Elisha = good fragrance wafted from it = because his bed was very whole and holy). Shabbos = exact opposite of qualities that ruin taste and fragrance and appearance. Shabbos = fullness of speech of lashon haKodesh = "v'daber davar" (many times; Zohar). Lashon haKodesh = exact opposite of vulgar language. Called lashon haKodesh because there is in it no name at all for the reproductive organ (early authorities). "Kol makom she'atah motzei geder arayah atah motzei Kedushah." Shabbos = true judgment = "v'es mishpatai shmoru / v'es Shabsosai kadshu" (Ezekiel 20:19–20); aspect of truth (many times); aspect of light of the eyes. Opposite of accepting bribes = "ki hashochad ye'aver" (Exodus 23:8). Shabbos = holiness of guarding of covenant + nullification of desire for sexual immorality (many times). Through all of this: taste and appearance and fragrance are rectified → return and find the aspect of the true Tzadik = the Gardener who watches over the tikkun of the garden → merits good life = "kulam yisb'u v'yis'angu mituvecha / v'sova'nu mituvecha" (said in Shabbos prayer). Shabbos = speech that has completeness = "v'daber davar" (many times; Zohar). "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas tov lehodos laHashem." When holiness of Shabbos arrives → songs and riddles and praises and melodies are awakened to G-d (Zohar). Israel increases with songs and melodies and praises on Shabbos. "Lehagid baboker chasdecha v'emunascha baleilos" + Targum: "v'kushtach b'leilin." Lovingkindnesses of truth = essential becoming of the time of all the days = from which come all the riddles and songs containing all the wisdoms. "Lehagid davka" = "haggadah" is "milah d'chochmata" (Zohar). Most excellent of the days = Shabbos = "u'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim." "Yamim yotzaru v'lo echad bahem" (Psalms 139:16; Sages: this is the day of Shabbos) = itself = the light of truth (many times). Great lovingkindnesses drawn. Holiness of Shabbos given to Israel through chesed shel emes = "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay v'Shabbas shemah va'ani mevakesh l'tena lah l'Yisrael." Sacred point of all the days (Zohar). Therefore: wondrous songs and praises are awakened = above the aspect of all songs. Aspect of Shir haShirim = for the Melech shehaShalum shelo (= the holy Shabbos; well-known). This song encompasses all the wisdoms = "kulam b'chochmah asisa" (Psalms 104:24). All the days encompassed in holy Shabbos (Zohar) = Shabbos is their fullness = wondrous and very supreme wisdom shines in it = "ki Kodesh hi" (well-known). Shabbos = sanctity of the brain and the lung and the heart (Zohar; Tikunim; many times) = their supreme root = the spring and the heart and the bird that spreads its wings over the heart and shields it (well-known). Shabbos = fullness of sacred throat = alludes to Binah and to Tiferes (Pardes); both encompassed in holiness of Shabbos (many times). Then: all sacred vapors and voices drawn and awakened in fullness = seven voices in "Mizmor l'David" (Psalms 29; said at entry of Shabbos; understood in kavannos). Then: unity between two sacred birds flashes and shines. "Ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu." Shabbos = "the few containing the many" = ultimate end of the category of place entirely = "al yetzei ish mimekomo" (Exodus 16:29; stated regarding Shabbos). Shabbos encompasses in it the entire creation (well-known). Shabbos = mekomo shel Olam (Likutay Tinyana Siman 83 cross-ref.). Through holiness of Shabbos: can come to the holy tree (mentioned within) = which is entirely above place = aspect of what is explained in Zohar: ascent of the souls on holy Shabbos upward and upward entirely. Holiness of Shabbos encompasses all attributes of this tree: three roots = faith / humility / awe; truth = body of the tree; all these attributes encompassed in holiness of Shabbos (many times). Through holiness of Shabbos: essential drawing of the healing for the princess (within) = "Shabbas hu miliz'ok v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" (LM Siman 58 cross-ref.); through teshuvah of Shabbos: healing drawn in physical and spiritual = "rak shivto yitein v'rapa yirapei" (Exodus 21:19); through holiness of Shabbos: Sitra Achra subdued (= source of the arrows cast at the princess). Through holiness of Shabbos: can extract arrows from princess even after they have already reached her = "afilu aved avodah zarah k'dor Enosh mochalin lo" (Sages); "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar" (Isaiah 6:7). Essential fullness of charity = through holiness of Shabbos (many times) = "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi shemesh Tzedakah u'marpe." Essential ordination of Sages (semichas Chachamim) = through holiness of Shabbos = "Moshe samach Yehoshua b'Shabbas davka" = "Shabbas shel diyuzgi" (Sages; many times). All ten kinds of melody (asarah minei niggina) encompassed in holiness of Shabbos = "tov lehodos / alay asor" (many times). The melody is the healing of the princess (within). The healing of the princess = the aspect of the complete redemption that is destined to come speedily in our days = "b'yom chavosh Hashem es shever amo u'machtzo makosam yirpa" (Isaiah 30:26). "Ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu." Midrash Rabbah Beshalach Parashah 25: "ilmalai shamru Yisrael Shabbas echad k'raui miy'yad ben David ba." May it be so — speedily in our days.

segments.he: וכן עיקר שלימות הצדקה הוא ע"י קדושת שבת כנ"ל כ"פ. וזה בחי' וזרחה לכם יראי שמי שמש צדקה ומרפא וכו'. וכן עיקר סמיכת חכמים הוא ע"י קדושת שבת שזה בחי' מה שסמך משה ליהושע בשבת דייקא בבחי' משארז"ל שבת של דיוזגי היתה וכנ"ל כ"פ. כי אז עיקר הופעת אור החכמה בעולם בבחי' כי קדש הוא כידוע. גם בקדושת שבת כלולין כל העשרה מיני נגינה שזה בחי' טוב להודות וכו' עלי עשור וכו' וכנ"ל כ"פ.
segments.en: Simanim 32(b), 40(b), 87(b), 88(b), 93, and 259 continue in the next installment.

segments.he: והנגינה הוא הרפואה של הבת מלכה כמבואר בפנים.
segments.en:
נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

segments.he: וזה ידוע כי הרפואה של הבת מלכה הוא בחי' הגאולה שלימה העתידה לבא במהרה בימינו כ"ש (ישעי' למד) ביום חבוש ה' את שבר עמו ומחץ מכתו ירפא וכיוצא בזה פסוקים רבים. וע"כ ארז"ל אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות מיד נגאלין ובמ"ר בשלח פרשה כה מבואר אלמלי שמרו ישראל שבת אחד כראוי מיד בן דוד בא וכו' אכי"ר במהרה בימינו.
segments.en: Yikara DiShabsa — Final Simanim: 32(b), 40(b), 87(b), 88(b), 93, 259

segments.he: שיחות הר"ן
segments.en:
Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Part Two — Chelek Beis · Final Simanim: 32(b) · 40(b) · 87(b) · 88(b) · 93 · 259

segments.he: סימן לב-צריך לחזק א"ע באמונה
segments.en:
נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

✦ חלק ב · PART TWO — CONCLUSION ✦

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' עולם המחשבה וגם הוא בחי' אמונה כנ"ל כ"פ. וע"כ זוכין אז לאמונה שלימה וישרה במחשבה זכה וטהורה בלי שום חקירות ובלבולים כלל.
segments.en:
Siman 32 [second occurrence] — סימן לב (Part Two)
 Tzarich l'Chazek Atzmo b'Emunah — Shabbos = world of thought = faith — the illumination of the will = above even wisdom — on Shabbos: pure and complete faith free of investigations — the holiness of the sacred union of Shabbos = holy children = completely full in faith — Shabbos letters = boshes — ta'ameha chayyim zachu = the righteous lives by his faith — Isaiah 58

segments.he: ועי"ז זוכין לבחי' הארת הרצון שהוא למעלה אפי' מבחי' חכמה שזה בחי' ועתיקא קדישא גלי רצון דילי' הנאמר לענין קדושת שבת. וע"כ זוכין אז ליכסוף להשי"ת באהבה גדולה וברצון גדול ובהשתוקקות נמרץ מאד מה שהוא למעלה מכל בחי' ידיעה וחכמה וכמובן בפנים. וזה בחי' אז תתענג על ה' על ה' דייקא דא עתיקא קדישא היינו כנ"ל. והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין בחי' עליית המלכות (שהוא בחי' האמונה הק' בשלימות).
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of the world of thought [olam hamachshavah] — and also the aspect of faith [emunah] — as mentioned above many times. And therefore — on Shabbos — one merits complete and upright faith — in pure and clean thought — without any investigations or confusions at all.

segments.he: וזה ג"כ מעלת קדושת הזווג של שבת. כי יש שבאים עליהם מחשבות של בלבולי אמונה ח"ו מחמת שלא נולדו בקדושה כראוי. ויש שבאים לזה מחמת איזה עבירה וחטא ר"ל אבל בשבת ארז"ל כל המשמר את השבת כהלכתו מוחלין לו על כל עוונותיו וממילא נתבטלין גם הבלבולי אמונה שבאים עי"ז. וכן ע"י קדושת המחשבה וקדושת האמונה שזוכין בשבת כ"א לפי בחינתו עי"ז זווגו בקדושה וזוכה להוליד בנים קדושים ובעלי אמונה בשלימות בלי שום חקירות וחכמות זרות ובלי שום בלבולים כלל. וזהבחי' והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך. כי יעקב זכה שתהיה מטתו שלימה ולהוליד בנים שהיו כולם קדושים ובעלי אמונה בשלימות וכשדרז"ל על השבטים שאמרו ליעקב אבינו שמע ישראל וכו' כשם שאין בלבך אלא אחד כך אין בלבנו אלא אחד היינו כנ"ל.
segments.en:
And through this one merits the aspect of the illumination of the will [ha'arat haRatzon] — which is above even the aspect of wisdom. For this is the aspect of: "v'Atika Kadisha gali re'useh dileih" — stated regarding the holiness of Shabbos. And therefore one merits then to long for the Almighty with great love and great will and very intense yearning — which is above all aspects of knowledge and wisdom — as understood within. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — al Hashem davka — da Atika Kadisha" — that is, as mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — (which is the aspect of the sacred faith in fullness).

And this is likewise the excellence of the holiness of the sacred union of Shabbos. For there are those upon whom thoughts of confusion of faith come, heaven forfend — because they were not born in holiness as fitting. And there are those who arrive at this because of some transgression and sin, heaven have mercy. But on Shabbos — our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who guard the Shabbos as its law requires — he is forgiven all his sins. And through this — the confusions of faith that come from this are likewise nullified. And likewise — through the sanctity of thought and the sanctity of faith that each person merits on Shabbos according to his level — through this — his union is in holiness. And one merits to beget holy children — and ones full of faith in fullness — without any investigations or foreign wisdoms — and without any confusions at all. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — for Yaakov merited that his bed should be complete [mitaso sheleimah] — and to beget children who were all holy and fully possessors of faith in fullness — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: regarding the tribes who said to Yaakov our Patriarch: "shema Yisrael" — and so on — "k'shem she'ein b'libbecha ela echad — kach ein b'libbeinu ela echad [just as in your heart there is only One — so too in our heart there is only One]" — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזה שמובא ששבת אותיות בשת כי מחמת שבימי החול יש איזה אחיזה להחקירות והבלבולים הנ"ל שהם ההיפך מקדושת שבת. ע"כ קודם שנכנסין לקדושת שבת צריכין לשוב בתשובה שלימה ולהתבייש בלב נשבר מאד על עוונותיו שגרמו לו את כל הבלבולים הנ"ל או על שנולד בגשמיות כזה וכמבפ"נ. ואז זוכה אח"כ לקבל קדושת שבת בשלימות וזה בחי' טועמיה חיים זכו היינו בחי' וצדיק באמונתו יחי'. כי כשזוכין לאמונה שלימה אז חיים חיים חזקים וטובים מאד כמבפ"נ.
segments.en: And this is what is brought: that "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — for because during the weekdays there is some grip for the investigations and confusions mentioned above — which are the opposite of the holiness of Shabbos — therefore before one enters into the holiness of Shabbos — one must repent in complete repentance — and feel shame with a very broken heart — over one's sins that caused all these confusions — or over the fact that one was born in such a physical manner. And as explained within. And then one merits afterward to receive the holiness of Shabbos in fullness. And this is the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" — that is, the aspect of [Habakkuk 2:4]: "v'tzaddik be'emunaso yichyeh [and the righteous person shall live by his faith]." For when one merits complete faith — then one lives a very strong and very good life — as explained within.

segments.he: סימן מ-בענין ספרי המחקרים וכו'
segments.en:
Siman 40 [second occurrence] — סימן מ (Part Two)
 B'Inyan Sifrei haMechkarim — On Shabbos: the surrounding lights enter — complete faith — the wheel that turns [galgal hachozer] = upper ones below and lower ones below — on Shabbos: the essential revelation of His simple Unity — the extra soul — the ascent of the worlds — Shabbos is juxtaposed to the Mishkan — the image of the Mishkan is like the image of the act of Bereishis

segments.he: בשבת נכנסין אורות המקיפין כמבואר בכתהאריז"ל.
segments.en:
On Shabbos — the surrounding lights [oros hamakifin] enter — as explained in the writings of the holy Ari z"l.

And then one merits complete faith — to know and to believe: that Hashem's word is upright — and all His deeds are in faith — and one may not question Him in any matter. In particular regarding the general matter of the order of the creation — why each person merited his level — that is, the angel is separate and is an angel — and the star and the constellation is at its level. And the lowly person is from among the lowly inhabitants of this world.

segments.he: ואז זוכין לאמונה שלימה לידע ולהאמין כי ישר דבר ה' וכל מעשיהו באמונה ואין להרהר אחריו בשום דבר בפרט בכלל ענין סדר הבריאה מפני מה זכה כ"א למעלתו היינו שהמלאך הוא נבדל ומלאך וכוכב ומזל הוא במעלתו. והאדם השפל הוא מבני עוה"ז השפלים.
segments.en: And in all these there are many levels — and many variations and particulars between one and another. And even within each and every single one — there are many aspects — head and foot — and the like. And all of it is with knowledge and wondrous wisdom — and with straightforwardness and justice and truth and faith — and one may not question this at all. And in truth — the wheel turns in the world [galgal chozer ba'olam] — in the aspect of: upper ones below and lower ones above [elyonim l'mata u'tachtonim l'ma'alah]. And everything turns in a cycle — and is encompassed in the secret of Unity — for there is the root and the beginning of all. And there is the fullness of the ultimate purpose of all.

segments.he: ובכל אלו יש מדריגות רבות ושינויים ופרטים רבים בין זה לזה ואפי' בכל או"א בעצמו יש בחינות רבות ראש ורגל וכדומה והכל בדעת ובחכמה נפלאה ויושר וצדק ואמת ואמונה ואין להרהר בזה כלל. ובאמת גלגל הוא החוזר בעולם. בבחי' עליונים למטה ותחתונים למעלה והכל חוזר חלילה ונכלל בסוד האחדות ששם שורש וראשית הכל ושם הוא שלימות התכלית של הכל.
segments.en: And the essential revelation of His simple Unity, blessed be He, is on the holy Shabbos — as explained in Likutay Tinyana, Siman 2. And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of: the ultimate purpose of the act of heaven and earth. And this is the aspect of: "raza d'Shabbata — ihi Shabbas d'isachada b'raza d'echad — l'mishreh alah raza d'echad." And this is the aspect of the great illumination that descends on Shabbos below — to the lowly inhabitants of this world. And from there — each person receives the aspect of the extra soul of the holy Shabbos. And likewise — on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential ascent of the worlds — that they return and ascend and are encompassed upward — upward — in a very supreme and wondrous holiness. For this is the aspect of: upper ones below and lower ones above — mentioned above. And therefore Shabbos is juxtaposed to the Mishkan. For the essential building of the Holy Temple is the aspect of the wheel that turns — the aspect of upper ones below and lower ones above — mentioned above — as explained within. And therefore the image of the Mishkan [tziurah d'Mishkana] is like the image of the act of Bereishis [tziurah d'uvda d'Bereishis]. For the entire creation of the act of Bereishis is in the aspect of the wheel that turns — mentioned above. And the essential fullness of this aspect is drawn and shines on Shabbos — as mentioned above.

segments.he: ועיקר התגלות אחדותו הפשוט ית' הוא בשבת קודש כמבואר בליקות"נ סי' ב. וע"כ שבת הוא בחי' תכלית מעשה שמים וארץ. וזה בחי' רזא דשבתא איהי שבת דאתאחדת ברזא דאחד למשרי עלה רזא דאחד. וזה בחי' ההארה הגדולה היורדת בשבת למטה לבני עוה"ז השפל ומשם מקבל כל אחד בחי' נפש יתירה של שבת קודש. וכן בשבת קודש אז עיקר עליית העולמות שחוזרין ועולין ונכללין למעלה למעלה בקדושה עליונה ונפלאה מאד שזה בחי' עליונים למטה ותחתונים למעלה הנ"ל. וע"כ נסמך שבת אצל המקדש. כי עיקר בנין ביהמ"ק הוא בחי' גלגל החוזר בחי' עליונים למטה ותחתונים למעלה הנ"ל כמבפ"נ. וע"כ ציורא דמשכנא הוא כציורא דעובדא דבראשית. כי כל הבריאה של כל מעשב"ר הוא בבחי' גלגל החוזר הנ"ל. ועיקר שלימות בחי' זו נמשך ומאיר בשבת כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 87 [second occurrence] — סימן פז (Part Two)
 Lefi Bechinas haYamim Nora'im — Sages: "blessed with the light of a person's face" — on Shabbos: merit great mental faculties — chochmas Adam ta'ir panav — chalitzas atzamos — the extra soul = the mochin — tikkun of the bones — the three Shabbosim and the three mochin — Shabbos = love — ki na'ar Yisrael va'ahaveihu — the will = temimei darech — "Shabbas" with vowel points = temimei darech — lekach Yehoshua — the seven complete weeks — Isaiah 58

Our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding Shabbos: one is blessed with the light of a person's face [me'or panav shel Adam] — and so on. For on Shabbos one merits great mental faculties — as mentioned above many times. And this is the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 8:1]: "chochmas Adam ta'ir panav [a person's wisdom illuminates his face]." And then one also merits the liberation of the bones [chalitzas atzamos] — in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:11]: "v'atzmosecha yechalitz" — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught — for the name of which one says: "retzei v'hachalitzeinu" on Shabbos. For on Shabbos one merits to receive the extra soul [neshamah yeseirah] — which is itself the aspect of the aforementioned mental faculties — in the aspect of [Job 32:8]: "v'nishmas Shadai tevinam" — and as mentioned above many times. And the tikkun of the soul [nefesh] is the aspect of the tikkun of the bones — in the aspect of [Job 33:19]: "u'moach atzmosav yeshukah" — and as explained in Likutay Moharan — in the teaching "Vayiven es haTzela" — Siman 67. And the essential fullness of the sanctity of the mental faculties of Shabbos is in the aspect of what is explained within — that is, that one draws the illumination of the mental faculties from the head [moach shebaRosh] to the mental faculties of the extremities [moach shebaVa'u Katzavos]. And from there the illumination of the mental faculties flows to the aspect of Malchus. And this is the aspect of the three Shabbosim — explained in Zohar Yisro, folio 92 [Tzaddi-Beis]: the upper Shabbos [Shabbas ila'ah] — and the Shabbos of day [Shabbas d'yoma] — and the Shabbos of night [Shabbas d'leila]. The upper Shabbos is the aspect of the mental faculties in the head. And the Shabbos of day is the aspect of the mental faculties in the extremities. And the Shabbos of night is the aspect of the mental faculties in Malchus. And therefore Shabbos is called: "menuchas ahavah v'nedavah [the rest of love and freewill]." And likewise: "v'Shabbas Kodshecha b'ahavah u'v'ratzon hinchaltanu." For this is the aspect of [Hosea 11:1]: "ki na'ar Yisrael va'ahaveihu [for Israel is a youth — and I love him]" — as explained within. That is — for Israel has the letters of: "li Rosh [to Me — head]" — the aspect of the supreme complete mental faculties — as is well-known. And one who merits to receive the sacred mental faculties in fullness — and nonetheless sets aside his wisdom and his knowledge — and draws the essential illumination of his mental faculties into the aspect of the Va'u Katzavos — which are the totality of the good attributes — as is well-known — that is, he draws the essential illumination of his mental faculties into wholeness and simplicity — to serve the Almighty in gradation and in measure — and to perform good deeds and good attributes. Through which it is evident that he accepts upon himself the yoke of His Kingship, blessed be He. And as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 49. And this is the aspect of: from there — he draws the illumination of the mental faculties toward Malchus — as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן פז-לפי בחי' הימים נוראים
segments.en: And also — Malchus is the aspect of faith — as is well-known. That is, he draws the essential illumination of the sacred mental faculties into the aspect of the sacred faith — in the aspect of [I Chronicles 28:9]: "da es Elokei avicha v'avdeihu" — and so on — which is the essential perfection — as explained elsewhere. Through this — the Almighty loves him greatly — in the aspect of: "ki na'ar Yisrael va'ahaveihu." That is, even though he is in the aspect of "Yisrael" — and attains great mental faculties — nonetheless — he is still in the aspect of a youth [na'ar] — and serves G-d in wholeness and simplicity and complete faith — as mentioned above. And therefore: and He loves him.
