segments.he: ארז"ל לענין שבת ברכו באור פניו של אדם וכו' כי בשבת זוכין למוחין גדולים כנ"ל כ"פ. וזה בחי' חכמת אדם תאיר פניו ואז זוכין גם לחילוץ עצמות בחי' ועצמותיך יחליץ וכשדרז"ל שעל שם זה אומרים רצה והחליצנו בשבת כי בשבת זוכין לקבל נפש יתרה שזה בעצמו בחי' המוחין הנ"ל בחי' ונשמת שדי תבינם וכנ"ל כ"פ. ותיקון הנפש הוא בחי' תיקון העצמות בחי' ומוח עצמותיו ישוקה וכמבואר בליקו"א במאמר ויבן את הצלע סי' סז. ועיקר שלימות קדושת המוחין של שבת הוא בבחי' המבפ"נ היינו שממשיכין הארת המוחין שבראש אל המוח שבעצמות שזה בחי' המוחין שבואו קצוות. ומשם נמשך הארת המוחין אל בחי' המלכות וזה בחי' הג' שבתות המבואר בזוהר יתרו ד' צב. שבת עילאה ושבת דיומא ושבת דלילא שבת עילאה הוא בחי' המוחין שבראש. ושבת דיומא הוא בחי' המוחין שבואו קצוות. ושבת דלילא הוא בחי' המוחין שבמלכות. וע"כ נקרא שבת מנוחת אהבה ונדבה. וכן ושבת קדשך באהבה וברצון הנחלתנו כי זה בחי' כי נער ישראל ואהבהו המבפ"נ. היינו כי ישראל אותיות לי ראש בחי' המוחין העליונים השלימים כידוע. ומי שזוכה לקבל המוחין הק' בשלימות ואעפי"כ הוא מסלק את חכמתו ודעתו וממשיך עיקר הארת המוחין שלו לתוך בחי' הואו קצוות שהם כלל המדות טובות כידוע היינו שממשיך עיקר הארת המוחין שלו לתוך תמימות ופשיטות לעבוד את השי"ת בהדרגה ובמדה ולעשות פעולות ומדות טובות שעי"ז ניכר שהוא מקבל עליו עול מלכותו ית' וכמבואר בליקו"א סי' מט וזה בחי' שמשם ממשיך הארת המוחין אל המלכות היינו כנ"ל.
segments.en:
And this is the aspect of the illumination of the sacred will that shines on Shabbos — as mentioned above many times. For this is the aspect of [Proverbs 11:20]: "v'retzono temimei darech" — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who walk before the Holy One, blessed be He, in wholeness [temimut] — (that is, in the aspect of "ki na'ar Yisrael" — mentioned above) — it is as if he fulfilled all His will — as it is stated: "v'retzono temimei darech." And also — for through complete faith in wholeness and simplicity — one merits to receive such a high illumination of the will — which is above, as it were, all the aspects of the sacred wisdoms and knowledge — as mentioned above in Siman 32. And this is what is brought in Pri Etz Chayyim: that "Shabbas" with the vowel points — which are patach and kamatz — has the gematria of: "temimei darech" — as mentioned above. For on Shabbos one merits to receive sacred mental faculties — and to draw them into the aspect of wholeness — for this is the aspect of: "v'retzono temimei darech" — as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — that is, the aspect of the sacred mental faculties and the illumination of the supreme will — mentioned above.

segments.he: גם המלכות הוא בחי' אמונה כידוע היינו שממשיך עיקר הארת המוחין הק' לתוך בחי' האמונה הק' בבחי' דע את אלקי אביך ועבדיהו וכו' שזה עיקר השלימות כמבואר במ"א עי"ז השי"ת אוהבו מאד בבחי' כי נער ישראל. היינו שאעפ"י שהוא בבחי' ישראל ומשיג מוחין גדולים אעפי"כ הוא עדיין בבחי' נער ועובד את ה' בתמימות ובפשיטות ובאמונה שלימה כנ"ל עי"ז ואוהבו.
segments.en: And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — that is, the ascent of Malchus — mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — the aspect of the mental faculties of the extremities — mentioned above. And also — regarding Yaakov it is stated [Genesis 25:27]: "v'Yaakov ish tam" — the aspect of the aforementioned wholeness. And this is the aspect of [Psalms 37:18]: "yodea Hashem yemei temimim — v'nachalasam l'olam tihyeh [Hashem knows the days of the wholehearted — and their inheritance shall be forever]" — that is, the aspect of the heritage of Yaakov — mentioned above. And therefore — when Israel went out of Egypt and merited to receive great mental faculties — which is the aspect of the illumination of the mental faculties of Shabbos — and therefore also Passover is called "Shabbas" — as it is written [Leviticus 23:15]: "mimacharat haShabbas" — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And afterward — the mental faculties departed — because they did not merit to receive them through [their own] awakening from below [is'arusa d'letata] — as is well-known. But nonetheless — a great residual impression [reshimah] remained from the illumination of the sacred mental faculties. And then they counted afterward seven weeks [sheva shabbosos] — and so on. That is, they engaged in this — to draw the illumination of the mental faculties toward the aspect of the Va'u Katzavos — and toward the aspect of Malchus — that is, to draw the illumination of the mental faculties into the aspect of the sacred wholeness — mentioned above. And this [Leviticus 23:15]: "u'sfartem lachem mimacharat haShabbas" — and so on — [Leviticus 23:15]: "sheva Shabbasos temimos tihyena — Shabbasos temimos davka" — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזה בחי' הארת הרצון הק' שמאיר בשבת כנ"ל כ"פ כי זה בחי' ורצונו תמימי דרך (משלי יא) וכשדרז"ל על זה כל מי שהולך בתמימות לפני הקב"ה (היינו בבחי' כי נער ישראל הנ"ל) כאלו עשה כל רצונו שנאמר ורצונו תמימי דרך. גם כי ע"י אמונה שלימה בתמימות ובפשיטות זוכין לקבל הארת הרצון גבוה כזה מה שהוא למעלה כביכול מכל בחי' החכמות והידיעות הק' כנ"ל בסי' לב. וזה שמובא בפרי עץ חיים ששבת עם הנקודות שהן פתח קמץ גימטריא תמימי דרך היינו כנ"ל. כי בשבת זוכין לקבל מוחין קדושים ולהמשיכן לתוך בחי' תמימות שזה בחי' ורצונו תמימי דרך כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 88 [second occurrence] — סימן פח (Part Two)
 Hafikas haShulchan — Shabbos = sacred speech — from speech: eating and livelihood — on Shabbos: the table set — the showbread — lechem mishneh = the complete speech = double mouth

segments.he: וזה בחי' אז תתענג על ה' דא עתיקא קדישא. היינו בחי' המוחין הק' והארת הרצון העליון הנ"ל.
segments.en:
It is explained above many times in the name of the holy Zohar: the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred speech [dibbur d'Kedushah] — the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos.

And since from there comes the essential eating and livelihood — as explained within — therefore it is a commandment to set the table and to eat on Shabbos. And from it [Zohar]: "mineih mis'barchin kol shita yomin [from it are blessed all six days]" — as explained in the holy Zohar. And therefore — they would set the showbread [lechem haPanim] on the table then. For then — the table and the eating are in the aspect of: face [panim] — in the aspect of [Ezekiel 41:22]: "zeh haShulchan asher lifney Hashem — davka [this is the table that is before Hashem — specifically]" — the aspect of face — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the double bread [lechem mishneh] of Shabbos — for the complete speech [dibbur shalem] is the aspect of: "pi shenayim [double mouth]" — as explained elsewhere.

segments.he: והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין היינו בחי' עליית המלכות הנ"ל. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א בחי' המוחין שבואו קצוות הנ"ל גם אצל יעקב נאמר ויעקב איש תם בחי' תמימות הנ"ל. וזה בחי' יודע ה' ימי תמימים ונחלתם לעולם תהיה היינו בחי' נחלת יעקב הנ"ל. וע"כ כשיצאו ישראל ממצרים וזכו לקבל מוחין גדולים שזה בחי' הארת המוחין של שבת. וע"כ גם פסח נקרא שבת כ"ש ממחרת השבת וכשדרז"ל. ואח"כ נסתלקו המוחין מחמת שלא זכו לקבל אותם ע"י אתעדל"ת כידוע. אך אעפי"כ נשאר רשימה גדולה מהארת המוחין הק' ואז ספרו אח"כ שבע שבתות וכו' היינו שעסקו בזה להמשיך הארת המוחין אל בחי' הואו קצוות ואל בחי' המלכות היינו להמשיך הארת המוחין אל בחי' התמימות דקדושה הנ"ל. וזה וספרתם לכם ממחרת השבת וכו' שבע שבתות תמימות תהינה שבתות תמימות דייקא כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 93 — סימן צג (Part Two)
 Da sheYesh Or — Shabbos = the sanctity of the light that shines in one thousand worlds — "ha'Alef lecha Shlomoh" — "u'masa'ayim l'notrim es piryo" — the Sages who are nokem v'noter — "es Shabsosai tishm'ru" = dividing the thousands into hundreds — the preservation of life overrides Shabbos — from it comes the resurrection of the dead — "Yaakov Avinu lo mes" — Adam the first man was saved from death through Shabbos — Isaiah 58

segments.he: סימן פח-הפיכת השולחן
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of the sanctity of the light that shines in one thousand worlds — as understood in Pri Etz Chayyim, the gate of Shabbos, chapter 8. Where it is written there: after one elevates the world of Beriah into Atzilus — in [the prayer]: "tov lehodos" — one should have in mind to receive bounty and holiness from one thousand worlds — and so on. And through this one will merit the addition of nefesh — ru'ach — neshamah on Shabbos — and so on. And see there as well — regarding the secret of the one thousand portions of light that are restored to Moshe — in the secret of the addition of Shabbos — and so on. And through the guarding of the holy Shabbos — all of Israel merit to receive from this light — through the holy Tzadikim — who know how to divide the thousands into hundreds [l'chalek ha'alafim l'me'os]. And this [Song of Songs 8:12]: "ha'Alef lecha Shlomoh" — Shabbos is the aspect of Shlomoh [Shelomoh] — the aspect of the king upon whom peace depends [Melech shehaShalum shelo]. And it is the secret of the light that shines in the one thousand worlds — as mentioned above. And this [Song of Songs 8:12]: "u'masa'ayim l'notrim es piryo [and two hundred for those who guard its fruit]" — that is, the guardians of Shabbos merit to receive from this light — through the fact that it is divided into hundreds — as mentioned above. And since — regarding the secret of this tikkun mentioned above — that is, to divide the thousands into hundreds — one needs the Torah scholars who are vengeful and bearing grudge [nokem v'noter] — and so on — as brought within. Therefore — this aspect is also found in the holiness of Shabbos itself. And this is what is written [Exodus 31:13]: "ach es Shabsosai tishm'ru" — and its Targum: "bes yomei Shabbaya deili tetrun" — and so on — "ki os hu" — and so on — "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem." For through this one merits to receive from the secret of the aforementioned light — where is the essential fullness of the mental faculties and Da'as — which is the aspect of "Kodesh" — as is well-known. And therefore — the commandment here regarding the guarding of Shabbos is expressed in the plural: "es Shabsosai [My Shabbosim]." For the essential attainment is through the dividing of the light — as mentioned above.

segments.he: מבואר לעיל כ"פ בשם הזוה"ק ששבת קודש הוא בחי' הדיבור דקדושה בחי' ודבר דבר הנאמר בשבת.
segments.en:
And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded [Tractate Yoma 85]: "es Shabsosai tishmoru — yachol l'chol — talmud lomar ach — chalak." — "chalak" — specifically — for one must divide the light into hundreds — as mentioned above. And therefore they learned from this: that the preservation of life overrides Shabbos.

For through the dividing of the thousands into hundreds — through this comes the resurrection of the dead [techias haMeisim] and the saving of souls from death, heaven have mercy — as explained within. And this [Exodus 31:16]: "v'shamru Bnay Yisrael es haShabbas" — and its Targum: "v'yitrun — v'yitrun davka" — the aspect of the aforementioned "nokem v'noter." And this [Exodus 31:14]: "ki Kodesh hi lachem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded from this as well: that the preservation of life overrides Shabbos — as it is stated: "ki Kodesh hi lachem — hi mesurah b'yadchem" — and so on. That is — for through the holiness of Shabbos — one merits to receive from the aforementioned light — through the dividing of the thousands into hundreds — which is the secret of the resurrection of the dead. And therefore — it is impossible not to save a soul of Israel physically — because of the holiness of Shabbos. Rather — on the contrary — the preservation of life overrides Shabbos. And this is what they expounded as well [Leviticus 18:5]: "v'chai bahem — v'lo sheyamus bahem" — as mentioned above. And this [Exodus 31:14]: "mechaleleha mos yumas — ki kol ha'oseh vah melachah v'nichresah" — and so on. And this is through the aspect of the sacred "nokem v'noter" that is in the holiness of Shabbos — through which the thousands are divided into hundreds — and the aspect of the resurrection of the dead is drawn. For this is the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu." But when Shabbos is desecrated, heaven forfend — then on the contrary — the light of the thousands departs — and death results, heaven have mercy — as understood within.

segments.he: ומחמת שמשם עיקר האכילה והפרנסה כמבפ"נ ע"כ מצוה לסדר השולחן ולאכול בשבת. ומניה מתברכין כל שתא יומין כמבואר בזוה"ק. וע"כ מסדרין אז הלחם הפנים על השולחן. כי אז השולחן והאכילה בבחי' פנים בחי' זה השולחן אשר לפני ה' דייקא בחי' פנים כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' הלחם משנה של שבת כי הדיבור השלם הוא בחי' פי שנים כמבואר במ"א.
segments.en: And therefore — it is a very great matter to come to Tzadikim on Shabbos. For then one can even more to receive and benefit from the light of their Torah — through the fact that they draw then even more the sanctity of the aforementioned light — and divide it into hundreds — so that the students can benefit from his study and receive from him. For this is the aspect of: "sof shetehene mitalmudo [ultimately you benefit from his study]" — as explained within. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — that is, one will merit to attain the aforementioned supreme light — which is the aspect of "al Hashem" — as is well-known. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — this is the aspect of the sacred "nokem v'noter" — the aspect of [Deuteronomy 33:29]: "v'yichachash oyvecha lach — v'atah al bamosemo tidroch" — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded in the holy Zohar: this verse — regarding the ascent of Malchus — which is the aspect of the avenging sword — the aspect of [Leviticus 26:25]: "v'eretz mitkomemes lo" — the aspect of the sacred "nokem v'noter" — mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the middle bolt [bri'ach hatichon] — that passes from end to end. For it receives and draws from the aforementioned supreme light — all the way to the aspect of Malchus. And through this it illuminates all the levels — from the illumination of the aforementioned sacred supreme light — through the dividing of the thousands into hundreds. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: do not read "mah" but rather "me'ah [a hundred]." And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: "Yaakov Avinu lo mes" — for through this the dead are revived. And from the letters of "maves [death]" come the letters: "me'os [hundreds]" — as explained within. And this is the aspect of [Micah 7:20]: "titen emes l'Yaakov." For from the letters of "maves" come the letters: "v'emes" — as brought. And "emes" is the sign of life — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And as it is written [Joshua 2:12]: "u'nesatem li os emes — v'hecheyisem" — and so on. And this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of truth — as mentioned above many times. And it is called many times: "os" [a sign] — for [Exodus 31:13]: "os hi beini u'veineichem" — and so on. And this is the aspect of: the sign of truth — which is the sign of life — the aspect of the resurrection of the dead — the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" — mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן צג-דע שיש אור
segments.en: And therefore — also Adam the first man was saved from death through the fact that the holiness of Shabbos shielded over him — as our Sages of blessed memory taught — as mentioned above. For through the holiness of Shabbos — the sacred light mentioned above was drawn upon him. And therefore he merited to live afterward one thousand years — (together with the seventy years that he gave from his years to David — as our Sages of blessed memory taught) — for upon him was drawn the light of the aspect of the one thousand — mentioned above.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחי' קדושת האור שמאיר באלף עולמות כמובן בפרי עץ חיים שער השבת פרק חית שכתב שם ואחר שהעלה בריאה באצילות בטוב להודות יכוון לקבל שפע וקדושה מאלף עולמות וכו' ועי"ז יזכה לתוספת נר"נ בשבת וכו'. ועיי"ש ג"כ מסוד האלף חלקים של אור שמחזירין למשה בסוד תוספת שבת וכו' וע"י שמירת שבת קודש זוכין כל ישראל לקבל מאור הזה ע"י הצדיקים הק' שיודעים לחלק האלפים למאות. וזה האלף לך שלמה שבת הוא בחי' שלמה בחי' מלך שהשלום שלו. והוא סוד האור שמאיר באלף עולמות כנ"ל. וזה ומאתים לנוטרים את פריו היינו ששומרי שבת זוכין לקבל מהאור הזה ע"י שמחלקין אותו למאות כנ"ל. ומחמת שלענין סוד תיקון זה הנ"ל היינו לחלק האלפים למאות צריכין להיות ת"ח נוקם ונוטר וכו' כמובא בפנים. ע"כ נמצא בקדושת שבת בעצמה ג"כ בחי' זו. וזה שכתוב אך את שבתותי תשמרו (ותרגומו ית יומי שבייא דילי תטרון וכו') כי אות הוא וכו' לדעת כי אני ה' מקדשכם. כי עי"ז זוכין לקבל מסוד האור הנ"ל ששם עיקר שלימות המוחין והדעת שהוא בחי' קדש כידוע. וע"כ צוה כאן על שמירת שבת בלשון רבים את שבתותי. כי עיקר ההשגה הוא ע"י שמחלקין האור כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 259 — סימן רנט (Part Two)
 Vayeshev Yaakov — Shabbos = the three colors of the eye [tlas guvnin d'eina] — through this: sees one's lowliness — saved from pride — all the denials are nullified — merits complete faith — all the judgments are sweetened — the deficiency of the moon is filled — the Name Havayah and the Name Elokim are united — the sanctification of the moon at the going out of Shabbos — the blessing of the new month on Shabbos — "raza d'Shabbata ihi Shabbas d'isachada b'raza d'echad" — the calling of the Name Havayah as it is written — Isaiah 58

It is explained within that Shabbos is the aspect of: "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" — and through this — one merits to see one's own lowliness — and is saved from pride. And all the denials are nullified — and one merits complete faith. And through this — all the judgments are sweetened — and the deficiency of the moon is filled — and the Name Havayah is united with the Name Elokim. And the illumination of the Name Havayah is drawn upon Israel — and all the blessings and all the influences [hashpa'os] are drawn to Israel. And one merits to the aspect of the calling of the Name Havayah as it is written [kikesivah] — for this is the aspect of [Zechariah 14:9]: "b'yom hahu yihyeh Hashem echad u'shmo echad" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is why they are careful to sanctify the moon at the going out of Shabbos [kiddush levonah b'motza'ei Shabbas]. For through the holiness of Shabbos — the deficiency of the moon is filled. And this is why the blessing of the new month [birchas haChodesh] is pronounced on the holy Shabbos. And this is what is explained in the holy Zohar: "v'ha okimnah raza d'Hashem echad u'shmo echad — raza d'Shabbata — ihi Shabbas d'isachada b'raza d'echad" — and so on. For Shabbos is the foretaste of the World to Come — when then the aspect of: "Hashem echad u'shmo echad" — mentioned above — will be in fullness.

segments.he: וזה שדרז"ל (יומא פה) את שבתותי תשמרו יכול לכל ת"ל אך חלק. חלק דייקא כי צריכין לחלק האור למאות כנ"ל וע"כ למדו מזה שפיקוח נפש דוחה שבת.
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — that is, through the holiness of Shabbos — one will merit to nullify the pride — in the aspect of [Psalms 36:12]: "al tevo'uni regel ga'avah [let not the foot of pride come upon me]." And through this — one merits complete faith — which is the aspect of [Psalms 26:12]: "ragli amda b'mishor [my foot stands on level ground]" — as explained within. And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" — for when one merits to elevate and rectify the sacred faith — which is the aspect of: "ad shetechleh regel min hashuk [until the foot ceases from the marketplace]." That is, one clarifies and elevates the faith — which is the aspect of: the foot from the marketplace [regel min hashuk] — which is the outer places — the aspect of the denials [kefirot] — as explained within. Through this — the foot literally ceases from the marketplace — for one does not need to go out to the marketplace for labor and commerce. For through faith — all the blessings and all the influences are drawn. And then one does not need any labor or business for livelihood. For this is the aspect of what on Shabbos all the labors are forbidden. And this is the aspect of: "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" — and so on. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: they give him all the desires of his heart — as it is stated [Psalms 37:3–4]: "shechen eretz u're'eh emunah — v'his'anag al Hashem — v'yiten l'cha mishalos libecha." For the sacred faith is the source of all the blessings and all the influences — as mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — that is, one merits to nullify pride completely — and to nullify all the denials and idolatry — and the blemish of faith — from which is the essential grip of the Malchus d'Sitra Achra — and as explained elsewhere. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded from this: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — that is, the complete unity between the Name Havayah and the Name Elokim is made. For this is the aspect of the heritage of Yaakov — who said [Genesis 28:21]: "v'hayah Hashem li l'Elokim" — and these two Names are the aspect of the sun and the moon. And this is likewise the aspect of Yaakov — as it is stated [Genesis 32:32]: "vayizrach lo hashemesh" — and he specifically counts according to the moon — as it is written [Exodus 12:2]: "hachodesh hazeh lachem" — and our Sages of blessed memory taught: the small one [katan] counts according to the small luminary — and so on. And also — the heritage of Yaakov is the aspect of the sacred Name Havayah — which is called only upon us — the holy people — the children of Yaakov. As explained in the holy Zohar. And Yaakov himself corresponds to the aspect of the sacred Name Havayah. For the holy Patriarchs — who are Avraham — Yitzchak — Yaakov — correspond to the aspect of the three sacred Names — which are: "El — Elokim — Hashem" — as is well-known. And also — the essential heritage of Yaakov is the World to Come — when then the sacred Name Havayah will be called as it is written — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for the speech [dibbur] — which is the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of "Elokim" — as it is written [Psalms 108:8]: "Elokim diber b'kodsho" — (and as explained elsewhere) — is united with the sacred Name Havayah, blessed be He — as mentioned above.

segments.he: כי ע"י שמחלקין האלפים למאות עי"ז נעשה בחי' תחיית המתים והצלת נפשות ממות ר"ל כמבפ"נ. וזה ושמרתם את השבת (ותרגומו ותטרון ית שבתא ותטרון דייקא בחי' נוקם ונוטר הנ"ל) וזה כי קדש היא לכם ודרז"ל מזה ג"כ שפיקוח נפש דוחה שבת שנאמר כי קדש היא לכם היא מסורה בידכם וכו' היינו כי ע"י קדושת שבת זוכין לקבל מן האור הנ"ל ע"י שמחלקין האלפים למאות שזה סוד תחיית המתים וע"כ א"א שלא להציל נפש מישראל ממש מחמת קדושת שבת רק אדרבא פיקוח נפש דוחה שבת. וזה שדרשו ג"כ וחי בהם ולא שימות בהם היינו כנ"ל. וזה מחלליה מות יומת כי כל העושה בה מלאכה ונכרתה וכו' וזה ע"י בחי' נוקם ונוטר דקדושה שיש בקדושת שבת שעי"ז מחלקין האלפים למאות וממשיכין בחי' תחיית המתים שזה בחי' טועמיה חיים זכו. אבל כשמחללין שבת ח"ו אזי אדרבא נסתלק אור האלפים ונעשה מות ר"ל כמובן בפנים.
segments.en:
✦ Translator's Summary — Final Simanim: 32(b), 40(b), 87(b), 88(b), 93, 259
 
 Siman 32(b) — Tzarich l'Chazek Atzmo b'Emunah — Shabbos = world of thought = faith / illumination of the will / complete faith free of investigations / sacred union = holy children full of faith / "Shabbas" letters = "boshes" / ta'ameha chayyim zachu = righteous lives by his faith: Shabbos = world of thought (olam hamachshavah) + aspect of faith (emunah; many times). On Shabbos: complete and upright faith in pure clean thought without any investigations or confusions at all. Through this: merits the illumination of the will (ha'arat haRatzon) = above even the aspect of wisdom = "v'Atika Kadisha gali re'useh dileih" (stated regarding Shabbos). Therefore: merits to long for G-d with great love and great will and very intense yearning — above all aspects of knowledge and wisdom (within). Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag al Hashem al Hashem davka = da Atika Kadisha"; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus = sacred faith in fullness. Excellence of holiness of sacred union of Shabbos = there are those upon whom thoughts of confusion of faith come heaven forfend (because not born in holiness as fitting, or because of some transgression); on Shabbos: "kol hamishmor es haShabbas k'hilchaso mochlin lo al kol avonosav" → confusions of faith that come from this are likewise nullified. Through sanctity of thought and faith on Shabbos according to one's level → union is in holiness → merits to beget holy children = ones full of faith in fullness without any investigations or foreign wisdoms or confusions. "V'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" = Yaakov merited "mitaso sheleimah" = begat children all holy and fully in faith = Sages: tribes said to Yaakov "shema Yisrael / k'shem she'ein b'libbecha ela echad kach ein b'libbeinu ela echad." "Shabbas" has same letters as "boshes" = during weekdays there is some grip for investigations and confusions (= opposite of holiness of Shabbos) → before entering holiness of Shabbos: must repent in complete repentance + feel shame with a very broken heart (over one's sins or over one's physical birth; within). Then: merits to receive holiness of Shabbos in fullness = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" = "v'tzaddik be'emunaso yichyeh" (Habakkuk 2:4) = when merits complete faith: lives a very strong and very good life (within).

segments.he: וע"כ דבר גדול מאד לבא לצדיקים על שבת. כי אז יכולין ביותר לקבל וליהנות מאור תורתם ע"י שממשיכין אז ביותר קדושת האור הנ"ל ומחלקין אותו למאות בכדי שיוכלו התלמידים ליהנות מתלמודו ולקבל ממנו שזה בחי' סוף שתהנה מתלמודו כמבפ"נ. וה אז תתענג על ה' היינו שיזכה להשיג האור העליון הנ"ל שהוא בחי' על ה' כידוע והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ זה בחי' הנוקם ונוטר דקדושה בחי' ויכחשו אויבך לך ואתה על במותימו תדרוך וכשדרז"ל. וזשדרז"ל בזוה"ק פסוק זה על בחי' עליית המלכות שהוא בחי' חרב נוקמת בחי' וארץ מתקוממה לו בחי' דנוקם ונוטר הנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 40(b) — B'Inyan Sifrei haMechkarim — On Shabbos: surrounding lights enter / complete faith / the wheel that turns = upper ones below and lower ones above / essential revelation of His simple Unity / the extra soul / ascent of the worlds / Shabbos juxtaposed to the Mishkan: On Shabbos: oros hamakifin enter (writings of Ari z"l). Through this: complete faith = "ki yashar devar Hashem v'chol ma'asehu b'emunah" = may not question Him in any matter. In particular: why each person merited his level = the angel is separate and is an angel; the star and the constellation is at its level; the lowly person is from the lowly inhabitants of this world. In all these: many levels / variations / particulars. Even within each single one: many aspects (head and foot). All of it with knowledge and wondrous wisdom and straightforwardness and justice and truth and faith — one may not question this at all. In truth: "galgal chozer ba'olam" = "elyonim l'mata u'tachtonim l'ma'alah." Everything turns in a cycle and is encompassed in the secret of Unity = root and beginning of all = fullness of ultimate purpose of all. Essential revelation of His simple Unity on holy Shabbos (Likutay Tinyana Siman 2 cross-ref.). Therefore Shabbos = ultimate purpose of act of heaven and earth. "Raza d'Shabbata ihi Shabbas d'isachada b'raza d'echad l'mishreh alah raza d'echad." Great illumination descends on Shabbos below to the lowly inhabitants of this world → each person receives the extra soul of the holy Shabbos. On Shabbos: essential ascent of the worlds = return and ascend and are encompassed upward and upward in very supreme and wondrous holiness = "elyonim l'mata u'tachtonim l'ma'alah" (above). Therefore Shabbos juxtaposed to the Mishkan = essential building of Holy Temple = aspect of galgal hachozer = "elyonim l'mata u'tachtonim l'ma'alah" (within). Therefore "tziurah d'Mishkana k'tziurah d'uvda d'Bereishis" = entire creation of act of Bereishis in the aspect of the galgal hachozer (above). Essential fullness of this aspect drawn and shines on Shabbos (above).

 Siman 87(b) — Lefi Bechinas haYamim Nora'im — "Blessed with the light of a person's face" / chalitzas atzamos / extra soul = the mochin / tikkun of the bones / three Shabbosim = three mochin / Shabbos = love / ki na'ar Yisrael va'ahaveihu / will = temimei darech / "Shabbas" with vowel points = temimei darech / seven complete weeks / Isaiah 58: Sages (regarding Shabbos): "berchu b'me'or panav shel Adam" = on Shabbos: merits great mochin (many times) = "chochmas Adam ta'ir panav" (Ecclesiastes 8:1). Then also: chalitzas atzamos = "v'atzmosecha yechalitz" (Isaiah 58:11; Sages) → therefore says "retzei v'hachalitzeinu" on Shabbos. On Shabbos: merits extra soul (neshamah yeseirah) = itself the aspect of the aforementioned mochin = "v'nishmas Shadai tevinam" (Job 32:8; many times). Tikkun of the soul (nefesh) = tikkun of the bones = "u'moach atzmosav yeshukah" (Job 33:19; Likutay Moharan Siman 67 cross-ref.: "Vayiven es haTzela"). Essential fullness of sanctity of mochin of Shabbos = draws illumination of mochin from moach shebaRosh to moach shebaVa'u Katzavos → from there: illumination of mochin flows to Malchus. Three Shabbosim of Zohar Yisro folio 92: Shabbas ila'ah = moach shebaRosh; Shabbas d'yoma = moach shebaVa'u Katzavos; Shabbas d'leila = moach shebaMalchus. Therefore Shabbos called "menuchas ahavah v'nedavah" + "v'Shabbas Kodshecha b'ahavah u'v'ratzon hinchaltanu." Aspect of "ki na'ar Yisrael va'ahaveihu" (Hosea 11:1; within). "Yisrael" = letters "li Rosh" = supreme complete mochin (well-known). One who merits to receive sacred mochin in fullness + nonetheless sets aside his wisdom and knowledge + draws essential illumination of his mochin into aspect of Va'u Katzavos (= totality of good attributes; well-known) = draws illumination of mochin into wholeness and simplicity = serves G-d in gradation and in measure and in good deeds and attributes → evident that he accepts upon himself the yoke of His Kingship (Likutay Moharan Siman 49 cross-ref.) → from there: draws illumination of mochin toward Malchus (above). Also: Malchus = aspect of faith (well-known) = draws essential illumination of sacred mochin into sacred faith = "da es Elokei avicha v'avdeihu" (I Chronicles 28:9; elsewhere) = G-d loves him greatly = "ki na'ar Yisrael va'ahaveihu." Even though he is in the aspect of "Yisrael" (= attains great mochin) → nonetheless still in aspect of "na'ar" → serves G-d in wholeness and simplicity and complete faith (above) → therefore: "va'ahaveihu." Aspect of illumination of sacred will that shines on Shabbos (many times) = "v'retzono temimei darech" (Proverbs 11:20) + Sages: all who walk before G-d in temimut (= "ki na'ar Yisrael") = as if fulfilled all His will = "v'retzono temimei darech." Also: through complete faith in wholeness and simplicity → merits such a high illumination of the will = above all the aspects of sacred wisdoms and knowledge (Siman 32 cross-ref.). Pri Etz Chayyim: "Shabbas" with vowel points (patach and kamatz) = gematria of "temimei darech" (above) = on Shabbos: merits sacred mochin + to draw them into aspect of wholeness = "v'retzono temimei darech" (above). Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = sacred mochin and illumination of supreme will; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus (above); "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = mochin shebaVa'u Katzavos (above); also regarding Yaakov: "v'Yaakov ish tam" (Genesis 25:27) = aspect of the aforementioned wholeness; "yodea Hashem yemei temimim v'nachalasam l'olam tihyeh" (Psalms 37:18) = aspect of heritage of Yaakov (above). When Israel went out of Egypt: merited to receive great mochin (= illumination of mochin of Shabbos) → therefore also Passover called "Shabbas" = "mimacharat haShabbas" (Leviticus 23:15; Sages). Afterward: mochin departed because they did not merit to receive them through is'arusa d'letata (well-known). But nonetheless: great reshimah remained from illumination of sacred mochin. Then: counted seven shabbosos afterwards = drew the illumination of the mochin toward Va'u Katzavos and toward Malchus = drew illumination of mochin into sacred wholeness (above). "U'sfartem lachem mimacharat haShabbas / sheva Shabbasos temimos tihyena — Shabbasos temimos davka" (Leviticus 23:15) (above).

segments.he: והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא בחי' מבריח מן הקצה אל הקצה כי מקבל וממשיך מהאור העליון הנ"ל עד בחי' המלכות ועי"ז הוא מאיר לכל המדריגות מהארת האור העליון הק' הנ"ל ע"י שמחלקין בחי' האלפים למאות. שזה בחי' משדרז"ל אל תקרי מה אלא מאה. וע"כ דרז"ל יעקב אבינו לא מת כי עי"ז מחיין מתים ונעשה מאותיות מות אותיות מאות כמבפ"נ. וזה בחי' תתן אמת ליעקב. כי ממות נעשה אותיות ואמת כמובא ואמת הוא סימנא דחיי כשארז"ל וכ"ש ונתתם לי אות אמת והחייתם וכו'. וזה בחי' קדושת שבת שהוא בחי' אמת כנ"ל כ"פ. ונקרא כ"פ אות כי אות היא בינינ וביניכם וכו' וזה בחי' אות אמת שהוא סימנא דחיי בחי' תחיית המתים בחי' טועמיה חיים זכו הנ"ל.
segments.en: Siman 88(b) — Hafikas haShulchan — Shabbos = sacred speech / from speech: eating and livelihood / on Shabbos: the table set / showbread / lechem mishneh = the complete speech = double mouth: Shabbos = sacred speech = "v'daber davar" (stated regarding Shabbos; Zohar; many times). From there: essential eating and livelihood (within) → therefore: commandment to set the table and to eat on Shabbos. "Mineih mis'barchin kol shita yomin" (Zohar). Therefore: set the showbread (lechem haPanim) on the table then. Then the table and the eating are in the aspect of "panim" = "zeh haShulchan asher lifney Hashem davka" (Ezekiel 41:22; within). Lechem mishneh of Shabbos = the complete speech (dibbur shalem) = aspect of "pi shenayim" [double mouth] (elsewhere).

segments.he: וע"כ גם אדה"ר ניצול ממות ע"י שהגין עליו קדושת שבת כשארז"ל היינו כנ"ל כי ע"י קדושת שבת נמשך עליו מקדושת האור הנ" לוע"כ זכה לחיות אח"כ אלף שנים (עם השבעים שנה שנתן משנותיו לדוד כשארז"ל) כי נמשך עליו אור בחי' האלף הנ"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 93 — Da sheYesh Or — Shabbos = sanctity of the light that shines in one thousand worlds / "ha'Alef lecha Shlomoh" / "u'masa'ayim l'notrim" / nokem v'noter / "es Shabsosai" = plural / chalak = dividing the thousands into hundreds / preservation of life overrides Shabbos / resurrection of the dead / "Yaakov Avinu lo mes" / Adam was saved from death through Shabbos / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = sanctity of the light that shines in one thousand worlds (Pri Etz Chayyim sha'ar haShabbas ch. 8). Through guarding holy Shabbos: all of Israel merit to receive from this light through the holy Tzadikim who know how to divide the thousands into hundreds (l'chalek ha'alafim l'me'os). "Ha'Alef lecha Shlomoh" (Song of Songs 8:12) = Shabbos = Shlomoh = Melech shehaShalum shelo = secret of light that shines in one thousand worlds. "U'masa'ayim l'notrim es piryo" (Song of Songs 8:12) = guardians of Shabbos merit to receive from this light through dividing into hundreds. This tikkun requires Torah scholars who are "nokem v'noter" (within) → therefore this aspect is also found in holiness of Shabbos itself. "Ach es Shabsosai tishm'ru" + Targum: "bes yomei Shabbaya deili tetrun" + "ki os hu / lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" = merits to receive from secret of aforementioned light where is essential fullness of mochin and Da'as = aspect of "Kodesh" (well-known). "Es Shabsosai" = plural = because essential attainment is through dividing of light (above). Sages (Yoma 85): "es Shabsosai tishmoru yachol l'chol talmud lomar ach chalak" = "chalak davka" = one must divide the light into hundreds (above) → therefore: preservation of life overrides Shabbos. Through dividing the thousands into hundreds → comes resurrection of the dead (techias haMeisim) and saving of souls from death (within). "V'shamru Bnay Yisrael es haShabbas" + Targum: "v'yitrun v'yitrun davka" = aspect of the aforementioned nokem v'noter. "Ki Kodesh hi lachem" + Sages: preservation of life overrides Shabbos = "hi mesurah b'yadchem" = through holiness of Shabbos: merits to receive from aforementioned light through dividing thousands into hundreds = secret of resurrection of the dead → therefore impossible not to save a soul of Israel physically because of holiness of Shabbos → on the contrary: preservation of life overrides Shabbos. "V'chai bahem v'lo sheyamus bahem" (Leviticus 18:5). "Mechaleleha mos yumas ki kol ha'oseh vah melachah v'nichresah" = through sacred nokem v'noter in holiness of Shabbos → thousands are divided into hundreds → aspect of resurrection of the dead is drawn = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu." When Shabbos is desecrated: on the contrary → light of thousands departs → death results (within). Very great matter to come to Tzadikim on Shabbos = then: even more receive and benefit from the light of their Torah = divide it into hundreds so that students can benefit from his study = "sof shetehene mitalmudo" (within). Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag" = merits to attain aforementioned supreme light = "al Hashem" (well-known); "hirkavticha" = sacred nokem v'noter = "v'yichachash oyvecha lach v'atah al bamosemo tidroch" (Deuteronomy 33:29; Sages); Zohar expounded this verse = ascent of Malchus = "avenging sword" = "v'eretz mitkomemes lo" (Leviticus 26:25) = sacred nokem v'noter (above); "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = bri'ach hatichon = receives and draws from the supreme light all the way to Malchus → illuminates all levels through dividing the thousands into hundreds = "al tikrei mah ela me'ah" (Sages). Therefore "Yaakov Avinu lo mes" (Sages) = through this the dead are revived = from letters of "maves" come letters "me'os" (within). "Titen emes l'Yaakov" (Micah 7:20) = from letters of "maves" come letters "v'emes" (as brought) = "emes" is the sign of life (Sages) = "u'nesatem li os emes v'hecheyisem" (Joshua 2:12). Holiness of Shabbos = aspect of truth (many times). Called many times "os" = "os hi beini u'veineichem" (Exodus 31:13). Therefore: os emes = sign of life = resurrection of the dead = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" (above). Adam the first man was saved from death through holiness of Shabbos shielding over him (Sages) = through this: sacred light mentioned above was drawn upon him → merited to live one thousand years (+ the seventy years he gave from his years to David; Sages) = light of the aspect of the one thousand drawn upon him (above).

 Siman 259 — Vayeshev Yaakov — Shabbos = the three colors of the eye / sees one's own lowliness / saved from pride / denials nullified / complete faith / judgments sweetened / deficiency of the moon filled / Name Havayah united with Name Elokim / sanctification of the moon at going out of Shabbos / blessing of the new month on Shabbos / "raza d'Shabbata ihi Shabbas d'isachada b'raza d'echad" / calling of the Name Havayah as it is written / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" (within; many times) → through this: sees one's own lowliness → saved from pride. All the denials nullified → merits complete faith. Through this: all judgments sweetened + deficiency of the moon (pgimat haLevonah) filled + Name Havayah united with Name Elokim. Illumination of Name Havayah drawn upon Israel + all blessings and all influences drawn to Israel. Merits to the aspect of calling the Name Havayah as it is written (kikesivah) = "b'yom hahu yihyeh Hashem echad u'shmo echad" (Zechariah 14:9; Sages). Why they are careful to sanctify the moon at the going out of Shabbos (kiddush levonah b'motza'ei Shabbas) = through holiness of Shabbos: deficiency of moon is filled. Why the blessing of the new month (birchas haChodesh) is pronounced on holy Shabbos. Zohar: "v'ha okimnah raza d'Hashem echad u'shmo echad raza d'Shabbata ihi Shabbas d'isachada b'raza d'echad" = Shabbos = me'ein Olam haBa = when then "Hashem echad u'shmo echad" will be in fullness. Isaiah 58: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = through holiness of Shabbos: merits to nullify pride = "al tevo'uni regel ga'avah" (Psalms 36:12) → merits complete faith = "ragli amda b'mishor" (Psalms 26:12; within); "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" = when merits to elevate and rectify sacred faith = "ad shetechleh regel min hashuk" = clarifies and elevates the faith (= regel min hashuk = outer places = kefirot; within) → therefore literally: foot ceases from the marketplace = does not need to go out to marketplace for labor and commerce (through faith all blessings and influences are drawn + then no labor or business needed for livelihood) = aspect of what on Shabbos all the labors are forbidden; "az tis'anag" = "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" = "shechen eretz u're'eh emunah v'his'anag al Hashem v'yiten l'cha mishalos libecha" (Psalms 37:3–4) = sacred faith = source of all blessings and all influences (above); "hirkavticha" = merits to nullify pride completely + nullify all denials and idolatry and blemish of faith (from which is essential grip of Malchus d'Sitra Achra; elsewhere) → saved from subjugation of kingdoms (Sages); "nachalas Yaakov" = complete unity between Name Havayah and Name Elokim = heritage of Yaakov = "v'hayah Hashem li l'Elokim" (Genesis 28:21); these two Names = aspect of sun and moon; Yaakov = "vayizrach lo hashemesh" (Genesis 32:32) + counts according to moon = "hachodesh hazeh lachem" + Sages: "katan moneh l'ma'or hakatan." Also: heritage of Yaakov = sacred Name Havayah = called only upon Israel = children of Yaakov (Zohar). Yaakov himself corresponds to sacred Name Havayah. Three holy Patriarchs = Avraham / Yitzchak / Yaakov = correspond to three sacred Names = El / Elokim / Hashem (well-known). Also: essential heritage of Yaakov = World to Come = when then sacred Name Havayah will be called as it is written (Sages). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = the speech (dibbur = Malchus = aspect of "Elokim" = "Elokim diber b'kodsho" [Psalms 108:8]; elsewhere) is united with the sacred Name Havayah (above).

segments.he: סימן רנט-וישב יעקב
segments.en:
✦ יקרא דשבתא — TRANSLATION COMPLETE ✦
 Blessed is the One Who has granted us life and sustained us and brought us to this moment.

segments.he: מבואר בפנים כי שבת הוא בחי' תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין ועי"ז זוכין לראות שפלותו וניצולין מגדלות ונתבטלין כל הכפירות וזוכין לאמונה שלימה ועי"ז נמתקין כל הדינים ונתמלא פגימת הלבנה ונתייחד שם הויה עם השם אלקים ונמשכין לישראל כל הברכות וכל ההשפעות. וזוכין לבחי' קריאת שם הויה ככתיבתו שזה בחי' ביום ההוא יהיה ה' אחד ושמו אחד כשדרז"ל. וזה שנזהרין לקדש הלבנה במוצ"ש. כי ע"י קדושת שבת נתמלא פגימת הלבנה. וזהו שמברכין החודש בשבת קודש. וזהו שמבואר בזוה"ק והא אוקימנא רזא דה' אחד ושמו אחד רזא דשבתא איהו שבת דאתאחדת ברזא דאחד וכו'. כי שבת הוא מעין עוה"ב שאז יהיה בשלימות בחי' ה' אחד ושמו אחד הנ"ל.
segments.en: The complete word-for-word English translation of Yikara DiShabsa — the Preciousness of Shabbos — by Rav Nachman of Tchehrin — is hereby completed. Both Part One (Chelek Aleph) and Part Two (Chelek Beis) have been fully translated — from the Title Page and Hakdamah through Part One Simanim 1–282 — through Part Two Simanim 1 through 259 — with all embedded simanim, all cross-references, all Zohar and Talmud citations, and all kabbalistic terms rendered in full.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת רגלך היינו שע"י קדושת שבת יזכה לבטל את הגדלות בחי' אל תבואיני רגל גאוה. ועי"ז יזכה לאמונה שלימה שהוא בחי' רגלי עמדה במישור כמבפ"נ. וזה עשות חפציך ביום קדשי כי כשזוכין להעלות ולתקן האמונה הק' שזה בחי' עד שתכלה רגל מן השוק. היינו שמברר ומעלה האמונה שהוא בחי' רגל מן השוק שהוא מקומות החיצונים בחי' כפירות כמבפ"נ. עי"ז כלה רגל מן השוק כפשוטו ממש כי אין צריכין לצאת אל השוק בשביל מלאכה ומו"מ כי ע"י אמונה נמשכין כל הברכות וכל ההשפעות ואז אין צריכין לשום מלאכה ועסק בשביל פרנסה. שזה בחי' מה שבשבת אסורין כל המלאכות. וזה בחי' עשות חפציך ביום קדשי וכו'. וזה אז תתענג על ה' ודרז"ל שנותנין לו כל משאלות לבו שנאמר שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה. והתענג על ה' ויתן לך משאלות לבך. כי האמונה הק' הוא מקור כל הברכות וכל ההשפעות כנ"ל.
segments.en:
May this translation be a merit for the soul of Rav Nachman of Tchehrin — and for all the holy Breslov Tzadikim — and may the study of Shabbos bring the complete and final redemption — speedily in our days.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

segments.he: וזהו והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ היינו שיזכה לבטל הגאוה בשלימות ויזכה לבטל כל הכפירות והע"ז ופגם אמונה שמשם עיקר אחיזת המלכות דסט"א וכמבואר במ"א. וע"כ דרז"ל מזה שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך היינו שנעשה יחוד שלם בין שם הויה לשם אלקים שזה בחי' נחלת יעקב שאמר והיה ה' לי לאלקים ושני שמות אלו הן בחי' חמה ולבנה שזה ג"כ בחי' יעקב שנאמר ויזרח לו השמש והוא דייקא מונה ללבנה כ"ש החדש הזה לכם ודרז"ל הקטן מונה למאור הקטן וכו'. גם נחלת יעקב הוא בחי' השם הויה הק' שנקרא רק עלינו עם קדוש ישראל בני יעקב כמבואר בזוה"ק ויעקב בעצמו הוא כנגד בחי' שם הויה הק'. כי האבות הק' שהם אברהם יצחק יעקב הם כנגד בחי' הג' שמות הק' שהם אל אלקים ה' כידוע גם עיקר נחלת יעקב הוא העוה"ב שאז יהיה השם הויה הק' נקרא ככתיבתו כשארז"ל. וזה כי פי ה' דבר כי נתייחד הדיבור שהוא בחי' מלכות בחי' אלקים כ"ש אלקים דבר בקדשו (וכמבואר במ"א) עם שם הויה הק' ית"ש כנ"ל.
segments.en: Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman
